chapters.title: Chapter 4551: Shameless method
paragraphs: Chapter 4551: Shameless method
Editor: Henyee Translations

“Though I am a Venerate, I am only an ordinary One Star, and you are a formations grandmaster. Furthermore, you are also the strongest Sect Master in history.” Ma Bangye deprecated himself, and praised Ling Han madly, “How about it? If you beat me, you can create history.”
Sect Master defeating Venerate Tier, something that had never happened in all of history!
Ling Han shook his head, and said with a smile, “Since you want to die, I’ll oblige you.”
“How truly arrogant!” Ma Bangye stood up and flew into the air.
That’s right!
Everyone instantly understood why Ma Bangye was so confident.
Fighting in midair, or even battling in space, would Ling Han still be able to extract Earth Qi?
Even if he could, how many times would it be weakened?
F***, a Venerate Tier was battling a Sect Master, and he still had to be so shameless?
Thus, none of the Imperial Sons made a move. Instead, they mobilized this Ma Bangye.
The label of shamelessness was naturally going to fall on his shoulders.
—The Imperial Sons needed a shameless person, and Ma Bangye wanted to depend on the Imperial Clans, so the two sides naturally hit it off.
Not good, Ling Han was going to be in big trouble!
Ling Han smiled and flew into the sky as well, arriving at the same level as Ma Bangye.

The people in the surroundings also arrived in the air, wanting to watch the battle from a close distance. However, they didn’t dare to come too close. After all, this was a battle between elites of Venerate Tier. If one’s cultivation level was slightly lower, even being swept by the aftermath would be fatal.
“When I became famous, who knows where you were!” Ma Bangye said, his face bearing a strong disdain, as well as an indescribable jealousy.
Just look at Ling Han. Perhaps he wasn’t even 200 years old, but his cultivation level was already at this level?
Nine Star Sect Master, only a line’s breadth away from him!

In fact, it could be said that if it was not for the jealousy of the heaven and earth, Ling Han would definitely be like Ding Shu, Origin and the others by now, long since surpassed the threshold of Venerate Tier, and reached Two Stars or Three Stars, surpassing him.
F***, he had worked hard for over 10,000 years to finally attain this kind of accomplishment, and Ling Han had attained it in just 200 years?
‘You’re not an Imperial Son!’
Ma Bangye was jealous, and glared hatefully at this opponent who was who knew how many times younger than him.
Ling Han merely smiled faintly. When he had been in Genesis World, he had also risen up strongly, causing who knew how many old monsters to be dumbfounded.
He had seen this kind of gaze many times.
“Come on.” He had no interest in speaking nonsense with this person, and crooked a finger at Ma Bangye.
“Die!” Ma Bangye roared loudly, and threw a punch. Boom, it turned into a black fist the size of a mountain, with three Seven Star Regulations entwined around it.

The might of this kind of attack was far inferior to Yi Taishu, but the crux of the matter was that Ma Bangye was shameless enough. He had more or less reached the borders of Xuanwu Planet. In this place, could Ling Han still extract Earth Qi?

Ling Han gave it a try, and discovered that his control over the ley lines was many times weaker. He could only summon three Earth Dragons, and they would need time to fly up from the ground. It was impossible for him to block this attack in time.
Everyone could see this clearly, and they all shook their heads.
True enough, this move had a firm hold on Ling Han’s weakness.
There was nothing else he could do.
Now, it was truly Sect Master versus Venerate Tier, and in terms of personal battle prowess, how could Ling Han compare to Venerate Tier?
“Ling Han is done for this time!”

“It can’t be helped. Who asked him not to quit while he was ahead? The Imperial Clans have already announced that they would not take the initiative to make a move on him at the banquet. If he insists on accepting the challenge, there is no one to blame.”
“Sigh, the former number one prodigy is about to die just like that!”
Everyone felt rueful.

Ling Han didn’t have the title of number one prodigy before. Compared to Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu, and the others, it was uncertain who was stronger. However, he was now envied by the heavens, and was actually locked at the level of Sect Master. It was because of this that he became publicly acknowledged as number one.
But now, the legend was about to come to an end.
Boom! Ma Bangye’s colossal fist shot over with crushing force.
What could he do?
Everyone was watching, their minds filled with thoughts.
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but clench her fists tightly, appearing extremely nervous.
“Sister, Brother-in-law will definitely be fine!” Chi Mengshan, on the other hand, was even more confident in Ling Han. For some reason, she was certain that nothing could stop Ling Han.
Chi Menghan didn’t say anything, and simply nodded.
Among these people, only the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the perverted pig were confident. They really weren’t anxious at all.
Just how freakish was Ling Han?
Even the little azure dragon couldn’t beat him, all right?
This was a f****** Twelve Star Sect Master!
You guys should also experience the shock they had experienced in the past.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and tapped out a finger, greeting the massive fist that was flying towards him.
‘You… are you joking?’
Oh, he clearly knew that he was no match, so he had given up on himself?
It must be. Otherwise, no matter what, he would have struggled for a while.
Xiu, a ray of light shot out from Ling Han’s fingertip, and there were 30 flashes of Regulations entwined around it.
Of course, it was Six Star Regulations.
This streak of light landed on the gigantic fist, and immediately sank in.
However, the attack of the giant fist was not stopped, and landed solidly on Ling Han.
He was done for!
Sigh!
Everyone shook their heads. Though this was within everyone’s expectations, seeing a legend die with their own eyes still filled their hearts with feelings that they did not know how to describe.
Chi Menghan even stood up, her face ashen.
Boom! The colossal fist struck, yet it suddenly shattered into pieces.
What!
Everyone was once again incredibly stunned, because after the punch, Ling Han was still standing proudly in space.
Not the slightest bit of injury!
How was this possible?
Everyone felt their scalps go numb. Some of them were even trembling.
A Venerate had punched a Sect Master, and the Sect Master had taken it head-on. Yet, he was completely unscathed?
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
“Good job, brother-in-law!” Chi Mengshan immediately cheered, appearing extremely excited.
Chi Menghan also breathed a long sigh of relief. She slowly sat down, yet discovered that her back was completely drenched in sweat.
The Imperial Sons were all dumbfounded. Even Ding Shu and the others were surprised, appearing to be in disbelief.
The higher the cultivation level, the stronger the barrier to the cultivation level would be.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
The difficulty level of battling above one’s cultivation level at Sect Master-level was 100 times, 1000 times more difficult than battling against a Core Formation Tier in the Cauldron Forging Tier!
It could be said that there has never been a Sect Master that could match a Venerate in history.
None! Definitely none!
But now, it seemed like Ling Han was going to rewrite history.
Ling Han was actually this powerful?
‘How the f*ck did you cultivate?’
F***, if you weren’t bound by the heaven and earth, just how freakish would you be?
Ma Bangye also couldn’t accept it at all. He exclaimed in shock, “How could you possibly take a blow from me?”
This attack had condensed the Seven Star Regulations, a single streak of which could crush any Six Star Regulations, so how could it possibly be blocked?
Ling Han smiled and said, “This is strength, right?”
Strength your sister!
There were so many Sect Masters in the world, so how could you be the only one capable of matching the strike of a Venerate?

“I don’t believe it!” Ma Bangye was flustered and exasperated. Although he said that Ling Han would be able to leave his name for eternity as long as he defeated him, that was only a teasing line. He had absolutely no intention of making himself a background to showcase Ling Han’s brilliance.
“Die!” He launched another attack. He delivered a palm strike, which turned into a piercingly cold light that slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and tapped out another finger.
Peng, the cold light was instantly destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4552: Attack
paragraphs: Chapter 4552: Attack
Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone could see this attack clearly.
Ling Han didn’t use any tricks. He simply and decisively blocked the attack.
However, it was also because of this that everyone was even more stunned, exclaiming in disbelief.
Ma Bangye’s attack had unleashed three flashes of Seven Star Regulations, and with the Seven Star Regulations as the blade, that was practically indestructible.
How could it possibly be dispersed by Six Star Regulations?

“You guys, did you guys see clearly? How many Six Star Regulations has Ling Han used?” someone suddenly asked in a trembling voice. He discovered that it was not just the fact that a Sect Master had dispersed the attack of a Venerate.
“That’s right, that number is terrifyingly great!”
“Thirty!”
Pu!
Everyone was once again numb with shock.
For a Sect Master, unleashing twenty Six Star Regulations with a single strike should be the upper limit, but what about Ling Han?
30 flashes!
F***, this was too terrifying.
No wonder he was bound by the heaven and earth. Otherwise, this guy would really defy the heavens.
“However, even if there are 30 Six Star Regulations, they shouldn’t be able to match the Seven Star Regulations!” someone said.
This gained the approval of the Venerates.

Because it was indeed impossible for Sect Master and above to deliver 30 Six Star Regulations with a single strike — of course, Ling Han was an exception — but Venerates could, and it was not like they had not done experiments before.
If the Six Star Regulations wanted to block the Seven Star Regulations, they would need a hundred times the number.
Only 100 Six Star Regulations could block one Seven Star Regulations.
“That’s right. To block three Seven Star Regulations, as many as three hundred Six Star Regulations are needed.”
“How could it be resolved with 30 flashes?”
When they thought of this, everyone was even more confused, and even more stunned.
Ma Bangye gritted his teeth. F*ck, he really wouldn’t become the first Venerate to be defeated by a Sect Master, right?
If that was the case, he would really be infamous for ten thousand years.

“You must have used some kind of secret technique. It is definitely impossible for you to maintain this state forever!” he shouted loudly, and once again launched a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
Ling Han moved casually, interweaving Regulations extremely easily.
To say nothing of the fact that Ma Bangye could only unleash three Seven Star Regulations with a single strike, even someone as powerful as the little azure dragon was still blocked by Ling Han.
He was also trying to find out the reason why he could match Venerate Tier.
Of course, it was because the Six Star Regulations were intertwined with some kind of rhythm, but the question was why would this cause a qualitative change.
This had to be found in the midst of battle.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ma Bangye attacked fiercely, but no matter what he did, Ling Han was always able to easily block his attacks, and it was as if he still had some power left.
How was this possible?
You, a Sect Master, are battling against a Venerate, and you actually still have spare energy?
“This!”
“The number one freak in the world!”
“He really lives up to his name!”
“If anyone tells me otherwise, I’ll cut off my own head and hand it over to them.”
“Too bad, such a prodigy is actually stuck at the level of Sect Master. Otherwise, he really could have become a Great Emperor, invincible in the world.”
Hearing the discussions of the masses, the Imperial Sons, including Ding Shu and the others, all had slightly ugly expressions.
To become a Great Emperor, one needed not only talent, but also power.
Now that he had gained the upper hand, success would naturally follow.
The will of the people was a great support.
When everyone thought that you could do it, it would naturally produce a kind of power of will that would be boosted on your body. Whatever you do, it would be half the work and double the effect.
Another example was the Saint needed the power of belief. Not only could it ignite the holy flame, but it could also increase one’s battle prowess.
This was the will of the people, and also a kind of great support.
Why did the various great forces like to expand their territory? Wasn’t this all because of the will of the people?
In fact, Ling Han didn’t even need to expand his territory. He could easily do so. How many people in the universe admired him to the extreme?
Such a cripple!

The Imperial Sons all gritted their teeth. Previously, they had looked down on Ling Han as much as possible, because Ling Han had not occupied any territory, and could not reap any faith. Thus, no matter how freakish Ling Han was, he was still grassroots and had no background, and could not be compared to them.
But now… the people that Ling Han conquered were not just one city or one town, but the whole world.
This was the bearing of a true Great Emperor.
Go and take a look at history. Which Great Emperor hadn’t been renowned throughout the world when they were young, and won the admiration of the whole world, successfully completing the final leap?

—If these Imperial Sons knew that Ling Han still had a Genesis World in his body, with countless citizens, and the power of belief was practically endless, who knew what kind of expressions they would have.
Would they still feel superior?
To say nothing of them, Ma Bangye was really about to go crazy.
Why couldn’t Ling Han be killed?
With every additional strike, he felt as if someone had slapped his face, causing him great pain.
A dignified Venerate was actually unable to do anything against a Sect Master?
How could he endure this?
This was practically a great humiliation!
Why was Ling Han’s secret technique still channeling? Why hadn’t it stopped yet?
To be able to make a Sect Master so powerful, this secret technique should have expended an extremely great amount of energy. Why could it last for such a long time?
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Don’t live in your own world, and be a frog at the bottom of a well.”
Hearing these words, everyone shook their heads.
There has only been one such freak like you in history, all right?
“I will definitely kill you!” Ma Bangye had already lost his composure, his eyes bloodshot.

“Humph, there is no animosity between you and I. In order to curry the favor of the Imperial Clans, you provoked me into battle, wanting to kill me.” Ling Han’s smile also disappeared, and his voice turned cold, “I have always distinguished between kindness and hatred. If others do not trifle with me, then no matter how weak they are, I will not make a move.”
“But whoever wants to bully me, then no matter how strong they are, I will still throw a punch!”
Boom!
He roared loudly, and no longer defended passively. Instead, it was his first time taking the initiative to attack.
As he threw a punch, 35 flashes of Regulations intertwined!
Gods!
Everyone was collectively petrified again. 35 flashes! F***, what had they seen?
Even though there were only five additional Regulations, the 35 Regulations intertwined with some kind of rhythm, unleashing a terrifying might.
Boom!
This attack could move heaven and earth.
How could Ma Bangye possibly retreat? He gritted his teeth, and also greeted Ling Han with a punch of his own.
Peng!
Light exploded from both their fists. That was Regulations, as well as power.
However, with a collision, Ma Bangye’s attack immediately crumbled. Ling Han controlled his fist, and like a hot knife through butter, arrived in front of Ma Bangye.
What!
Ma Bangye’s jaw dropped, and his pupils contracted, silently expressing his shock.
As it turned out, Ling Han was really at ease, and really still had spare energy.
He was done for.
He had not even finished this thought, when Ling Han’s fist had already ruthlessly smashed down, landing on Ma Bangye’s face.
Peng! Ma Bangye’s head was instantly obliterated.
His mind was shattered, and even gods couldn’t save him.
In space, Ling Han retracted his fist and stood proudly. Though the blood around him was pouring like rain, he was not touched in the slightest.
A Sect Master had killed a Venerate!
Everyone could only look up in admiration. This kind of magnificent feat would be recorded in the annals of history, and the extent of its terror was not inferior even to becoming a Great Emperor.
After all, a Great Emperor would appear once every era, but the feat of a Sect Master kiling a Venerate?
Throughout history, this was the first time.

Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Don’t live in your own world, and be a frog at the bottom of a well.”
Hearing these words, everyone shook their heads.
There has only been one such freak like you in history, all right?
“I will definitely kill you!” Ma Bangye had already lost his composure, his eyes bloodshot.
“Humph, there is no animosity between you and I.

In order to curry the favor of the Imperial Clans, you provoked me into battle, wanting to kill me.” Ling Han’s smile also disappeared, and his voice turned cold, “I have always distinguished between kindness and hatred.
If others do not trifle with me, then no matter how weak they are, I will not make a move.”
“But whoever wants to bully me, then no matter how strong they are, I will still throw a punch!”
Boom!
He roared loudly, and no longer defended passively.
Instead, it was his first time taking the initiative to attack.
As he threw a punch, 35 flashes of Regulations intertwined!
Gods!
Everyone was collectively petrified again.
35 flashes!
F***, what had they seen?
Even though there were only five additional Regulations, the 35 Regulations intertwined with some kind of rhythm, unleashing a terrifying might.
Boom!
This attack could move heaven and earth.
How could Ma Bangye possibly retreat?
He gritted his teeth, and also greeted Ling Han with a punch of his own.
Peng!
Light exploded from both their fists.
That was Regulations, as well as power.
However, with a collision, Ma Bangye’s attack immediately crumbled.
Ling Han controlled his fist, and like a hot knife through butter, arrived in front of Ma Bangye.
What!
Ma Bangye’s jaw dropped, and his pupils contracted, silently expressing his shock.
As it turned out, Ling Han was really at ease, and really still had spare energy.
He was done for.
He had not even finished this thought, when Ling Han’s fist had already ruthlessly smashed down, landing on Ma Bangye’s face.
Peng!
Ma Bangye’s head was instantly obliterated.
His mind was shattered, and even gods couldn’t save him.
In space, Ling Han retracted his fist and stood proudly.
Though the blood around him was pouring like rain, he was not touched in the slightest.
A Sect Master had killed a Venerate!
Everyone could only look up in admiration.
This kind of magnificent feat would be recorded in the annals of history, and the extent of its terror was not inferior even to becoming a Great Emperor.
After all, a Great Emperor would appear once every era, but the feat of a Sect Master kiling a Venerate?
Throughout history, this was the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4553: Battle prowess fully unleashed
paragraphs: Chapter 4553: Battle prowess fully unleashed
Editor: Henyee Translations
At this moment, the space was extremely silent.
Aside from shock, everyone’s minds were in a mess, completely blank.
Something unprecedented had actually happened right in front of their eyes.
The number one freak in the world, no, the number one freak in history.
“Ling Han!” an Imperial Son murmured. There was shock, fury, and an indescribable fear.
Compared to him, the Imperial Son was like a chicken.
Then, with a boom, the space was filled with madness.
A great many people had activated their connection devices, and were broadcasting live on Galaxy Network. The number of people watching was constantly soaring.

And when the scene of Ling Han killing Ma Bangye with a single punch appeared in practically every corner of the universe in real time, it also welcomed the greatest climax. It could be said that 99% of those who had a connection device cast their eyes over, but they were scattered in different livestream rooms.
“Heavens, how could there be such a freak?”
“He killed a Venerate, and it was an insta-kill at that!”
“Did you guys see that? He can unleash 35 Six Star Regulations with a single strike.”
“That’s right. Merely this fact is enough to go down in history.”
“Too bad!”
“Sigh, what a pity!”
“The more powerful he appears, the more of a pity it is.”

“He is eternally frozen at the level of Master. So what if he can defeat a low-level Venerate? Against a high-level Venerate, he’ll still be done for! Worse come to worst, even if he’s not inferior to a top-level Venerate, so what? When a Saint moves, he’ll be done for, right?”
“In this lifetime, there is no hope for me to possess Saint-level battle prowess, what more becoming a Great Emperor.”
“It can’t be helped. He’s too powerful, and the heavens envy him.”
The Galaxy Network was flooded with discussions about Ling Han.

By now, there was no doubt that Ling Han was freakishly strong, but at the same time, he was also envied by the heavens. The fact that he was envied by the heavens, and eternally stuck at Sect Master-level was also something that everyone knew, causing others to sigh with emotion and pity.
Otherwise, would there still be anyone in the world that could contend for the throne with Ling Han?
Who was worthy?
“Ling Han!” A Golden Generation cultivator suddenly shouted, “Your attacks are truly vicious. It’s only a sparring match, and you actually put someone to death!”
“For someone like you, the heaven and earth would not tolerate you!”
Boom, he immediately charged over, and shot out a palm strike. Shockingly, ten Seven Star Regulations shone brilliantly.
The Red Lotus Imperial Clan’s Tao Yu, a three-star Venerate!
Ling Han smirked coldly, “Now you guys don’t even want your face anymore?”
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to dodge this attack.
“Die!” Since Tao Yu had moved, he would naturally throw caution to the wind, determined to get rid of Ling Han.
Though Ling Han had already eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, the Imperial Sons had suffered too many losses at his hands. They definitely had to kill him to vent their anger.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Tao Yu was an Imperial Son, and was also a Golden Generation. His battle prowess was not something that Ma Bangye could match at all.
Ten streaks of Regulations surged, and even the Void was trembling, as if it was terrified.
Everyone shook their heads.
Ling Han was indeed freakish, but the fact that a Sect Master could use 35 Six Star Regulations was definitely his limit. Thus, how could he possibly match Tao Yu?

Although everyone didn’t quite understand, from the battle between Ling Han and Ma Bangye, they could roughly judge that Ling Han’s ten Six Star Regulations were capable of matching a Seven Star Regulations.
In that case, 35 Six Star Regulations would only be able to match four Seven Star Regulations, at most.
Right now, Tao Yu was unleashing 10 Seven Star Regulations with a single strike. This was naturally a crushing attack. It was no wonder that Ling Han didn’t dare to face this attack head-on.

“Ling Han, you’ve been trapped at the level of Sect Master forever. To you, this is endless torture. Why don’t you let me free you!” As Tao Yu attacked aggressively, he continued to attack Ling Han spiritually.
No matter how freakish you are, so what? You are already crippled.
Ling Han humphed, and shot out a punch, sending out a flash of fist light to greet Tao Yu’s attack.
Peng, this attack was naturally easily dispersed. However, everyone exploded in shock again.
What had they seen?
40 Regulations!
Heavens, 35 flashes of Regulations was actually still not Ling Han’s limit?
Just what kind of freak was this!
“That’s right. He is stuck eternally at Sect Master-level. How could the other Sect Masters in the world endure that?”
“En, in future, there should be an additional cultivation level added between Sect Master and Venerate Tier, and that would be Ling Han’s cultivation level.”
“Hiss, do you guys think that forty flashes of Regulations would still not be Ling Han’s limit?”
“Er, you’re overthinking things, aren’t you? 40 flashes, that’s already more than double the limit!”
“That’s right, but I still think…”
Whether it was those on the spot, or those watching through the Galaxy Network, everyone couldn’t help but think, was 40 flashes of Six Star Regulations Ling Han’s limit?
“You!” Tao Yu was so shocked that his eyes were fixed on Ling Han. He clearly knew that Ling Han would be eternally trapped at the level of the Sect Master, so what if Ling Han was freakish?
However, there were 40 six-star Regulations, so who wouldn’t be stunned for a long while at that?
“Again!” Ling Han said with a smile. He took the initiative to attack. This time… there were 50 Six Star Regulations.
‘Holy f*ck!’
The entire Galaxy Network instantly fell silent. At this moment, words could no longer express their shock.
There was only silence, and then reverence.
Tao Yu shot out an attack, and easily dispersed this punch from Ling Han. However, there was not the slightest bit of pride in his heart. In fact, there was a faint feeling of fear.
Was fifty the limit?
No!
Ling Han threw another punch, and this time, there were another ten Regulations.
Peng!
Just like before, this attack was easily dispersed, but next, Ling Han unleashed 70 Regulations.
Everyone had already gone blank with shock. At this moment, they should have been shouting and exclaiming to express their surprise, but no one could make a sound.
“Again!”
Eighty flashes!
Boom, in this clash, though Tao Yu had still dispersed Ling Han’s attack, it could be seen that the gap between the two of them was no longer as wide as the gap between heaven and earth.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and unleashed his ultimate battle prowess.
90 flashes!
This time, Ling Han didn’t launch any more long-distance attacks. Instead, he charged forward with his fists.
Peng, in the exchange of blows, Ling Han was instantly sent flying, but Tao Yu’s feet also hovered, and he took a few steps back.
‘Holy f*ck!’
They had almost come to a tie.
“No, no, no. At most, Ling Han’s attacks are only equivalent to nine Seven Star Regulations. He’s still inferior to Tao Yu.”
“However, this is too terrifying!”

Everyone regained the ability to speak, and were filled with anticipation. Would Ling Han be able to advance further, and blast out a hundred Six Star Regulations? In this way, he would definitely be able to truly stand against Tao Yu.
However, unleashing 90 Six Star Regulations in a single strike was indeed Ling Han’s limit. Next, though he attacked repeatedly, he was no longer able to increase the number of Regulations.
“Ninety.”
“It should be the limit.”
“For ordinary Sect Masters, Nine Stars would only allow them to grasp nine Regulations.”
“He has 90 flashes!”
“Heavens!”
This was definitely an achievement that had never been achieved before, and it was possible that it would never happen again.

Though it was already publicly acknowledged that Ling Han was the number one prodigy in history, and the strongest Sect Master, Ling Han himself had pushed this height to a few more levels, so that no one could even think of surpassing him.

The Imperial Sons, Ding Shu and the others were all astounded, especially Ding Shu and the others. They were all Lords of the Genesis World, and although there had been some gap between them before, how could there have been such a large gap?
Have you taken alchemical pills or cheated?

chapters.title: Chapter 4554: Stronger and Stronger with Battle
paragraphs: Chapter 4554: Stronger and Stronger with Battle
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and attacked continuously.

Though he was indeed behind by “one star” in terms of Regulations, his physique was tough enough, and added with the high speed of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was completely qualified to fight Tao Yu.
Power was not the only factor that determined battle prowess, nor was Regulations.
However, it could not be denied that Tao Yu had the advantage of “one star” in terms of Regulations, so he did indeed have the advantage on the field.
After all, he was the Three Star Venerate, Golden Generation.

He had finally restrained Ling Han. Furthermore, it seemed like Ling Han could no longer increase the number of Regulations he possessed. This caused the other Imperial Sons to heave a sigh of relief.
Alright, this freakish performance had finally come to an end.

However, a Three Star Venerate of the Golden Generation was actually unable to take down a Sect Master, even after a long time. With every move that the battle dragged out for, the Imperial Sons would lose a bit of face.
This was really a slap to the face.
To Ling Han, this was already a supreme honour. Being able to do this as a Sect Master, that was enough to be proud of.
However, with how competitive Ling Han was, how could he be satisfied with just this?
He wanted to win!
However, in terms of Regulations, he was indeed “one star” weaker, and his power was also suppressed. His only advantage was his speed, but if he wanted to defeat a Golden Generation with mere speed?
Ling Han was extremely calm. He was looking for a solution on his own.

The reason why he could stand against a Venerate Tier was because the Regulations he had grasped were intertwined with some kind of rhythm, and he had been studying the reason since he had exchanged blows with the little azure dragon.
Why was it that when Regulations intertwined, their might could increase so greatly?
Now that the battle was so arduous, Ling Han had also pushed himself to his limits. The circulation of his brain had increased tenfold, or even a hundredfold, compared to its normal state.

“The reason why the might of my Regulations can be so strong, and even be comparable to Seven Stars when ten Regulations intertwine together, is because the Regulations are stimulating each other, causing their might to increase greatly.”
“Then, if I can further increase this kind of activation effect, would my battle prowess be able to increase further?”
Ling Han hadn’t intertwined the Regulations on his own volition. Instead, he had naturally become like this after breaking through to Ten Stars.
Now, he began to make changes.
However, with this change, his battle prowess instantly dropped drastically.
Peng!
Tao Yu’s attack sent Ling Han flying. The Regulations transformed into a sharp blade that ruthlessly slashed into his chest.
‘Ow, ow, ow!’
Ling Han bared his teeth, and when he lowered his head to look, a deep wound had appeared on his chest. Even his bones had a shallow wound.

It could not be helped. He had made a mistake in “activation”, and after slight adjustment, not only did the power of Regulations not improve, it had instead decreased considerably, causing him to be completely unable to block a single blow from Tao Yu, and his chest had almost been forcefully torn open.
No, he couldn’t make such attempts blindly. The intertwining of Regulations was extremely complex. If he could casually try it out, what Sect Master or Venerate would not do the same?
He channelled the Ten Cultivation Technique to control his injuries and heal them. On the other side, he continued to maintain the intertwining of Regulations as he exchanged blows with Tao Yu.

However, in his mind, he was presently performing a high-speed deduction, analyzing the profound secrets of the present intertwining Regulations. Using this as a blueprint, he would activate it again.

It was impossible for others to try it out, because Regulations itself was changing, so there was no limit to the number of times they could try it out. It was impossible to complete it just by copying.
However, Ling Han was different, because he had grasped the method of interweaving Regulations, so he could completely study it.
This was his greatest advantage.
Perhaps, this was the only intertwining technique, and it was impossible to increase its might further, but if he did not give it a try, with Ling Han’s personality, how could he give up?
The battle continued.
One day, two days, three days, and the two elites showed no signs of stopping the battle.
One did not want to lose, while the other was determined to win. Thus, the battle was naturally in a stalemate.
No one was impatient. Under normal circumstances, how could they have the chance to witness such a battle?
This was a Venerate Tier-level battle, and below Saint Tier, that was the strongest.
As long as one could fathom a sliver of the profound secrets, and gain the slightest bit of appreciation, that would be incredibly beneficial.
Even the Imperial Sons, Ding Shu and the others were observing Ling Han, investigating the secret of his intertwining Regulations.
—With their intelligence, how could it be that after such a long time, they still could not tell that the problem lay in Ling Han’s interweaving Regulations?

However, merely interweaving Regulations could actually increase battle prowess to such a terrifying extent. Who wouldn’t be tempted by this, wanting to investigate the profound secrets within, and turn it for their own use?
Thus, everyone hoped that the battle could continue until they could grasp the profound secrets.
Except for one person—Tao Yu.
As Ling Han’s opponent, he naturally wanted to deal with Ling Han as soon as possible. The longer this dragged on, the more humiliated he would be — though it was already very embarrassing.
“Die!”
He deliberately slowed down the rhythm of the battle. This naturally was not going easy on him, but rather he was accumulating Regulations.
Boom!
He launched another attack, and twelve Regulations appeared at the same time.
Xiu, Ling Han channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and easily dodged this attack.
Trying to trick him? Hehe.
A light suddenly flashed in Ling Han’s eyes.
He finally had appreciation.
‘Come!’
He threw a punch, and it was still ninety streaks of Regulations, but there was a slight change in the order in which they intertwined.
Peng!
In an exchange of blows, Ling Han was still sent flying, but Tao Yu’s expression changed drastically in shock.
That was because he had sensitively discovered that Ling Han’s battle prowess had actually increased by a sliver.
Though it was only a sliver, they had already gone all out, and the might of his ultimate battle prowess had still been increased by a sliver. Just how difficult was that?

However, because the extent of this increase was really too small, only an opponent like Tao Yu discovered it. In the eyes of others, this scene was very normal. Hadn’t Ling Han been sent flying again?
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. His efforts had not been in vain.
Again!
The more Regulations there were, the more intertwining changes there would be. Thus, there was also more room for improvement in battle prowess.
Ling Han had already found some clues. He threw punch after punch, and his battle prowess was steadily increasing.
Half a day passed, and everyone shockingly discovered that in terms of Regulations, Ling Han was no longer inferior to Tao Yu.
Right now, the only advantage that Tao Yu had was his power.
However, from the True Self Tier onwards, the effects of power would gradually decrease. Unless one was overwhelmingly powerful, the effects on one’s battle prowess would be very, very small.
Thus, this slight advantage was no longer enough for Tao Yu to gain the upper hand.
The two of them… fought to a tie.
Heavens!
Everyone stared at Ling Han as if they were looking at a monster. This was really… indescribable.
Ling Han threw a flurry of punches. He felt that he still had room for improvement. He still hadn’t unleashed the full might of the interweaving Regulations.
‘Come, let’s battle again. This battle is a good opportunity to become my whetstone.’
After battling for another day, Ling Han’s battle prowess had indeed increased another notch, and he now had an extremely slight advantage.
“Stop!” Imperial Son Ming spoke up, and moved directly, stopping the battle.
They couldn’t continue fighting, or Ling Han would become stronger and stronger.
This was a freak, and could not be judged with common sense.

Perhaps, this was the only intertwining technique, and it was impossible to increase its might further, but if he did not give it a try, with Ling Han’s personality, how could he give up?
The battle continued.
One day, two days, three days, and the two elites showed no signs of stopping the battle.
One did not want to lose, while the other was determined to win.
Thus, the battle was naturally in a stalemate.
No one was impatient.
Under normal circumstances, how could they have the chance to witness such a battle?
This was a Venerate Tier-level battle, and below Saint Tier, that was the strongest.
As long as one could fathom a sliver of the profound secrets, and gain the slightest bit of appreciation, that would be incredibly beneficial.
Even the Imperial Sons, Ding Shu and the others were observing Ling Han, investigating the secret of his intertwining Regulations.
—With their intelligence, how could it be that after such a long time, they still could not tell that the problem lay in Ling Han’s interweaving Regulations?
However, merely interweaving Regulations could actually increase battle prowess to such a terrifying extent.
Who wouldn’t be tempted by this, wanting to investigate the profound secrets within, and turn it for their own use?
Thus, everyone hoped that the battle could continue until they could grasp the profound secrets.
Except for one person—Tao Yu.
As Ling Han’s opponent, he naturally wanted to deal with Ling Han as soon as possible.
The longer this dragged on, the more humiliated he would be — though it was already very embarrassing.
“Die!”
He deliberately slowed down the rhythm of the battle.
This naturally was not going easy on him, but rather he was accumulating Regulations.
Boom!
He launched another attack, and twelve Regulations appeared at the same time.
Xiu, Ling Han channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and easily dodged this attack.
Trying to trick him?
Hehe.
A light suddenly flashed in Ling Han’s eyes.
He finally had appreciation.
‘Come!’
He threw a punch, and it was still ninety streaks of Regulations, but there was a slight change in the order in which they intertwined.
Peng!
In an exchange of blows, Ling Han was still sent flying, but Tao Yu’s expression changed drastically in shock.
That was because he had sensitively discovered that Ling Han’s battle prowess had actually increased by a sliver.
Though it was only a sliver, they had already gone all out, and the might of his ultimate battle prowess had still been increased by a sliver.
Just how difficult was that?
However, because the extent of this increase was really too small, only an opponent like Tao Yu discovered it.
In the eyes of others, this scene was very normal.
Hadn’t Ling Han been sent flying again?
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
His efforts had not been in vain.
Again!
The more Regulations there were, the more intertwining changes there would be.
Thus, there was also more room for improvement in battle prowess.
Ling Han had already found some clues.
He threw punch after punch, and his battle prowess was steadily increasing.
Half a day passed, and everyone shockingly discovered that in terms of Regulations, Ling Han was no longer inferior to Tao Yu.
Right now, the only advantage that Tao Yu had was his power.
However, from the True Self Tier onwards, the effects of power would gradually decrease.
Unless one was overwhelmingly powerful, the effects on one’s battle prowess would be very, very small.
Thus, this slight advantage was no longer enough for Tao Yu to gain the upper hand.
The two of them… fought to a tie.
Heavens!
Everyone stared at Ling Han as if they were looking at a monster.
This was really… indescribable.
Ling Han threw a flurry of punches.
He felt that he still had room for improvement.
He still hadn’t unleashed the full might of the interweaving Regulations.
‘Come, let’s battle again.
This battle is a good opportunity to become my whetstone.’
After battling for another day, Ling Han’s battle prowess had indeed increased another notch, and he now had an extremely slight advantage.
“Stop!” Imperial Son Ming spoke up, and moved directly, stopping the battle.
They couldn’t continue fighting, or Ling Han would become stronger and stronger.
This was a freak, and could not be judged with common sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 4555: Challenging the Peak
paragraphs: Chapter 4555: Challenging the Peak
Editor: Henyee Translations
Even if everyone knew that Ling Han would be eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, Imperial Son Ming still didn’t want Ling Han to become even stronger.
—The purpose of this banquet was to humiliate Ling Han, and not for him to show off his might.
Tao Yu stepped back angrily, his expression shifting continuously.
This was too humiliating. A dignified Three Star Venerate was actually unable to suppress a Sect Master. He was destined to become a joke for all eternity.
If Ling Han could become Emperor in the future, then he would at least feel slightly better. After all, he had lost to the future Great Emperor.
But the problem here was that Ling Han would be eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, and that was the real fatal thing.
This was a great humiliation.
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and looked towards Imperial Son Ming, “What is it? Are you also going to ask for some guidance from me?”
Imperial Son Ming scoffed, “You are not worthy!”
He was a Seven Star Venerate, and judging by the battle prowess that Ling Han had displayed just now, he did have a crushing advantage. Thus, his words could not be considered an exaggeration.
Imperial Son Tian also spoke up, saying, “It’s about time. The martial arts feast this time should also come to an end.”
‘Yi, it ended just like that?
Hadn’t they agreed to humiliate Ling Han? Now? On the other hand, it was the Imperial Clans that had been severely humiliated by Ling Han.
The proud Imperial Sons were actually able to tolerate this?
This was practically… unimaginable!

Imperial Son Ming continued, “Didn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan say that they wanted to find a good partner for Fairy Chi? There are so many prodigies here, so there should be a few that can gain the attention of the Donglin Imperial Clan, right?”
Yi!
Why was this suddenly brought up?
That’s right!

Many people immediately nodded in agreement. Ling Han’s freakishness was far too terrifying. Even a Three Star Venerate of the Golden Generation was unable to suppress Ling Han. If they sent out a more powerful Golden Generation… so what if they won?
Everyone in the world could see it clearly through the Galaxy Network. That would only be a humiliation to the Imperial Clans.
However, back to the problem of Chi Menghan.
Could the Donglin Imperial Clan betroth the Imperial Daughter to Ling Han?
This was absolutely impossible!
So what if Ling Han was freakish? He was eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, and even if you could match a Venerate, so what?
All the Golden Generation had the aptitude to even become a Saint. No matter how awesome Ling Han was, could he challenge a Saint?
Furthermore, Chi Menghan’s natural talent was astonishingly high. The husband she was looking for would definitely have a chance of breaking through to the imperial throne.
Thus, this had even less to do with Ling Han.
Hehe, to watch helplessly as his girlfriend was betrothed to another as his wife, what kind of blow was that?
This kind of face-slapping was the most painful.

“Hehe, just what I wanted.” An old Venerate from the Donglin Imperial Clan spoke up. He was the Imperial Son from the last era, and had long since cultivated to the level of nine stars. However, he could not advance any further, and had no chance of becoming a Saint.
His eyes swept over the gathered masses, then said calmly, “I am representing the Donglin Imperial Clan, and I hereby announce that the husband chosen for Chi Menghan is—”
“Brother-in-law!” Chi Mengshan immediately interjected. However, she was immediately suppressed again.
“Baili Tian!” the old Venerate from the Donglin Imperial Clan called out loudly. Even in the empty and silent universe, his voice still spread out in all directions under the influence of his power.
As expected!

Everyone nodded. Donglin Imperial Clan definitely wouldn’t choose Ling Han as their son-in-law. Ling Han was just a cripple, so even if he was the strongest Sect Master in history, what benefits could he bring to the Imperial Clan?
They had already produced a Great Emperor before, so would they still care about the title of the strongest Sect Master in history?
Shua, all of a sudden, everyone’s eyes turned towards Ling Han.
How would Ling Han… react?

If he didn’t move, then his woman would be snatched, and he still didn’t dare to make a sound. How big a blow would this be to his image? And if he exploded, hoho, wasn’t challenging Baili Tian akin to courting death?
No matter how they looked at it, this was a dilemma. It would either be an embarrassment or a loss of life.
From the moment Ling Han appeared, he had already fallen into a trap. He was destined to be stuck in a dilemma.
The difference lay in the fact that the Imperial Sons had wanted to defeat Ling Han previously, causing him to suffer a series of blows.
Everyone looked at Ling Han. This time, it was really difficult to deal with.
Would you show that you are a man now?
Meanwhile, Chi Menghan clenched her fists and shouted in her mind, “Don’t be rash! Don’t be rash!”
Her cultivation level had been sealed by the Saints of her clan, and she couldn’t even speak.

Under the expectant gazes of countless people, Ling Han smiled and said calmly, “You guys are all hoping for me to make a move, so I will satisfy your wishes! Baili Tian, you will know that even if you are a Seven Star Venerate, you still can’t do anything to me!”
Baili Tian humphed lowly, appearing extremely displeased.
The alliance with the Donglin Imperial Clan had actually been decided long ago, and had only been announced now. Thus, he was naturally not the slightest bit surprised.
However, being challenged by a Sect Master, even if it was part of the plan, he was still displeased.
“I, grant you death,” he stated calmly.
“Come!” Ling Han let out a battle cry, and took the initiative to charge out. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, and his two flaming wings stretched out as long as thirty thousand meters.
Xiu, with just a flap, he had appeared in front of Baili Tian, and shot out a punch.
“You’re courting death!” Baili Tian casually blocked his attack. However, he was a Seven Star Venerate, and with a casual strike, fourteen Seven Star Regulations appeared.
Peng, Ling Han’s attack was undoubtedly dispersed.
Baili Tian took advantage of the opening to counterattack. He delivered a palm strike, possessing the power to destroy the heavens and earth.
He wasn’t far from igniting the holy flame, so his battle prowess was naturally boundlessly terrifying.
Ling Han didn’t face this attack head-on. This wasn’t Tao Yu, and there was a gulf of “five stars” between them. This was an absolute domination.
With a light flap of his flaming wings, he could come and go as he pleased.
Baili Tian’s attack missed, but he didn’t take it to heart. He simply said calmly, “Ling Han, since you’re challenging me, why do you still dodge and evade? How are you going to defeat me like this?”
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He simply leaped forward and threw a punch.
He had been tricked!
Everyone shook their heads. This was obviously provocation. Why had Ling Han fallen for it so easily?𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
Baili Tian bared his teeth in a grin, and also threw a punch.
Weng!
His punch arrived, yet a tower suddenly appeared in front of Ling Han, completely enshrouding him.
Thus, this punch naturally landed on the body of the tower. Instantly, he felt like an ordinary person that had punched an iron plate, and a sharp pain came from his fist.
F***, what was this?

He had not even finished this thought, when he saw that the tower had already disappeared. Though Ling Han had been sent backwards several hundred meters, this little distance was nothing to him. He threw another punch.
In a rush, Baili Tian could only just barely manage to parry, and set up nine Seven Star Regulations.
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, but it only broke through the defenses of Baili Tian, and his attack was also powerless to continue.
After all, the gap between their cultivation levels was far too large.
Even so, everyone was still stunned. Ling Han was just a tiny bit away from threatening Baili Tian.
“Origin Gold!” Baili Tian’s eyes swept over it, and he already understood.

Only the Saintly Material and the Origin Gold could cause him to feel as if his bones were about to break from the force of the punch. Moreover, it wasn’t as if he hadn’t seen the Imperial Weapon before, so he naturally recognized it immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 4556: Saint Tool appears
paragraphs: Chapter 4556: Saint Tool appears
Editor: Henyee Translations
What, Origin Gold!
Everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han. The tower that had flashed past just now was forged from Origin Gold?
No wonder he could block Baili Tian’s attack.
Hiss, was this guy really the Son of Destiny?
What Great Emperor hadn’t obtained the Origin Gold after achieving Dao and forged it into an Imperial Weapon? However, what about Ling Han? He had actually obtained it when he was only a Sect Master.
Too bad, too bad. If it was not for the fact that this guy was too outstanding, and was envied by the heavens, who would be able to compete with him for the throne?
—His battle prowess at the same cultivation level was unparalleled, and he also had a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon in hand. If he didn’t become Emperor, who would be qualified to become Emperor!
“Do you think that just because you have a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, you can stop me?” Baili Tian asked calmly, but there was a sliver of heat in his eyes.
Ling Han had even taken out the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, which meant that he really had used all his trump cards, and his battle prowess had already reached peak stage.
Since he now knew Ling Han’s true limits, wouldn’t it be easy to deal with him?
And after killing Ling Han, the Origin Gold would naturally belong to him.
This was destiny!𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Ling Han also smiled faintly, “Go ahead and try!”
His words were filled with confidence.
Many people’s emotions were instantly ignited, and they actually felt an urge to roar in excitement.

“Die!” Baili Tian was extremely calm. With a leap, he charged towards Ling Han and delivered a palm strike. Fourteen Seven Star Regulations dazzled, turning into a God Tool that slashed towards Ling Han.
Kuang!
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared in time to block this attack.
So what if it was the Seven Star Regulations? Could it hurt Origin Gold in the slightest?
However, Baili Tian still had an advantage in power, after all. Although the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower blocked the attack, it was also sent flying.
At this moment, Ling Han put away the Origin Gold, and replied with a punch of his own.
“I was just waiting for you!” Baili Tian sneered, and delivered another palm strike. Shua, fourteen Seven Star Regulations flashed again.
After having attacked so suddenly, he still wanted to trick him?
Who did they think the Golden Generation was?
Ling Han chuckled, and the power of his fist burst forth, turning into a ball of blazing light that continued to blast towards Baili Tian.
Peng!
Their attacks collided head-on, and there was a temporary stalemate. Then, Ling Han’s Regulations began to break. After all, the gap between them was too wide.
However, Baili Tian’s Regulations were actually melting as well!

When Ling Han’s attack was easily destroyed, Baili Tian’s attack was also shattered. Its might declined by who knew how many times, and when it hit Ling Han, it was completely insufficient to pose a threat.
This!
Everyone was numb with shock. In this blow, Ling Han did not rely on the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, but rather a display of his own strength.
That black light!

There was no shortage of smart people here. They immediately recalled that when Ling Han had delivered that attack, the Regulations were still wrapped in a layer of black light, like flames, but darker than darkness itself.
Was it this thing that had corroded Baili Tian’s Regulations?
If that was not the case, what else could it be?
However, what light was so terrifying that it could melt even Seven Star Regulations?

Ding Shu, Heaven Crushing, Jing Haoran, and the others all wore solemn expressions. They had all mastered the Destructive Energy, but they knew very well that the destructive power of Destructive Energy that they had unleashed was far from being as powerful as this.
“Complete form!”
They exchanged a glance, and saw the same message in each other’s eyes.
Ling Han had actually grasped the complete power of Destructive Energy. No wonder it was so powerful.

They couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation. The unique trait of Destructive Energy was its terrifying destructive ability. Theoretically speaking, it could destroy anything. In fact, it even allowed Ling Han to compensate for the gap of a whole “five stars”.
If they could also obtain the full Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, they would naturally be as powerful as well, and their battle prowess would soar to another level.
Baili Tian was extremely shocked. As the person involved, he knew better than anyone else just how terrifying Destructive Energy was.
That was practically unreasonable destruction. So what if he had the advantage in Regulations? Seven Star Regulations was still easily destroyed.

He had a feeling that this was still because Ling Han’s cultivation level was too low. If Ling Han was also a Venerate Tier, it was very likely that his attack would strike over and destroy him as well.
No wonder he was envied by the heaven and earth, that they had eternally imprisoned him at Sect Master-level!
The existence of this kind of person had completely broken the balance.
“Die!” His expression was cold, and he charged out again, but it was unknown how many times more careful he was.
That black energy possessed the ability to wound or even kill him — it should be known that after advancing into Venerate Tier, the Substitution Seal was no longer effective.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them exchanged blows. Whether it was Regulations or power, Ling Han was at a far disadvantage, but with Destructive Energy being capable of destroying anything and everything, he forcibly withstood it.
This caused everyone to have no choice but to bow in admiration.

It should be known that Baili Tian was already a Seven Star Venerate Tier elite, and was also a Golden Generation. Thus, his battle prowess practically represented the peak stage of Venerate Tier, but Ling Han, as a Sect Master, was actually capable of matching him!
This was really a huge gap of a whole major tier in cultivation level.
The greatest miracle in history.
Even the old Venerate from the Donglin Imperial Clan felt that it was a pity. If Ling Han hadn’t been crippled, he would definitely have been the only option for the Donglin Imperial Clan.

Unfortunately, even if you could defeat Venerate Tier elites, you would never be able to step into Saint-level battle prowess in this lifetime, and have no hope of becoming Emperor. Then, there was nothing that could be done. You would not be qualified to marry Chi Menghan.

Of course, if Ling Han was willing to marry into the Donglin Imperial Clan, the Donglin Imperial Clan would still be willing to choose one of their clan members to be betrothed to Ling Han. After all, Ling Han’s descendants would have the effect of perfecting the Chi Clan’s bloodline.
Boom!
As his thoughts flew, Ling Han and Baili Tian exchanged several dozen moves. The shockwaves from the battle swept out, forcing even the Sect Masters to retreat, not daring to be touched even once.
Whether it was the Seven Star Regulations or the Destructive Energy, their destructive power was too great. Insta-killing a Sect Master was no issue.
As time passed, Baili Tian couldn’t maintain his composure any longer.

He, a dignified seven-star Venerate Tier elite, was practically standing at the peak stage of Venerate Tier, and furthermore, he was a Golden Generation elite. After so long, he was actually still unable to do anything to a Sect Master?
Moreover, this was being broadcast live by Galaxy Network!
He humphed, and also took out the Spirit Tool.
Before this, he disdained from doing this at all, thinking that it was demeaning himself, but now, he couldn’t care less.
Defeating Ling Han was his top priority!

This was a saber, and not a replica of the Ziwei Imperial Clan’s Imperial Weapon. However, the saber’s blade was as red as blood, yet it exuded a terrifying aura that would cause one’s heart to palpitate.
It was as if heaven and earth would be split into two if the saber moved.
This was… a Saint Tool!
F***, Baili Tian actually had a Saint Tool on him?

Upon further thought, he was already a Venerate Tier, and was only a step away from becoming a Saint by igniting the holy flame. Furthermore, the Golden Generation had already surpassed ordinary people in the first place. Thus, even if the Saint Tool couldn’t unleash its full might in his hands, one percent should be enough, right?
When the Saint moved, he only had to release a tiny bit of his aura, and it would be enough to completely destroy the soul and body of a Venerate Tier.
In an instant, everyone hurriedly turned around and fled. Once the Saint Tool unleashed its might, those at close range would all become cannon fodder.
Who wanted to die?
Ling Han also tensed at this. This was a Saint Tool! This was a little difficult to deal with.

Since he now knew Ling Han’s true limits, wouldn’t it be easy to deal with him?
And after killing Ling Han, the Origin Gold would naturally belong to him.
This was destiny!𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Ling Han also smiled faintly, “Go ahead and try!”
His words were filled with confidence.
Many people’s emotions were instantly ignited, and they actually felt an urge to roar in excitement.
“Die!” Baili Tian was extremely calm.
With a leap, he charged towards Ling Han and delivered a palm strike.
Fourteen Seven Star Regulations dazzled, turning into a God Tool that slashed towards Ling Han.
Kuang!
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared in time to block this attack.
So what if it was the Seven Star Regulations?
Could it hurt Origin Gold in the slightest?
However, Baili Tian still had an advantage in power, after all.
Although the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower blocked the attack, it was also sent flying.
At this moment, Ling Han put away the Origin Gold, and replied with a punch of his own.
“I was just waiting for you!” Baili Tian sneered, and delivered another palm strike.
Shua, fourteen Seven Star Regulations flashed again.
After having attacked so suddenly, he still wanted to trick him?
Who did they think the Golden Generation was?
Ling Han chuckled, and the power of his fist burst forth, turning into a ball of blazing light that continued to blast towards Baili Tian.
Peng!
Their attacks collided head-on, and there was a temporary stalemate.
Then, Ling Han’s Regulations began to break.
After all, the gap between them was too wide.
However, Baili Tian’s Regulations were actually melting as well!
When Ling Han’s attack was easily destroyed, Baili Tian’s attack was also shattered.
Its might declined by who knew how many times, and when it hit Ling Han, it was completely insufficient to pose a threat.
This!
Everyone was numb with shock.
In this blow, Ling Han did not rely on the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, but rather a display of his own strength.
That black light!
There was no shortage of smart people here.
They immediately recalled that when Ling Han had delivered that attack, the Regulations were still wrapped in a layer of black light, like flames, but darker than darkness itself.
Was it this thing that had corroded Baili Tian’s Regulations?
If that was not the case, what else could it be?
However, what light was so terrifying that it could melt even Seven Star Regulations?
Ding Shu, Heaven Crushing, Jing Haoran, and the others all wore solemn expressions.
They had all mastered the Destructive Energy, but they knew very well that the destructive power of Destructive Energy that they had unleashed was far from being as powerful as this.
“Complete form!”
They exchanged a glance, and saw the same message in each other’s eyes.
Ling Han had actually grasped the complete power of Destructive Energy.
No wonder it was so powerful.
They couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation.
The unique trait of Destructive Energy was its terrifying destructive ability.
Theoretically speaking, it could destroy anything.
In fact, it even allowed Ling Han to compensate for the gap of a whole “five stars”.
If they could also obtain the full Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, they would naturally be as powerful as well, and their battle prowess would soar to another level.
Baili Tian was extremely shocked.
As the person involved, he knew better than anyone else just how terrifying Destructive Energy was.
That was practically unreasonable destruction.
So what if he had the advantage in Regulations?
Seven Star Regulations was still easily destroyed.
He had a feeling that this was still because Ling Han’s cultivation level was too low.
If Ling Han was also a Venerate Tier, it was very likely that his attack would strike over and destroy him as well.
No wonder he was envied by the heaven and earth, that they had eternally imprisoned him at Sect Master-level!
The existence of this kind of person had completely broken the balance.
“Die!” His expression was cold, and he charged out again, but it was unknown how many times more careful he was.
That black energy possessed the ability to wound or even kill him — it should be known that after advancing into Venerate Tier, the Substitution Seal was no longer effective.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows.
Whether it was Regulations or power, Ling Han was at a far disadvantage, but with Destructive Energy being capable of destroying anything and everything, he forcibly withstood it.
This caused everyone to have no choice but to bow in admiration.
It should be known that Baili Tian was already a Seven Star Venerate Tier elite, and was also a Golden Generation.
Thus, his battle prowess practically represented the peak stage of Venerate Tier, but Ling Han, as a Sect Master, was actually capable of matching him!
This was really a huge gap of a whole major tier in cultivation level.
The greatest miracle in history.
Even the old Venerate from the Donglin Imperial Clan felt that it was a pity.
If Ling Han hadn’t been crippled, he would definitely have been the only option for the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Unfortunately, even if you could defeat Venerate Tier elites, you would never be able to step into Saint-level battle prowess in this lifetime, and have no hope of becoming Emperor.
Then, there was nothing that could be done.
You would not be qualified to marry Chi Menghan.
Of course, if Ling Han was willing to marry into the Donglin Imperial Clan, the Donglin Imperial Clan would still be willing to choose one of their clan members to be betrothed to Ling Han.
After all, Ling Han’s descendants would have the effect of perfecting the Chi Clan’s bloodline.
Boom!
As his thoughts flew, Ling Han and Baili Tian exchanged several dozen moves.
The shockwaves from the battle swept out, forcing even the Sect Masters to retreat, not daring to be touched even once.
Whether it was the Seven Star Regulations or the Destructive Energy, their destructive power was too great.
Insta-killing a Sect Master was no issue.
As time passed, Baili Tian couldn’t maintain his composure any longer.
He, a dignified seven-star Venerate Tier elite, was practically standing at the peak stage of Venerate Tier, and furthermore, he was a Golden Generation elite.
After so long, he was actually still unable to do anything to a Sect Master?
Moreover, this was being broadcast live by Galaxy Network!
He humphed, and also took out the Spirit Tool.
Before this, he disdained from doing this at all, thinking that it was demeaning himself, but now, he couldn’t care less.
Defeating Ling Han was his top priority!
This was a saber, and not a replica of the Ziwei Imperial Clan’s Imperial Weapon.
However, the saber’s blade was as red as blood, yet it exuded a terrifying aura that would cause one’s heart to palpitate.
It was as if heaven and earth would be split into two if the saber moved.
This was… a Saint Tool!
F***, Baili Tian actually had a Saint Tool on him?
Upon further thought, he was already a Venerate Tier, and was only a step away from becoming a Saint by igniting the holy flame.
Furthermore, the Golden Generation had already surpassed ordinary people in the first place.
Thus, even if the Saint Tool couldn’t unleash its full might in his hands, one percent should be enough, right?
When the Saint moved, he only had to release a tiny bit of his aura, and it would be enough to completely destroy the soul and body of a Venerate Tier.
In an instant, everyone hurriedly turned around and fled.
Once the Saint Tool unleashed its might, those at close range would all become cannon fodder.
Who wanted to die?
Ling Han also tensed at this.
This was a Saint Tool!
This was a little difficult to deal with.

chapters.title: Chapter 4557: I Have a Beast Pet
paragraphs: Chapter 4557: I Have a Beast Pet
Editor: Henyee Translations
Who would have thought that dealing with a Sect Master like Ling Han would not only require a Venerate Tier, but also a Saint Tool?
Merely with this accomplishment, Ling Han could look down on all past and present.
However, how was he going to pass this test?

Baili Tian humphed, his right hand holding onto the hilt of the saber. As his aura surged, hong, the whole bloody saber was glowing, its bright red colour seeming to turn into blood that was about to drip from it.
The Saint Tool was about to be unleashed.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Since you’ve even mobilized the Saint Tool, I’m also going to summon my pet beast to help.”
Yi, Ling Han was actually a beast tamer?
Everyone was surprised. They had never heard of it.

Ling Han took out the Great Emperor Horn and blew it, instantly reducing his spiritual power by a significant amount. Meanwhile, those near and far were all howling uncontrollably at the sky—except for the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters. Xiu! A shadow streaked over from the distance.
This was… the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan’s Golden Generation, Di Qingyun.
Yi, why had he come out?
Just when everyone was at a loss and confused, they saw that Di Qingyun had actually returned to his original form.
—A silver wolf that was as tall as nine meters.
He was standing right next to Ling Han’s feet, rubbing his head against Ling Han’s ankle, looking completely like a pet dog.
“Sigh, how embarrassing for a dog!” In the distance, the large black dog deliberately said. However, he couldn’t hide his mischievous grin.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Who could have imagined that this would happen?
Everyone only felt that this was extremely bizarre, their eyes wide, not knowing what kind of reaction they should have.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Come!”
“Ao!” Di Qingyun also howled at Baili Tian, his ferocious nature on full display.
Baili Tian instantly felt a headache coming on.

What was going on here? Why was Di Qingyun helping Ling Han? This was completely illogical. Moreover, if he wanted to help, so be it. Why did he have to take the form of a wolf? Did he really think of himself as a pet beast?
At this moment, Baili Tian’s heart was filled with complaints, and he didn’t know where to start complaining.
“Go!” Ling Han pointed a finger, and Di Qingyun immediately pounced out.
“Brother Di!” Baili Tian leaped out to dodge. His strength was superior to Di Qingyun, so he could easily defend and not attack. “Do you have some weakness in that brat’s hands?”

How could he have possibly imagined that there would be something as amazing as the Great Emperor’s horn in this world? Furthermore, Imperial Sons like them all had treasures that had been forged by the Great Emperor, which could block all negative effects.
How could it be that when it came to the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, it would no longer be effective?

Thus, Di Qingyun must have had some kind of weakness in Ling Han’s hands, and was forced to participate in the battle. Just look, he had appeared in the form of a wolf, because he really had no face to see others.
Di Qingyun was also very depressed. He could not control himself at all, all right?
“Ao! Ao! Ao!” He pounced and bit continuously, looking completely like a wolf.
Baili Tian decided to ignore Di Qingyun and directly target Ling Han instead.
As long as he killed Ling Han, everything would be resolved.
He focused, and once again activated the Saint Tool.
Xiu, at this moment, Di Qingyun suddenly stood in front of Ling Han.
F***, how could he be so shameless?

Baili Tian definitely couldn’t deliver this strike. If he killed Di Qingyun, then no matter what the reason was, the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan and Ziwei Imperial Clan would definitely become mortal enemies.
At present, the Netherworld was invading. At such a crucial time, if the two great Imperial Clans fell out… hoho, the consequences would be unthinkable.
Thus, Ling Han was far too despicable and shameless.
He was actually using Di Qingyun as a shield!
“One can’t be too shameless!” Baili Tian said through gritted teeth.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “You’re a seven-star Venerate Tier elite with a Saint Tool in hand, and you’re talking about shamelessness to me? Tsk, tsk!”
Who was the shameless one?
Baili Tian was instantly rendered speechless. In this battle, he had already taken full advantage of Ling Han, so what right did he have to say that Ling Han was shameless?
If anyone was truly shameless, it was him, all right?
But the problem was, how were they supposed to fight like this?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “You’re not going to fight anymore, right? All right then, it can be considered a tie!”
A tie?

Everyone thought for a moment. Indeed, putting aside the Saint Tool and Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, Ling had indeed not been at a disadvantage at all when Ling Han had previously clashed with Baili Tian. Thus, calling it a tie was not a boast at all.
Baili Tian didn’t say anything. Di Qingyun’s sudden “betrayal” caught him off guard, and he was completely flustered.
“Menghan!” Ling Han looked in Chi Menghan’s direction, and suddenly called out loudly, “Wait for me. It won’t be long before I go to the Donglin Imperial Clan to pick you up!”
Chi Menghan couldn’t speak, yet she kept nodding, excitement on her pretty face.
“Brother-in-law is so handsome!” Chi Mengshan’s eyes were dazed, her arms crossed over her chest, looking like a fangirl.
This scene made everyone feel rueful. They kept feeling that there was suddenly something green and lush above Baili Tian’s head1.
Baili Tian’s hands were also tightly clenched. This was a kind of betrayal!
“You all—” Ling Han swept an eye over the Imperial Sons, “Just you wait as well. Not too long after, I will return, and hang you all up for a beating!”
After saying this, he directly tore a rip into space and left.
All the Imperial Sons were furious. You, a cripple, actually dare to be so arrogant?
But in full public, it would not be proper for them to pursue.

Previously, the Imperial Clans had already announced that as long as Ling Han dared to come, it was guaranteed that they would not make a move on him. If they pursued him now, would the Imperial Clans still have any face?
Especially at a time when Yin souls were invading, how damaging would that be to morale?
However, Ling Han was already a cripple anyway, so it was impossible for him to break through to the Fourth Extreme. Thus, they decided to let him be smug for a while longer.
Afterwards, Ling Han could only watch helplessly as the Imperial Sons became Saints, one after another, and could only watch as the woman he loved was married to another.
Ling Han could only forcefully swallow this kind of bitterness.
Thus, it was better to let him live.
The Imperial Sons could only console themselves like this.
To the others, however, this was a good show of how the Imperial Sons had been humiliated.
Striking at Ling Han?

Haha, it had only fulfilled the fame of being the strongest Sect Master in history. Even if Ling Han was really stuck at Sect Master-level forever, he could still leave a mark in history that would last for a hundred lifetimes, and the legend would not be destroyed.
And as for the Imperial Sons?
Without becoming Emperor, one would ultimately be annihilated in the long passage of history.
Just ask, with so many Saints originating from the Imperial Clans, just how many people could actually remember who they were?
Without becoming Emperor, it would ultimately be all for naught.
Once Ling Han left, the large black dog, little azure dragon and pervert pig naturally tore a rip into space and left as well.
A dozen over days later, Ling Han and the others had returned home.
Ling Han immediately began to concoct alchemical pills. Having obtained so much Celestial Qi, what kind of gain was this?
He was rich!

He hadn’t refined all of the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills; he had also concoted a portion of Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills. He had distributed some to the large black dog and the others, as well as some for Brother Monkey.
Sigh, so even though there were many Celestial Qi, including those around him, it was actually… still not enough.

Good steel naturally had to be used on the cutting edge. Thus, as much as possible, the Celestial Qi would be used on Ling Han and Brother Monkey. They represented the strongest battle prowess of Ling Han’s faction, and as long as Ling Han or Brother Monkey became Emperor, they would naturally have as much Celestial Qi as they could want.
—The Imperial Clans were already able to extract Celestial Qi, what more the Great Emperor.
