chapters.title: Chapter 4558: Meat-Devouring Xianzhi
paragraphs: Chapter 4558: Meat-Devouring Xianzhi
Editor: Henyee Translations
As Ling Han concocted alchemical pills, he also took some time to ingest and refine them.
Three months later, he had also refined a large amount of Celestial Qi, pushing his cultivation level to the peak stage of Twelve Stars.
Break through!
This was completely no problem for Ling Han. Not too long after, he had advanced into Thirteen Stars.
After breaking through, Ling Han actually had no intention of trying to rip open the black chains at all. By this time, his mindset had already changed.
He saw these black chains as an opportunity. He wanted to see how many stars he could reach.
Fifteen? Or twenty?
In short, he would charge as high as he could, because this was truly improving his battle prowess.
If he became a Venerate, what Venerate Tier would be able to match him?
If he became a Saint, what Saint would not bow their head in submission?
If he became Emperor, through the ages, what Great Emperor could compare to him?
If he was going to do it, he was going to be the strongest!
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, and continued to ingest alchemical pills, pushing his cultivation level up.
However, after arriving at Thirteen Stars, it was as if he had also advanced into Four Star Venerate Tier. The amount of Celestial Qi needed for every step forward was really too much.
Six months had passed, and he had actually still not cultivated to the peak stage of Thirteen Stars. He was like a bottomless pit.
At this time, Brother Monkey returned.
“Brother Monkey, you’re injured?” Ling Han hurriedly rushed out to receive him. The large black dog and the others also came over.
There were obvious wounds on Brother Monkey’s body. Although he wasn’t bleeding, the wounds were very deep and a little shocking.
“It’s fine,” Brother Monkey said calmly.
He took out something and handed it over to Ling Han. It looked like a piece of meat jelly, and was completely grey in colour. It was only the size of a fist, and was extremely elastic.
“Unfortunately, I didn’t find any top-grade Great Herb,” Brother Monkey said. “There’s only this.”
“What is this?” Ling Han asked.

“Amongst Celestial medicines, it can be considered quite peculiar,” Brother Monkey said. “This is Meat-Devouring Xianzhi. Though it does not increase one’s cultivation level, it can increase one’s power of masculinity. Furthermore, after ingesting it for a year, no matter how high one’s cultivation level is, one would definitely be able to have children.”
F***, there was such a strange Celestial medicine?
Instantly, the eyes of the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the pervert pig all lit up.
It had to be said that though this Celestial medicine was strange, it was guaranteed that even Saints would want it.
Why?
It guaranteed that one could have children.
It should be known that the higher one’s cultivation level was, the more difficult it would be for them to bear offspring, as if they had been cursed by the heaven and earth.

This was especially the case for Saints. Perhaps they had given birth to descendants when they were young, but how long could Saints live for? As long as they had lived for hundreds of thousands of years, their son, and possibly great-great-grandson, would have already died.
Though it was possible that they would have descendants, they were definitely incomparable to his own son and daughter.
Thus, how tempting would it be to have another son in old age?
“It’s better to give it to Grandpa Dog.” The large black dog was completely shameless, and stretched out a paw, “It’s about time that Grandpa Dog left behind a child.”

“Forget about it. Your descendant would definitely be shameless and extremely despicable, so it’s best not to harm others.” The little azure dragon immediately said, “You should give it to Grandpa Dragon. The lineage of the True Dragon is only left with Grandpa Dragon.”
“Get lost, you are just a little brat!” The large black dog immediately undermined him.
“Give this old pig!” It was rare for the perverted pig to speak human language. He stretched out his hoof, “Enhance masculinity! Enhance masculinity!”
It didn’t care whether it could definitely have children or not, but felt that the aphrodisiac-strengthening function was too useful.
“It’s to increase one’s power of masculinity. Who told you that it could boost one’s masculinity?” the large black dog and the little azure dragon rebuked at the same time.
“Enhancing masculinity and increasing the power of masculinity, isn’t it the same?” The pervert pig spread out his hooves.
“Get lost, perverted pig!” The large black dog shot out a leg and kicked the perverted pig away.
Meanwhile, the perverted pig sighed, “Everyone wants to do the same thing, but why does it become lecherous when this old pig says it?”
It was very confused.

Meanwhile, Ling Han stuffed the Meat-Devouring Xianzhi into Brother Monkey’s hands, and said, “Brother Monkey, I have long since had a large number of children and grandchildren, but you still have no children. You had best hurry up and give me a nephew.”
Brother Monkey shook his head, “Old Sun only has battle in my heart!”
Having children or whatnot was simply a waste of time.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “If Brother Monkey meets the right person one day, you won’t think like this.”
He thought for a moment, then said, “I’ll take care of this Meat-Devouring Xianzhi first. When Brother Monkey needs it, I’ll give it to you.”
The large black dog and the others all shook their heads upon seeing Ling Han put away the Meat-Devouring Xianzhi. They clearly needed it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4559: Skeleton Saint Tool
paragraphs: Chapter 4559: Skeleton Saint Tool
Editor: Henyee Translations
What was surprising was that the Yin souls did not launch another attack for a long time, as if they were resting.
No one felt relaxed. This was definitely not because Yin souls had given up just like that. Instead, they must be preparing a powerful offensive.
Day after day passed, and a month later, the Yin souls that had not moved for a long time finally launched a new round of attacks.
They didn’t attack from all directions. Instead, they targeted a single direction and launched a series of attacks.
Unfortunately, Ling Han and the others just happened to be on this path.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han and Brother Monkey raised their heads at the same time. Fear rose up in their hearts, as if they had a premonition that something terrifying was about to happen.
Afterward, only then did the large black dog, the little azure dragon and the perverted pig sense something, and they too looked up at the sky.
“Let’s go take a look.”
Ling Han and Brother Monkey used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight at the same time, and flew towards space.

They stretched out their vision as far as they could, looking towards the planet occupied by the Yin souls. Then, amidst the darkness, they saw an army that was rapidly approaching. The vanguard was shockingly twelve massive skeletons.

Each skeleton was 30,000 meters tall. Their bodies were made of pitch-black metal, and even at such a far distance, they still emitted a terrifying aura, making people feel fear that came from the depths of their souls.
“Saintly Material!”
Ling Han, Brother Monkey, and the little azure dragon called out at practically the same time.
Gods, these skeletons were actually completely made up of Saintly Material.
Which also meant that these twelve skeletons were equivalent to twelve Saint Tools!
“It’s not just that!” Brother Monkey muttered, his expression considerably serious.
It was very rare to see Brother Monkey reveal such a serious expression, which clearly showed the seriousness of the matter.
Ling Han nodded and said, “Although Saintly Material can be enlarged, shrunk, and transformed according to one’s will, look at these skeletons… They’re made up of different Saintly Material!”
What kind of concept was this?
A Saintly Material could forge a Saint Tool, then, with a different Saintly Materials forming a body, just how terrifying would this skeleton “Spirit Tool” be?
How many Saints had joined forces to launch this attack?
However, was this possible?
If might could be boosted with the layering of Saintly Material, then the Imperial Clans would completely be able to build the number one Saint Tool in the world.
No way!

The might of the Saintly Material couldn’t be stacked, so it would be better to use one piece of Saintly Material to forge a Saint Tool instead of two. The might would instead be greater, so as to avoid the might of different Saintly Material clashing, and weakening the power instead.

However, both Ling Han and Brother Monkey could sense that these skeletal Spirit Tools were all exuding a world-shaking aura. The different Saintly Materials were perfectly combined, and did not conflict with each other. Instead, they magnified each other’s might.
If this kind of Spirit Tool unleashed its might, what Saint would be able to block it?
After such a long time, the Yin souls finally released a powerful move, and this powerful move… was too terrifying.
“Let’s go!”
Ling Han said at the first instant. Seeing that Brother Monkey was still a little eager to give it a try, he hurriedly grabbed Brother Monkey and pulled him forcefully towards the ground.
Brother Monkey was bellicose, and it was as if he wanted to charge up and fight. However, as a Venerate, there was a high chance that he would never return if he charged into such a lineup.
—With how few members of the Battle Saint Emperor’s line there were, did they all just ignore everything else and charge forward with their staff when their saw an enemy?
Ling Han couldn’t help but complain.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
Brother Monkey had also woken up. After returning to the ground, they hurriedly retreated.
To say nothing of them, even Saints would have to retreat if they came across such an army of Yin souls.
They tore a rip into space and left. At the same time, they also sent out a call for help, giving a simple explanation.
Not long after, several Saints arrived.
A Saint immediately moved, blasting towards the Yin souls.
A Skeleton Saint Tool suddenly lashed out, unleashing a palm strike that was radiating with a myriad of colors. It then unleashed a burst of supreme Sword Rays, slicing the Saint into two.
Thankfully, the vitality of a Saint was incredibly tenacious. He immediately pieced the two halves of his body back together, and fled back in an extremely sorry state.
This was too terrifying. A Saint had been killed with a single strike.
“This is no ordinary Tool. It can completely be viewed as a Saint Tool, and can actively attack!”
“Heavens, the combination of Saintly Materials actually amplifies each other’s might!”
“The might of this strike is at least seven stars and above!”
The Saints did not dare to oppose this either. Immediately, they retreated, and then voiced out their opinion.
The Yin soul army penetrated deeply, invincible.
All of a sudden, the Galaxy Network was filled with discussions about this newly appeared Skeleton Saint Tool.

“Putting aside how we can ensure that different Saintly Materials do not conflict with each other, and can compound their power, just the Netherworld is only a land of nothingness. How could there possibly be so many Saintly Materials?”
“That’s right. The Netherworld doesn’t produce anything at all, so how could there possibly be Saintly Materials? And there are so many of them at that?”
However, discussion was discussion, but this could not stop the advance of the Yin soul army.
Right until the Imperial Clan brought the Imperial Weapon over.
The might of the Imperial Weapon finally stopped the advance of this army. However, what was terrifying was the fact that even the Imperial Weapon was unable to annihilate this army.

When the Imperial Weapon unleashed its might, the 12 skeletal Saint Tools combined together to form a bone shield that actually blocked the Imperial Weapon’s attacks—although they were forced into continuous retreat.

However, the Imperial Weapon couldn’t unleash its might forever, so when the Imperial Weapon stopped, the Skeleton Saint Tool took advantage of the opening to counterattack. It quickly recovered its lost territory and charged in.
When the news spread out, the whole world was shocked.
The Imperial Weapon was the final line of defense for all the members of the Imperial Clans, as well as everyone else.
In everyone’s eyes, no matter how powerful the enemy was, even if the a Pseudo-Emperor made a move, they would have to retreat when faced with the Imperial Weapon, but now?
The Imperial Weapon was actually blocked!

It wasn’t that the Imperial Weapon wasn’t awesome enough, but that no one could continuously activate the Imperial Weapon. Otherwise, with the offensive ability of the Imperial Weapon, no matter how hard your bone shield was, after a few hundred or a few thousand slashes, there was no way it couldn’t be dealt with.
More Saints rushed over with their Imperial Weapons. The dozen or so Imperial Weapons unleashed their might one after another, and only then did they manage to block the Skeleton Saint Tools.
However, the Netherworld sent out another army, and twelve Skeleton Saint Tools were also the commanders-in-chief, sweeping aside all opposition.
The Imperial Clans hurriedly split up again, bringing the Imperial Weapons to suppress the enemy troops.
Their path was also blocked, but bad news came again. The Netherworld had mobilized a third army, and it was still 12 Skeleton Saint Tools that were leading the vanguard.
This was blocked again, but the Imperial Weapons were almost used up.

Every army needed over a dozen Imperial Weapons to suppress, and the third army had already expended close to forty Imperial Weapons. If the Netherworld could still mobilize another army, and still had the Skeleton Saint Tools as the vanguard, how would they be able to block this attack?
This worry… very quickly became a reality.
Sure enough, the Netherworld mobilized a fourth army, with 12 Skeleton Saint Tools leading the vanguard.
This time, the army on this path was unstoppable.
The Yin souls penetrated deeply, like a hot knife through butter.

The only good news was that the invasion of the Yin souls was not very fast, because they had to wait for the Yin Qi to spread out, so that the environment could be transformed. Only then would the territory be truly conquered, or it would be a waste of effort.
With how big the universe was, it would be impossible to completely transform the environment of the Living Realm into the Netherworld without tens of thousands of years or even longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 4560: Embracing River Planet
paragraphs: Chapter 4560: Embracing River Planet
Editor: Henyee Translations
At present, the Netherworld was very powerful, and the Living Realm could not stop them.
Everyone was scrambling their brains to think of a way to stand against the Skeleton Saint Tools.
There was always a way, wasn’t there?
Actually, as long as Buddha Doga appeared, with his cultivation level as a Pseudo-Emperor, he should be able to resist the Skeleton Saint Tools.
However, the Netherworld army continued to advance, and Buddha Doga still didn’t appear.

A great many people were complaining both in the open and secretly, accusing Buddha Doga of being selfish. At such a critical moment, he actually stayed out of it, but even more intelligent people had guessed that the Netherworldhad not sent out the Lord of the Blood Sea and the others.
They were most likely on the same level as Buddha Doga, so they were hindering each other.
Buddha Doga didn’t appear, and neither did the Lord of the Blood Sea and the others.
“Could the skeletal Saint Tools have been created by those from the Blood Sea and Yin River?” Ling Han guessed.
After all, the Netherworld was too barren. It was impossible to find even a single Saintly Material, what more for them to be forged into close to fifty Skeleton Saint Tools.
However, the rulers of the Blood Sea and Yin River had always been in the Living Realm. Moreover, how many Saints were buried inside? Since there were Saints, why didn’t they have Saint Tools?
After refining the Saint Tools for a while, wouldn’t it return to its original form?
“Gasp! Going by that logic, this situation… is far too terrifying!” the large black dog inhaled sharply.

The little azure dragon also nodded in agreement. The Yin River and Blood Sea had most likely existed for an extremely long time. Thus, from such an early age, the Netherworld had already begun to set up the Living Realm?
“Sigh, why did Grandpa Dragon have to be born in this era? Otherwise, Grandpa Dragon could have easily become Emperor!” he exclaimed.

Ling Han frowned. He had never minded the strength of his enemies, and firmly believed that he would be able to surpass them one day. However, at his level, the Celestial Qi that he needed amounted to a bottomless pit, but it just so happened that it was not easy to obtain it now.
—Every battle line had Skeleton Saint Tools standing guard, so how was he supposed to kill Yin souls?
Without the rewards of heaven and earth, he could only depend on the Celestial Qi, but just how difficult would it be to capture the Celestial Qi?
Thus, normally speaking, it was very normal for a Sect Master to spend 20,000 to 30,000 years of hard cultivation to advance into the Venerate Tier. Celestial Qi was too hard to capture.
How could Ling Han have so much time?

“If there is an Imperial Weapon, and there is the aura of the Great Emperor within, it would be able to easily attract the Celestial Qi,” Brother Monkey said. After all, he was a descendant of the Saint Emperor, so he should know some secrets.
Thus, the Imperial Clans didn’t need to worry about not being able to obtain Celestial Qi.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up, “I don’t believe that the bet I made with Yi Taishu really made the Imperial Clans take out all the Celestial Qi.”
Just how deep was the wealth of the Imperial Clans!

The large black dog knew Ling Han best, and he immediately said, “Right now, the various Imperial Clans are all using the Imperial Weapons to fight against the Skeleton Saint Tools. We can seize this opportunity to plunder their home base!”
“Tsk, isn’t that a bit inappropriate?” the little azure dragon said with slight embarrassment. However, his hands that were rubbing together in excitement betrayed him.
“Let’s go!” Brother Monkey was the most decisive, and slung the staff over his shoulder.
“Brother Monkey, don’t be rash. We have to plan which Imperial Clan we should go to. Furthermore, we have to know where it is, right?” Ling Han hurriedly said.

The location of the Imperial Clan had all been created by the Great Emperor in the past. Thus, if it was normal, it would be on a planet, but if it was abnormal, it could possibly be in space, or even in the sun.
“Then, where do we go first?” the little azure dragon asked. As for whether this was being appropriate or not, he had completely forgotten about it.
“The Ziwei Imperial Clan!” Ling Han immediately said without any hesitation.
The Baili Clan had gone too far. Furthermore, they even wanted to marry his future wife. How could he tolerate that?
“All right!” Everyone nodded.
The next problem was… where was the Ziwei Imperial Clan?
Everyone set off to gather information.
Thankfully, the location of the Ziwei Imperial Clan was no secret.
They were an Imperial Clan, one of the most powerful forces in the universe. Was there any need for them to hide the location of their ancestral grounds?
Just ask, who would dare cause trouble?
Without waiting for the Imperial Weapon to show its might, the Imperial Formation would be able to kill them first.
“Now we know where the Ziwei Imperial Clan is, but how do we pass through the imperial formation?” the large black dog said.
This was a huge dilemma. Once the imperial formation was activated, even Saints could only die immediately.
They had not managed to steal the Celestial Qi, and had instead lost their lives.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “I think that the monarch formation should be in a dormant state usually, and would only be truly activated when it encounters an attack.”
For example, if a supreme elite delivered an attack, the great formation would definitely be immediately activated, and block this attack.
But if it was maintained in active mode, how long would this Great Emperor killing formation be able to last?
To be able to kill a Saint, just how terrifying was its might? It was naturally very exhausting.
“So, as long as we don’t cause any damage, we should be able to sneak inside,” Ling Han said in a low voice.

The little azure dragon and the large black dog both bared their teeth. That was because Ling Han had used uncertain words like ‘possible’, ‘should’, or ‘maybe’. Just hearing this was enough to make their b@lls hurt. If they were careless, they would definitely die.
“Brother Monkey, I’ll go with you to investigate the situation first,” Ling Han said.
“All right.” Brother Monkey nodded. He feared nothing in this world. So what if there was a Great Emperor killing formation?
—It was not without reason that the line of the Battle Saint Emperor had few people.
Ling Han sighed. Was he going to complain that he was going further and further on this path of no return?
The two of them set off first, heading towards the Embracing River Planet. This was where the Ziwei Imperial Clan was located.
This was the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan, so it was naturally extraordinary.
Looking down from space, this planet was exuding a purple light, as if it was destined to be great.
If one wanted to go to Embracing River Planet, he had to first apply.
This was the core area of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, so how could others come here so easily?

However, there were too many members of the Imperial Clan, so there was no lack of entertainment. Hence, there was also an endless stream of merchants from all over the universe, delivering large amounts of treasures, ingredients, and Celestial medicines over.

Ling Han and Brother Monkey pretended to be intergalactic merchants. They passed the inspection, and rode the Transfer Formation from an adjacent planet. Very soon, they arrived at the Embracing River Planet.
The moment he exited the Transfer Formation, Ling Han immediately sensed the astonishing power of heaven and earth.
As expected of the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan. If one cultivated here, it would definitely be half the work and double the results.
Of course, this kind of environment was no longer of any help to Ling Han.

The two brothers first pretended to sell something, but the price was too high so naturally, there would be people asking around, but no one made a move, so the two of them could use this as a cover to continue pretending to be doing business, but actually planning a robbery.
No one noticed that Ling Han and Brother Monkey had already quietly circled around the Embracing River Planet.
Ling Han had once attempted to communicate with the ley lines here, but he discovered that the ley lines here were firmly controlled by an even stronger power, and could not possibly be used by him.
Was this the Great Emperor killing formation?
Ling Han didn’t try to forcefully seize control of the ley lines. Firstly, he couldn’t win, and secondly, he couldn’t alert the enemy.
After ten days, they had already gained a basic understanding of this place.

No matter how many members of an Imperial Clan there were, they could not possibly occupy the entire planet. Thus, in truth, the true ancestral grounds of the Baili Clan was located within a great mountain.
Firmament Mountain.

This was a large mountain, so tall that it could reach the clouds. It was the tallest mountain on the Embracing River Planet. It was constantly enshrouded in celestial mist, and outsiders were not allowed to enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 4561: Technique to enter the formation
paragraphs: Chapter 4561: Technique to enter the formation
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and Brother Monkey arrived at the foot of the Firmament Mountain.
In this place, Ling Han immediately felt as if the ley lines of the entire planet had been gathered here, and a slight change could affect the whole planet.

He was astonished. This was because even though the power of the planet was terrifying, it was only on par with the strike of a Saint, at most. Thus, how could it support a Great Emperor killing formation?
This was something that could kill Saints!
Brother Monkey looked ahead, then shook his head, “The killing intent ahead is densely covered. Don’t act rashly.”
Ling Han also channeled his eye technique, and saw a field of incredibly terrifying killing intent.
This was the Great Emperor killing formation!

F***, he had initially thought that maintaining the Great Emperor killing formation would expend an innumerable amount of energy, so it would definitely not be activated under normal circumstances. It would only be activated when the Imperial Clan encountered danger, but from the look of things now, that was not the case.
Strange, to maintain the activation of the Imperial Formation continuously, just how exhausting would that have to be? Why was the Imperial Clan able to afford it?
Was this the so-called background of the Imperial Clan?
If they rashly forged ahead, the Great Emperor killing formation would definitely be activated, and then he and Brother Monkey would die a tragic death.
Brother Monkey was fond of battle, but he wasn’t stupid at all. How could he step forward when he knew that he would definitely die?
He was of the line of the Battle Saint Emperor, so shouldn’t he ignore all dangers and shout a slogan before charging forward every single time?
Ling Han mocked internally, then sighed. Oh no, oh no, why did he like to mock so much recently?
“Let’s retreat first.”

Ling Han and Brother Monkey returned. Don’t even think about barging into the Great Emperor killing formation, and don’t even think about finding any weak points. If the Great Emperor killing formation still had weak points, how could the Great Emperor have such a high status?
“We can’t force our way in.”
“We can only get through with our wits.”
The problem was, how were they supposed to outsmart them?
“The Ziwei Imperial Clan will definitely be able to freely enter and exit the imperial formation. Thus, we can capture one of them and interrogate him.”
They stood guard, and it wasn’t long before they saw a person descend from the Firmament Mountain.
Brother Monkey moved and captured that person.
—If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, wouldn’t it be a piece of cake?
Ling Han searched through this person’s memories.
His name was Baili Aoyun, and though his name was a bit cocky, in truth, he was an unremarkable clansman of the Ziwei Clan1.
However, no matter what, the bloodline of the Imperial Clan flowed in his veins. Thus, he was naturally able to freely enter and exit the core area of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
And there was only one way to safely pass through the imperial formation, and that was to possess the mark of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
This mark… from the day that Baili Aoyun was born, it was branded in his blood by his clan and resonated with his bloodline. Thus, outsiders could not possibly steal this mark.
Then what could they do?
There was another way, and that was for the person who had the mark to bring others through the imperial formation.
Threatening Baili Aoyun to bring them in?
No, as long as he entered into the imperial formation, Baili Aoyun would be able to communicate with the formation, and silently issue a must-kill order, killing Ling Han and Brother Monkey.
Then what could they do?
“Erase his memories from this period of time.”
“This person is extremely fond of beauties, so we can make a move on him from this aspect.”
Ling Han and Brother Monkey exchanged a glance. The corners of their mouths twitched, and a mocking expression appeared on their faces.
Brother Monkey moved, and lightly wiped Baili Aoyun’s head, erasing his memories from when he came out of the imperial formation. Then, with a leap, the two of them disappeared without a trace.
‘Hmm?’
Baili Aoyun suddenly straightened his upper body, and looked dumbly at his surroundings, his eyes very vacant.
‘Why am I here? And why am I lying on the ground?’
He got to his feet, and carefully examined his body. He discovered that he was completely fine from head to toe, and did not suffer the slightest injury.
Strange, too strange.
After being stunned for a while, he finally continued to advance. However, there were still doubts in his mind.
However, he was here to do something, so he quickly put aside his confusion and went to settle the matter first. Then, he began to wander around, acting all arrogant and haughty.

In the ancestral grounds, he was only an insignificant clansman. He would have to bow and nod respectfully no matter who he met, and even if he endured countless more years until his beard had turned white, he was still only a minor character of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.

There was nothing that could be done. He was only a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and had already been stuck for a very, very long time. This should be the strongest he could attain in this lifetime.
However, after leaving the ancestral grounds, he was now a mighty figure who bore the halo of the Ziwei Imperial Clan. Anyone who saw him would have to respectfully address him as Lord Yun.

Thus, he was very fond of going out. Firstly, he could enjoy the glory of being valued and respected by others, and secondly, he was a person who especially liked women. After he came out, he naturally could seek pleasure.
On his way here, he had been called Lord Yun who knew how many times, causing him to be enraptured, completely forgetting his previous confusion.
Yi?
His eyes suddenly lit up, and he stared ahead.
He saw two graceful and extremely beautiful women walking towards him. Even if he had seen many beauties, he still couldn’t help but feel his heart beat faster.𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
They were stunningly beautiful.

He could not hold back the restlessness in his heart, and immediately walked forwards, striking up a conversation, “Two beauties, this must be the first time you have come to the Embracing River Planet, right? Otherwise, with your outstanding beauty, I would definitely remember!”
This ingratiation was a little over the top. With how big the Embracing River Planet was, how many people could you have seen? Furthermore, could you remember clearly all the people you had seen?
But when it came to compliments, who would take it too seriously, or care too much?
However, these two beauties were extremely cold and aloof, and ignored him completely.
Baili Aoyun did not take it to heart at all, because he still had a trump card that he had yet to use.
“I am Baili Aoyun,” he said, a strong pride in his tone.
The Imperial Clan was born to stand proudly above all other clans.

One of the two beauties was dressed in a long blue dress, while the other was dressed in a purple palace dress. At this moment, the woman in the long blue dress said, “So it is a noble descendant of the Imperial Clan!”
It was unclear whether these words were a compliment about his background, or a mockery that he would only use his background to scare others.
Baili Aoyun also hesitated for a moment, then said, “Two Young Misses, how should I address you?”
“Han Ling.”
“Sun Hou.”

“Good name!” Baili Aoyun immediately praised. Since they had struck up a conversation, he began to spout nonsense. In short, he would try his best to curry the favor of these two beauties, and then exaggerate his position in the Imperial Clan Clan.
In this way, these two beauties that had initially been indifferent towards him finally changed their attitudes, and agreed to his invitation to tour the ancestral grounds.
“Please! Please!” He set out with the two beauties, and soon arrived in front of the imperial formation.

“Two beauties, the Great Emperor killing formation is right in front of us. It can even kill Saints,” he said with a hint of arrogance. “Inside this great formation, I have the power to decide life and death. Everyone’s life and death would be decided with a single thought from me.”
This successfully drew the exclamations of surprise from the two beauties, and also made him feel very pleased with himself.

“After entering into the formation, you both have to follow me closely. You must not leave the range of three meters from me, and you must not walk around randomly either, or your lives would be in danger!” Baili Aoyun said seriously.

Baili Aoyun also hesitated for a moment, then said, “Two Young Misses, how should I address you?”
“Han Ling.”
“Sun Hou.”
“Good name!” Baili Aoyun immediately praised.
Since they had struck up a conversation, he began to spout nonsense.
In short, he would try his best to curry the favor of these two beauties, and then exaggerate his position in the Imperial Clan Clan.
In this way, these two beauties that had initially been indifferent towards him finally changed their attitudes, and agreed to his invitation to tour the ancestral grounds.
“Please!
Please!” He set out with the two beauties, and soon arrived in front of the imperial formation.
“Two beauties, the Great Emperor killing formation is right in front of us.
It can even kill Saints,” he said with a hint of arrogance.
“Inside this great formation, I have the power to decide life and death.
Everyone’s life and death would be decided with a single thought from me.”
This successfully drew the exclamations of surprise from the two beauties, and also made him feel very pleased with himself.
“After entering into the formation, you both have to follow me closely.
You must not leave the range of three meters from me, and you must not walk around randomly either, or your lives would be in danger!” Baili Aoyun said seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 4562: Move separately
paragraphs: Chapter 4562: Move separately
Editor: Henyee Translations

The three of them entered into the Great Emperor formation. Baili Aoyun walked in front, and deliberately pretended to be very careful, causing the two beauties to follow closely behind him, making him feel both pleased and proud.
He also walked very slowly. This made the two supreme beauties think of him as their backbone, and the feeling of them completely obeying him was really too wonderful.
However, no matter how large the Great Emperor Formation was, the area it covered was still limited. Very quickly, they had “entered” the great formation.

The Great Emperor Formation was actually a spherical shape that enshrouded the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan in all directions. However, this “sphere” was hollow, and the solid part was the formation area, while the hollow part was the ancestral grounds of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
“Come, follow me.” Baili Aoyun brought the two beauties to his quarters.

Though his status in the clan was not very high, as a member of the Imperial Clan, his living conditions were still quite good. He had a very large courtyard, but it was located in the periphery of the formation, and not in the centre.
—The central area was naturally where the mighty figures of the clan stayed, such as the Saints, Venerates, as well as Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters.

“The two of you must be tired. Hurry up and take a rest.” Baili Aoyun called out, “I have a good hot spring pool here. The two of you can take a bath and wash away the dust on your bodies. Furthermore, it is also extremely beneficial for nourishing the body.”
These two beauties smiled slightly, then changed their appearances at the same time.
Baili Aoyun’s mouth instantly gaped open, revealing an expression of absolute shock.
F***, these were actually two men! It was one thing for them to be men, but one of them was a fur-faced monkey!
Heavens!
Baili Aoyun instantly crumbled. To think that he had wanted to make love with these two beauties before, but now? He was so scared that he directly shrank back, all right?
Not good, he had fallen into a trap!
Although Baili Aoyun’s cultivation level was low, he wasn’t stupid.

He immediately associated it with how he had been lying on the ground for some reason and lost his memories for a period of time. Though it was pitifully short, when he associated it with these two beauties that had suddenly become men, the answer was obvious.
He had been used to help others smuggle themselves in.
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but tremble all over. If these two people were involved in a conspiracy, wouldn’t he become an accomplice?
In this way, he would definitely be implicated!
No, he had to report it immediately.
However, before he could make any sound, he suddenly felt his vision darken, and he had already been knocked unconscious.
“Brother Monkey, let’s go.” Ling Han removed his female attire and changed into his normal attire.
Brother Monkey nodded, and similarly took off his female clothing.
With their strength, how could Baili Aoyun see through their feminine disguise?
Who asked this guy to be so lecherous?
Ling Han covered himself and Brother Monkey with the Void Beast hide. Then, they began to walk around the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan.
This ancestral grounds looked heavily guarded on the outside, but security was relaxed on the inside.
They were already under the protection of the Great Emperor formation, so what was there to be afraid of?
The two of them searched once, and had basically gotten a rough idea of this place.
“There’s a Medicinal Garden in the southeast corner.”
“The treasure chamber is to the west.”
“There’s a cave in the north that’s heavily guarded. It’s probably some Spiritual Spring.”

Originally, it would have been impossible for the Firmament Mountain to have so many natural treasures, but this was something that had been personally created by the Great Emperor. Then, with the abilities of the Great Emperor, how difficult would it be for him to transport some natural treasures?
“There’s a place in the northwest corner that vaguely exudes a terrifying aura.”
“It is highly possible that there is a Saint slumbering within, and cannot be disturbed.”
“Let’s move separately.”
Ling Han and Brother Monkey went their separate ways. Ling Han was responsible for robbing the Medicinal Garden, while Brother Monkey headed to the treasure chamber.
They had to be careful and definitely not alert anyone, because after they were done, they still had to leave quietly with the help of Baili Aoyun.
Otherwise, it would have been impossible for him to tear a rip into space and leave after being enveloped by the Great Emperor Formation.

The two of them split up. Ling Han handed the Void Beast hide to Brother Monkey, while he cast the Strange Shadow Steps. With his current accomplishments, as long as he wasn’t facing a Saint directly, he wouldn’t be discovered at all.
Not long after, the Medicinal Garden was right in front of his eyes.
This place was naturally heavily guarded.
Don’t think that because everyone’s surname was Baili, they were united.

Indeed, when faced with external enemies, they were a united force. However, there would definitely be internal strife within great clans, and it was inevitable that they would be fighting for power and profit. Even the Imperial Clan was no exception to this rule.
Thus, it was very understandable that the treasure chamber and Medicinal Garden were heavily guarded.
It was as if Ling Han had become one with the Void, and he quietly passed under the eyes of the seven guards.
“Yi?” A guard suddenly shivered, “Why do I suddenly feel like my hair is standing on end?”
“Is it because you’ve been sleepong around too much recently that you’re feeling weak?” The other guards beside him immediately laughed at him.
“That’s right. I heard that you have taken another concubine recently?”
“Which number is this? Eleventh?”

“Get lost, I’m as strong as a Primordial Barbaric Bull. To say nothing of thirteen, it is no problem for me to have thirty women in one night!” the guard who had previously shivered declared loudly. Men would definitely not cower in this aspect.
“Hahaha!” This caused the others to laugh loudly.
Ling Han also smiled, and continued onwards.
After entering the Medicinal Garden, it would be a smooth journey.
There were only farmers here, and there were no more guards. Furthermore, there were not many farmers at this time.
Ling Han walked quietly. His eyes were too sharp. Ordinary Celestial medicines were completely beneath his notice.
If he wanted to steal, he would have to steal a top-grade Great Herb, or at least, a Venerate Tier-level Great Herb. It would be best if it was a Saint Herb.
He searched around, and not long after, he saw masses of Venerate Tier-level Great Herbs.
“F*ck! These are all mother tree-level treasures!”
Ling Han was stunned. What was the mother tree? A planet could only nurture one, and was the source of all the Celestial medicines on this planet.
However, in this place, there were many mother trees.
This was completely illogical!

“This involves the Great Emperor, so even if it doesn’t make sense, it does make sense now,” Ling Han said with a sigh. This was definitely the Great Emperor’s doing. It was definitely because of this that he had managed to plant so many mother trees in the same area.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
He sensed for a while, and couldn’t help but feel even more stunned.
“Underneath each mother tree is a portion of the planet’s Source Power!”

Ling Han finally understood. The Great Emperor’s power was truly incredible. While transplanting the mother tree, he had also extracted a portion of the corresponding life force of the planet. Thus, theoretically speaking, he could complete the transplant of the mother tree.
Of course, if a Saint did such a thing, even if they could extract a portion of the planet’s Source Power, it would definitely be unable to support the mother tree.
—Otherwise, there would not be just one mother tree in the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Transplantation was one matter, and raising them was another matter altogether. For the moment, this was something that only the Great Emperor could do.
Ling Han faltered upon this. It was as if he suddenly understood.
Why were they not afraid that the Great Emperor killing formation would expend energy excessively? Was it supported by an endless supply of Source Power?
With the abilities of the Great Emperor, he was completely capable of refining planets, shrinking them into a small ball, and becoming the source of energy for the imperial formation.
Planets were a body of their own, and they could extract energy from the universe. Unless the planet died of old age, they would never have to worry about running out of energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4563: Great Sweep
paragraphs: Chapter 4563: Great Sweep
Editor: Henyee Translations
That should be the case.

Ling Han nodded. However, even if he understood this kind of thing — even if anyone knew about it, they would not be qualified to imitate it, because refining a planet was something that only the Great Emperor could do.
No matter how awesome a Saint was, they would only be able to shatter a planet.
But why don’t you try having a Saint destroy a sun?
Impossible!

It was not that the Saint did not have this kind of ability, but rather that when the sun crumbled, the shockwave of energy created by that terrifying explosion was similarly capable of killing the Saint.
This was just like how Venerates could destroy planets, yet didn’t dare to.
Destroying it was one matter, and keeping himself out of it at the same time was another matter.
“I’ll take them all!”

Ling Han’s eyes shone. There were a great many Great Herbs here that were incredibly valuable, and could revive the dead or regrow severed limbs. Of course, there were also some that contained Celestial Qi, and they were seven or eight stars at that.
He quickly made his move. Not only did he pluck the ripened celestial fruits and Celestial medicines, even if they weren’t mature enough, he also dug them out along with the life force of the planet.
If he could grow them, then he would. If he couldn’t, then he couldn’t allow them to benefit the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
In a short while, all the Venerate Tier-level Great Herbs were swept clean by him.
He set up another illusion-type formation. As long as one did not touch it, what others saw was a scene of prosperity. There was definitely not a single Great Herb that had disappeared.
Then, he continued onwards.
The Venerate Tier-level Great Herbsswept clean, and it was now the Saintly medicine’s turn.
After walking for a while longer, he arrived at the Saintly medicine zone.
Compared to the masses of Venerate Tier Great Herbs, there were pitifully few Saintly medicines. At most, there were only nine.

Some were low-rise fruit trees that bore vermillion fruits, some were as large as dragon’s eyes, and some were as small as grains of rice; some were lotus flowers that bloomed with a refreshing fragrance; there were also old purple-red vines that bore a small bunch of grapes…
I’m rich! I’m rich!
Ling Han rubbed his hands together, unable to conceal his excitement.

He reached over and plucked all of the Saint Fruits, regardless of whether they were ripe or not. If there were no fruits, he would pluck the flowers that had bloomed. Swallowing them raw should have some effects, though it would be slightly inferior.
However, it was a shame that he didn’t dare to excavate the Saintly medicine. The Source Power of the planet was far too terrifying, so it would definitely cause a huge commotion once it was removed.
Before he left, this naturally could not be allowed.
Forget it. He could always come back in the future.
He set up a formation to restore the appearance of this place.
Just as he finished, he sensed three people approach.
Ling Han hurriedly used the Strange Shadow Steps and fled into the Void.
The three people who had come were all very young. They were two men and one woman respectively.
They arrived at the Saintly medicine area, and immediately sat down in a cross-legged position, as if they were cultivating.

Realization dawned on Ling Han. As the Saintly medicine grew, not only would it exude a little bit of medicinal power, it would be greatly nutritious for cultivators. Furthermore, it would also extract the Regulations of heaven and earth as nutrients. In this process, it was very possible to glimpse the essence of Regulations.
Thus, there were great benefits to cultivating beside the Saintly medicine.
From this, it could be seen that these three people should be well-known figures among the rising stars of the Baili Clan. Otherwise, they would not be qualified to cultivate here.
However…
“Yi, don’t you guys feel that the energy you absorbed today is a little weak?” Among the three of them, the man in purple suddenly spoke up.
“I thought I was mistaken. So you have also sensed it?” The red-clothed woman nodded, showing an expression of surprise.
“Me too.” Finally, the man in green nodded as well.

The three of them were all at a loss. What was going on? The cultivation area near the Saintly medicine Pill was rich in energy, and it was also very easy to sense the Regulations. It was the best place to cultivate, so why had its effects suddenly declined sharply?

Since Baili Che was crippled, and Baili Yun was killed, there was still Baili Tian, a Golden Generation, to hold up the fort. However, the Ziwei Imperial Clan had a severe lapse in their Imperial Sons, and there was an urgent need to select new young clansmen to replace them.
Everyone wanted to become the Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter. Once they were chosen, the benefits they would receive were practically unimaginable!
—How fortunate would it be to be nurtured with the full efforts of the clan?
Thus, the competition was far too intense.

“It must be that the person who cultivated here last time was too ruthless. In fact, he even used some secret technique and absorbed the power of the Saintly medicine, causing the Saintly medicine to be damaged. That’s why this situation happened,” the purple-robed man said.
“That’s right. No wonder Baili Mo has suddenly become so much stronger. It must be him!” The man in green clapped his hands.
The purple-robed man and red-clothed woman rolled their eyes. Even if you can’t beat Baili Mo, why don’t you look for the reason behind your own weakness first?
However, it was true that the quality of the environment had declined a little too much.
“Let’s first use up all the time we have to cultivate, then go and report the situation!”
A smile tugged at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. If he had a negative energy system, he would definitely be making a fortune now.
Fine, you guys go ahead and discuss slowly.

Ling Han left quietly. He needed to hurry up. After these three people returned to make their report, there would definitely be people investigating the situation. Then, the matter of the Saintly medicine being stolen would immediately be exposed. If he and Brother Monkey wanted to leave again, that would be very, very difficult.
He planned to take another look. There were still a few corners that he had yet to check out. Since he was already here, he definitely had to take a closer look.
Moreover, these three people were still cultivating, so it would take at least a day or so.
There was no need to be too anxious.
Ling Han continued to search around. After searching for a while, he was only left with the last corner.
But when he arrived here, he discovered that there was actually someone standing guard.
Furthermore, this was actually a Venerate!
‘What?’
Ling Han was astonished. A Venerate Tier had deliberately stood guard here?

Previously, where the Venerate Tier-level Great Herbs and Saintly medicines, it was completely out in the open and unguarded, and others could still be allowed to cultivate in their proximity and absorb some benefits. Why was it in this place, a Venerate Tier was standing guard?
Ling Han carefully observed for a while. Though this Venerate’s aura was reserved, under his eye technique, the depth of his cultivation level could not be hidden.
A Nine Star Venerate Tier!
Having reached this kind of cultivation level, there was already no meaning to cultivate diligently. Instead, he had to study the Heavenly Dao to light up the holy flame.
There were only two ways to ignite the holy flame. The first was to gather enough power of belief, and the second was to have an absolute grasp of the Heavenly Dao and forcibly ignite it.
Yi?

He couldn’t help but think back to how the Ziwei Imperial Clan had sent the old Venerate Tier of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire to recover lost territory. Their purpose was to harvest the power of belief, because they had an old Venerate that was about to break through.
It couldn’t be this person, right?
Was the power of belief not enough?

But if it wasn’t enough, what are you staying in the Medicinal Garden for? Shouldn’t you manifest miracles everywhere to strengthen the faith of your citizens, or open up new territory and conquer more believers?
Could it be that… sitting here could strengthen the appreciation of Heavenly Dao?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a jolt in his heart. What kind of Celestial medicine had been planted in this last corner? They actually had to send a Venerate to stand guard?
He definitely had to go in and take a look.
Ling Han quietly walked forwards. Under the effects of the Strange Shadow Steps, he did not arouse the slightest ripple of Regulations.
“En?” That Venerate suddenly opened his eyes, and looked towards where Ling Han was.

However, the Ziwei Imperial Clan had a severe lapse in their Imperial Sons, and there was an urgent need to select new young clansmen to replace them.
Everyone wanted to become the Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter.
Once they were chosen, the benefits they would receive were practically unimaginable!
—How fortunate would it be to be nurtured with the full efforts of the clan?
Thus, the competition was far too intense.
“It must be that the person who cultivated here last time was too ruthless.
In fact, he even used some secret technique and absorbed the power of the Saintly medicine, causing the Saintly medicine to be damaged.
That’s why this situation happened,” the purple-robed man said.
“That’s right.
No wonder Baili Mo has suddenly become so much stronger.
It must be him!” The man in green clapped his hands.
The purple-robed man and red-clothed woman rolled their eyes.
Even if you can’t beat Baili Mo, why don’t you look for the reason behind your own weakness first?
However, it was true that the quality of the environment had declined a little too much.
“Let’s first use up all the time we have to cultivate, then go and report the situation!”
A smile tugged at the corners of Ling Han’s lips.
If he had a negative energy system, he would definitely be making a fortune now.
Fine, you guys go ahead and discuss slowly.
Ling Han left quietly.
He needed to hurry up.
After these three people returned to make their report, there would definitely be people investigating the situation.
Then, the matter of the Saintly medicine being stolen would immediately be exposed.
If he and Brother Monkey wanted to leave again, that would be very, very difficult.
He planned to take another look.
There were still a few corners that he had yet to check out.
Since he was already here, he definitely had to take a closer look.
Moreover, these three people were still cultivating, so it would take at least a day or so.
There was no need to be too anxious.
Ling Han continued to search around.
After searching for a while, he was only left with the last corner.
But when he arrived here, he discovered that there was actually someone standing guard.
Furthermore, this was actually a Venerate!
‘What?’
Ling Han was astonished.
A Venerate Tier had deliberately stood guard here?

Previously, where the Venerate Tier-level Great Herbs and Saintly medicines, it was completely out in the open and unguarded, and others could still be allowed to cultivate in their proximity and absorb some benefits.
Why was it in this place, a Venerate Tier was standing guard?
Ling Han carefully observed for a while.
Though this Venerate’s aura was reserved, under his eye technique, the depth of his cultivation level could not be hidden.
A Nine Star Venerate Tier!
Having reached this kind of cultivation level, there was already no meaning to cultivate diligently.
Instead, he had to study the Heavenly Dao to light up the holy flame.
There were only two ways to ignite the holy flame.
The first was to gather enough power of belief, and the second was to have an absolute grasp of the Heavenly Dao and forcibly ignite it.
Yi?
He couldn’t help but think back to how the Ziwei Imperial Clan had sent the old Venerate Tier of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire to recover lost territory.
Their purpose was to harvest the power of belief, because they had an old Venerate that was about to break through.
It couldn’t be this person, right?
Was the power of belief not enough?
But if it wasn’t enough, what are you staying in the Medicinal Garden for?
Shouldn’t you manifest miracles everywhere to strengthen the faith of your citizens, or open up new territory and conquer more believers?
Could it be that… sitting here could strengthen the appreciation of Heavenly Dao?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a jolt in his heart.
What kind of Celestial medicine had been planted in this last corner?
They actually had to send a Venerate to stand guard?
He definitely had to go in and take a look.
Ling Han quietly walked forwards.
Under the effects of the Strange Shadow Steps, he did not arouse the slightest ripple of Regulations.
“En?” That Venerate suddenly opened his eyes, and looked towards where Ling Han was.

chapters.title: Chapter 4564: Weed
paragraphs: Chapter 4564: Weed
Editor: Henyee Translations
This Venerate was called Baili Chuixue.
Being able to become a Venerate, even in the Imperial Clan, was extremely impressive, and required astonishing natural talent in cultivation.

Furthermore, Baili Chuixue had already glimpsed the hope of becoming a Saint, but he was still a little bit away from reaching that level. He would either have to improve further in his appreciation of the Heavenly Dao, or have a little more power of belief, and he would be able to light up the holy flame.

In truth, the power of belief was already more or less enough. The reason why he had not begun to attempt breaking through to Saint Tier was because if he used his own power to light up the holy flame, the Saint that he would become would be even stronger.
This was already the last step, so he naturally couldn’t be too rash. He had to pursue greater strength.
—To him, this was definitely the last step. Becoming Emperor? Heh, that was impossible.
As a nine-star Venerate, and as someone who was actually close to having one foot into Saint Tier, he was extremely sensitive to auras.
He looked at where Ling Han was, and a suspicious expression appeared on his face.

Instinct told him that there was something off about where he was looking, but as far as his eyes could see, and as far as his divine sense could sense, everything told him that there was absolutely no problem.
What was going on here?
He did not understand.
“Could it be that I have a misconception because I want to break through too much?” Baili Chuixue frowned, and found a reason for himself.
He closed his eyes again, but right at this moment, he stretched out his hand at the same time, grabbing out at the place that he had previously been looking at.
There was nothing!
Only then did Baili Chuixue confirm that he had been mistaken. He began to close his eyes and sense again.
Ling Han pursed his lips. Just now, he had changed his position at the first instant, and just happened to dodge this blow from Baili Chuixue.
He had almost been pierced through!
As expected of someone who was about to step into Saint Tier. This intuition was really frightening.
He had to leave.
Ling Han circled around Baili Chuixue from afar, and entered into the last area of the Medicinal Garden.
However… this place was far too ordinary.
Ling Han was surprised. This was just an ordinary piece of soil, and there was no Celestial medicine planted at all. The majority of the place was empty, and only a weed grew at the extreme corners.
F***, what need was there to guard this place? Furthermore, a Venerate Tier elite had been mobilized!
Ling Han was just about to leave, but he immediately faltered.
This was the Medicinal Garden, and with the rich nature of the Imperial Clan, plants that were qualified to be planted here were Celestial medicines that were at least Four Stars and above.
Why waste a piece of land?
Furthermore, how could there possibly be weeds here?
With a thought from Ling Han, he headed towards that weed.
This really was a weed. It was very ordinary, and there was nothing unusual about it at all.
Had the Imperial Clan been careless, and allowed a weed to grow out of this place?

However, the Medicinal Garden was an important place, and there had always been farmers there to take care of it. How could there be any that slipped through the net? Moreover, there was still a Venerate Tier standing guard here.
Ling Han carefully observed this weed again, and not long after, his expression gradually became solemn.
At present, this blade of grass only had two leaves, but what surprised Ling Han was that these two leaves were actually exactly the same.
Every detail, including the veined pattern!
How was this possible?
There were definitely no two identical flowers, two identical people, or two identical leaves in this world.
Strange.

The veined patterns on these leaves were actually very simple. A main vein ran from the stem of the leaf all the way to the tip of the leaf, and nine more branches grew from the main vein, as if they were tributaries.
But as he watched, Ling Han felt as if he had suddenly seen Heavenly Dao.
That’s right, it was the Heavenly Dao.
It was the main vein of that leaf, and the Heavenly Dao manifested, gaining all kinds of Regulations.
Of course, this leaf only had nine branches now, and was far from being as abundant as the number of Regulations in real life.

In his shock, he hurriedly regained his senses, because he discovered that this leaf was incredibly captivating to his soul. It was as if he could look at it forever, disregarding time, right until his death.
No wonder that Venerate Tier merely stood guard outside and didn’t come in. He was probably afraid that under his full concentration, his soul would be lost forever.
Ling Han was astonished. Just how powerful and perfect was his divine sense? Yet, he was actually engrossed?
This blade of grass… was Saint Tier?
No, if it was Saint Grade, why wasn’t it planted together with the Saintly medicines from before?
But if it was not the Saintly medicine, could it be that it was a Great Emperor-level medicine?
Was there something like an Emperor-level medicine?
This was a Spirit Herb that had been nurtured by heaven and earth. At its peak, it was Saint Grade, but there was no Imperial Herb.

There were indeed treasured medicines that could extend the lifespan of a Great Emperor. In fact, there were even those that could allow one to live a second life. However, those were the peak grade medicines among Saintly medicines. Furthermore, the fact that they could allow one to live a second life was not entirely due to the effects of the treasured medicines. Part of the reason was also because of the Great Emperor’s own heaven-defying strength.
F***, then what exactly was this?
Should he dig it out?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Who cares what grade it was? He would just dig it up and take it away.
‘F*ck!’
He was just about to put it into action. However, just as his hand touched the dirt, he immediately sensed a terrifyingly powerful aura, causing him to feel powerless and unable to continue.
Hiss!
That feeling was as if he had touched the body of a Great Emperor.
Imperial Weapon?
No, the Great Emperor killing formation.
The core of the Great Emperor killing formation was here?

Ling Han suddenly had a guess. In truth, he had not walked out of the Great Emperor killing formation, but had rather walked in. Thus, it was naturally nothing strange for the core of the Great Emperor killing formation to appear here.
He couldn’t move. Otherwise, the Great Emperor killing formation would activate and easily kill him.
Ling Han retreated, and quickly left.
Just as he was about to leave, he turned around to take a look, committing the appearance of this mysterious herb to memory. Then, he left resolutely.
He returned to Baili Aoyun’s quarters, and after waiting for a while, Brother Monkey also returned.
“How’s your harvest?” Ling Han asked.
Brother Monkey bared his teeth in a grin, “As expected of Ziwei Imperial Clan. My gains are astonishing.”

“I have also harvested a great many Celestial medicines. Furthermore, I have also discovered a stalk of mysterious herb.” Ling Han said. Then, he related the matter of that Venerate Tier guarding the mysterious herb.
Brother Monkey was also extremely surprised. Being guarded by a Venerate Tier, and being able to make people be completely enraptured, how could it possibly be an ordinary weed?
However, there was not much time left, and it was not enough for him to observe as well.
“It’s time to leave.”
The two of them changed their appearance again, and changed into women’s clothing, then woke Baili Aoyun up.
Of course, another part of his memory had been erased.
“Yi, when did I sleep on the bed?” Baili Aoyun was very confused. He didn’t remember such a thing happening.
Moreover, he had brought two beauties back, so shouldn’t he be enjoying himself? Why did he have to lie on the bed alone? What a waste.
However, the two beauties were extremely anxious, and said that they had something important to attend to.

There was nothing else that could be done. He could only escort them out first. In any case, there was still a lot of time. With his identity as a member of the Imperial Clan, how could it be that it would be too difficult for him to tempt them into bed?
The three of them set out, and soon exited the imperial formation.
Peng, Baili Aoyun once again fell onto the ground without a doubt.
“Let’s go!”
Brother Monkey directly tore a rip into space, and left with Ling Han.
Since they had left, they naturally did not care. So what if they were discovered? They could come chase after them, if they could.
However, this slight fluctuation was too small, and did not draw the attention of the Ziwei Imperial Clan at all.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey successfully returned.

chapters.title: Chapter 4565: Wedding date
paragraphs: Chapter 4565: Wedding date
Editor: Henyee Translations
After returning, it was naturally time to go through their spoils.

The resources of the Imperial Clan were indeed astonishing. Though the Ziwei Imperial Clan definitely had treasure chambers in other places, where they stored some treasures, as well as Medicinal Gardens, they definitely couldn’t compare to the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan.
Even if all of them were added together, they would probably be inferior by more than a little.
Thus, Ling Han and Brother Monkey had really profited greatly this time. Who knew how many generations the Ziwei Imperial Clan had accumulated these treasures.
Unfortunately, he did not manage to obtain the Imperial Scroll from the Baili Clan.
Otherwise, if Ling Han and Brother Monkey had the chance to control the Ziwei Imperial Clan’s Imperial Weapon, then the Ziwei Imperial Clan would be in big trouble.

One after another, alchemical pills were concocted. Brother Monkey’s strength rapidly increased, and soon reached Nine Star Venerate Tier. Next, Brother Monkey no longer needed Celestial Qi, but rather appreciation of the Heavenly Dao.
To ignite the holy flame and become a Saint!𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Ling Han believed that Brother Monkey didn’t need the power of belief to complete this step. However, how much time it would take would depend on Brother Monkey’s good fortune.
It could be one or two years, or it could be hundreds or thousands of years. In fact, it wouldn’t be strange even if it took tens of thousands of years.

Ling Han was also furiously ingesting Celestial pills, but his body was like a bottomless pit. No matter how much Celestial Qi entered his body, he would still absorb it all. There was no sign that he would not be able to absorb it.
When all the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills had been consumed, Ling Han had just barely reached the end of Fourteen Stars.
He began to break through to Fifteen Stars.
This time, he almost died.
He charged towards Fifteen Stars, but did not manage to charge through. The terrifying power was rebounded back, almost shattering his mind.
Ling Han rested for half a year before finally recovering.
And in this period of time, the news of the Ziwei Imperial Clan being visited by a mysterious thief and their entire chamber of treasures being robbed was not concealed, and quietly spread out.
The Galaxy Network shuddered.
Who would be so outrageously bold to actually dare to steal treasures from the Ziwei Imperial Clan? Moreover, they had succeeded.
Could it be that it was a Saint?
No, no, no. Even Saints would die if they entered the Great Emperor killing formation.
Then was it a Pseudo-Emperor?
If Buddha Doga moved, there was still a chance that he could block the Great Emperor killing formation… right?
However, the Ziwei Imperial Clan had not been invaded. Instead, they had been robbed by thieves!
That definitely wasn’t Buddha Doga. For someone as powerful as the Pseudo-Emperor, was there any need to act in such a sneaky manner?
Thus, the people on the Galaxy Network were all speculating about just how awesome it was to actually steal from the Imperial Clan.
Very soon, the large black dog stepped out, and spoke on the Galaxy Network, “Grandpa Dog hereby announces that I am responsible for the theft of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.”
Instantly, this caused a heated discussion on the Galaxy Network.
The large black dog had an incredibly close relationship with Ling Han. Thus, with the large black dog’s words, it was equivalent to leading the clues to Ling Han.
Was it Ling Han’s doing?
Hiss, this guy was really not afraid of trouble.

You see, Baili Tian had just said that he wanted to marry Chi Menghan as his wife, and in the end? Ling Han had first fought with Baili Tian, and as a Sect Master, he was able to withstand a Golden Generation that was on the level of Seven Star Venerate Tier. Then, he made a public declaration, expressing that he would take Chi Menghan away from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
This kind of provocation practically caused Baili Tian to lose all face, all right?
Not only that, but they had even directly robbed the ancestral grounds of Baili Tian.
Impressive!
Thus, everyone could only admit that they were impressed.

Indeed, now that the Netherworld had invaded, the interior of the Imperial Clans were empty. However, no matter how empty it was, there would definitely be one or two Saints left behind to keep watch. Added with the Great Emperor killing formation, it was practically impregnable.
How could someone sneak in and practically ransack the entire residence?
Hehe.
The Ziwei Imperial Clan instantly became a huge joke. A great many people began to wonder if this Imperial Clan was not living up to its name?
Immediately, some people who were blind went to provoke them, and the result was naturally incredibly tragic.

After a great many people died, everyone was certain that the Ziwei Imperial Clan was still the Ziwei Imperial Clan, one of the most powerful forces in the world. It was completely because Ling Han was too powerful that the Ziwei Imperial Clan was humiliated.

Originally, Ling Han had already gradually disappeared without a trace. After all, he was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, so he could not possibly attract the constant attention of others. Only those who could become Emperor like the Golden Generation, Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu and the others could endlessly create topics of conversation, and engender discussion.
But what was the result?
Ling Han would usually silent, but would shake the world abruptly with a single feat.
Robbing an Imperial Clan clean, was there a second person that could do it?

Meanwhile, the Ziwei Imperial Clan, who had become the butt of jokes, appeared extremely silent. They actually didn’t say anything crazy, such as telling Ling Han to bring the stolen treasures and plead guilty, or saying anything about killing Ling Han’s entire family.
They remained silent, as if nothing had happened.
This made everyone feel strange. This kind of reaction was completely not the style of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
How domineering was the Imperial Clan? They thought they were the number one in the world, and it had only ever been them bullying others. How could they keep quiet after suffering a loss?
How strange.
However, only a month had passed, and the Ziwei Imperial Clan suddenly released news that Baili Tian would marry Chi Menghan after a hundred years.
When this news spread out, the whole world was shocked.
The Ziwei Imperial Clan’s counterattack arrived.
Wasn’t Ling Han very capable? But look, your woman is about to marry and become someone else’s wife.
If you have the ability, then come and make a fuss at the wedding.
As a mere Sect Master, if he dared to appear in public, what else could it be but courting death?
Why a hundred years later?
There was subsequent news that Baili Tian had already cultivated to Nine Star Venerate Tier, and was about to ignite the holy flame and advance into Saint Tier.
At that time, Baili Tian would become a Saint, and in his strongest state, he would kill Ling Han, who had come to cause trouble. Wouldn’t that be the best way to vent his anger?
He himself had died, and the woman he loved had married his enemy. Even if he became a ghost, he would not be able to live in peace.
Thus, this was the ultimate move of revenge that the Ziwei Imperial Clan had been preparing for a long time.
In reality, even if the Ziwei Imperial Clan wanted to kill Ling Han to vent their anger, could they do so? Where would they find him?
However, no matter how freakish Baili Tian was, it was still extremely difficult for him to become a Saint.
It may take fifty years, or it may take eighty years, but that was really uncertain.
Thus, what if Baili Tian was still unable to become a Saint if he boasted that he would become a Saint in 50 years? Wouldn’t that be slapping himself in the face?
If it was a hundred years, this time should be enough.
“A hundred years!”
Ling Han murmured to himself as he gazed into the distance. A smile slowly tugged at the corners of his lips.

In 100 years, even if he didn’t become a Saint, he would at least be able to cultivate to the level of Nine Star Venerate Tier. Moreover, with his freakish talent, Baili Tian wouldn’t necessarily be a match for him even if he became a Saint.
Ling Han tried to tear open the black chains on the fruit of cultivation, but discovered that he still lacked a little more strength.
“Thus, the key is whether or not I can break through to Fifteen Stars.”

“Once I break through to Fifteen Stars, I will be able to break through the restrictions of this heaven and earth, and this, I am sure, is also the pinnacle of Sect Master-level. It is impossible that there would be Sixteen Stars after that.”
Ling Han pulled himself together, and once again charged towards Fifteen Stars.
However, he still ended in failure, as if this was an impossible feat.
In truth, to say nothing of Fifteen Stars, above Nine Stars, which cultivation level had ever been reached before?
Fifteen Stars was as difficult as ascending the heavens!
