To ignite the holy flame and become a Saint!𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Ling Han believed that Brother Monkey didn’t need the power of belief to complete this step.
However, how much time it would take would depend on Brother Monkey’s good fortune.
It could be one or two years, or it could be hundreds or thousands of years.
In fact, it wouldn’t be strange even if it took tens of thousands of years.
Ling Han was also furiously ingesting Celestial pills, but his body was like a bottomless pit.
No matter how much Celestial Qi entered his body, he would still absorb it all.
There was no sign that he would not be able to absorb it.
When all the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pills had been consumed, Ling Han had just barely reached the end of Fourteen Stars.
He began to break through to Fifteen Stars.
This time, he almost died.
He charged towards Fifteen Stars, but did not manage to charge through.
The terrifying power was rebounded back, almost shattering his mind.
Ling Han rested for half a year before finally recovering.
And in this period of time, the news of the Ziwei Imperial Clan being visited by a mysterious thief and their entire chamber of treasures being robbed was not concealed, and quietly spread out.
The Galaxy Network shuddered.
Who would be so outrageously bold to actually dare to steal treasures from the Ziwei Imperial Clan?
Moreover, they had succeeded.
Could it be that it was a Saint?
No, no, no.
Even Saints would die if they entered the Great Emperor killing formation.
Then was it a Pseudo-Emperor?
If Buddha Doga moved, there was still a chance that he could block the Great Emperor killing formation… right?
However, the Ziwei Imperial Clan had not been invaded.
Instead, they had been robbed by thieves!
That definitely wasn’t Buddha Doga.
For someone as powerful as the Pseudo-Emperor, was there any need to act in such a sneaky manner?
Thus, the people on the Galaxy Network were all speculating about just how awesome it was to actually steal from the Imperial Clan.
Very soon, the large black dog stepped out, and spoke on the Galaxy Network, “Grandpa Dog hereby announces that I am responsible for the theft of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.”
Instantly, this caused a heated discussion on the Galaxy Network.
The large black dog had an incredibly close relationship with Ling Han.
Thus, with the large black dog’s words, it was equivalent to leading the clues to Ling Han.
Was it Ling Han’s doing?
Hiss, this guy was really not afraid of trouble.
You see, Baili Tian had just said that he wanted to marry Chi Menghan as his wife, and in the end?
Ling Han had first fought with Baili Tian, and as a Sect Master, he was able to withstand a Golden Generation that was on the level of Seven Star Venerate Tier.
Then, he made a public declaration, expressing that he would take Chi Menghan away from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
This kind of provocation practically caused Baili Tian to lose all face, all right?
Not only that, but they had even directly robbed the ancestral grounds of Baili Tian.
Impressive!
Thus, everyone could only admit that they were impressed.
Indeed, now that the Netherworld had invaded, the interior of the Imperial Clans were empty.
However, no matter how empty it was, there would definitely be one or two Saints left behind to keep watch.
Added with the Great Emperor killing formation, it was practically impregnable.
How could someone sneak in and practically ransack the entire residence?
Hehe.
The Ziwei Imperial Clan instantly became a huge joke.
A great many people began to wonder if this Imperial Clan was not living up to its name?
Immediately, some people who were blind went to provoke them, and the result was naturally incredibly tragic.
After a great many people died, everyone was certain that the Ziwei Imperial Clan was still the Ziwei Imperial Clan, one of the most powerful forces in the world.
It was completely because Ling Han was too powerful that the Ziwei Imperial Clan was humiliated.
Originally, Ling Han had already gradually disappeared without a trace.
After all, he was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, so he could not possibly attract the constant attention of others.
Only those who could become Emperor like the Golden Generation, Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu and the others could endlessly create topics of conversation, and engender discussion.
But what was the result?
Ling Han would usually silent, but would shake the world abruptly with a single feat.
Robbing an Imperial Clan clean, was there a second person that could do it?
Meanwhile, the Ziwei Imperial Clan, who had become the butt of jokes, appeared extremely silent.
They actually didn’t say anything crazy, such as telling Ling Han to bring the stolen treasures and plead guilty, or saying anything about killing Ling Han’s entire family.
They remained silent, as if nothing had happened.
This made everyone feel strange.
This kind of reaction was completely not the style of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
How domineering was the Imperial Clan?
They thought they were the number one in the world, and it had only ever been them bullying others.
How could they keep quiet after suffering a loss?
How strange.
However, only a month had passed, and the Ziwei Imperial Clan suddenly released news that Baili Tian would marry Chi Menghan after a hundred years.
When this news spread out, the whole world was shocked.
The Ziwei Imperial Clan’s counterattack arrived.
Wasn’t Ling Han very capable?
But look, your woman is about to marry and become someone else’s wife.
If you have the ability, then come and make a fuss at the wedding.
As a mere Sect Master, if he dared to appear in public, what else could it be but courting death?
Why a hundred years later?
There was subsequent news that Baili Tian had already cultivated to Nine Star Venerate Tier, and was about to ignite the holy flame and advance into Saint Tier.
At that time, Baili Tian would become a Saint, and in his strongest state, he would kill Ling Han, who had come to cause trouble.
Wouldn’t that be the best way to vent his anger?
He himself had died, and the woman he loved had married his enemy.
Even if he became a ghost, he would not be able to live in peace.
Thus, this was the ultimate move of revenge that the Ziwei Imperial Clan had been preparing for a long time.
In reality, even if the Ziwei Imperial Clan wanted to kill Ling Han to vent their anger, could they do so?
Where would they find him?
However, no matter how freakish Baili Tian was, it was still extremely difficult for him to become a Saint.
It may take fifty years, or it may take eighty years, but that was really uncertain.
Thus, what if Baili Tian was still unable to become a Saint if he boasted that he would become a Saint in 50 years?
Wouldn’t that be slapping himself in the face?
If it was a hundred years, this time should be enough.
“A hundred years!”
Ling Han murmured to himself as he gazed into the distance.
A smile slowly tugged at the corners of his lips.
In 100 years, even if he didn’t become a Saint, he would at least be able to cultivate to the level of Nine Star Venerate Tier.
Moreover, with his freakish talent, Baili Tian wouldn’t necessarily be a match for him even if he became a Saint.
Ling Han tried to tear open the black chains on the fruit of cultivation, but discovered that he still lacked a little more strength.
“Thus, the key is whether or not I can break through to Fifteen Stars.”
“Once I break through to Fifteen Stars, I will be able to break through the restrictions of this heaven and earth, and this, I am sure, is also the pinnacle of Sect Master-level.
It is impossible that there would be Sixteen Stars after that.”
Ling Han pulled himself together, and once again charged towards Fifteen Stars.
However, he still ended in failure, as if this was an impossible feat.
In truth, to say nothing of Fifteen Stars, above Nine Stars, which cultivation level had ever been reached before?
Fifteen Stars was as difficult as ascending the heavens!

chapters.title: Chapter 4566: Fifteen Stars!
paragraphs: Chapter 4566: Fifteen Stars!
Editor: Henyee Translations
After Ling Han recovered from his injuries, he continued to charge towards Fifteen Stars.
Once, twice, thrice… he kept failing, and every time he failed, not only would it be an incredibly painful experience, it would also damage his life force.
This was fatal. If it accumulated to a certain extent, to say nothing of breaking through, he would lose his life.
However, this was the only path that he could take.
Without breaking through to Fifteen Stars, he would not be able to tear off the shackles of the fruit of cultivation, and thus break through to Venerate Tier.
If he was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, then there was naturally no need to mention anything else.
So what if he was the strongest Sect Master in history, how could this be something that Ling Han wanted to pursue?
If he didn’t succeed, he would die trying.
Ling Han wasn’t rash. Instead, he forged on slowly and steadily. Before every breakthrough, he would summarize his experience of failing last time. He couldn’t fail twice in the same ditch.
However, he was still failing, and the damage to his life force was becoming more and more serious.
Pu! Ling Han spat out a mouthful of blood. He had failed again.
“The remaining life force… is only enough for another attempt.”
“If I fail again, then I’m done for.”
“As expected of the shackle of heaven and earth.”
“I have been forced into desperate straits.”
Ling Han murmured under his breath. Although he was saying that he was going to die, his eyes were extremely bright.
After so many failures, he finally had some confidence.
“Next time, there is a fifty-fifty chance. There’s a fifty-fifty chance of ascending to the heavens, and a fifty-fifty chance of going to hell.”
Ling Han began to recuperate, and this time, he used a whole three years’ time.
Aside from the fact that his life force had been severely damaged, he had already adjusted his condition to his strongest state.
“Come!”
He was resolute, and began the final attempt to break through to Fifteen Stars.
If he failed this time, he would forever lose the chance to attempt breaking through to Fifteen Stars. In fact, he would very quickly die due to the severe wilting of his life force.
However, he didn’t care.
If he didn’t become Emperor, what difference would he be from a commoner? What difference would living for tens of thousands of years be from a salted fish1?
He sat upright. Boom, the power in his body surged rapidly, right until it was boiling. A tsunami-like change also began to take place in his mind.
Fifteen Stars, break!
Hong! Hong! Hong!

He charged wave after wave. However, the black chain was imprisoning the fruit of cultivation, and its length was limited. Furthermore, the fruit of cultivation was continuously growing, and had already stretched the black chain to its limit. No matter what, it could not advance any further.

As the saying went, Fifteen Stars, so an additional golden pattern on the fruit of cultivation was only a symbol. The true change was still the fruit of cultivation itself. Its size directly determined how many Regulations Ling Han could deliver with a single strike.
Thus, the fruit of cultivation being suppressed and unable to grow, firmly trapped Ling Han at the peak stage of Fourteen Stars.
A vein popped on Ling Han’s forehead. He was accumulating power; he was going to unleash an explosive power.

After so many failures, he discovered that though this black chain was incredibly sturdy, it was not as sturdy as iron plates. Instead, there were a few places that were relatively weaker, and this was his breakthrough point.
‘Open!’
Ling Han roared loudly. Pu, all the pores on his body were spurting out blood, and boiling energy also surged into his mind, helping him take that last step.
Kuang!
A crisp sound rang out, and a segment of the black chain snapped.
“Haha!” Ling Han laughed loudly, an indescribable heroism surging up in his heart. So what if it was the shackle of heaven and earth? It would not be able to stop him!
Just like how he wanted to become Emperor, heaven and earth couldn’t stop him!
“Open! Open! Open!”
He roared loudly. There was no need for his divine sense to take human form to break the chain. The fruit of cultivation rapidly expanded, continuously breaking the black chain.
It was as easy as crushing dry weeds and crushing rotten wood.
It was as if the fruit of cultivation had been trapped by the black chain for too long, and had also suffocated enough. At this moment, it finally exploded.
“Pu!” Ling Han opened his mouth, and spat out a mouthful of blood.
However, this mouthful of blood was black, and there was an indescribable darkness about it.
He did not have the time to take note, when he felt the energy in his body boil, and his mind move like a tide.
He was in the process of breaking through, so how could he be distracted?
Ling Han hurriedly composed himself and continued on his path of breakthrough.
However, the black shackle had already been broken, and he had also unlocked the shackle of Fifteen Stars. Wasn’t the next step simple?
Only two days later, Ling Han had truly set foot on the level of Fifteen Stars.
He opened his eyes, and with a sweep, discovered that the mouthful of blood he had spat out had disappeared.
Yi?
He frowned, but at this moment, the joy of breaking through to Fifteen Stars surpassed all else. Very quickly, a smile appeared on his face.
“Now, how strong would I be?”
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and instantly, 99 Regulations appeared at the same time.
Only 99 flashes?

It should be known that when he was at Twelve Stars, he could deliver 90 flashes of Regulations with a single strike, but when he charged up from Twelve Stars to Fifteen Stars, he actually only gained an additional nine flashes of Regulations?
It was not as simple as that.
This was because after reaching the 90th Regulation, the might of each additional Regulation would be equivalent to 10 Regulations from before!
Why?
The larger the base number of Regulations, the more intertwined Regulations would be created with the new addition, which further magnified its might.
“Now, even if I don’t use Destructive Energy, it would be enough to fight Baili Tian.”
This was really too terrifying. He was only Sect Master-level, and he was already capable of contending against him, or even defeating the strongest Golden Generation, Venerate Tier-level!

But upon further thought, his Fifteen Stars was completely equivalent to a six-star Venerate. Then, Ling Han, who was a six-star Venerate… would he still not be able to sweep aside all oppostion of Fourth Extreme?
Speaking of which, Ling Han was at a disadvantage because he couldn’t use the Seven Star Regulations. Otherwise, he wouldn’t just be able to “battle” Baili Tian, but would be able to suppress him.
“However… the loss of life force is really too great.”

Ling Han sighed. Previously, his life force had been too severely damaged. Though this would not affect his battle prowess, when he broke through to Venerate Tier or Saint Tier in future, he could only have one chance in which he must succeed.
If he failed once, his life force would be damaged again, and he would be able to say goodbye to cultivation. In fact, he might even be able to say goodbye to his life.
“There are pitifully few Great Herbs that can heal life force. Last time, even after raiding the Ziwei Imperial Clan, I still couldn’t find a single one.”
“Yi, there is none in the Baili Clan. I can go and take a look elsewhere.”
Ling Han broke into a grin. Though he had charged up to Fifteen Stars, if he wanted to reach the peak stage of Fifteen Stars, who knew how much Celestial Qi he would need.
Thus, if he could plunder a few more Imperial Clans, he should be able to quickly send his cultivation level to the end of the level of Sect Master, and then break through to Venerate Tier.
“The fourth pinnacle level… How much later am I than the others?”

Now that the Yin souls had invaded, it was as if the younger generation had all developed cheat codes. The speed of their cultivation was frighteningly fast. For example, quite a number of Silver Generation elites had already advanced into Venerate Tier, surpassing Ling Han’s cultivation level.
Of course, cultivation level was cultivation level, and battle prowess was battle prowess, so they didn’t completely match.
Ling Han came out of seclusion. When they heard the news, everyone was overjoyed.

This was a double blessing. Firstly, Ling Han had successfully broken through again, and secondly, this was also the most significant, Ling Han had finally broken through the shackle of heaven and earth.
Once he broke through, there would be no further barriers in his path of advancement.
After celebrating with everyone, Ling Han called out Brother Monkey.
“Should we go and do another job?” he asked.
“Alright, Grandpa Dog will go too!” The large black dog immediately approached.

chapters.title: Chapter 4567: Holy Flames
paragraphs: Chapter 4567: Holy Flames
Editor: Henyee Translations
“Which clan should we rob?” The little azure dragon also approached. He and the large black dog were the type to want nothing more than for the world to be in chaos.
Ling Han sighed, “The two of you have come to cause trouble again?”
“What do you mean by causing trouble? With our abilities, we can be called elites no matter where we go,” the little azure dragon said defiantly.
“That’s right. Our cultivation level is higher than even you, brat,” the large black dog said.
One of them was a three-star Venerate, while the other was a four-star Venerate. Their abilities were truly impressive, and there were already not many people in the world that could surpass them.
“Sure, let’s move separately. Brother Monkey and I will be in one group, and the two of you will be in another,” Ling Han said with a smile.

“No way!” The large black dog and the little azure dragon shook their heads at the same time. F***, without Brother Monkey’s protection, or Ling Han’s large pile of rare treasures, they didn’t have much confidence.
After all, this was a trip to loot the Imperial Clans.
Ling Han shrugged, “Then you guys had best just obediently stay here.”
“Take us with you.”
“We promise not to cause trouble!”
The large black dog and little azure dragon looked at Ling Han with eager eyes. They even tried their best to widen their eyes to increase their sincerity.
“… All right then.”
They soon set out, their target being the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan.
However, after learning the lesson from the Ziwei Clan, whichever Imperial Clan it was now, they had greatly increased their protection of the ancestral grounds.

Previously, as long as there was a member of their clan leading them, they would be able to freely enter and exit the imperial formation. Now? As long as there were outsiders who entered, they would all be killed.
In this way, Ling Han and the others’ hopes were directly cut off.
It wouldn’t work.
“Why don’t we shrink down and hide in the body of some member of the Shi Clan? This imperial formation can’t kill us along with that person, right?” the large black dog suggested.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “If the Great Emperor Formation is truly activated, it’ll definitely discover our presence. Even if the imperial formation doesn’t unleash any killing intent, we’ll definitely suffer once the Saint from the Shi Clan appears.”
“That’s right. Old Black is really unreliable, coming up with all kinds of bad ideas,” the little azure dragon took the chance to complain.
“If you’re so capable, why don’t you come up with an idea?” the large black dog rolled his eyes.
The little azure dragon naturally refused; how could there possibly be a solution?
Unless they had the strength of a Pseudo-Emperor and could forcefully break through the formation.
But that was only a guess. It was still unknown whether the Pseudo-Emperor could hold up to the Great Emperor killing formation.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han shook his head.
“We’re just going to return with our tails between our legs like this?” The large black dog was dissatisfied.
“Yeah, that’s too embarrassing,” the little azure dragon also said.
Ling Han smiled, “Then Brother Monkey and I will go back first, and wait for good news from the two of you.”

“No, no, no.” The large black dog immediately shook his head, and said, “Grandpa Dog performed a divination just now. Our luck hasn’t been good these past few days, so we’re more suited to a peaceful life at home.”
Of course, Ling Han was only teasing. The four of them had no choice but to return.
They went to a few other Imperial Clans, but without exception, all of them increased their defenses.
Moreover, there were even more Imperial Clans hidden in the depths of the universe, such as the Buddhist Race in the 33 Heavens, and so on. Who knew what kind of place that was or where it was.
Not long after returning, the Nine Mountains Saint suddenly arrived.

The Nine Mountains Saint couldn’t help but frown upon seeing Ling Han. “And you’re still at the Sect Master-level? I’ve received news that you’ve been restricted by the Heavenly Dao and are unable to break through to the fourth pinnacle level. At first, I thought this was only a rumor, but I didn’t expect it to be true!”
Otherwise, if even the Silver Generation elites were beginning to advance into the Venerate Tier, there was no reason that Ling Han was still stuck at the level of Sect Master.
The Nine Mountains Saint looked up at the sky, and said, “Damn heavens, you’re far too ruthless!” Kuang! However, a bolt of lightning suddenly materialized in the air and struck down at him.
The Nine Mountains Saint reached over to block this attack, yet a scorch mark appeared on his palm.
Gasp! A Saint had been wounded?
This was a punishment from the heaven and earth, because the Nine Mountains Saint had insulted the Heavenly Dao.
Why was it that no matter how others cursed heaven and earth, it was fine, but Saints could not?
This was because the Saint could accomodate the Regulations of heaven and earth after igniting the holy flame. Thus, they could be viewed as the representative of the Heavenly Dao.
Thus, Saints naturally couldn’t insult heaven and earth.
Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, the Nine Mountains Saint immediately said, “I’ll use the holy flame to help you break out of this situation!”
Ling Han got a scare. The old man was going all out.
The holy flame was the foundation of a Saint. Once it was extinguished, not only would one fall from the position of Saint, it would also signify that their life had come to an end.

And the growth of the holy flame was extraordinarily difficult. Thus, after a great many Saints had advanced into Saint Tier, they would be stuck at the level of One Star all their lives, and would not be able to take another step further.
The old man was using the holy flame to help him. That was practically risking his position as a Saint and his life.

Ling Han was touched, and he hurriedly said, “Old man, I’ve already broken through the seal of heaven and earth. Now, as long as I have enough Celestial Qi, I can break through to the fourth pinnacle level.”
The Nine Mountains Saint faltered upon hearing this. “Really?”
“Of course it’s real,” Ling Han said with a smile.

Thus, his hopes were all on Ling Han.
This incredibly young disciple could become Emperor.
Ling Han displayed his strength, causing the Nine Mountains Saint to remain silent for a long time.

The freakish nature of Ling Han was indescribable, but from the look of things now, Ling Han’s strength had increased explosively again.
“If you battle Baili Tian again now, you will definitely be able to kill him within ten moves,” the old man concluded.
Ling Han nodded. That was indeed the case. Of course, the prerequisite was Baili Tian was still a Seven Star Venerate.

“That’s right.
Our cultivation level is higher than even you, brat,” the large black dog said.
One of them was a three-star Venerate, while the other was a four-star Venerate.
Their abilities were truly impressive, and there were already not many people in the world that could surpass them.

All right then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4568: Saint Tomb
paragraphs: Chapter 4568: Saint Tomb
Editor: Henyee Translations
If outsiders saw this, they would definitely exclaim in disbelief.
This was the holy flame! Even Saints would be envious of it, yet these two people were actually pushing to to each other?
You guys don’t want it, but we do.

In the end, it was still the Nine Mountains Saint that accepted the broken sword. Just as Ling Han had said, this holy flame was constantly weakening. Who knows, when Ling Han became a Saint, it would have completely extinguished. That would really be too much of a waste.

The old man was very rueful. The reason why he had been able to advance into Saint Tier was because of the Imperial Scroll that Ling Han had given him, and now he had also taken his disciple’s holy flame, which made him, as a senior, feel very apologetic. Why did he keep accepting things from this disciple?
For others, it was the seniors who would be bestowing things on their juniors.
However, the Nine Mountains Saint hadn’t come just to see Ling Han. There was another matter—an extremely important matter.
The Saint Tomb had opened.
“The Saint Tomb?” Ling Han was surprised. He had never heard of such a place.
What was going on? Were Saints all buried there after their deaths?
That was impossible.

“The Saint Tomb is an extremely mysterious place in the universe,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. “From some unknown era onwards, more and more elderly Saints started to venture there. They wanted to make a final gamble and see if they could obtain the holy flame and extend their lifespan.”
“As time passed, more and more Saints went there.”
“And indeed, there is the holy flame there. A Saint managed to obtain it successfully, extending his lifespan and increasing his abilities.”
“Thus, every time it opened, not only would the old Saints go, but there would also be a great many new Saints. After all, the holy flame is not something as simple as extending their lifespan.”
“Because there are innumerable Saints buried there, and under the nourishment of innumerable Saint-level substances, that place is also rich in Great Herbs.”
Realization dawned on Ling Han. No wonder the Nine Mountains Saint had come. That was because it was not just the Saints. The others could also benefit from the Saint Tomb.
According to the old man’s original plans, he wanted to use the holy flame to help him, and then bring him to the Saint Tomb.
—The old man could use that holy flame to repair himself, and in his case, he could also search for opportunities there, and take another step further.
“Has the Saint Tomb already opened?” Ling Han asked.
“It hasn’t completely opened yet. There are only signs,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. “It’ll probably take half a month, at most, and no more than a month.”
Ling Han nodded. Where there was Saintly medicine, there would definitely be Celestial Qi. Thus, if he was lucky, when he came out of the Saint Tomb, he would be a Venerate Tier.
He called Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others over. Everyone prepared themselves, and then set out.

There were not many people going this time, and they were at least Venerate Tier-level, or those with Venerate Tier-level battle prowess. Those like the empress and the others stayed back. Even if they went, they would not be of much help.
In the Saint Tomb, the main force would definitely be the Saint.
Ling Han and the others had to be careful. They didn’t want to be killed by someone in a moment of carelessness.

The Saint Tomb was about to open, and a large amount of saintly power surged through the universe. Every Saint would sense this, so there was no need for anyone to inform them. Every Saint was aware of this matter.
When Ling Han and the others arrived, they saw that a hole had cracked open in space. Hurricanes blew out, turning into a terrifying energy storm that swept through the universe.
There were a great many Saints here.
Even though the Netherworld beings were invading, and this was a critical period of the war, a large number of Saints still arrived.

There were a lot of important things in this world, but nothing was naturally as important as one’s own life. Moreover, if he could obtain the holy flame, and increase his battle prowess, wouldn’t he be able to better defend against the invasion of the Netherworld?
Ling Han and the others were all very low-key, and even concealed their appearance to avoid being recognized.
After all, the Nine Mountains Saint was only a One Star Saint. Without the might of the Imperial Weapon, the Nine Mountains Saint’s battle prowess was the lowest level among Saints.

Of course, he still had the Saint Tool. It was forged by the Nine Suns Saint, so its might was astonishing. If they really fought to the death, there were not many Saints that could defeat the old man.
However, they had come to search for great opportunities. If they fought, what else would they have time to find?
Right now, the Saint Tomb was still yet to open. Thus, they all waited in silence.
These were all Saints, and any one of them could shake the universe with a single stomp of their feet. All of them exuded an air of pride.
Ling Han could see very clearly. As expected, the majority of Saints had brought their juniors with them. To everyone, this was a great opportunity.
As time passed, more and more Saints came. A great many of them came from the Imperial Clans.
Some Saints were so old that their teeth had fallen out of their mouths. Their entire bodies were exuding an aura of decay.

It should be known that Saints could regrow severed limbs, yet now, even their teeth had fallen out completely. It was clear just how badly the life force had lost. The holy flame was already like a candle in the wind, and could be extinguished at any moment.

This kind of Saint was naturally here to make a final gamble. As long as he could find a large amount of holy flame, so that the holy flame in his body could once again burn fiercely, he would be able to return to his prime.
Quite a number of Golden Generations had come.

Ling Han swept an eye over them. It could be said that aside from Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian, all the Golden Generations had arrived, and they were basically either eight or nine stars in cultivation level. They were already not far from lighting up the holy flame.

In the case of the Silver Generation, most of them had already advanced into the Venerate Tier, and only a small number were still stuck at the level of Sect Master. In the case of the ordinary Imperial Sons, there was temporarily no one that had advanced into the Venerate Tier.

Ding Shu was here, Origin was here, Jing Haoran was here, and so on. These masters of the Genesis World were all here, but Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling and other ancient prodigies were nowhere to be seen.
Yi, why could they be seen in some places, but not in other places?
This was the Saint Tomb; weren’t the opportunities here great enough?
Ling Han was only curious for a moment, but did not take it to heart. This had nothing to do with him.

Another few days later, that crack in space became larger and larger, and the energy storm that swept out became stronger and stronger. Even the Saints were unwilling to face it directly, and they all dodged.
The Saint Tomb was about to open.
Ling Han saw the old Saint from the Donglin Imperial Clan. He had brought a few juniors with him, and one of them was Chi Dao. However, their strongest clan member, Chi Menghan, was not among them.
This supreme prodigy that was comparable to the Golden Generation actually didn’t come?
Although Chi Menghan’s natural talent was astonishing, it definitely hadn’t reached the point where she could attempt to break through to the Saint Tier.
Thus, she had most likely been grounded by the Donglin Imperial Clan, so there was no way she could leave.
Otherwise, if Chi Menghan ran off with Ling Han, wouldn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan be utterly humiliated?
Moreover, they would also become enemies with the Ziwei Imperial Clan because of this.

Another two days later, that fissure opened up to the size of a planet, and madly poured out the energy storm, which lasted for half a day’s time. Then, the energy storm withdrew, and finally, it became completely peaceful.
The Saint Tomb had opened.
“Let’s go!”
One after another, Saints flew out, bringing their juniors with them, and rushed into that massive crevice.
“Let’s go too,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. He grabbed the others, and with a step, he had already stepped into the large crack.

chapters.title: Chapter 4569: Broken Planet
paragraphs: Chapter 4569: Broken Planet
Editor: Henyee Translations
This was a dark world, just like the cold universe outside. It was empty.
But now, multiple Saints were exuding light, like torches in the darkness.
Ling Han saw a flame burning inside the Nine Mountains Saint’s body.
That was the holy flame!
Strange, if it was in this place, the holy flame would actually appear automatically.
It could be seen that the color of the holy flame was different.
Some were purple, some were red, some were white, and their sizes were also different. Some were only the size of a fist, some were the size of a human head, and some were even like a furnace.
Strange, it was clearly inside the body, and the body was only normal in size, but the size of the holy flame far exceeded that.

“There are nine levels in Saint Tier, and the color of the holy flame corresponding to each minor level is different,” the Nine Mountains Saint explained to Ling Han and the others. “For example, I’m only a One Star Saint, and the color of the holy flame is white.”

“Further up, two stars would be red, three stars would be orange, four stars would be yellow, five stars would be green, six stars would be green, seven stars would be blue, eight stars would be purple, and nine stars would be black.”
With these words, it was very easy to distinguish the cultivation level of the Saint.

Ling Han swept his gaze over the surroundings again, and discovered that the majority of the people here were Five Star Saints. There were more low-level Saints, and those above Five Stars were pitifully few.
The Saint with the highest cultivation level was an eight-star Saint. However, his entire body was enshrouded in black mist, and it was impossible to distinguish his appearance at all.

—If it was not for the fact that this place would automatically manifest the holy flame, it was probable that everyone would have overlooked him. How could they have possibly imagined that he was actually an eight-star Saint here!
In the first place, there were not many Saints in the world, and there were even pitifully few Eight Star Saints.
Everyone was guessing the origins of this person. Though cultivation level couldn’t absolutely represent battle prowess, being able to cultivate to eight stars, how could he not be strong?
Moreover, he could already cultivate to Saint Tier, and mediocre people would have long since died off completely.
After advancing for a while, they saw that a floating continent had actually appeared ahead of them.
This continent had been forcefully dug out from a planet. It was flat on top, and protruding on the bottom. It itself was like a mountain that had been turned upside down.
Was this the Saint Tomb?
Ahead of them, a great number of Saints had already stopped, and landed on that continent.

The Nine Mountains Saint, Ling Han, and the others also descended. This was a desolate world. Although it was covered with forests, every single tree had already died, leaving behind only bare tree trunks.
The ground was also black, like black iron.
The Nine Mountains Saint set down the four of them. They all possessed battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier, so they were completely capable of walking freely in this place.
This continent wasn’t large, and they quickly circled around. However, they didn’t discover anything.
This was an ordinary continent. There was no Celestial medicine, nor was there any Saintly corpse.
Saint Tomb?
Without a Saint’s corpse, how could this be called Saint Tomb?
When they reached the end of the continent, they saw that a great many Saints had already set out with their juniors, continuing onwards.
The Nine Mountains Saint also set off with Ling Han and the others, heading towards their next destination.

That was because this planet had actually been destroyed, leaving behind only a core.
Gasp! Had the floating continents all originated from this planet?

It was huge, astonishingly huge.
When this planet was in its complete form, its size was incredibly shocking. At present, there was not a single planet in the universe that could compare to it.
Going by that theory, this was the heart of this place, and also the end?
The Saints all descended, arriving at the core of this planet.
In truth, though this was the inner core of a planet, it was still astonishingly huge. It was not inferior to any great planet of today.
“Yi?”
As soon as they landed, the Saints all exclaimed in shock. That was because in this place, their holy flames were suddenly suppressed, and their abilities were greatly restricted.

Of course, no matter how restricted they were, their strength was still far superior to the Venerate Tier. However, if the gap in strength between a One Star Saint and a Three Star Saint had been ten times, it had now shrunk to three times, or even smaller.

In this way, the Saints with lower cultivation levels were much more relaxed, because even if they encountered a Nine-Star Saint, they would not be overwhelmed. Though they were still outmatched, they had gained quite a bit of initiative.
They began a search, looking for any clues.
After circling around, this planet was still very empty. However, in the extreme south, there was a massive cave.
Was this the key to this place?
Without much hesitation, the Saints all entered.
After walking for another half a day, a fork in the path appeared in the cave.
Ling Han and the others tried to take the left tunnel, but before they could enter, they immediately felt a terrifying pressure assault them, forcing them to hurriedly retreat.
If they were to face this head-on, they would definitely be crushed into dust.
Only the Nine Mountains Saint could enter.
This was saintly might.
Trying out the other path, though the pressure was not small either, a Venerate was completely capable of coming and going as he pleased.
“Old man, the true Saint Tomb should be on this path on the left,” Ling Han said. “Then, we’ll go our separate ways here.”
The Nine Mountains Saint thought for a moment, then nodded.

Now that they were here, it was impossible for the younger generation to take the left path. They could only choose the right path. Then, with the strength of Ling Han and the others, they would not be afraid of anyone.
And would a Saint walk the path on the right?

Saints weren’t babysitters, so they definitely had to search for their own opportunities. Thus, how could they leave the holy flame alone and not search for it, but choose to stand guard over their juniors?
There was no Emperor in the world, and Saints were the strongest. What kind of status did they have?

Even if 100 juniors all advanced one step further, none of these improvements were as significant as raising the Saint’s cultivation level by one star or increasing his lifespan by a few hundred years.
Thus, Ling Han and the others should also be facing a competition of peers, and even if they encountered a nine-star Venerate, what need was there for Ling Han and the others to be afraid?
The Nine Mountains Saint set off without worry, while Ling Han and the others entered the other path.
After walking for a long time, the path ahead suddenly opened up, and an extremely long canyon appeared.
At the entrance to the canyon, there was a large number of young people standing. They did not rashly enter into the canyon.
This was the Saint Tomb. Even if there was no pressure from a Saint here, how could they act rashly?

Right now, many people were trying to form good relations with each other. Since they couldn’t rely on the Saint from their respective forces anymore, and since they weren’t powerful enough, they could only rely on each other. Although this would decrease their profits, it was still better than having no profits at all. In fact, it would be better than losing their lives, right?
Thus, small teams quickly formed one after another.
“The four of you, go, scout ahead!”
Just as Ling Han and the others were observing the situation, someone suddenly shouted at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4570: Command
paragraphs: Chapter 4570: Command
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han knew that they were all people who were born with a halo of trouble. Wherever they went, they would cause trouble.
However, they had just arrived, and trouble had already befallen on them. This still made him grit his teeth.
This was too disrespectful, wasn’t it?
Ling Han and the others exchanged looks, and all of them smiled.
“You guys… are you sure you want to do this?” Ling Han asked.

There were a total of seven of them, and they were all Sect Masters. Furthermore, they were all high-level Sect Masters. Although they looked young, each of them had lived for about ten thousand years.
Thus, these seven people were most likely the Dao Child of some Holy Land, who had been brought here by the Saint of their forces.
They gathered together for warmth, but still felt that this canyon was dangerous and unpredictable, and wanted others to take the lead.
However, they were really too jumpy.
Didn’t they see that the Imperial Sons here were also watching, and did not make any rash moves? What were they trying to do?
Could it be that they wanted to use this to show their goodwill to the Imperial Sons?
Hehe, if they were planning this, then they would really be making a huge mistake.
“What is it? Are we still unable to command you?” A man in white robes asked proudly.

Ling Han and the others all shook their heads. In order to keep a low profile, they not only changed their appearance, but also suppressed their cultivation level, exuding the aura of Sect Master. Of course, Ling Han didn’t need to do anything extra. He was already a Sect Master, in the first place.
However, the disadvantage of being too low-key was that one would be easily bullied.
“Scram!” Brother Monkey rebuked harshly, and his face appeared and disappeared in a flash. Meanwhile, the aura of a Venerate Tier also fluctuated vaguely.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
Pa, pa, pa! The seven Sect Masters all collapsed to the ground, cold sweat pouring down their bodies. They had really been scared out of their wits.
Gods, it was as if they had seen an ancient Demonic Monkey that could split open the skies and shatter the earth, making them wet their pants in fright.
They didn’t dare to say a word as they hurriedly scrambled to their feet and fled.
At this moment, they were all on the verge of a mental breakdown. Why had they simply picked a random few people to bully, and discovered that they had kicked an iron plate
Thankfully, Ling Han and the others had not killed all of them. Otherwise, how could they have escaped so easily?
“Yo, the four of you are pretending to be pigs to eat tigers!” A young man was waving a paper fan. He was dressed in snow-white robes, and looked to have an elegant and peerless bearing.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel awkward, but his expression was strange, because this young man was one of the three cultivators that he had seen in the Medicinal Garden in Ziwei Imperial Clan. At the time, those three people had gotten permission to cultivate beside the Saintly medicine, but in the end, because the mature Saintly medicine had been harvested by Ling Han, it caused them to be suspicious for a long time.
This was a member of the Baili Clan. Hehe, Ling Han revealed a smile, and said, “In the dark of night, you’re waving a paper fan. The smell of showing off has already floated very far.”
“Haha!” The large black dog and little azure dragon laughed loudly. Brother Monkey, on the other hand, was unconcerned. He used the Fiery Golden Eyes, and carefully surveyed this valley.
Brother Monkey’s Fiery Golden Eyes were not inferior to Ling Han’s eye technique. Thus, Ling Han was also very relaxed, and could spare some time to play around.
“How dare you!” The white-robed young man’s expression became stern, “Do you know who I am?”
“Sigh!” The large black dog sighed, and said, “Can’t you villains be a little more creative? Don’t ask ‘do you know who I am’ every time! F*ck! How does Grandpa Dog know who you are?”

The white-robed young man almost exploded in fury. He was a member of the Imperial Clan. Furthermore, after one of the two Imperial Sons had been crippled, and the other had been killed, he had already been promoted to become a Pseudo Imperial Son.
As long as he performed well this time, and obtained a great opportunity in the Saint Tomb, he would be able to become a genuine Imperial Son.

Thus, he was naturally proud. Furthermore, precisely because he was not yet the Imperial Son, he was far prouder than the real Imperial Son. After all, his pride was weaker, and he had not developed strong self-confidence yet.
“I am Baili Yunhe!” he called out loudly, “The newly promoted Pseudo-Imperial Son of the Ziwei Imperial Clan!”
“Che, only a Pseudo-Imperial Son.” The large black dog waved his paw.
“Grandpa Dragon has even killed a few Imperial Sons,” the little azure dragon also boasted.
Baili Yunhe scoffed. What a joke; how many Imperial Sons have you killed? Why don’t you just ascend to the heavens while you are at it?
“You people are pretending to be pigs to eat tigers. Aren’t you afraid of encountering the True Dragon, who would turn around and devour you?” Baili Yunhe said balefully1.
“You’re asking for a beating!” The little azure dragon was enraged, and it threw a punch.
Peng!
Baili Yunhe was instantly sent flying. How could he withstand a single blow?
“Grandpa Dragon hates it the most when people like you pretend to be the the descendant of the True Dragon!” the little azure dragon said in displeasure.
Now, there was only one pure Dragon Race in the world, and that was him.
This punch caused those in the vicinity to turn their eyes towards him. A considerable number of Imperial Sons even looked suspicious.
Why did these four people give them a familiar feeling?
Baili Yunhe got to his feet. His eyes were fixed on the little azure dragon, and he revealed an expression of fury.
As a member of the Imperial Clan, he had actually been sent flying in public?
This was a great humiliation!
“Tell me your name!” he said proudly. He was clearly outmatched, but his attitude became even more arrogant.
The little azure dragon looked towards Ling Han. Ling Han pondered for a moment, then nodded.
They were already here, so there was no need for them to hide their identities any longer.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and said, “Little He, have you forgotten that when you were in the Medicinal Garden, the power of heaven and earth suddenly exhausted, and Regulations did not appear?”
Pu!
A considerable number spluttered. Little He, to think that this guy could actually utter such words.
Furthermore, what did this guy mean?
Others didn’t know, and were puzzled, but Baili Yunhe’s heart was suddenly hammered heavily.
Ling Han!

Though the whole world knew that the Ziwei Clan had been ransacked, the details were only limited to the core members of the Baili Clan, and those who knew that he had been cultivating in the Medicinal Garden… could only be the people involved.
Heavens, at that time, Ling Han was actually in the Medicinal Garden, and actually was right next to him?
Baili Yunhe instantly started to shiver. Who didn’t know that Ling Han was the Imperial Son Killer? He had killed members of Imperial Clans without batting an eyelid!
He was just lucky.
Yi, could it be that he was not Imperial Son, and that was why Ling Han did not kill him… not good, then he was nowa Pseudo-Imperial Son. Then wouldn’t he be on Ling Han’s kill list?
If it was anyone else, Baili Yunhe wouldn’t be afraid at all, but Ling Han was different.

This was the publicly acknowledged Imperial Son Killer. Who knew how many Imperial Sons had died at his hands? Now when his name was spoken in the Imperial Clans, it was enough to stop children from crying.
All of a sudden, Baili Yunhe’s forehead was covered with cold sweat. He felt that his legs were trembling so much that he could collapse at any moment.
Yi, what was going on here?
Everyone was astounded. Ling Han had only said something without rhyme or reason, so why had Baili Yunhe become like this?
What kind of magic did these words carry?
“Have your dog’s eyes been blinded? You don’t even recognize your Grandpa Dragon?” The little azure dragon also revealed itself at the right time.
Though a great many years had passed, his body had not grown too much. He was still like a four-legged snake. At most, he had only grown a foot.
He was far from reaching the age of a young dragon. No matter how high his cultivation level was, he was still a young dragon.
“F*ck off! What do you mean by ‘dog’s eyes blinded’?” The large black dog immediately flared up in anger. Wasn’t this insulting a baldy right in front of a monk?
“I’ll bite you to death!” The large black dog also returned to its original form, biting at the little azure dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 4571: Strength!
paragraphs: Chapter 4571: Strength!
Editor: Henyee Translations
Woof, woof, woof! Howl, howl, howl!
The little azure dragon and the large black dog were embroiled in a fierce battle.

This wasn’t the first time that this pair of jokers had caused such a ruckus. Ling Han didn’t even cast a second look at them. At most, he would only give them a kick when they were about to bite him.
“Four-Legged Snake!”
“Despicable dog!”
At this moment, everyone cried out one after another, all of them in disbelief.
This pair of jokers was only secondary. The main thing was now that they had appeared, how far could Ling Han be?
“You, you, you, you, you, you are… Ling Han!” Baili Yunhe finally could speak. He pointed at Ling Han, his voice trembling, his pupils contracting.
The Imperial Son Killer, a supreme demon king!
Ling Han smiled faintly. His appearance changed, and he returned to his original appearance.
“Ling Han!”
“It really is Ling Han!”

Everyone exclaimed one after another. Though everyone knew that Ling Han was trapped at the level of Sect Master forever, the battle prowess of this Sect Master was really too strong. In the past, he could even battle a seven-star Venerate, Baili Tian. That had really stunned the world.
Though very few people were discussing Ling Han now, but when they saw this legendary figure with their own eyes, who wouldn’t sigh with emotion?
—If it was not for the restrictions of heaven and earth, this guy could possibly become the strongest Venerate in history, the strongest Saint in history or even actually ascend the throne.
“Hehe, Brother Ling, long time no see!” Ding Shu greeted Ling Han.
Ling Han looked over, and said with a smile, “What is it? Do you think you can defeat me now, so you don’t even call me Master anymore?”
Ding Shu’s expression instantly became gloomy. If he had known this earlier, why would he have greeted him?
“You’re already frozen at the Sect Master level, so why is your mouth still so unforgiving?” he sighed.

“What a pity. I had initially wanted to spar with you.” Shui Qingchang, meanwhile, felt it was a pity. She was already a seven-star Venerate. Though she had reached the same level as Baili Tian in the past, just how powerful was the battle prowess of the Genesis World’s master?

Furthermore, Ling Han could stand against Baili Tian because he had mastered Destructive Energy, but it should be known that Shui Qingchang had also mastered Destructive Energy, though she had not reached its complete form yet.
Thus, while both was a Seven Star Venerate battling against a Sect Master, she was naturally confident that she could defeat Ling Han. In fact, she could even insta-kill Ling Han.
Since that was the case, was there still any need to battle?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Then please protect me, Big Sister Shui.”
Shui Qingchang instantly rolled her eyes. “Who’s your sister? Am I that old?”
Among the Genesis World’s rulers, which one of them wasn’t an old monster who had lived for countless years?
But no matter what, Shui Qingchang was still a woman, and as long as she was a woman, there wasn’t one that didn’t care about age.
“Ling Han!” At this moment, an Imperial Son spoke up, interrupting the reminiscence between Ling Han and his “old friends”.
“Are you seeking death?” Ling Han turned around to look. This was Jade Drop Imperial Clan’s Han Yun, so he naturally didn’t need to give him any face.

However, Han Yun was already a nine-star Venerate now. He had entered the Saint Tomb this time to strengthen Saint-level experiences, so that he could catch up to Baili Tian, Yan Dongming, or even surpass them in terms of cultivation level.
The battle to become Emperor had already reached a crucial point.
Thus, he naturally looked down on Ling Han.

—No matter how powerful Ling Han was, he could only manage a tie with Baili Tian, who was a seven-star Venerate. However, they were both Golden Generations, and he was already a nine-star Venerate, and what about Ling Han?
He was eternally stuck at Sect Master-level, so it was already impossible for his abilities to improve any further.
There was a great disparity in battle prowess, so was there any need to go into more detail?

Han Yun looked at Ling Han proudly, and said calmly, “You are already a cripple. Logically speaking, you should hide in some corner of the universe, and watch the changes of the era from the sidelines. In that way, you would still be able to live out your retirement in peace.”
“Yet you insist on jumping around. How preposterous!”
“Grandpa Dragon will go and kill him!” The little azure dragon jumped out.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “You are no match for him.”

The little azure dragon was at a disadvantage in terms of cultivation level. It was only at seven stars, and could at most rival Han Yun, who was at eight stars. After all, the latter was a Golden Generation, and this wasn’t just empty boasting.
Although it was displeased, the little azure dragon still stepped back.
“At least you know your own limitations,” Han Yun said calmly.
Ling Han smiled, “Does the Han Clan still have a reserve Imperial Son?”
What was the meaning of this?
“I’ve already killed Han Di. If I kill you this time, will the Han Clan have a temporary deficit in manpower?” Ling Han added.
This!𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Just how confident are you?
He had clearly been trapped forever at Sect Master-level, so why did he still feel like he was the number one prodigy in the world?

“Hehe, since you are so determined to seek death, then I will oblige you!” Han Yun strode forwards, heading towards Ling Han. Boom, multiple ribbons of iridescent light surged out of his body, turning into long rivers.
This was a nine-star Venerate, and furthermore, he was a Golden Generation at that. It was really unreasonable that he was so strong. Only Saints could suppress him.
Ling Han stood, arms crossed behind his back, as if he had no intention of fighting at all.
“Die!” Han Yun pointed a finger at Ling Han, and instantly, a long river surged out, slashing towards Ling Han.
In the long river, the manifestations of Regulations appeared faintly.
Seven Star Regulations, sixteen flashes!

Han Yun didn’t overestimate himself. He knew that Ling Han was freakish, and with the help of that mysterious black energy, he could even resist fourteen Seven Star Regulations. Thus, he went all out from the very beginning.
Boom, the long river surged over. Every drop of river water contained the Seven Star Regulations, and its destructive power was incredibly terrifying.
How was Ling Han supposed to block this?
Everyone was curious. It should be known that Han Yun was much stronger than Baili Tian from many years ago. After this trip, he should be able to break through to Saint Tier.
How many Saints had there been in history that were 200 to 300 years old?
This era was really too expansive and grand. Unfortunately, Ling Han was destined to only be able to watch from the sidelines, and could not personally participate.
Sigh, he was probably unwilling to accept this, and that was why he insisted on challenging Han Yun.
The problem was, even if you didn’t die this time, so what? Would you be able to become a Venerate? Would you be able to become a Saint?
Thus, you would ultimately be abandoned by time.
Right in front of everyone’s eyes, Ling Han also stretched out a finger to greet that long river.
The 95 Regulations were faintly discernible, intertwining into one piece, exuding an indescribable brilliance.
Peng!
With a tap of his finger, the long river instantly crumbled, but fourteen Seven Star Regulations appeared, turning into a Divine Sword that continued to slash down.
However, the Regulations that Ling Han shot out formed into a fist that blocked the Divine Sword.
Ka, ka, ka, ka!
Cracks appeared on the Divine Sword and fist at the same time, and in the end, they both crumbled.
W-what!
This scene caused everyone’s eyes to pop out of their heads.
He had blocked it, and it was done so carelessly at that, so easily and casually.
This guy had become a Venerate?
No, no, no. This aura was clearly at the level of Sect Master. Furthermore, everyone could clearly see that the Regulations that the other had used were clearly Six Stars.
Heavens, heavens!

In other words, although Ling Han was trapped at the level of Sect Master, his strength was constantly improving. From the time when he could just barely match Baili Tian, to now when he could easily block Han Yun, just how much had his abilities improved?
It should be known that he had not used that black-coloured energy yet!
Everyone felt their scalps go numb. Even Ding Shu and the others inhaled sharply, and looked solemn.

chapters.title: Chapter 4572: Battling the Imperial Sons
paragraphs: Chapter 4572: Battling the Imperial Sons
Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone knew that the higher one’s cultivation level, the harder it was to battle above one’s cultivation level.

When one’s cultivation level was low, there were indeed people who could defeat their opponent with a disadvantage of a major tier, and as one’s cultivation level increased, the range of tier surpassing battle prowess would become smaller and smaller.
And when it came to Venerate Tier, only the Golden Generation could battle with a gap of around seven stars.
But what about Ling Han?
Not only did he manage to surpass a major tier, but he even managed to surpass a series of minor levels.
What kind of monster are you?
Han Yun hadn’t expected this either. After being stunned for a moment, he moved again. Boom, boom, boom! This time, the seven rivers surged at the same time, charging towards Ling Han.
Ling Han casually moved, completely dispersing the attack that came towards him, appearing to be extremely relaxed.
At this moment, everyone had to admit that Ling Han indeed possessed the strength to match a nine-star Venerate . Moreover, this nine-star Venerate was a Golden Generation elite.
It could be said that Ling Han was already capable of sweeping aside the entire level of Venerate Tier.
This was practically a freak.
Throughout the ages, who could do this?
“Don’t tell me that though Ling Han’s cultivation level has been trapped forever at Sect Master-level, his abilities can be endlessly improved. In fact, he can even reach the power of a Saint!”
“Hehe, impossible! Absolutely impossible!”

“Are you sure? You have to know that if someone had told you before that a Sect Master was capable of matching a Venerate Tier, would you believe it? Moreover, it isn’t a One Star or Two Star Venerate, but a Nine Star Venerate, and a Golden Generation at that?”

“However, surpassing two major tiers… Moreover, just how powerful is a Saint? After igniting the holy flame, one has truly transcended the level of elites. Instead, he would be a supreme great elite!”
Everyone was stunned by Ling Han’s strength, but they still did not think that Ling Han would be able to grow endlessly, to even be capable of matching a Saint.
This was something that they had guessed. Fifteen Stars was the end of Ling Han’s line. He could not take another step further, and charge up to Sixteen Stars.

Han Yun did not make another move. When one had reached a height like he had, the depth of his opponent would be known with a slight probe, and he was certain that Ling Han had definitely not relied on external factors to be a match for him, but had truly possessed this kind of battle prowess.
He couldn’t figure it out. How could a mere Sect Master be as strong as this?
Ling Han was always able to break through his limits time and time again, breaking everyone’s understanding, creating miracles that others didn’t even dare to think about.
But now that things had come to this, was there any way out for him?
Even a nine-star Venerate couldn’t kill a Sect Master, and this would become an internal demon that he couldn’t erase. Would he still be able to break through to Saint Tier?
“Die!” He charged out once more, “Drop the Jade Drop into the Underworld, and the Heavenly River will be destroyed for ten thousand miles!”
Boom, streams of river water descended from the skies, like waterfalls, but also like sharp blades.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and leaped out, greeting Han Yun’s attack.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two of them battled fiercely, but it could be clearly seen that Ling Han was obviously much more relaxed. At times, he would only use his left hand, at times, his right hand, and at times, he would place his hands behind his back, completely relying on the movement of his feet to dodge.
Han Yun, on the other hand, was going all out. His expression was twisted, and his mentality was about to collapse.
“Ling, Han!” Han Yun roared loudly. Boom! There was actually a sliver of saintly might circulating in his body.
He was getting serious.
Ling Han used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to dodge this attack.
The current Golden Generation had Saintly bones implanted into their bodies. This could both increase their battle prowess, and could also help them advance into Saint-level faster.

Though Ling Han was freakish, at present, he was definitely unable to contend against Saint-level power. Thus, he could not face it head-on, or he would only be seeking his own suffering, or even seeking his own death.

When Han Yun saw that he had suppressed Ling Han, he couldn’t help but laugh loudly. He increased the intensity of his offensive, and every blow that he delivered contained a sliver of saintly might, allowing his battle prowess to have a qualitative improvement.
After parrying more than a dozen moves, Ling Han was also irritated.
Did he really think that he had no more tricks up his sleeve?
Ling Han shouted lightly, and finally used Destructive Energy.
Boom, he threw a punch, and the black-coloured energy turned into a streak of light. Its speed was indescribable, as it rapidly blasted towards Han Yun.
Han Yun hurriedly parried, forming a spherical shield in front of him.
However, under the effects of Destructive Energy, what effect could this kind of defense have?
The shield immediately melted, and the power of the punch penetrated deeply.
However, this still bought Han Yun some time, allowing him to retreat.
Ling Han took advantage of the victory to follow up on his attack. He swung his fists again. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Destructive Energy was blasted out, turning into meteors that filled the skies.

Han Yun counterattacked as he dodged. He was naturally relying on his saintly power, and there was a sliver of it in every strike. At present, this was something that Ling Han was definitely no match for.
Thus, the two of them had a powerful weapon that could intimidate the other. What was originally a close-quarters battle had become a long-distance exchange of blows and pursuit.
“Sigh!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Though it was still a tie at the moment, it was clear who was stronger at a glance.
—Ling Han was relying completely on his own abilities, and as for Han Yun? The reason why he could use saintly might was because a Saintly bone had been implanted into his body.
How could they compare?
But in this world, only the result mattered, and no one asked for the reason.
Han Yun had not lost, and that was enough. Furthermore, when he advanced into Saint Tier in future, what about Ling Han?
He was an eternal Sect Master.

“Let’s attack together, and eliminate this scourge!” Another Imperial Son declared. That was Yi Taishu. Previously, he had made a bet with Ling Han, and lost over a hundred Eight Star Celestial Qi. Just thinking about it made him feel suffocated.
By now, he was already an eight-star Venerate, and also had Saintly bones in his body. His battle prowess was only slightly inferior to Han Yun.
Xiu, with a leap, he joined the battle.
“You people are too despicable!” the little azure dragon shouted, about to join the battle.
“No need to come!” Ling Han laughed loudly, appearing extremely heroic, “Today, I will defeat these weaklings!”
‘What?’
He actually dared to compare the Golden Generation to weaklings?

The remaining Golden Generations were all enraged. Furthermore, the feeling that Ling Han gave them was really too dangerous. It was clear that he should be eternally stuck at Sect Master-level, but his abilities were still continuously improving, which made them feel uneasy.
Kill, only by killing him would they be able to let go of the weight in their hearts.

One after another, the Golden Generations joined the battle. Aside from a limited few members of the Imperial Clans that remained neutral, the other members of the Golden Generation all took the field.

And in this kind of battle, the Venerate Tier-level Silver Generations weren’t even qualified to participate in the battle. What was the point of Venerates below five stars fighting? They would be completely insta-killed by Ling Han.
Ling Han laughed loudly, his heroic spirit like an ocean.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Come on then!
Boom, he finally unleashed his full battle prowess. 99 Six Star Regulations appeared, intertwining to form a staff that he held in his hand, sweeping out in all directions.

His spirit was too strong. Though there was an end to the number of Regulations, with the boost of his divine sense, this staff of Regulations had enlarged to about three thousand meters in size. With a wave of the staff, the Imperial Sons could only flee in disarray.
If they came into contact with it, they would definitely die.
Everyone was dumbfounded. How could this be?
In their one-on-one battle just then, Ling Han and Han Yun had only been equally matched. Now, however, he was actually able to rival so many Imperial Sons without falling into a disadvantage?
Heavens!

At present, this was something that Ling Han was definitely no match for.
Thus, the two of them had a powerful weapon that could intimidate the other.
What was originally a close-quarters battle had become a long-distance exchange of blows and pursuit.
“Sigh!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Though it was still a tie at the moment, it was clear who was stronger at a glance.
—Ling Han was relying completely on his own abilities, and as for Han Yun?
The reason why he could use saintly might was because a Saintly bone had been implanted into his body.
How could they compare?
But in this world, only the result mattered, and no one asked for the reason.
Han Yun had not lost, and that was enough.
Furthermore, when he advanced into Saint Tier in future, what about Ling Han?
He was an eternal Sect Master.
“Let’s attack together, and eliminate this scourge!” Another Imperial Son declared.
That was Yi Taishu.
Previously, he had made a bet with Ling Han, and lost over a hundred Eight Star Celestial Qi.
Just thinking about it made him feel suffocated.
By now, he was already an eight-star Venerate, and also had Saintly bones in his body.
His battle prowess was only slightly inferior to Han Yun.
Xiu, with a leap, he joined the battle.
“You people are too despicable!” the little azure dragon shouted, about to join the battle.
“No need to come!” Ling Han laughed loudly, appearing extremely heroic, “Today, I will defeat these weaklings!”
‘What?’
He actually dared to compare the Golden Generation to weaklings?
The remaining Golden Generations were all enraged.
Furthermore, the feeling that Ling Han gave them was really too dangerous.
It was clear that he should be eternally stuck at Sect Master-level, but his abilities were still continuously improving, which made them feel uneasy.
Kill, only by killing him would they be able to let go of the weight in their hearts.
One after another, the Golden Generations joined the battle.
Aside from a limited few members of the Imperial Clans that remained neutral, the other members of the Golden Generation all took the field.
And in this kind of battle, the Venerate Tier-level Silver Generations weren’t even qualified to participate in the battle.
What was the point of Venerates below five stars fighting?
They would be completely insta-killed by Ling Han.
Ling Han laughed loudly, his heroic spirit like an ocean.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Come on then!
Boom, he finally unleashed his full battle prowess.
99 Six Star Regulations appeared, intertwining to form a staff that he held in his hand, sweeping out in all directions.
His spirit was too strong.
Though there was an end to the number of Regulations, with the boost of his divine sense, this staff of Regulations had enlarged to about three thousand meters in size.
With a wave of the staff, the Imperial Sons could only flee in disarray.
If they came into contact with it, they would definitely die.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
How could this be?
In their one-on-one battle just then, Ling Han and Han Yun had only been equally matched.
Now, however, he was actually able to rival so many Imperial Sons without falling into a disadvantage?
Heavens!

chapters.title: Chapter 4573: Showing off his might
paragraphs: Chapter 4573: Showing off his might
Editor: Henyee Translations

Previously, Ling Han had deliberately reserved some strength, and only used the 95 Regulations, but now, those who should make a move had all made their move, so he was no longer hiding his abilities.
Boom, the staff that was formed from the 99 flashes of Regulations was too terrifying. With a single strike, the Imperial Sons were all running here and there, dodging in a sorry state.
However, the Imperial Sons were not to be trifled with either.
When Ling Han’s staff swept past, they immediately took advantage of the opening to attack.
Weng! A tower of lightning materialized above Ling Han’s head, radiating with Primal Chaos Qi and blocking all of the attacks.
Hong long long, though the tower trembled, it still gave Ling Han some rebounding power, but what was this slight tremor worth to Ling Han’s powerful physique?
“Bunch of trash!” Ling Han charged out, his staff of Regulations sweeping out, displaying an invincible stance.
“Come, let’s work together!” Han Yun shouted loudly.
To be attacked so tragically by a Sect Master, they were really too embarrassed.
“Do you really think that we are no match for you?” All the Imperial Sons smirked coldly.
Boom, they joined forces, and wrapped the saintly power around their hands. Then, they all blasted towards the staff of Regulations.
Peng!

After all, it was a dozen or so Golden Generations, and they were all using saintly might. With their combined efforts, the staff of Regulations was finally blocked, and it was gripped tightly at that.
At this time, the remaining three Golden Generations took advantage of the opening to charge towards Ling Han.
How was he supposed to defend?
Ling Han smiled, and very decisively let go, “If you guys like it, just take it.”
He shook his hands again, and a sword of Regulations appeared in each of his hands. He charged towards the Golden Generations that were attacking.
The expressions of the three Golden Generations changed drastically, and they hurriedly retreated.
They were too deceived by their inherent beliefs. They thought that as long as they could grab hold of Ling Han’s weapon, Ling Han’s battle prowess would naturally be greatly destroyed.
This was a f****** manifestation of Regulations. Ling Han just had to regather Regulations as he liked.
He aggressively pursued the three Golden Generations, and the other Golden Generations hurriedly chased after him. They couldn’t give Ling Han a chance to defeat them one by one.
However, in terms of speed, how could they compare to Phoenix Wings Divine Flight?
Ling Han flapped his flaming wings, and in just a few moves, he had already caught up to the three Golden Generations.
As the Sword of Regulations slashed out, it was also entwined with Destructive Energy.
This was even more terrifying, and this was Ling Han’s true killing move.
The three Golden Generations could no longer retreat. They all roared loudly, and used their saintly power to counterattack Ling Han.
At this moment, there was no time for them to retreat. Otherwise, they would definitely die.
Peng!
The three of them joined forces, and blasted onto the Sword of Regulations.

“Ah!” They all screamed in agony. The might of the sword of Regulations and the Destructive Energy was too terrifying. It had directly penetrated their defenses, and caused great damage to their physical bodies.
However, Ling Han wasn’t having a good time either.

Under the backlash from the Saint-level power, he was also throwing up blood madly. He felt that there were three different powers surging in his body. Though they were not very strong, in terms of quality, they were too terrifying, and possessed the ability to crush him.

Hence, these three streaks of power were like three needles. Though the wound that they had pierced was not very big, they were all causing damage inside his body, and for the moment, he could not pacify them.
This was the power of a Saint.
Even if it was only a Saintly bone, and furthermore, it was fused into the body of a Venerate Tier, so it could only unleash a little bit of its might.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, the Imperial Sons quickly charged over from behind.
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and temporarily suppressed the foreign power in his body. Then, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and charged out of the encirclement.

In this exchange, Ling Han was slightly injured, but the three Imperial Sons were severely injured. If it was not for the fact that they still had the defense of Saintly Bones inside their bodies, it was not impossible that they would be insta-killed.

All the Imperial Sons were astounded. When one had reached the level of Venerate Tier, the Substitution Seal was no longer effective. If one was killed, that would be absolute death, and there would be no second chance.
“Charge!” They were all furious. They wanted to take advantage of the chance when Ling Han was injured to take down this strongest opponent.
Boom!
They had all used the unique ability of Venerate Tier. The Four Extremes manifested, connecting heaven and earth, as if it was an omnipotent giant.

Ling Han merely dodged and did not attack. He was presently using Ten Cultivation Technique to refine the foreign power in his body. This was saintly power, and though it was pitifully little, it was like a thin needle stabbing into his body, stabbing him at all times, making him feel extremely uncomfortable.
In this way, he was naturally at a disadvantage.

The Imperial Sons took advantage of the victory to press their advantage. The Fourth Extreme connected the heaven and earth, and was their weapons and eyes and ears. Wherever Ling Han went, he would be attacked harshly.
Thankfully, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was kickass enough, allowing Ling Han to move unhindered.
Very quickly, Ling Han forced out the saintly power in his body.
This time, his battle prowess was fully recovered, and he had nothing to worry about.
Boom, he brandished the staff of Regulations again, incredibly domineering.
“Good one!” The little azure dragon and the large black dog were both cheering him on, while Brother Monkey was completely unconcerned. He was only observing the area ahead of him.
That was because he had absolute trust in Ling Han.

So what if the Fourth Extreme held up the heavens and connected the earth? Under the sweep of the staff of Regulations, it was still destroyed completely, because there was still Destructive Energy on the staff of Regulations. This destructive power far surpassed the level of Venerate Tier.
“Brother!” At this moment, Brother Monkey suddenly called out, “Follow Old Sun!”
With the Fiery Golden Eyes, he could see through everything.
“All right!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and withdrew his attack. With a leap, he landed beside Brother Monkey.
The Imperial Sons only chased for two steps before stopping.
One Ling Han was already very difficult to deal with, and now there was Brother Monkey?

It should be known that Brother Monkey was the first of the younger generation to break through to Venerate Tier, much earlier than Imperial Son Tian and the others. At that time, he had even fought against three of them all by himself, and forced Imperial Son Tian and the others to flee in disarray.
He added with Ling Han, with the two of them working together, their battle prowess was naturally even stronger.
“Let’s go.” Brother Monkey slung the metal rod over his shoulder and strode forward, completely ignoring those Imperial Sons.
This kind of indifference was too destructive, causing the Golden Generation’s members to feel extremely stifled.
Ling Han followed Brother Monkey. He wasn’t walking randomly, but rather following a certain pattern.
“B@stards, come at me if you have the guts!”
The large black dog and little azure dragon both gave the Imperial Sons the middle finger, then followed Ling Han.

This infuriated the Imperial Sons. However, the valley was extremely dangerous, and it was completely unsuitable for them to gang up on Ling Han here. Thus, if they rashly pursued him, it was extremely likely that Ling Han would defeat them one by one, or use the killing intent in the valley to kill them.
They exchanged looks. If Baili Tian and Yan Dongming didn’t appear, was there no one who could deal with Ling Han and the others?
Ahead of them, Brother Monkey took the lead.
With the help of the Fiery Golden Eyes, he saw through the killing intent in this canyon. Every step was very particular, and he couldn’t make a mistake.

After walking for a long time, they finally arrived at the end of the canyon. However, they shockingly discovered that there was a mountain wall at the end, and there was a clear palm print engraved on it.
“Yi, could it be that it was this palm that pushed out this canyon?” Ling Han and the others all guessed.
The person who had attacked was definitely incredibly powerful.
