chapters.title: Chapter 4574: Saintly medicine and severed arm
paragraphs: Chapter 4574: Saintly medicine and severed arm
Editor: Henyee Translations
Previously, when Ling Han had exchanged blows with the Imperial Sons, his battle prowess was on full throttle, and he did not hold back in the slightest.
However, this canyon was unscathed. Only a few pieces of rubble had been shaken off, which was proof enough of its sturdiness.
However, this palm strike had blasted the canyon over a few hundred kilometers, so how terrifying was its might?
Thus, the strength of this person definitely far surpassed Venerate Tier.
“This is the doing of a Saint.”

This was the Saint Tomb. Throughout history, there had been far too many Saints who hadme here to search for the holy flame. Some hadme here to strengthen their abilities, while others hadme here to extend their lifespan. Thus, it was only natural that the doings of a Saint would appear here.
“Yi, there is the fragrance of herbs!”
“Saintly medicine?”
The four of them took a deep breath at the same time. That was because theyuld smell the fragrance of herbs, causing all the pores on their bodies to open up, which was incrediblymfortable.
It was as if Heavenly Dao was right in front of their eyes, within reach.
Only the Saintly medicineuld do this. Furthermore, it was a fully mature Saintly medicine, whichntained the power of stars, the light of time, and shards of Regulations.
The four of them hurriedly searched, and soon found a plant that was no more than a foot tall at the foot of the mountain. It just happened to bear four fruits.
“Saintly medicine!” Their eyes lit up.

They were all Venerates or possessed Venerate Tier-level battle prowess. If they directly ingested the Saintly medicine, the powerful medicinal effects would cause their bodies to explode and they would die.
However, Ling Han was also an alchemist, and the Alchemy Emperor at that!
Hence, as long as he moved, andcted the Saintly medicine into an alchemical pill, heuldmpletely degrade it to bensumed by a Venerate.
After all, he had obtained the true inheritance of an Alchemy Saint.
However, they did not act rashly.
That was because this Saintly medicine was actually exuding saintly might. If one forcibly stepped forwards to pluck it, they would only be shattered into pieces.
Strange.

The four of them were allnfused. No matter what kind of Celestial medicine it was, ituld not possibly have any destructive power by itself. At most, it would only have a little poison, or have spikes thatuld ignore the defense of one’s physique, and so on.
But to release pressure like a Saint, this was too inceivable.
“Strange,” they all said.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey used their eye technique and Fiery Golden Eyes respectively to look ahead. After a while, they both nodded.

“The problem is not above this Saintly medicine, but rather beneath it, there is an object that has been enveloped by light,” Ling Han said. His eye technique was also unable to penetrate that light, and see through to its essence.
Brother Monkey nodded. He had also seen the same thing.

“Then what do we do?” the large black dog asked anxiously, as he rubbed his paws together. The Saintly medicine was right in front of him, yetuld not be harvested. He was really about to die of anxiety.
Ling Han and Brother Monkeyntinued to observe. If thingsuldn’t be done, they would resolutely give up. No matter how good Saintly medicine was,uld theympare to their lives?
“It’s possible.” After a while, the two of them looked at each other at the same time, and both nodded.
“Brother Monkey,operate with me,” Ling Han said.
“Alright,” Brother Monkey nodded.
The two of them separated slightly, then took a step forwards at the same time.
“Yi?” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both let out surprised exclamations, because Ling Han and Brother Monkey were both perfectly fine, and had not suffered any injury.

One had to realize that the saintly might would permeate the surroundings if they advanced one step further. Even if they weren’t shattered into pieces, they would at least be able to cause blood vessels to explode and skin to bleed.
Yet Ling Han and Brother Monkey were actually unscathed!

“That’s right.” The little azure dragon clapped its hands, and analyzed, “If the front ismpared to a formation, then the two of them would be stepping on the nodes within respectively. Furthermore, they would be nodes thatuld resonate, which would be just enough to affect the formation, and minimize its might.”
Only Ling Han and Brother Monkeyuld do this, because they had both awakened a vision-type Mystical Power.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎

Ofurse, in the case of others, Ding Shu and the Genesis World rulersuld do the same. Imperial Son Ming also had the Void Eye Technique, so heuld do the same. However, Ding Shu and the others hadn’t arrived yet, and Imperial Son Ming hadn’tme at all.

As the large black dog listened, realization spread across his face. However, after the little azure dragon finished speaking, he immediately became angry and embarrassed, and said, “What doesn’t Grandpa Dog understand? Do I need a little kid like you to give me pointers?”
“Despicable dog, if Grandpa Dragon didn’t teach you, what would you know!” the little azure dragon immediately retorted.
“See if I don’t bite you to death, you four-legged snake!”
“I’ll beat you up, you old black dog!”
“Woof!”
“Ao!”
The two of them started fighting again.

Ling Han and Brother Monkey moved in unison. You take one step, and I will also take a step. The two of them were like formation eyes, always stepping on the most crucial point, so that the saintly might would not be able to permeate onto them.
After carefully walking for a dozen over steps, they finally arrived in front of that Saintly medicine.
Ling Han moved, and gently plucked the fruits from the Saintly medicine.
“Look down?” he asked.
Brother Monkey nodded, an expectant look in his eyes.
Looks like Brother Monkey was not only bellse, but also a curious person.

Ling Han and Brother Monkey dug up the dirt, and not long after, they divered that ball of light, and looking at it with the naked eye, that ball of light was actually not that blazing. Theyuld clearly see what was inside the ball of light.
In truth, it should be said that something was glowing.
A hand, a severed hand.

This was a hand that had been forcefully torn off. Its fingers were slender and long, its skin snow-white and delicate. At a glance, it was obvious that it was a female hand. It had been forcefully torn off at the wrist, and oneuld see its snow-white bones, which were still dripping with blood.
“Wu!”
Ling Han and Brother Monkey both felt a terrible pain in their eyes, anduldn’t help but shed tears of blood.
The two of them hurriedly turned around and buried the dirt back in. Then, they quickly retreated.
“What did you guys see?” the large black dog and little azure dragon hurriedly asked.

“A broken arm,” Ling Han said. He wiped away the tears of blood. Thankfully, his eyes had not been injured, “It should be the hand of a Saint. In fact, it may have been the hand of a Saint that had delivered a palm strike at this canyon.”
Thus, the saintly might of this place diffused, anduld not be approached, and under the nourishment of the Saintly Blood, it actually nurtured a Saintly medicine
“This Saint must be very strong!”
“En, in the case of an ordinary Saint, even if there were eight to ten of them minced into pulp and planted into the ground, they may not be able to mature a Saintly medicine.”
“And now, a severed hand has nurtured a Saintly medicine. This Saint… is probably above seven stars in cultivation level.”
“Unfortunately, she still euntered a powerful enemy, and one of her hands was actually severed.”

This severed hand must have been torn off from that Saint when she was still alive. Otherwise, if the hand had been severed after death, the Saintly Blood would not have that kind of vitality, anduld not have possibly nurtured Saintly medicine.
Only a living oneuld provide such thriving vitality.
“The Saint… Heh, is this the tomb of Saints after death, or the tomb of Saints buried alive!”
The four of them felt rueful. This place was really a little strange.
“I hope the old man can leave safely.”
“Let’s go.”
Since the Saintly medicine had already been harvested, what was the point of staying here any longer?

The four of themntinued onwards. After climbing over this mountain wall, there was a massive dark forest ahead of them, but there was an extremely wide path in the middle that extended into the distance. The enduld not be seen.

The Saintly medicine was right in front of him, yetuld not be harvested.

If thingsuldn’t be done, they would resolutely give up.
No matter how good Saintly medicine was,uld theympare to their lives?

“Yi?” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both let out surprised exclamations, because Ling Han and Brother Monkey were both perfectly fine, and had not suffered any injury.
One had to realize that the saintly might would permeate the surroundings if they advanced one step further.
Even if they weren’t shattered into pieces, they would at least be able to cause blood vessels to explode and skin to bleed.
Yet Ling Han and Brother Monkey were actually unscathed!

Only Ling Han and Brother Monkeyuld do this, because they had both awakened a vision-type Mystical Power.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Ofurse, in the case of others, Ding Shu and the Genesis World rulersuld do the same.
Imperial Son Ming also had the Void Eye Technique, so heuld do the same.

“See if I don’t bite you to death, you four-legged snake!”

“Woof!”
“Ao!”

You take one step, and I will also take a step.

A hand, a severed hand.

Thankfully, his eyes had not been injured, “It should be the hand of a Saint.

Thus, the saintly might of this place diffused, anduld not be approached, and under the nourishment of the Saintly Blood, it actually nurtured a Saintly medicine
“This Saint must be very strong!”
“En, in the case of an ordinary Saint, even if there were eight to ten of them minced into pulp and planted into the ground, they may not be able to mature a Saintly medicine.”
“And now, a severed hand has nurtured a Saintly medicine.
This Saint… is probably above seven stars in cultivation level.”
“Unfortunately, she still euntered a powerful enemy, and one of her hands was actually severed.”
This severed hand must have been torn off from that Saint when she was still alive.
Otherwise, if the hand had been severed after death, the Saintly Blood would not have that kind of vitality, anduld not have possibly nurtured Saintly medicine.
Only a living oneuld provide such thriving vitality.
“The Saint…
Heh, is this the tomb of Saints after death, or the tomb of Saints buried alive!”
The four of them felt rueful.
This place was really a little strange.
“I hope the old man can leave safely.”
“Let’s go.”
Since the Saintly medicine had already been harvested, what was the point of staying here any longer?
The four of themntinued onwards.
After climbing over this mountain wall, there was a massive dark forest ahead of them, but there was an extremely wide path in the middle that extended into the distance.
The enduld not be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 4575: Blood-coloured Worm
paragraphs: Chapter 4575: Bloodloured Worm
Editor: Henyee Translations
This was a vast black forest. What was shocking was that these trees actually did not die, and were still exuding slivers of vitality.
There was only one type of tree in the black forest. The tallest was close to three hundred meters tall, but the leaves were all the size of cattail leaf fans, as smooth as iron plates.
Though there was life in this place, it still gave off a feeling of desolation.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey both looked at it with their eye techniques, then nodded.
It was fine, theyuld go through it.
The four of them moved out, and walked into the forest.
“Strange!”
After walking for a while, Ling Han finally spoke.
“En, strange!” The large black dog also said.
“What’s strange about it?” the little azure dragon asked.

“Four-Legged Snake, you’re really too inexperienced!” The large black dog took the opportunity to teach the little dragon a lesson. “Look, there are trees here, but there’s not a single leaf on the ground. Isn’t this strange?”
“This…” The little azure dragon pondered for a moment. “Perhaps they were blown away by the strong winds?”

“Why didn’t it sweep you away?” the large black dog sneered, “Even if the strong windsntinue, you should still be able to see the leaves fluttering in the wind, and when the winds stop, there would definitely be fallen leaves on the ground.”
“Now, do you see any leaves in the air, or fallen leaves on the ground?”
The little azure dragon was instantly rendered speechless.

In terms of battle prowess at the same cultivation level, the little azure dragon was definitely stronger than the large black dog. However, in terms of experience, the little azure dragonuldn’tmpare to the large black dog.
In the Genesis World, how long had the large black dog been alive for?
All the Saints in history added together may not have lived as long as the large black dog.

Thus, Ling Han and the large black dog’s reactions in some details far surpassed that of the little azure dragon and Brother Monkey. This was somethingming from the fact that they had experienced enough, anduld not be helped.
“Then tell me, what’s going on?” the little azure dragon asked.

Ling Han had also been thinking about this problem this entire time, and he said, “Firstly, these leaves will never wilt, and sndly, some kind of living creatures are living underground. They specialize in eating fallen leaves, and will be eaten the moment they fall.”
However, the snd possibility was too small.
The falling of leaves should have happened at all times. After all, this forest was so big, but as far as theyuld see,uld they possibly see any leaves falling?
“Won’t we know if we pluck a leaf and take a look?” Brother Monkey said.
Instead of analyzing for such a long time here, they might as well make a move and give it a try!
This was Brother Monkey’s train of thought. He would always use the simplest method to deal with problems, regardless of whether this method was dangerous or not.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
…There were few members of the line of the Battle Saint Emperor… Er, heuldn’tmplain anymore.
Ling Han warned himself that he had to change.
Brother Monkey walked to the side of a large tree, and stretched out a hand to grab at a leaf.

There was a gap of about nine meters between him and this tree leaf, but with his strength, to say nothing of a gap of nine meters, even if there was a gap of 90,000 meters, it would still be a piece of cake for him.
However, they divered that under this move from Brother Monkey, the tree leaf did not move at all.
Yi?
Although Brother Monkey definitely wouldn’t waste much power on a leaf, a nine-star Venerate actuallyuldn’t even pluck a single leaf. This was strange.
What was going on?

Brother Monkey was also stunned for a moment. If this was Ling Han, he would definitely activate his eye technique to take a closer look. No matter what, he would have to study it. However, Brother Monkey’s thoughts were not so roundabout. He directly increased the power of his movement.
Pa, a leaf was forcibly torn off by him.
However, the entire tree was trembling, as if it was a living creature.
Ling Han and the others were all stunned. This tree was far too strange.

He had not even finished the thought, when he saw that where the leaf stem had been severed, a bloodloured insect that was three feet long had crawled out. There were streaks of yellowish-yellow lines on its body, and it had many small legs. It was squirming, which was incredibly disgusting.
This insect stared at Ling Han and the others, its small eyes exuding killing intent.
Xiu, this insect arched its body, and charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Hanuldn’t help but grit his teeth in pain. It wasn’t him who had done it, so why was it targeting him?
‘Do you think I’m easy to bully just because my cultivation level is low?’
“Haha!” The large black dog and little azure dragon immediately laughed.
Ling Han shook his head, and pressed down with his hand. This insect was under hisntrol, and it hovered in midair.
“Sect Master-level!”
“Hiss, as a little insect, this is very awesome.”
The large black dog and little azure dragon said one after another.

Ferocious beasts wouldn’t cultivate, so theyuld naturally grow to therresponding cultivation level. Generally speaking, however, ferocious beasts thatuld reach a higher cultivation level were all famous breeds such as Primordial Demonic Elephant, Green Patterned Black Python, and so on.
This insect that was obviously parasitizing on a tree branchuld actually reach the level of Sect Master. This was very illogical.
It should be known that though wild beasts would be able to reach therresponding cultivation level after they matured, they still had to have enough “nourishment”.
Just think, a Sect Master was already powerful enough to be regarded as a great elite. How much energy would one need to expend to raise such a ferocious beast?
This great treeuld actually raise it?
Furthermore… there might not be just one.
“Let’s try again.”
They plucked a leaf again, and sure enough, a snd bloodlored insect appeared. However, after plucking the third leaf, no insect appeared, but after the fourth leaf, it came again.
After plucking a hundred leaves in a row, they came to a roughnclusion. This tree was indeed infested with a large number of insects. For every ten leaves, there were about seven parasitic insects.
This was an astounding number. Just how large was this forest?
They were all Sect Master-level insects?
Hiss!
Now, the dozens of insects were all squirming, wanting to break free from Ling Han’sntrol, and attack him.
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and pa, pa, pa, these insects all turned into bloody foam.
Mere Sect Masters actually dared to be impudent in front of him? He was someone whould insta-kill the majority of nine-star Venerates.
“These insects are much weaker than normal Sect Masters,” he added.
“However, an abundance of ants can bite an elephant to death. If all the insects in this forest were really provoked, no one would be able to bear it,” the large black dog bared his teeth and said.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon was curious. “Could it be that theseare all Celestial Trees? Otherwise, howuld they have nurtured so many Sect Master-level Blood Insects?”
With these words, the four of them were slightly excited.
One black treeuld nurture several hundred Blood Insects; how nutritious would that be? And this kind of tree… there was a whole forest of them.
“Come, try cutting one,” they all said.
In any case, there were so many trees, so theyuld use one to test it out. Even if it was damaged, it would be bearable.
They had not made their move, when they felt a wave of auraming from behind them.
The four of them turned around, only to see Origin, Ding Shu, Myriad Dao and the others rapidly approaching.
Aside from them, the Imperial Sons also followed behind, and the Dao Childs were even further behind.
“Wait first,” Ling Han said.
How fast was the speed of a Venerate? Xiu, xiu, xiu! Origin and the others descended one after another.
“Yi, there are so many insectrpses here,” Myriad Dao immediately said.
“The aura of Sect Master-level.” Origin also said.
“So smelly!” Shui Qingchang waved her delicate hand in front of her nose.
They were all curious. Why were there so many insects all over the ground?

chapters.title: Chapter 4576: Sea of insects
paragraphs: Chapter 4576: Sea of insects
Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone was curious. Howuld there be so many insects here?
They looked at the passageway in the black forest, and all of them began to hesitate.
Just how many unknown dangers lay ahead of them?
They hadme to search for great opportunities, not to seek death.
Ling Han and the others didn’t say anything. These trees might be Great Herbs, but it was best to keep this secret in their hearts.
“There’s something strange about this forest!” Origin suddenly said.
“En, there are no fallen leaves,” Heaven Crushing also said.
With their reminder, everyone came to a sudden realization.
This was indeed very strange.
Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed. Others might have been careless, but as the Genesis World’s rulers, howuld it be that Origin and the others didn’t have enough experience?
Some rashly went to pluck the leaves, and when they divered that they actuallyuldn’t pluck it easily, they were all extremely curious.
However, no matter what, howuld mere tree leaves be difficult for these Venerates and Sect Masters?

Very quickly, large swathes of leaves were torn off, but multiple bloodloured worms also crawled out from where the leaves had been severed. Xiu, xiu, xiu, they arched their bodies and charged towards the masses.
“Humph, merely Sect Master-level!” Someone smirkedldly, and delivered a palm strike. Pa, pa, pa! Instantly, large swathes of the bloodloured worms died.
“So what if it is Sect Master-level?” Ling Han glared at him.
That was a Venerate, and he was already a Four-Star Venerate. However, with Ling Han’s glare, he didn’t dare to say a word.
F***, though this lord was also a Sect Master, his abilities had far surpassed a Nine Star Venerate.
In a moment of carelessness, he had also struck a blow on Ling Han. Naturally, he was asking for his own humiliation.
There were far too many Venerates here, so theyuld easily kill all of the bloodlored insects with a casual wave of their hand.
“Yi, are these insects absorbing the nutrients in the tree sap?” someone immediately asked.
“Hiss, absorbing tree sap can actually help them to grow to the level of Sect Master. These trees…”
Everyone inhaled sharply. This was an indescribable treasure trove.
There was no need for anyone to remind them. Everyone dispersed, and began to cut down the black trees.
Treasure, treasure!
“Sigh.” Ling Han shook his head, appearing very regretful.
However, this forest was too big, and the four of themuldn’t harvest itmpletely. It was impossible to monopolize it.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The weakest person here had also reached the level of Sect Master. How easy would it be to cut down a tree?
—Though it was indeed somewhat difficult.
But very soon, one after another, the great treesllapsed, releasing loud bangs.
More bloodlored worms crawled out from the tree trunks, launching attacks at everyone.

It was not just that. Someone had dug out a great tree by the roots. This was like turning over a hornet’s nest. A large number of bloodlored worms surged out from the ground. The scene of them densely packed together caused one’s heart to palpitate, and was incredibly gross.
Ling Han also casually severed a large tree. His eyes swept over it, yet he was surprised.
Because the tree trunk was hollow, when it was severed, a fountain of liquid spluttered out, emitting a putrid and disgusting smell.
This was Celestial medicine?

Ling Han shook his head. There was indeed astonishing energyntained within, but it was filled with poison, and wasmpletely unsuitable for a cultivator to refine. If he forcibly refined it, that would only kill him, and his lifespan would rapidly shrink.
No wonder these bloodloured worms were so weak. They were all a morbid kind of Sect Master-level fierce beasts.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
As more and more great trees fell, the number of bloodloured worms also increased further, numbering in the tens of thousands, or even in the hundreds of thousands.
Even if their strength was very weak, they were still Sect Master-level, after all. When their numbers reached a certain extent, they were still boundlessly terrifying.
Pu, pu, pu! They spat out liquid, which turned into multiple arrows that shot towards everyone.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
This liquid arrow was filled with a fishy stench that would make anyone want to vomit.

Some people were already beginning to vomit. Moreover, it was useless even if they held their breaths. This stenchuld directly spread through their skin, causing them to feel nauseous and lose all ability to fight.

“Is this what it means by ‘I can’t defeat you, but can disgust you to death’?” the large black dog mumbled. He was a Venerate, and he had used Regulations to form a shield. It was impossible for the liquid arrow to penetrate his defenses.
However, after several dozen to several hundred strikes, this shield was also slowly melting.
This was truly a case of ants biting an elephant to death.

Someone was hit, and the liquid arrow had landed on him. That patch of skin immediately began to rot. Furthermore, it was stillntinuously expanding, and very soon, a large hole had been torn into their body.
This was also very terrifying.
At present, the Venerates were still able to move with ease, but the Sect Masters were struggling. There were really too many bloodloured worms.
“Let’s go, let’s go.”
The surviving people all shouted loudly, and hurriedly soared into the sky, heading towards the depths of the forest.
What Celestial Tree was this? It was practically a rotten tree.
No one had any more greed, and left, one after another.
However, it was as if the bloodlored worms had also been angered. They similarly soared into the sky, andntinued to attack.
“Humph, do you really think I’m afraid of you guys?” This enraged a great many Venerates. They weren’t going to get serious, and you guys are still being overbearing?
Shua, shua, shua! The Venerates moved, and the Seven Star Regulations surged. The Fourth Extreme held up the skies, and instantly, masses of bloodloured worms died.
Previously, the Venerates had also joined the retreating troops. It was not that the Venerates were no match for them, but rather that there was no need.
Theyuldn’t reap any benefits, so what was the point of fighting?
However, the bloodlored wormsntinued to press down on them, and this naturally angered the Venerates.
Ling Han and the others didn’t attack. They simply stood in the air, and onlyunterattacked when insects attacked them.
“There’s movement,” Ling Han suddenly said, looking into the distance.

Brother Monkey and the others also looked over. With a bang, the ground split open, and a huge insect crawled out. It was as long as 30 meters. Its body was round, especially its stomach, which was bulging largely.
This giant insect aimed its behind at the people in the skies, and then began to squirm rhythmically. Peng, peng, peng! Instantly, multiple balls of light shot towards the people in the skies.

Pa, someone didn’t manage to dodge in time and was hit by the ball of light. The ball of light exploded, and it was actually a ball of liquid. The liquid inside splattered, and what was emitting light was precisely the liquid inside.

“Ah!” The person that had been hit released a terrible scream, and fell from the skies. He had not even landed on the ground, when his whole person had already melted to the point that not even a single bone was left behind.
‘Such terrifying power!’
Though that person was only a Sect Master, being insta-killed with a single strike still caused everyone to be greatly vigilant.
“This is a Venerate Tier-level insect,” the large black dog said. “Even its fart is so powerful!”
No wonder therrosive ability was so strong.
Pu, pu, pu! The giant insect attackedntinuously, and the balls of light swept towards everyone like a cannonball.

“Humph!” A Venerate moved, launching a strike. Peng, the ball of light instantly exploded in midair,rrosive light liquid spraying out. Its might was not the slightest bit inferior to exploding after hitting its target.
This caused everyone’s expressions to change drastically. This was a little troublesome.
“To take down the masses, capture the ringleader.” Heaven Crushing humphed, and directly charged down.
However, the bloodlored worms tried their best to block them. Though they died in droves, more and more worms pounced forwards.

Just how many unknown dangers lay ahead of them?
They hadme to search for great opportunities, not to seek death.
Ling Han and the others didn’t say anything.
These trees might be Great Herbs, but it was best to keep this secret in their hearts.
“There’s something strange about this forest!” Origin suddenly said.
“En, there are no fallen leaves,” Heaven Crushing also said.
With their reminder, everyone came to a sudden realization.
This was indeed very strange.
Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed.
Others might have been careless, but as the Genesis World’s rulers, howuld it be that Origin and the others didn’t have enough experience?
Some rashly went to pluck the leaves, and when they divered that they actuallyuldn’t pluck it easily, they were all extremely curious.
However, no matter what, howuld mere tree leaves be difficult for these Venerates and Sect Masters?
Very quickly, large swathes of leaves were torn off, but multiple bloodloured worms also crawled out from where the leaves had been severed.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, they arched their bodies and charged towards the masses.
“Humph, merely Sect Master-level!” Someone smirkedldly, and delivered a palm strike.
Pa, pa, pa!
Instantly, large swathes of the bloodloured worms died.
“So what if it is Sect Master-level?” Ling Han glared at him.
That was a Venerate, and he was already a Four-Star Venerate.
However, with Ling Han’s glare, he didn’t dare to say a word.
F***, though this lord was also a Sect Master, his abilities had far surpassed a Nine Star Venerate.
In a moment of carelessness, he had also struck a blow on Ling Han.
Naturally, he was asking for his own humiliation.
There were far too many Venerates here, so theyuld easily kill all of the bloodlored insects with a casual wave of their hand.
“Yi, are these insects absorbing the nutrients in the tree sap?” someone immediately asked.
“Hiss, absorbing tree sap can actually help them to grow to the level of Sect Master.
These trees…”
Everyone inhaled sharply.
This was an indescribable treasure trove.
There was no need for anyone to remind them.
Everyone dispersed, and began to cut down the black trees.
Treasure, treasure!
“Sigh.” Ling Han shook his head, appearing very regretful.
However, this forest was too big, and the four of themuldn’t harvest itmpletely.
It was impossible to monopolize it.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The weakest person here had also reached the level of Sect Master.
How easy would it be to cut down a tree?
—Though it was indeed somewhat difficult.
But very soon, one after another, the great treesllapsed, releasing loud bangs.
More bloodlored worms crawled out from the tree trunks, launching attacks at everyone.
It was not just that.
Someone had dug out a great tree by the roots.
This was like turning over a hornet’s nest.
A large number of bloodlored worms surged out from the ground.
The scene of them densely packed together caused one’s heart to palpitate, and was incredibly gross.
Ling Han also casually severed a large tree.
His eyes swept over it, yet he was surprised.
Because the tree trunk was hollow, when it was severed, a fountain of liquid spluttered out, emitting a putrid and disgusting smell.
This was Celestial medicine?
Ling Han shook his head.
There was indeed astonishing energyntained within, but it was filled with poison, and wasmpletely unsuitable for a cultivator to refine.
If he forcibly refined it, that would only kill him, and his lifespan would rapidly shrink.
No wonder these bloodloured worms were so weak.
They were all a morbid kind of Sect Master-level fierce beasts.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
As more and more great trees fell, the number of bloodloured worms also increased further, numbering in the tens of thousands, or even in the hundreds of thousands.
Even if their strength was very weak, they were still Sect Master-level, after all.
When their numbers reached a certain extent, they were still boundlessly terrifying.
Pu, pu, pu!
They spat out liquid, which turned into multiple arrows that shot towards everyone.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
This liquid arrow was filled with a fishy stench that would make anyone want to vomit.
Some people were already beginning to vomit.
Moreover, it was useless even if they held their breaths.
This stenchuld directly spread through their skin, causing them to feel nauseous and lose all ability to fight.
“Is this what it means by ‘I can’t defeat you, but can disgust you to death’?” the large black dog mumbled.
He was a Venerate, and he had used Regulations to form a shield.
It was impossible for the liquid arrow to penetrate his defenses.
However, after several dozen to several hundred strikes, this shield was also slowly melting.
This was truly a case of ants biting an elephant to death.
Someone was hit, and the liquid arrow had landed on him.
That patch of skin immediately began to rot.
Furthermore, it was stillntinuously expanding, and very soon, a large hole had been torn into their body.
This was also very terrifying.
At present, the Venerates were still able to move with ease, but the Sect Masters were struggling.
There were really too many bloodloured worms.
“Let’s go, let’s go.”
The surviving people all shouted loudly, and hurriedly soared into the sky, heading towards the depths of the forest.
What Celestial Tree was this?
It was practically a rotten tree.
No one had any more greed, and left, one after another.
However, it was as if the bloodlored worms had also been angered.
They similarly soared into the sky, andntinued to attack.
“Humph, do you really think I’m afraid of you guys?” This enraged a great many Venerates.
They weren’t going to get serious, and you guys are still being overbearing?
Shua, shua, shua!
The Venerates moved, and the Seven Star Regulations surged.
The Fourth Extreme held up the skies, and instantly, masses of bloodloured worms died.
Previously, the Venerates had also joined the retreating troops.
It was not that the Venerates were no match for them, but rather that there was no need.
Theyuldn’t reap any benefits, so what was the point of fighting?
However, the bloodlored wormsntinued to press down on them, and this naturally angered the Venerates.
Ling Han and the others didn’t attack.
They simply stood in the air, and onlyunterattacked when insects attacked them.
“There’s movement,” Ling Han suddenly said, looking into the distance.
Brother Monkey and the others also looked over.
With a bang, the ground split open, and a huge insect crawled out.
It was as long as 30 meters.
Its body was round, especially its stomach, which was bulging largely.
This giant insect aimed its behind at the people in the skies, and then began to squirm rhythmically.
Peng, peng, peng!
Instantly, multiple balls of light shot towards the people in the skies.
Pa, someone didn’t manage to dodge in time and was hit by the ball of light.
The ball of light exploded, and it was actually a ball of liquid.
The liquid inside splattered, and what was emitting light was precisely the liquid inside.
“Ah!” The person that had been hit released a terrible scream, and fell from the skies.
He had not even landed on the ground, when his whole person had already melted to the point that not even a single bone was left behind.
‘Such terrifying power!’
Though that person was only a Sect Master, being insta-killed with a single strike still caused everyone to be greatly vigilant.
“This is a Venerate Tier-level insect,” the large black dog said.
“Even its fart is so powerful!”
No wonder therrosive ability was so strong.
Pu, pu, pu!
The giant insect attackedntinuously, and the balls of light swept towards everyone like a cannonball.
“Humph!” A Venerate moved, launching a strike.
Peng, the ball of light instantly exploded in midair,rrosive light liquid spraying out.
Its might was not the slightest bit inferior to exploding after hitting its target.
This caused everyone’s expressions to change drastically.
This was a little troublesome.
“To take down the masses, capture the ringleader.” Heaven Crushing humphed, and directly charged down.
However, the bloodlored worms tried their best to block them.
Though they died in droves, more and more worms pounced forwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 4577: Annihilated
paragraphs: Chapter 4577: Annihilated
Editor: Henyee Translations
Heaven Crushing was a Seven Star Venerate, and just how powerful was the Genesis World’s Master?
Under the barrage of the murderous aura, he didn’t even need to make a move. The blood-colored insects in the surroundings collapsed one after another.
He had already charged over. With a slash of his sword, his sword shattered the ground and pierced the heavens.
Pu!
Without a doubt, the large insect was instantly killed. Sparkling liquid splattered, as if an underground spring had suddenly exploded.
Everyone cheered. This strike was really too handsome.
As expected of Heaven Crushing, powerful.
However, everyone’s cheers had not ended, when the ground trembled, and more giant insects shot out of the ground, and this time, it was not just one, but six of them had appeared at the same time!

Everyone thought that the giant insect that had been killed previously was an insect queen, and that was why the blood-coloured worms were protecting it with all their might. Then, as long as the insect queen was killed, the remaining insects would be nothing.
But the truth was not so. There were actually still a great many such giant insects. Furthermore, it was highly possible that these six were not the final number.
“Charge!”

Everyone stopped running. Though there was no benefit to be gained, these insects were still entangled with them. If they were not killed completely, they would probably continue to pursue them relentlessly.
Since that was the case, everyone was naturally prepared.
Originally, these people did things their own way. In fact, they were enemies with each other, but now, they had let go of their animosity and joined forces to destroy the swarm of bugs.
In fact, they weren’t allied with each other. It was just that they hadn’t attacked each other yet.

Ling Han and the others also joined the battle. They were all elites with battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier, so their abilities were naturally powerful. With a single strike, they could cause a large number of insects to collapse.
However, there were really too many ordinary blood-coloured worms. There was absolutely no end to them. After one had fallen, even more would appear.
Ling Han set his eyes on the six giant insects. He leaped out, and charged towards one of them.
Brother Monkey also targeted one, and similarly charged over.
On the other side, Origin, Myriad Dao and the others also charged towards the giant insects.
Though there were few of these insects, the threat they posed was extremely great. They had to be dealt with at the first instant.
Similarly, countless blood-coloured worms moved to block them, preventing them from easily succeeding.
Weng!

Ling Han, Origin, Myriad Dao nd the others all unleashed murderous aura attacks. This was the best method to deal with a group attack. They didn’t even need to attack, and swarms of insects would fall.
These people were like a hot knife through butter, directly charging in front of the giant insect.
Peng, peng, peng!

They all used their respective techniques. With a single strike, the giant insects exploded, and large amounts of liquid light splattered. However, it could not splash into their defensive shields at all, and they walked out completely unscathed.
The army of insects seemed to have fixated on them, and another ten giant insects shot out of the ground.
Since that was the case, they would continue to kill!

Everyone went on a killing spree. The insects were annihilated at an astonishing speed, and it was not that the side of the cultivators did not suffer any losses either. There were also a great many Sect Masters that had been turned into mush, and some had broken arms and legs, and were severely injured.
The easiest thing to despair about was that this was a sea of insects, and there seemed to be no end to their numbers. After killing one batch, another came.
This was too demoralizing.
Once their fighting spirit was extinguished, it would be very easy for them to make a mistake and be hit, and if they were touched by the corrosive liquid, they would definitely be severely injured.

More and more cultivators retreated from the battle, either dead or severely wounded. However, most of them were at Sect Master-level. The Venerates were far too powerful, and this kind of intense battle wasn’t powerful enough to wound them.
Three days later, everyone felt the pressure lighten.
They discovered that the number of the sea of insects was decreasing.
Though there were still insects charging out of the ground, both their numbers and speed had decreased considerably.
This caused their spirits to be greatly revived. In a single go, they wiped out the sea of insects.
At this point, no more insects charged out.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. They all descended, and began to adjust.
Ling Han’s mystical power was endless, and there was no need for him to rest at all. He gazed into the distance. In this battle, at least over three hundred cultivators had died.
Their losses could be considered heavy.

Those who had come here were all of the younger generation, and they all had hopes of breaking through to a higher cultivation level. Thus, though the ones who had died were Sect Masters, they could possibly be future Venerates, or even Saints.
Ling Han looked at the ground, and said, “I’m more curious about where these insects come from now.”
“Then, we’ll turn this forest upside down!” Brother Monkey said with a smile. With a wave of the staff in his hand, he blasted it heavily towards the ground.
Peng!
Under the heavy impact, the entire ground trembled madly, causing those who were resting to jump up.
“What are you doing?” Many people glared at Brother Monkey.
Brother Monkey leaned on his staff, slanted his head, and said, “Want to fight? Old Sun will keep you company.”
Instantly, everyone fell silent.
Brother Monkey’s strength was on the level of the Golden Generation, and he was already a nine-star Venerate. How many people in the world could compare to him?
Ling Han helped, causing great damage to the ground.
When Origin, Ding Shu and the others saw this, they also joined their team.
These people all had incredibly curious personalities. The sea of insects could not have appeared for no reason. Furthermore, the insect queen had not been killed yet.
Yi?
Ling Han was astounded. This was because the ground didn’t seem like real land. Instead, it was slightly elastic and filled with decay, emitting an indescribable stench.

Dig, dig, dig. Pu, all of a sudden, a fountain of blood spluttered out, soaring over thirty meters into the air. Then, it descended again, blood gushing out. However, there was a white turbid substance contained in this blood, which had an incredibly fishy smell.
Everyone was surprised. What was going on here?
Blood would be spewing out from the ground?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. A guess appeared in his mind, but he did not say it out loud.

He continued to dig, and there was more and more blood, turning into a lake of blood. And what was floating in the blood was something turbid white. It looked a little like meat, but also a little like oil, and was very hard to distinguish.
The female cultivators involuntarily covered their noses and retreated far away.
This smell was really too pungent, and could not be tolerated at all.
Boom!
All of a sudden, the entire ground trembled. This was much more powerful than the strike that Brother Monkey had delivered previously.
And what was going on here?
There was clearly no one blasting the ground.
Peng!
The ground trembled again, and this time, the undulations were even more intense.
“Let’s go,” Ling Han shouted lightly, and his figure was already flying.
Brother Monkey and the others naturally trusted Ling Han unconditionally. When they heard this, they all flew up.
They all stood in midair, having a panoramic view of their surroundings.
They were shocked to discover that the ground was squirming, as if something terrifying was about to rush out from below.
Insect queen?

Ding Shu and the others all reacted extremely quickly. They too leaped into the air, but there were still some who, perhaps because they were too confident or something else, were still walking on the ground, and were even attacking.
Boom! All of a sudden, the ground rose up at an astonishing speed.
Those who were still on the ground were instantly sent flying, and there were even a few that were directly turned into a foam of blood.
What was going on?
“What is this thing?”
“Heavens!”
Everyone exclaimed one after another.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦

chapters.title: Chapter 4578: Holy Beast
paragraphs: Chapter 4578: Holy Beast
Editor: Henyee Translations
What had appeared in front of Ling Han and the others?
A colossal beast!
It was shaped like a bull, and there were multiple sharp spikes growing from its back, while its tail was the tail of a scorpion, which had long, sharp spikes.
What earth, what forest!
They were not.
Just now, everyone had been standing on its back. That so-called black forest was actually its fur.
Now, it could still be clearly seen that there was a very large wound on its back. That was caused by everyone, but compared to its colossal size, this was negligible.
“Saint Tier!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
However, this was a great beast that was on the verge of death. Though there was still life fluctuating in it, it was incredibly weak.
Going by that theory, those blood-coloured worms were the parasites in its body?
Heavens, the parasites were all Sect Master-level, and there were even some giant insects that had reached Venerate Tier. Just how terrifying was this Holy Beast?
Seven-star Saint? Or perhaps even eight or nine stars?

However, regardless of how many stars it was, its lifespan was already nearing its end. It was because of this that its body had started to deteriorate. In fact, parasites had even started to appear in its body. Otherwise, the body of a Saint would naturally be as pure and flawless as could be. How could it have produced insects?𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
At this moment, everyone was extremely nervous, not daring to make the slightest movement.
This was a Holy Beast! Regardless of whether they were the Genesis World’s ruler or the Golden Generation, they were completely negligible in front of such a being.
“Thank you!” A thought rose up, and entered into everyone’s minds.
This was the Holy Beast’s divine sense transmission.
Boom!
The Holy Beast collapsed again, transforming back into a forest.
It was really about to die, so even if countless parasites grew out of its body, it could do nothing. Only when a large hole was dug into its back did it move, expressing its gratitude to everyone.
It was very easy to connect the dots. Thus, everyone felt incredibly rueful.
This was a Holy Beast that was at least seven stars, but now? It could only struggle at death’s door here. In fact, it could only helplessly allow the parasites in its body to overflow.
Furthermore, as long as the insect queen did not die, it would not take too long for it to continue breeding offspring, and continue to wreak havoc on it.
It was truly vexing for a Saint to fall into such a state.
“Little Han, if Grandpa Dog also falls to this extent one day, you can resolutely give Grandpa Dog a palm strike,” the large black dog sighed.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
The large black dog immediately jumped up, “What do you mean? Do you hope to see Grandpa Dog experience such a day?”
F***, wasn’t that what you said yourself?
“The correct answer is: even if Grandpa Dog has fallen to this extent, you have to try your best to save me!” the large black dog said.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. This dog was still as despicable as always.
“Get lost!”
Everyone had initially thought that there would be some great fortune here. They had not thought that their battle would have been for nothing, and they had instead lost a great many lives.
They had to leave.

Everyone set out one after another. The Saint Tomb was definitely not as small as what they had seen. There should still be opportunities in other places. If they could get some Saintly medicine and the like, this trip would not be in vain.
However, Ling Han didn’t move. Instead, he said, “Since we have already started, let’s just do it to the end. Why don’t we go and kill that insect queen as well?”
“All right.” Brother Monkey immediately nodded. If he had started something, he definitely could not give up halfway.
Though the large black dog and little azure dragon didn’t want to meddle in other people’s business, since Ling Han and Brother Monkey had already said so, they could only nod.

Ling Han released his divine sense, and expressed his intention to kill the insect queen to that Holy Beast, to prevent this Holy Beast from mistakenly thinking that they had malicious intentions, and risk death to bring them down with him.
—Even if a Saint was close to death, they definitely could not underestimate him.
After a very long time, the Holy Beast finally sent out a weak wave, expressing its agreement.
“Let’s go.”
The four of them leaped into the lake of blood that they had previously dug out. By now, they naturally understood that this was the blood vessel of the Holy Beast.
This Holy Beast was extraordinarily huge, its veins as wide as a small river, completely allowing the four of them to move freely.

However, this Holy Beast was already nearing the end of its lifespan. The blood, muscles, and bones in its body had already decayed, exuding an endless air of age and decay. Furthermore, this kind of aura had destructive power, assimilating all life that entered its body.
Ling Han and the others all set up a shield of Regulations to block this aura, but under the constant corrosion of this aura, the shield would not be able to last for too long.

This required them to replenish the energy expenditure of the Regulations shield from time to time, and the Regulations shield needed Spiritual Power to be mobilized. In other words, if they walked here, they would endlessly expend the power of their spirit.
Furthermore, this speed was very fast.
“Remember this place. When your Spiritual Power is exhausted, you must return.”
“M-hm.”
The four of them moved separately to find that insect queen.
However, the Holy Beast was far too large, and the veins in its body were also far too numerous. Added together, they were long enough to wrap around a great planet several times over.
They would be restricted here again, and after a while, they would have to go out to recover their Spiritual Power. The efficiency of searching for the insect queen was incredibly low.
After two days, none of them discovered the insect queen. Instead, the blood-colored worms appeared again.
The insect queen began to lay eggs again.
If this continued, how long would this drag out for?
Ling Han communicated with the Holy Beast, wanting the Holy Beast to provide the location of the insect queen. In this way, wouldn’t it be easy to charge over directly?
However, this Holy Beast was already on the verge of death, so its consciousness wasn’t always awake.

However, the time before death for ordinary people was only a few minutes, at most a day or half a day, but the lifespan of Saints was really too long. The time before death would also be as long as a few hundred or a few thousand years.
After a very long time, Ling Han finally received a divine sense signal, pointing out a location.
Ling Han immediately set off, heading in that direction.
After arriving, he discovered that this was the heart of the Holy Beast.

He entered through the blood vessels, only to see a gigantic insect sticking to the wall of the heart, madly absorbing the essence substance in the blood. At the same time, it also swallowed a great many turbid substances.
Pu, pu, pu! Its behind kept moving, laying egg after egg.
Ling Han humphed, and immediately charged over.
Several hundred blood-colored worms intercepted him, but what use was that? They were all wiped out by Ling Han’s murderous aura.
Shua, he raised his right hand, and the Regulations turned into a divine light that slashed towards the insect queen.
This insect queen was also a Venerate, but in front of Ling Han, what was an ordinary Venerate worth?
The divine light slashed past, and the insect queen also died instantly.
Ling Han then wiped out all the insect eggs. Now, even if there were some that slipped through the net, they would not be much of a threat.
He left, and exited the body of the Holy Beast.
“Let’s go,” he said.
“Yi, we’ve worked hard for two days, and we’re leaving just like that?” The large black dog bared his teeth, “Wouldn’t that be a terrible loss?”
Ling Han smiled, “When we do things, we only want our conscience to be clear. It is not everything that needs repayment.”
“Haha, these words match Old Sun’s intentions!” Brother Monkey clapped his hands and laughed loudly.
“Alright, as long as you guys are happy.” The large black dog spread out his paws.
“Wait a moment.” Just as the four of them were about to leave, a sliver of divine sense transmitted into their minds.

A colossal beast!
It was shaped like a bull, and there were multiple sharp spikes growing from its back, while its tail was the tail of a scorpion, which had long, sharp spikes.
What earth, what forest!
They were not.
Just now, everyone had been standing on its back.
That so-called black forest was actually its fur.
Now, it could still be clearly seen that there was a very large wound on its back.
That was caused by everyone, but compared to its colossal size, this was negligible.
“Saint Tier!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
However, this was a great beast that was on the verge of death.
Though there was still life fluctuating in it, it was incredibly weak.
Going by that theory, those blood-coloured worms were the parasites in its body?
Heavens, the parasites were all Sect Master-level, and there were even some giant insects that had reached Venerate Tier.
Just how terrifying was this Holy Beast?
Seven-star Saint?
Or perhaps even eight or nine stars?
However, regardless of how many stars it was, its lifespan was already nearing its end.
It was because of this that its body had started to deteriorate.
In fact, parasites had even started to appear in its body.

This was the Holy Beast’s divine sense transmission.
Boom!
The Holy Beast collapsed again, transforming back into a forest.
It was really about to die, so even if countless parasites grew out of its body, it could do nothing.
Only when a large hole was dug into its back did it move, expressing its gratitude to everyone.

Thus, everyone felt incredibly rueful.
This was a Holy Beast that was at least seven stars, but now?
It could only struggle at death’s door here.
In fact, it could only helplessly allow the parasites in its body to overflow.
Furthermore, as long as the insect queen did not die, it would not take too long for it to continue breeding offspring, and continue to wreak havoc on it.

F***, wasn’t that what you said yourself?

This dog was still as despicable as always.

Everyone had initially thought that there would be some great fortune here.

They had to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 4579: Seed of Regulations
paragraphs: Chapter 4579: Seed of Regulations
Editor: Henyee Translations
It was that old Holy Beast.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
Ling Han and the others all stopped as instructed. Could it be that this old Holy Beast wanted to give them some kind of treasure to thank them?
The large black dog rubbed his paws together, and said, “How can I accept this?” However, the look of anticipation on his face betrayed him very honestly.

“This is the seed of Regulations that I have condensed, and I present it to you. This is also the only thing that I can take out now.” The divine sense of the old Holy Beast continued to ring out in their minds.
Then, four balls of light floated in the air.
Seed of Regulations!
Ling Han and the others all looked overjoyed.
To become a Saint, the prerequisite was to ignite the holy flame, and what was the essence of igniting the holy flame?
That was his grasp of the Regulations of heaven and earth.

Using one’s own power to ignite the holy flame meant that one had an absolute understanding of the Regulations of heaven and earth. Thus, one could easily ignite the holy flame. And in the case of the power of belief, it could also be considered as a type of Regulations, a special Regulation formed by the power of belief of living beings.

As for the seed of Regulations… that was to turn his understanding of Regulations into a seed, and slowly fuse it into himself in a smooth and soundless manner. Naturally, his grasp of Regulations would be imperceptibly influenced.

However, the seed of Regulations could only be refined by Saints, and they were refined at the cost of sacrificing one’s own strength. Thus, which Saint would be willing to sacrifice themselves for the benefit of others?
The reason why the old Holy Beast was so generous was firstly, because Ling Han and the others had indeed solved a huge problem for him.
The feeling of only enduring helplessly when parasites swallowed its own flesh and blood was incomparably painful, yet there was nothing it could do. What kind of torture was this?
Now, Ling Han and the others had given him the peace that he had always dreamed of. This was naturally a great kindness.
On the other hand, though the old Holy Beast was still alive, it was indeed on its deathbed. So what if it sacrificed some of its cultivation level?
Ling Han and the others put away the seeds of Regulations, and placed them into their minds.
Then, they set out to leave.

Neither of them asked about the origins of the old Holy Beast. This was obviously something that the old Holy Beast was unwilling to mention. Otherwise, the old Holy Beast would definitely have taken the initiative to tell them.
“Such a powerful Holy Beast must have been an earth-shattering existence in the past,” the little azure dragon said.
“M-hm.”
Ling Han and the others all agreed. When they returned, they only had to make some enquiries, and it should not be too difficult for them to find out the identity of the old Holy Beast.
“Brother Monkey, here.” Ling Han retrieved his seed of Regulations from his mind and handed it over to Brother Monkey.
“What’s this for?” Brother Monkey asked.

“My path does not allow the Regulations of others,” Ling Han said smilingly, “And with two seeds of Regulations, Brother Monkey should be able to break through in a short period of time, and become a Saint!”

They did not have enough resources, and did not have the countless years of accumulation of an Imperial Clan. Thus, if they did not give Brother Monkey some special treatment, it would be very easy for Baili Tian and Yan Dongming to surpass him.

Although Ling Han’s battle prowess at the same cultivation level was unparalleled, his cultivation level was still too low, after all. No matter what, he still needed Brother Monkey to act as his front.
Brother Monkey thought for a moment, then did not stand on ceremony. The path that Ling Han had taken had indeed always been different from the rest.
Moreover, was there any need for him to be polite with Ling Han?
As the four of them advanced, Brother Monkey had already begun to refine the seeds of Regulations.

Previously, he had already begun to make preparations for breaking through to Saint Tier. Thus, he could completely refine the seeds of Regulations directly, and there was no need for him to be like the little azure dragon and the large black dog, having the seeds slowly bloom.
After they had travelled for a day, Brother Monkey suddenly spoke up, and said, “Old Sun is confident that I can light up the holy flame within two years!”
Hearing these words, Ling Han and the others were all incredibly pleasantly surprised.
If Brother Monkey could become a Saint within two years, he would definitely be the first among the younger generation to become a Saint.

Of course, being the first to become a Saint did not mean that one would be far ahead, because after advancing into Saint Tier, every step forwards would be much, much too difficult. It was very normal that one would not be able to take a step even after tens of thousands of years.

Thus, even though there was a gap of a few hundred, a few thousand, or even tens of thousands of years of cultivation time, when they advanced into Saint Tier, they had actually more or less reached the same starting line.
But no matter what, being the first of the younger generation to become a Saint still had great significance.
After walking for another three days, a mass grave suddenly appeared ahead of them!
It really was a mass grave. A large number of corpses were laid out there, lying or sitting. There were even some that were still standing upright, but they had all lost their vitality.
However, even if these people were already dead, there was still a terrifying pressure, as if it was going to tear their skin apart.
The corpses of Saints!

Ling Han and the others immediately thought. Only the Saint and the Great Emperor would be able to suppress Venerates or those with battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier like them. Meanwhile, it was obviously impossible that these were Great Emperors.
Yi, they had actually arrived at the true Saint Tomb. Then, where had the Nine Mountains Saint and the others run off to?
Was there a second graveyard?

The saintly might of this place permeated the air, and Ling Han and the others couldn’t release their divine sense at all. Otherwise, it would be equivalent to opposing the saintly might of this place, and it would be very easy for them to be wounded — unless the strength of their divine sense had reached Saint Tier.
Furthermore, there were a great many Saint corpses that were enshrouded in dense mist, which turned into pillars of light that shot into the skies, which also greatly affected their vision.
Thus, in this place, Ling Han and the others’ grasp over the environment could be said to have fallen to rock bottom.
“Be careful of ambush,” Brother Monkey said.
This place greatly restricted their divine sense and vision. Thus, if someone hid in the shadows and suddenly launched an attack when they passed, that would really be a little troublesome.

At present, those Golden Generations had all stepped into Venerate Tier, and some were only a step away from breaking through to Saint Tier. Thus, a great many people had Saint Tools on them, and if they secretly revived them and suddenly attacked, that would be very fatal.

—In other places, the commotion caused by reviving the Saint Tool would be too great, and could be sensed and seen from afar, but here, er, sorry, saintly might was spreading out everywhere, and it was not easy to distinguish it at all.
Ling Han and the others were all very careful. No matter how freakish and strong they were, they still had to be careful when they needed to be careful.
They entered into the tomb of Saints, and began their search.
Was this the Saint Tomb? It was practically a mass grave of Saints!
Ling Han looked at the corpses that had collapsed one after another, and couldn’t help but sigh internally.
These corpses had all been Saints when they had been alive, and each of them was all-powerful and renowned throughout the universe. But now? Hadn’t they all returned to dust?
They had all come for the sake of increasing their strength, or extending their lifespans, but in the end, they were all buried here. Their dreams had come to nothing.
Just how miserable and desolate was this?
They didn’t even have the chance to let their descendants mourn them.

Ling Han was even more determined to become Emperor. Though it was inevitable that the Great Emperor would die, his soul would fuse with the heaven and earth after his death. The corpse of an Emperor could be buried in the Void, and no one would ever be able to see it. It was better than this kind of desolation.
“Saintly medicine, Saintly medicine, Saintly medicine.” The large black dog mumbled as it walked, its eyes bright.
However, the saintly might here was too strong. Though it no longer had any destructive power, it greatly affected their search.

Moreover, Saint corpses couldn’t be casually tossed around. Although they had already been dead for countless years, they were still like God Tools that had been unsheathed. They would be wounded upon contact.

chapters.title: Chapter 4580: Female assassin
paragraphs: Chapter 4580: Female assassin
Editor: Henyee Translations
It could not be helped. They could only search slowly.
Ling Han and the others discussed for a while, and decided to move separately.

With the four of them together, the efficiency of searching was too low. Furthermore, the little azure dragon and the large black dog were already Seven Star Venerates. Even if they were no match for the strongest Golden Generation, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight would still allow them to escape safely.
Moreover, there were only a dozen or so nine-star Venerate Golden Generations. In such a place, the chances of encountering one were actually very small.
There was even less need to mention Brother Monkey and Ling Han. When others saw them, they should have fled, all right?
The four of them agreed to meet at the entrance of the mass grave one month later to decide whether they should continue their search or go to the next place.
Ling Han walked with his hands clasped behind his back, sensing the saintly might.
Actually, this was also beneficial for cultivation.

When a Saint died, the Regulations that were contained in their bodies would slowly disperse into heaven and earth. This process was very long. Furthermore, in the process of dispersing, the Regulations would occasionally manifest, allowing one to comprehend them.

This was a little similar to the effects of the Saintly medicine, but the Saintly medicine was absorbing the Regulations as nutrients while it was growing, and that was why the Regulations would occasionally appear.
Similarly, it had the word “Saint”, but when it showed the same effect, one was alive while the other was dead.
Life and death, death or life.
Ling Han was suddenly moved, as if he had caught hold of something. However, when he stretched out his hand to touch it, it was completely empty, which made him feel very uncomfortable.
He wracked his brains, yet he couldn’t recall anything no matter how hard he tried. This made him feel terrible, and he was even driven mad.
Shua!
Right at this moment, a flash of sword light suddenly appeared behind him, slashing fiercely towards him.
This strike was too sudden. Furthermore, it was too close to Ling Han, so close that he did not even have the space to dodge.
Assassin!
Ling Han humphed, and countered with a punch. With a qiang, he had blocked the sword that had slashed down.
The assassin appeared, but his whole body was enshrouded in a black mist. A shocked expression appeared on his face that no one could see.
In this kind of situation, Ling Han actually managed to parry in time. This reaction speed, the speed of his punches were practically freakish.
Ling Han turned around and said calmly, “You’re a good assassin, grasping the right moment just right. I was indeed distracted just now.”
No matter how careful he was, he suddenly felt appreciation. This was something that no one could have foreseen.
Unfortunately, he did not manage to grasp this sudden enlightenment.
The assassin didn’t say anything, and the mist on his body fluctuated as if to express something.
“You Battle God Palace people are truly pests!” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Unfortunately, the more you people chase me, the stronger I become.”
The assassin still didn’t speak. It was unknown whether it was because he didn’t want to speak or because he was at a loss for words.
Because indeed, Ling Han was already the number one Sect Master in history, and could even sweep aside the majority of Venerates. Only Saints could firmly suppress him.
After achieving such accomplishments, Ling Han could boast as much as he liked.
“Not talking?” Ling Han smiled faintly, “It’s all right. I don’t want to get anything out of you either.”
He moved, grabbing out at the assassin.
However, Regulations appeared, turning into a bright giant hand that moved loudly.

With a ‘hu’, the fog on the assassin’s body dispersed, revealing a snow-white naked body. Her pretty face had a beauty that could overturn the world, and her raven-black hair hung straight down to her waist.
This was actually a female assassin!

The power of the Battle God Palace… had far exceeded his expectations.

Ling Han let go of his doubts about the Battle God Palace. He had an invincible heart, so who cares how powerful your enemies are?

chapters.title: Chapter 4581: Killed
paragraphs: Chapter 4581: Killed
Editor: Henyee Translations
Extremely careful, Ling Han plucked that Seven Star Great Herb.
However, bright red blood was still dripping from the back of his hand.
The saintly might was like a supreme Divine Sword. So what if his physique was tough? He was merely scraped lightly, and his flesh was split open.
This was the might of a Saint. No matter how strong a Venerate was, they were nothing in front of a Saint.
Thus, all those below the level of Saint were mere ants. These words were not just empty words.
There was even less need to mention the Great Emperor. Only one could appear in each era, and he could blot out the skies with a single hand, suppressing an era.
“Put down the Celestial—”

A voice suddenly rang out from behind Ling Han, and as he spoke, Ling Han was also turning around. When the person behind saw Ling Han’s face, the remaining words were immediately swallowed back into his throat.
F***, Ling Han!
The person who had spoken was Tao Yu. He was presently wearing an awkward expression, as if he had been forcefully fed a fly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What do you want me to put down?”
Without another word, Tao Yu directly turned around and fled.
Fighting with Ling Han?
It was even more likely that he would be killed.
Moreover, he was someone who could become a Saint in the near future, so what need was there for him to battle against someone who was an eternal Sect Master and risk his life?
As long as he became a Saint, killing Ling Han would be a piece of cake.
Thus, why take the risk?
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure flashed, and he had already appeared in front of Tao Yu.
“We’ve finally met, so isn’t it inappropriate for you to leave without a word?” Ling Han said with a smile. “Moreover, you haven’t answered my question yet.”
Tao Yu humphed, and said, “Ling Han, don’t be so overbearing. Saintly might is everywhere here, and once we start fighting, it’s extremely likely that we’ll die together.”
Half of this was to scare Ling Han, and the other half was the truth.
“I already said, you still haven’t answered my question!” Ling Han raised his voice, then threw a punch.
Peng!

Tao Yu immediately dodged. This punch missed, and blasted towards a Saintly corpse, but before it had even landed, it exploded from the saintly might, turning into a wave of energy that spread out in all directions.
Instantly, the saintly might of the nearby Saintly corpses was all activated, and rolled out madly with a rumble, turning this place into an energy storm.
This was too terrifying. The energy storm was wrapped in saintly might, and that was fatal.
Tao Yu hurriedly dodged, but as his figure moved, he saw that Ling Han had already stepped in front of him, and shot out a punch.
He had no choice but to parry. Peng, this punch was blocked, but his figure also slid back, entering into the energy storm.
“Ah!” He released a terrible scream. Venerate Tier-level defense was completely useless against the saintly might, and innumerable wounds were instantly left on his back, blood gushing madly.
He couldn’t care less about his shock and anger, and hurriedly fled. Otherwise, under the crushing power of the energy storm, he would soon become a shattered corpse.
He naturally had to avoid Ling Han. However, just as he leaped out of the energy storm, he saw Ling Han block in front of him again, sending out a flying kick.
“No!” He was both furious and shocked, yet he couldn’t block it at all. He was kicked back into the energy storm again.
“Ah!” He continued to scream in pain, while his heart was filled with shock. If Ling Han continued to force him into the energy storm like this, he would soon be killed by the energy storm.
In a very easy and relaxed manner.
“Damn it, I’ll fight you to the death!” Tao Yu roared loudly, and saintly might instantly seeped out of his body, charging towards Ling Han.
He stimulated the Saintly bone in his body, and burst out with his strongest battle prowess.
“Get back!” Ling Han replied with a punch. Destructive Energy exploded in full power.
Boom!
In front of Destructive Energy, so what if there was a sliver of saintly power?
With a single punch, Tao Yu was immediately sent back into the energy storm again, and in Ling Han’s case, blood was seeping from his fist.

It could not be helped. Saintly power was still Saintly power. Even if Destructive Energy had melted part of it, there was still a sliver of it that could penetrate through, and cause damage to Ling Han.
Thankfully, it only caused his skin to split, and did not hurt his bones.
“You!” Tao Yu’s expression was filled with terror. If this continued, he would die, and he had never dreamed that he would die in such a way.
This would be such a worthless death..
“Ling Han, let’s go out and fight to the death!” he shouted loudly.
“Are you worthy?” Ling Han sneered, and delivered a palm strike. Peng, Tao Yu fell back into the energy storm.
When Tao Yu charged out again, his whole body was covered with blood, and he had also lost his left arm, as well as an ear. He looked extremely miserable.
He was even more sullen. A dignified Golden Generation was actually going to be killed by an energy storm?
Even if he became a ghost, he wouldn’t be able to rest in peace!
However, Ling Han sent out another palm strike, forcing him to have no choice but to parry. Then, he was blasted back into the energy storm.

After a dozen or so exchanges, Tao Yu’s life force started to rapidly decline. He had been damaged by the saintly might, so it was already extremely impressive that he could withstand it for so many exchanges. This was a clear sign of just how powerful he was.
Of course, this naturally was also thanks to the Saintly bone in his body.
He charged out again, his body swaying dangerously. His eyes were fixed on Ling Han, exuding endless hatred.
Peng!
So what? Ling Han delivered another palm strike, and Tao Yu was sent flying into the energy storm, and this time… he did not manage to escape.
He was dead.
A majestic Imperial Son, Golden Generation, Eight Star Venerate had died just like that.

“That’s why it’s said that those who don’t become Saints are ultimately ants. If they don’t become Emperor, the passage of time can erase all traces,” Ling Han murmured. “In fact, so what if they become Emperor? They can only prosper for an era. In history, it’s definitely not just these Great Emperors. However, haven’t the legends of many Great Emperors been annihilated in the passage of time?”
Without eternal life, it was impossible for there to be eternal legends.
Ling Han withdrew his sigh. This was a matter for the future. The present him only had to focus on his path of martial arts.
He walked far away. As long as he didn’t stoke the flames, the energy storm would slowly calm down.
Continuing to roam around, Ling Han occasionally gained something.

Though there were Saintly corpses all over this place, the lifespans of most of the Saints that had come here were close to drying up. There was a limited number of Saintly Particles, so how could all of them possibly nurture Saintly medicine after death?
Moreover, even a One Star or Two Star Saint did not have that kind of qualification. Only a Five Star Saint and above would have enough Saintly Particles to nurture a Saintly medicine.
The various levels of Saint Tier were too difficult to reach. How many Saints were above five stars?
Thus, it was already good enough that he could reap some benefits here, and he was still hoping for a lot?
A month later, Ling Han had more or less completed a tour of this place. Then, he returned to the exit, and met up with Brother Monkey and the others.
It wasn’t long before the four of them appeared, one after another.
However, there were signs of battle on everyone’s body. After all, this was searching for treasures in a Mystery Realm, so it would be strange if they hadn’t experienced battle.

They all talked about their experiences in the past month, and when Ling Han talked about the female assassin, both the large black dog and little azure dragon felt a little apprehensive. If it was them, it was very possible that they would be severely injured.
After sighing, they began to show off their gains. They had all gained a lot, which made the four of them very pleased.
“Let’s go. Perhaps there’s a second graveyard.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4582: Corpse Tower
paragraphs: Chapter 4582: Corpse Tower
Editor: Henyee Translations
They didn’t come across the Nine Mountains Saint here, and they didn’t come across any other Saints either.
Thus, it was extremely likely that there was more than one mass grave here.
They passed through this Saint Tomb, and continued onwards.
After walking for four days, as expected, another mass grave appeared ahead of them.
What surprised them was that in the center of the mass grave, there was a pile of corpses that towered high. It was like a steeple, and could be seen from afar.
Yi, who did this?
The four of them exchanged looks, all of them curious.
They refused to believe that it was the Saints themselves who had sat there and laid on them before their death.
How was this possible? To have deliberately chosen such a grave?
But if it was said that they had been thrown onto the pile after the Saints died… who could have done it?

After a Saint’s death, the saintly might would permeate the surroundings. This would not differentiate between allies and enemies. As long as someone approached or touched it, it would be activated, and it was guaranteed that killing a Venerate would be as easy as turning his palm over.
Thus, if one wanted to move the Saintly corpse, it could only be a Saint.
Just ask which Saint had nothing better to do than to pile up corpses for fun?
No matter what, they should first go in to find the Celestial medicine.
The four of them still moved separately, and still had the same agreement to meet back at their original location a month later.

Within a month, Ling Han encountered a few more Imperial Sons, but this time, their luck was not too bad. They fled very quickly, and did not give Ling Han the chance to catch them, which made him feel regretful.
In truth, these Imperial Sons should be complaining, all right?
—A dignified Venerate was actually being hunted down by a Sect Master Just what was going on here?
