chapters.title: Chapter 4583: Tower collapses
paragraphs: Chapter 4583: Tower collapses
Editor: Henyee Translations
W-what?
Cheng Feng involuntarily stiffened.
“I’ve already given you the Fourth Extreme Grass. What else do you want?” he asked, suppressing his anger.
Ling Han smiled and said, “That’s strange. I only told you to put the Fourth Extreme Grass down. I didn’t say that you could leave after you put it down.”
This!
Cheng Feng immediately recalled that he had also previously commanded those five Dao Childs to do the same, yet now the favor was returned to him.
This retribution was too fast, wasn’t it?
He gritted his teeth, “Then let’s battle!”
Obviously, there was no way that Ling Han would spare him. Thus, there was no need for him to seek his own humiliation any longer.
He took the initiative to charge out. Weng, a battle drum appeared above his head, and with a tong, it actually sounded on its own.
“Wu!” The five Dao Childs felt a pain in their chests, and instantly spat out blood madly.
It was as if the battle drum had struck their hearts, almost causing them to explode.
And this was still because Cheng Feng’s main target was Ling Han. They had only suffered a slight shockwave from the aftermath. Otherwise, they would have long since died by now.
Saint Tool!
Ling Han constructed a defense of Regulations in front of him, blocking the soundwave attack. However, when the soundwave passed, this shield of Regulations immediately shattered.
That was an attack delivered by a Saint Tool, so how could its might be ordinary?
And at this time, Cheng Feng took the chance… to turn around and leave.
He clearly realized that he definitely wouldn’t be able to kill Ling Han. Thus, instead of taking risks, it would be better for him to withdraw and leave.

That was because he was about to advance into Saint Tier, and Ling Han was stuck at Sect Master-level forever. Thus, with how precious he was, why did he have to clash head-on with someone as fragile as a piece of porcelain like Ling Han?
Even if he could win, if he had to pay a huge price, he would still choose to give up.

This was also the reason why he was willing to hand over the Fourth Extreme Grass. As the saying goes, the barefooted people are not afraid of those who wear shoes1. He had no wish to fight Ling Han to the death.
Ling Han did not pursue him, because Cheng Feng was not much inferior to him, and this place was extremely suitable for an ambush. He too did not want to take too many risks.
Was it not enough to forcefully snatch the Fourth Extreme Grass from the other’s hands?
“Thank you!” the five Dao Childs all said to Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded in understanding before turning around to leave.
Afterward, he did not encounter Imperial Sons again. A month later, he met up with Brother Monkey and the others, and then headed to the next location.
They had not even walked far, when they saw the Saintly Corpse Tower towering into the skies. It was the best guide.
They arrived at this fourth mass grave, and similarly agreed to meet at the foot of the corpse tower in a month’s time.
Every day, they were searching for Celestial medicines. Time passed very quickly, and a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Ling Han arrived at the foot of the Saintly Corpse Tower. This time, he was the first to arrive. Brother Monkey and the others hadn’t arrived yet, because he had arrived a day earlier.
He sat down in a cross-legged position. He had been immersed in the saintly might these past few days, and no matter what, he would have some appreciation. He needed to sort it out.
After half a day, someone arrived.
At first, Ling Han thought that it was Brother Monkey and the others, but when he turned his head, he saw that it was Jing Haoran.
“Old friend, we meet again.” Jing Haoran waved his hand in a very cordial manner.
This, I don’t seem to be too familiar with you, right?

Ling Han sighed. This guy was the same as the large black dog, and belonged to the category of having a bad mouth. It would be very logical for him to be hacked to death one day because of his loose tongue.
A thought flashed in his mind, and he said, “Old Brother, there’s a very profitable business deal. Are you up for it?”
“What business deal?” Jing Haoran immediately asked.
“I’ll use high-level Celestial Qi to exchange for low-level Celestial Qi with you. One star inferior, and I’ll trade one for every five, how about it?” Ling Han suggested.
Hiss!

Jing Haoran sucked in a sharp breath, then immediately said, “Fine, Old Brother, you’ve actually mastered the technique to refine a low-level Celestial Qi into a high-level Celestial Qi! Come, come, come, sell this technique to me, all right?”
This guy was quite smart. He had guessed the truth with just this bit of clue.
As expected of the Genesis World’s master. He definitely couldn’t be underestimated just because he spoke without thinking.
“Do you know how to concoct alchemical pills?” Ling Han asked smilingly.
“He, are you underestimating me?” Jing Haoran bared his teeth in a grin.
As the rulers of the Genesis World, which of them hadn’t lived for several epochs? Whether it was alchemy, forging, or other unorthodox techniques, they had definitely learnt all of them.
Ling Han also smiled. This was one matter, but what standards he had reached was another matter.

As far as he knew, Ding Shu also knew how to concoct alchemical pills. However, he could only say that he knew how to concoct alchemical pills. He didn’t have any particularly astonishing natural talent.
“Sure, 10,000 portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi in exchange for it.” He made an exorbitant demand.
With so much Celestial Qi, it would be enough for him to advance into the Venerate Tier, and cultivate to the peak stage of Venerate Tier. Then, he would not need Celestial Qi anymore.
“Why don’t you go rob while you are at it!” Jing Haoran rolled his eyes madly. Wasn’t this just a joke?
To say nothing of the fact that he could not produce 10,000 portions of Eight Star Celestial Qi, even if all the Imperial Clans were willing to generously contribute, that was still far from enough.
“Then how many portions can you take out?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Twenty portions, at most,” Jing Haoran Haoran bargained.
“Hehe, why don’t you go and commit robbery yourself?” Ling Han rolled his eyes. Why was he even more shameless than him?

“Eight-star Celestial Qi is already rare, okay? Besides, how many have you tricked last time?” Jing Haoran paused for a moment, “If worse comes to worst, I’ll add some Seven Stars Celestial Qi, Six Stars Celestial Qi, and so on to make up a hundred portions.”
This guy was really very good at bargaining.
Ling Han was just about to speak, when he gave an “en”, and looked towards the corpse tower.
It was the same for Jing Haoran. He sensed an unusual movement.
“Hey, hey, hey, you’re not going to turn into zombies, are you?” he muttered.
Right at this moment, the arm of a Saintly corpse suddenly moved.
“You jinx!” Ling Han exclaimed.
Jing Haoran shrugged. ‘It’s my fault?’
He chuckled, “How bad could it be?”
Boom, the whole corpse tower trembled lightly, and one after another, corpses fell from the highest level. Instantly, it was as if a rain of Saintly corpses had fallen, filling the skies.
“If you say one more word, I’ll chop off your head!” Ling Han warned Jing Haoran. This guy definitely had the ability to have his words turn into reality, but it was all negative.
The Genesis World’s Lord was indeed a weirdo. He had a halo of trouble, while Jing Haoran could always predict the worst situation.
It was only an instant, and the whole corpse tower collapsed loudly. Saintly corpses rained down, covering the whole mass grave.

Those below hurriedly dodged. Though the Saintly corpses that had fallen had long since died, that was still a Saintly corpse, after all. Who would dare let it come into contact with them? If it really landed, that would be equivalent to being directly struck by the Saint Tool, and it was guaranteed that they would die completely.
And while dodging, everyone was also heading in the direction of the Saintly Corpse Tower, wanting to know what exactly was going on here.
One, two, three… More and more people arrived.
This corpse tower had not collapsed completely, leaving behind a “tower base”.
What had happened?
Everyone came over, all bearing this kind of confusion.

Boom! Right at this moment, the remaining foundations of the tower also started to crumble. When all of the corpses of the Saints had rolled to one side, a large bronze coffin actually appeared beneath them.

Right at this moment, the arm of a Saintly corpse suddenly moved.
“You jinx!” Ling Han exclaimed.
Jing Haoran shrugged. ‘It’s my fault?’
He chuckled, “How bad could it be?”
Boom, the whole corpse tower trembled lightly, and one after another, corpses fell from the highest level.
Instantly, it was as if a rain of Saintly corpses had fallen, filling the skies.
“If you say one more word, I’ll chop off your head!” Ling Han warned Jing Haoran.
This guy definitely had the ability to have his words turn into reality, but it was all negative.
The Genesis World’s Lord was indeed a weirdo.
He had a halo of trouble, while Jing Haoran could always predict the worst situation.
It was only an instant, and the whole corpse tower collapsed loudly.
Saintly corpses rained down, covering the whole mass grave.
Those below hurriedly dodged.
Though the Saintly corpses that had fallen had long since died, that was still a Saintly corpse, after all.
Who would dare let it come into contact with them?
If it really landed, that would be equivalent to being directly struck by the Saint Tool, and it was guaranteed that they would die completely.
And while dodging, everyone was also heading in the direction of the Saintly Corpse Tower, wanting to know what exactly was going on here.
One, two, three…
More and more people arrived.
This corpse tower had not collapsed completely, leaving behind a “tower base”.
What had happened?
Everyone came over, all bearing this kind of confusion.
Boom!
Right at this moment, the remaining foundations of the tower also started to crumble.
When all of the corpses of the Saints had rolled to one side, a large bronze coffin actually appeared beneath them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4584: Bronze Coffin
paragraphs: Chapter 4584: Bronze Coffin
Editor: Henyee Translations
Coffin?
Those who cultivated would naturally not believe the theory of ascending “coffin” and becoming rich, and would only link the coffin to death1.
Hence, when they suddenly saw a coffin, everyone felt a terrible premonition.
“Er, this is the Saint Tomb in the first place, so it would be normal for a coffin to appear here,” someone said.
“… Have you ever seen other Saints buried in caskets?” someone immediately retorted.
“That’s right. Could it be that when it was the Saint entered, he had already prepared his own coffin?” Even more people found this strange.
Actually, none of the Saints that had come here wanted to die.
They either wanted to extend their lifespan, or wanted to increase their strength. None of them really wanted to be buried here.
Hence, no matter how they thought about it, bringing his own casket was incredibly strange.
Furthermore, the Saintly corpses had even been piled up together. What was the meaning of this?
Was this very fun?
A muscle twitched in Ling Han’s cheek. Unconsciously, he began to complain again.
“None of the other Saints have caskets, so this Saint must be incredibly powerful,” an Imperial Son speculated.
“A nine-star Saint?”
“Or even… Pseudo-Emperor?”
When it came to Pseudo-Emperor, everyone’s hearts skipped a beat.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor! Although it had the word ‘Pseudo’, it also had the word ‘Emperor’. Suppressing any Saint would be as easy as the turn of a palm.
If there was no Emperor in the world, Pseudo-Emperor could also suppress an era.
If they could obtain the treasures left behind by the Pseudo-Emperor, what kind of astonishing opportunity would that be?

Everyone’s hearts beat faster. If they could become Pseudo-Emperor, that would be on the same level as Buddha Doga, the master of the sea of blood and the like, standing at the frontmost lines in the race for the position of Great Emepror.
Even if they couldn’t become Emperor, with Pseudo-Emperor’s strength, they could bury this lifetime, live a second life after a few years, and then compete for the throne.
Just like Buddha Doga.
Before they knew it, everyone was moving forwards, getting closer and closer to this casket.
Though Ling Han was also slightly tempted, what he felt more was wariness.
What if this place was also like the sea of blood and Yin River?
You see, those places were also covered with Saintly corpses, which were very similar to this place. The only difference was that this was a place that the Saints had taken the initiative to enter.
Thus, even if this was really a Pseudo-Emperor, what if they had not died?
Furthermore, there were so many Saintly corpse towers here. If there was a bronze casket underneath every one of them, how many Pseudo-Emperors would there be?
With this in mind, Ling Han didn’t think that there was a Pseudo-Emperor buried in the casket.
Though there was still some possibility.
He stood still, and merely watched from the sidelines.
Seeing Ling Han act like this, Brother Monkey, the little azure dragon, and the large black dog also stopped in their tracks. There was already enough trust and tacit understanding between them.

Standing here, it was still very easy to see the bronze casket clearly. It was covered with patterns, forming the image of a Divine Beast, a Celestial Bird, and there was even a sunflower soaring into the sky, making all living beings worship it.
“Yi?” Everyone turned to look at one person.
Tong Xiao, Black Sunflower Imperial Clan’s Silver Generation.

Demonic Sunflower was the symbol of the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan. In the past, the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor had been a Demonic Sunflower. He had gone from being unknown to cultivating a world-shaking Mystical Power, becoming the invincible Great Emperor.

But now, the pattern of a sunflower had actually appeared here, and it was obviously the main character, enjoying the worship of all living beings… could it be that the person in this coffin was actually related to the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan?
Tong Xiao was also very confused. He thought for a long time, then said, “I don’t remember any Saint of my clan being buried here.”
Furthermore, it was impossible for a Pseudo-Emperor. After a Great Emperor appeared in their line, the word ‘Emperor’ had no further relation to the Imperial Clan.
Everyone became even more curious. Was there a Pseudo-Emperor buried inside this casket, and what relation did it have with the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan?
“Don’t worry about it, open the casket!” someone with an impatient nature said.
This gained the agreement of many people. Instead of making wild guesses here, wouldn’t they know everything with a single glance when they opened the coffin?
However, there were also a great many cautious people that expressed their objection, and thought that they should wait and see.

In the end, even more elites thought that they should observe it more closely. After all, what if there really was a Pseudo-Emperor? Then if they rashly opened the coffin, that could probably cause a terrifying and fatal calamity.
Everyone began to study it, but there was really nothing much to study about this coffin. Its appearance was just like that, so what could be seen?
“Let’s open the casket.”
In the end, everyone reached a concensus. Only a limited number of people still insisted on looking further, but they could no longer influence the overall situation.
But who would open it?
What if the casket was opened, and a terrifying killing intent surged out, and they were killed?
Everyone wanted to take advantage of others, but it was dangerous. Hehe, it was better to let others take the blow.
At this moment, no one stepped forward.
Among those that could cultivate to the level of Sect Master and Venerate Tier, which one of them was an idiot?
“Humph, since no one has taken the initiative to step out, then I can only pick someone,” Yi Taishu said balefully.
The other Golden Generations also nodded in agreement. At such a time, they naturally advanced and retreated in unison.

The remaining Dao Childs couldn’t help but tremble slightly. Obviously, if the Imperial Son called out names, he would definitely not choose the other Imperial Sons, and as for Ling Han, Ding Shu, and the others, the Imperial Sons could not command them at all, nor did they dare to.
Thus, the unlucky ones could only be them.
“You, you, you, and you, go.” Yi Taishu began to call out names.
Sure enough, he chose four Dao Childs, causing their expressions to instantly turn green.
They were both furious and shocked, but… could they resist?
Ling Han smiled faintly. Should he speak up, and call out for the Imperial Sons to open the casket?
Peng!
However, right at this moment, a muffled sound was heard, as if a drum was being beaten.
What… was going on?
Everyone was numb with shock, because the source of this muffled sound… was precisely that bronze casket.
Gods, was he going to come back to life?
“I didn’t say anything!” Jing Haoran immediately defended himself. He couldn’t be blamed for jinxing things.
Er!
Ling Han shook his head. However, at this moment, he wasn’t in the mood to complain. He simply stared at the bronze casket.
Tong!
This time, it was clearly louder than the last time.
There was complete silence. They merely focused their gazes on that casket, and some people were already prepared to flee.
Once some terrifying monster crawled out of the casket, they would naturally flee without hesitation.
There were so many people here, so they should be able to buy them some time.
Tong! Tong! Tong!
After a few loud bangs, the bangs suddenly stopped.
Yi, why was it gone?
Everyone was at the most tense moment. They were both expectant and afraid that something would pop out of the casket, but now, this sound had suddenly stopped, and they did not know how to react.
“That’s all?”
“Why did it stop?”
“What on earth is going on?”
“You go and open the casket.”
“Get lost, I’m not going. If you want to go, go ahead.”
Everyone wanted to know the reason, but no one was willing to walk out. It was obvious that this was too dangerous.
“Squeak!”
Right at this moment, a sound was heard from the casket again. Under everyone’s stunned gazes, the lid of the casket was slowly raised.

chapters.title: Chapter 4585: Black Sunflower Race
paragraphs: Chapter 4585: Black Sunflower Race
Editor: Henyee Translations
“Old Brother, you’re too awesome. You can still come back to life even after death; even the casket lid can’t hold you down!” Jing Haoran murmured to the side.
Though his voice was very low, the surroundings were now completely silent, and his voice had also reached everyone’s ears.
All of a sudden, everyone was glaring angrily at him.
Yi, why are you guys glaring at me?
Jing Haoran gave everyone a confused expression.
However, no one was in the mood to pay attention to him now.
The person in the coffin—no matter what it was—was about to come out.
Everyone’s eyes were focused on the casket, their hearts beating faster, nervous to the extreme.
Right at this moment, a hand suddenly stretched out and grabbed onto the edge of the coffin.
F***, had he really f****** come back to life?
The lid of the coffin was pushed open, and a man straightened his upper body. He was wearing a long black robe, exuding an air of dominance.
Though everyone was stunned, they immediately breathed a sigh of relief.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
This man… was not as strong as they had imagined.
In everyone’s minds, the being buried under the Saintly corpse tower had to be a nine-star Saint, at least. In fact, it might even be a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, this man was only at the fourth pinnacle level.
Though Venerates were also incredibly strong, they were ultimately not as terrifying as one would imagine.
Moreover, there was no shortage of Venerates here. Furthermore, these were the nine-star Venerates of the Golden Generation. Thus, what was there to be afraid of?
“Who are you?” Han Yun called out loudly.
The man in the coffin’s eyes swept over them, and stopped on Han Yun. He slanted his head slightly, “A mere ant dares to command me?”
This… he actually referred to the Imperial Son as an ant?
“You really don’t know how to write the word ‘die’!” Han Yun sneered.

He was just about to make a move, yet was stopped by a Dao Child. He said with a smile, “There is no need to use waste too much effort on a weak character, so allow me to move on behalf of Imperial Son Yun.”
Han Yun thought for a moment, then nodded at this bootlicker, “Alright.”
He didn’t know the strength of the person in the coffin, so he could use someone else to test it out.
The Dao Child was overjoyed. He had successfully gotten the support of this powerful backer.
He turned around, and shouted at the man in the coffin, “Insolent madman, quickly kneel down and apologize to Imperial Son Yun!”
“Imperial Son Yun?” the man in the coffin murmured. A smile appeared on his face, and he said, “So he’s a descendant of the Imperial Clan. No wonder he’s so arrogant.”
“Madman!” The Dao Child shouted loudly, and immediately charged out.
The man in the coffin didn’t seem to have seen the attack of the Dao Child at all. However, just as the Dao Child arrived in front of him, he turned into a rain of blood with a bang, completely dead.
This!
Everyone was stunned, and couldn’t help but frown.

Though this Dao Child was a bootlicker, and his personality was something to be despised, he was still a genuine Venerate, yet he actually couldn’t even make a single move, and was directly crushed. This was still too shocking.
The man in the coffin was clearly only a Venerate.
The man in the coffin stretched lazily, but still looked laidback. He swept his gaze over the masses, and said with a smile, “Since I have risen, you all can welcome me with blood.”
He stood up. Boom! A powerful aura circulated, causing many people to involuntarily take a few steps back as if they had been blown by a hurricane.
“Sir, what boastful words!” An Imperial Son smirked coldly. He actually said that he wanted to use them as blood sacrifices; what a joke.
This place was filled with the king tiers of the younger generation!
“What relation do you have with the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan?” Tong Xiao asked. This was what he was most curious about.
The man in the coffin glanced at Tong Xiao and gave an ‘oh’, and said, “So it’s a descendant of our clan! Humph, having such a lowly bloodline is really an embarrassment to our Black Sunflower Race!”
What, he was actually also a member of the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan?
Everyone was stunned. Though they had all had this kind of deduction previously, hearing it confirmed from the other’s mouth still made them panic.
This… was an old monster that had been sleeping for how long.
Yet Ling Han’s heart jolted, as he thought of Di Wuji.
Di Wuji clearly belonged to the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, but there was a difference between him and the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, and his words were filled with slight disdain.
Moreover, the Great Emperor Horn couldn’t affect him.
Could the situation be the same for the man in the coffin?
The man in the coffin smiled faintly, “You little guys don’t have much strength, but your attitude is quite arrogant. I have nothing better to do, so I’ll let you know what a supreme prodigy is!”
He crooked a finger, “Can you block a single strike from me?”
The other was a Silver Generation elite, a Four-Star Venerate.

The Imperial Son couldn’t help but feel enraged. He was just about to speak, yet the man in the coffin had already moved. He casually flicked a finger, and a brilliant light surged over, shooting toward him.
The Imperial Son hurriedly parried, but though his hands were defending in front of him, they were completely useless.
Pu! Both of his palms were pierced through. The streak of light struck him, and his body was also blasted through.
Fortunately, the strike landed on the right side of the chest, avoiding the heart. Otherwise, the Venerate’s heart might not have been destroyed, but he would definitely have been severely injured.
“You!” The man in the coffin pointed at another person. This was a Golden Generation, an eight-star Venerate.
He still snapped his fingers, and a brilliant light surged over, piercing through the body of that Golden Generation.
In two moves, he had defeated two Imperial Sons. Furthermore, if it was not for the fact that he had not aimed for their heads, these two would definitely have died.
Everyone was stunned. Previously, it was one thing for a Four-Star Venerate to be insta-killed, but an Eight-Star Venerate was also insta-killed with a single move. This was too terrifying.
“You!” The man in the coffin pointed at Han Yun, and still snapped his fingers.
Peng!

Han Yun hurriedly parried, and his body was instantly sent sliding backwards. He only stopped after retreating a good few hundred meters. However, this blow was finally blocked, though there were traces of a charred smell exuding from his arm.

“Yo.” The man in the coffin revealed a hint of surprise, as if he was surprised that he had not defeated his opponent in a single strike, “You are not too bad, being able to block a single blow from me.”
As a dignified Golden Generation, he hadn’t been insta-killed, so was his abilities worthy of praise?
Was this a compliment?
Han Yun was enraged, but he did not rashly counterattack.
This opponent was very strong!
The man in the coffin’s eyes swept over them, and came to a stop on Ling Han and his group. His gaze stopped on Brother Monkey, “Yi, you are a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor, right?”
Brother Monkey slung the staff over his shoulder, “It is your Grandpa Sun!”

“Hehe, the line of the Battle Saint Emperor all have such hot tempers. They speak without thinking, and that’s why there are so few of them,” the man in the coffin said. “Since I’ve encountered one, I’ll just kill another.”
He stood up and charged towards Brother Monkey.
How could Brother Monkey be afraid? With a harsh exclamation, he brandished his staff to greet the attack.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and as every attack swept past, a terrifying might would sweep over. To say nothing of Sect Masters, even Venerates would frown at this.
F***, this had already surpassed the level of Venerate Tier.
How could he possibly be so strong?
This didn’t make sense.
Yet Ling Han came to a realization.

Brother Monkey was so strong because he had been in the process of breaking through to Saint Tier in the first place. Afterwards, he had obtained the seed of Regulations, and his advancement speed had once again sped up. Now, even if he did not have one foot into Saint Tier, he would at least have half a foot, or slightlt less than half a foot.
Thus, his battle prowess was naturally strong.
And as for the man in the coffin… he was the same as Di Wuji!

The man in the coffin glanced at Tong Xiao and gave an ‘oh’, and said, “So it’s a descendant of our clan!
Humph, having such a lowly bloodline is really an embarrassment to our Black Sunflower Race!”
What, he was actually also a member of the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan?
Everyone was stunned.
Though they had all had this kind of deduction previously, hearing it confirmed from the other’s mouth still made them panic.
This… was an old monster that had been sleeping for how long.
Yet Ling Han’s heart jolted, as he thought of Di Wuji.
Di Wuji clearly belonged to the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, but there was a difference between him and the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, and his words were filled with slight disdain.
Moreover, the Great Emperor Horn couldn’t affect him.
Could the situation be the same for the man in the coffin?
The man in the coffin smiled faintly, “You little guys don’t have much strength, but your attitude is quite arrogant.
I have nothing better to do, so I’ll let you know what a supreme prodigy is!”
He crooked a finger, “Can you block a single strike from me?”
The other was a Silver Generation elite, a Four-Star Venerate.
The Imperial Son couldn’t help but feel enraged.
He was just about to speak, yet the man in the coffin had already moved.
He casually flicked a finger, and a brilliant light surged over, shooting toward him.
The Imperial Son hurriedly parried, but though his hands were defending in front of him, they were completely useless.
Pu!
Both of his palms were pierced through.
The streak of light struck him, and his body was also blasted through.
Fortunately, the strike landed on the right side of the chest, avoiding the heart.
Otherwise, the Venerate’s heart might not have been destroyed, but he would definitely have been severely injured.
“You!” The man in the coffin pointed at another person.
This was a Golden Generation, an eight-star Venerate.
He still snapped his fingers, and a brilliant light surged over, piercing through the body of that Golden Generation.
In two moves, he had defeated two Imperial Sons.
Furthermore, if it was not for the fact that he had not aimed for their heads, these two would definitely have died.
Everyone was stunned.
Previously, it was one thing for a Four-Star Venerate to be insta-killed, but an Eight-Star Venerate was also insta-killed with a single move.
This was too terrifying.
“You!” The man in the coffin pointed at Han Yun, and still snapped his fingers.
Peng!
Han Yun hurriedly parried, and his body was instantly sent sliding backwards.
He only stopped after retreating a good few hundred meters.
However, this blow was finally blocked, though there were traces of a charred smell exuding from his arm.

“Yo.” The man in the coffin revealed a hint of surprise, as if he was surprised that he had not defeated his opponent in a single strike, “You are not too bad, being able to block a single blow from me.”
As a dignified Golden Generation, he hadn’t been insta-killed, so was his abilities worthy of praise?
Was this a compliment?
Han Yun was enraged, but he did not rashly counterattack.
This opponent was very strong!
The man in the coffin’s eyes swept over them, and came to a stop on Ling Han and his group.
His gaze stopped on Brother Monkey, “Yi, you are a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor, right?”
Brother Monkey slung the staff over his shoulder, “It is your Grandpa Sun!”
“Hehe, the line of the Battle Saint Emperor all have such hot tempers.
They speak without thinking, and that’s why there are so few of them,” the man in the coffin said.
“Since I’ve encountered one, I’ll just kill another.”
He stood up and charged towards Brother Monkey.
How could Brother Monkey be afraid?
With a harsh exclamation, he brandished his staff to greet the attack.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and as every attack swept past, a terrifying might would sweep over.
To say nothing of Sect Masters, even Venerates would frown at this.
F***, this had already surpassed the level of Venerate Tier.
How could he possibly be so strong?
This didn’t make sense.
Yet Ling Han came to a realization.
Brother Monkey was so strong because he had been in the process of breaking through to Saint Tier in the first place.
Afterwards, he had obtained the seed of Regulations, and his advancement speed had once again sped up.
Now, even if he did not have one foot into Saint Tier, he would at least have half a foot, or slightlt less than half a foot.
Thus, his battle prowess was naturally strong.
And as for the man in the coffin… he was the same as Di Wuji!

chapters.title: Chapter 4586: The son of the Demon Emperor
paragraphs: Chapter 4586: The son of the Demon Emperor
Editor: Henyee Translations
In the previous battle between Ling Han and Di Wuji, though he was inferior to Di Wuji by a few minor levels, in terms of power, he had completely overwhelmed him.

That was because the Great Emperor had refined a few stars into Di Wuji’s body, allowing him to burst out with power on the level of Venerate Tier, and at that time, Ling Han had not broken through to the level of Ten Stars at all, so it was naturally impossible for him to be a match.
It was the same now.
Brother Monkey’s strength lay in his Regulations. He had already touched the territory of Saint Tier. Thus, every move he made carried a sliver of saintly might.

Though it was only a sliver, this was the comprehension that truly belonged to him, and not the saintly might that came from having a Saintly bone implanted in his body. The might could not be compared.
And the man in the coffin had the Planet Core, which allowed his power to far surpass the level that a Venerate should have.
Thus, this battle was actually a little similar to how Ling Han had battled against Di Wuji. One was more proficient in Regulations, while the other possessed an absolute advantage in terms of power.
Who exactly would emerge victorious?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Brother Monkey and the man in the coffin battled fiercely. In a short period of time, it was really impossible to determine who was stronger. Even Ling Han could not tell.

When one had reached this level, changes in battle could happen in an instant. A moment of carelessness would mean eternal damnation. Thus, there were too many factors that would affect the outcome of the battle, and it was really not easy to judge.
The man in the coffin laughed loudly, “So you have already touched a sliver of the threshold to Saint Tier. No wonder you can contend against me!”
He wanted to stop the battle. There was no meaning to continue fighting like this.
But who was Brother Monkey?
If you want to fight, we fight and if you want to stop, we just stop?
No way!
Brother Monkey brandished the metal rod, bold and pronounced, fighting spirit soaring into the skies.
The man in the coffin couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. Why had he chosen Brother Monkey?
It wasn’t like he didn’t know that all the members of the Battle Saint Emperor’s line were battle maniacs, yet he insisted on fighting Brother Monkey.

It was also him who had miscalculated. He had not thought that Brother Monkey was actually already on the verge of breaking through to Saint Tier. Otherwise, even if he was a nine-star Venerate, so what? How could he possibly be a match for him?
Only now did everyone know that Brother Monkey was about to break through to Saint Tier.
Hiss!
This was the number one person of the younger generation.

Though Brother Monkey had been born two to three thousand years earlier than the Golden Generation, when one had reached the height of Venerate Tier, what was this little age worth? They could all be categorized as belonging to the same generation.
But what basis did the man in the coffin have?
He was also about to become a Saint?
Ling Han opened his mouth, and said slowly, “You should be the son of the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor, right?”
Peng!
The man in the coffin was clearly dazed for a moment, and was instantly sent flying by Brother Monkey’s staff.
However, this only sent him flying, and did not cause him any injury.
However, these words were shocking and earth-shattering.
He was the son of a Great Emperor!
Was that possible?
However, if Ling Han was only spouting nonsense, would the man in the coffin have been shocked and sent flying by Brother Monkey?
But… the son of a Great Emperor?
Everyone felt their scalps go numb.
Why was the son of a Great Emperor here? Moreover, how could the Black Sunflower Clan not know that their second-generation ancestor was buried here?
Brother Monkey did not pursue any further. The other was already distracted, so he disdained from taking advantage of this.

Meanwhile, the man in the coffin breathed a sigh of relief. Unless he could easily kill his opponent in a fight with the line of Battle Saint Emperor, every time they fought, even if he could win, he would still be severely wounded.
He turned his gaze to Ling Han, and a curious expression appeared on his face, “How did you guess?”
With this question, it was equivalent to admitting it.
F***, that really was the case.
Everyone was stunned. The son of a Great Emperor had suddenly appeared. Was the era about to be overturned?
Tong Xiao’s expression became even more awkward. He didn’t know if he should address the man as Second Ancestor.

Because this was only Ling Han’s question, and the man in the coffin had tacitly agreed, there was no substantial evidence. If he was to randomly acknowledge someone as ancestor, then the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan would be completely humiliated.
“I don’t know if you know someone called Di Wuji,” Ling Han said casually.
“Yi?” The man in the coffin couldn’t help but look surprised, “You met Di Wuji, and are actually still alive?”
Ling Han cracked a smile, spread out his hands, and said, “I am living very well.”
“Di Wuji actually spared your life?” the man in the coffin murmured, and suddenly stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han, “Then I would really like to see what is so special about you.”
Seeing this, everyone smirked coldly.
You are very arrogant, and very insufferable, right?
Just wait to be shocked.
The man in the coffin saw everyone’s reaction, and a strange expression involuntarily rose up on his face. Why were everyone’s expressions so strange?
However, wouldn’t dealing with a Sect Master be a piece of cake for him? Did he need to be concerned?
Ling Han raised his fist and threw a punch at the man in the coffin.
Peng!
The Regulations burst forth, and the large hand that the man in the coffin had stretched out immediately crumbled.
Yi?

The man in the coffin revealed an astounded expression. Against a Sect Master, it was naturally impossible for him to go all out. He had only used a sliver of the power of Venerate Tier, as he thought it would definitely be a piece of cake.
However, reality was so strange.
What kind of Sect Master was this?
“Interesting.” He nodded, and made another move, but this time, it was slightly more powerful.
Ling Han stepped forward to block this attack. Peng! He shattered this attack with a single punch, then launched a counterattack at the man in the coffin.
Even if the man in the coffin was experienced and knowledgeable, he was still severely shocked.
He hurriedly increased his battle prowess again, and began fighting with Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled, and the man in the coffin finally gained the upper hand. However, it was only an upper hand.

In terms of Regulations, he was completely unable to suppress Ling Han. It was all because his power far surpassed the level of Venerate Tier, which was why he could suppress Ling Han to a limited extent.
“You!” The man in the coffin was really shocked. How could there be such a terrifying Sect Master?
Even if the Great Emperor came back to life, he would still have to kneel in front of this person in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
“What did you say just now?” Ling Han asked with a smile. “You want us to sacrifice ourselves to you?”
The man in the coffin was rendered speechless.
Originally, though he was a Venerate, he should have been absolutely invincible in this cultivation level. You see, even a nine-star Venerate Golden Generation was no match for him.
However, first, it was Brother Monkey, then Ling Han, and they both blocked him.
What shocked him the most was naturally Ling Han. Was this really a Sect Master?
He was practically doubting life itself.
Having slumbered for too long, this world was changing too quickly, wasn’t it?
“I refuse to believe this!” the man in the coffin said with a humph. Weng! Six stars materialized in his body.
These were genuine stars, and they had only shrunk to this extent after being refined by the Great Emperor with his supreme might.
Six?
Realization dawned on Ling Han. Even if he was the son of the Great Emperor, there were still differences in aptitude. The man in the coffin was obviously inferior to Di Wuji, who had seven stars.
“You are inferior to Di Wuji.” He did not give him any face, and directly pointed out.
The man in the coffin revealed an expression of fury. Indeed, he was inferior to Di Wuji, but being pointed out in public by Ling Han made him extremely angry and embarrassed.
“You’re going to pay the price for your rude words!” the man in the coffin roared. Boom! The six stars boosted him with power, yet he did not attack immediately.
This was accumulating power to deliver an absolutely powerful attack.
In a mere second, he had completed accumulation, and then shot out a punch.
Instantly, a streak of light shot over, its speed so fast that Ling Han had no time to dodge at all.
He could only parry.

chapters.title: Chapter 4587: Tong Ming
paragraphs: Chapter 4587: Tong Ming
Editor: Henyee Translations

However, the problem was that this was equivalent to the furious barrage of attacks from a One-Star or even Two-Star Saint. It only lacked the level of Regulations, and its destructive power was still boundlessly terrifying.
How could Ling Han possibly block this?
If he faced it head-on, he would definitely be severely injured, and every single bone in his body would be crushed!
Peng, this attack had already arrived. Light exploded, incredibly dazzling.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically. What kind of terrifying attack was this?
So what if it was a nine-star Venerate? He would probably be smashed into smithereens under this attack.
Was this the battle prowess of the son of a Great Emperor?
This was too shocking.

The Golden Generation elites were even more humiliated. They were all claimed to be close to the level of the Great Emperors in the past, and compared to the actual sons of Great Emperors, just how wide was the gap between them? And they still wanted to compare to the Great Emperors in the past? Pei!
“En?” A hint of surprise appeared on the man’s face.

The light dissipated, and Ling Han was still standing proudly in the air. However, a tower had appeared above his head, and Primal Chaos Qi was emanating from it. There was supreme lightning flickering.
“Imperial Weapon!” the man in the coffin said in a solemn voice. However, he immediately shook his head and said with a burning gaze, “Origin Gold! You actually obtained a piece of Origin Gold!”

Origin Gold was too rare. Who knew how many years it would take for the heaven and earth to nurture a piece. Thus, even if the Great Emperor was invincible in this world, they could only obtain one piece of Origin Gold, and forge an Imperial Weapon.
It could not be helped. With the lifespan of a Great Emperor, even if he lived a second life, he would not be able to wait until the appearance of a second piece of Origin Gold.
Thus, it was possible that there would only be one such Great Emperor that could encounter two pieces of Origin Gold in his lifetime.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You have good insight. Old Black, deliver a reward.”
The large black dog immediately retrieved a bone and tossed it toward the man in the coffin.
‘Holy f*ck!’
You guys are really too despicable, aren’t you?
Everyone was dumbfounded. They had not thought that Ling Han would still be in the mood to make fun of others at this moment, and the large black dog actually had a bone with him.
—It really was a dog.
Meanwhile, the man in the coffin exploded in fury. Veins were popping on his forehead and neck, and he looked like he was about to commit murder and devour someone.

“Die!” He charged over, six stars surrounding him. This was completely a deadly weapon. As long as they was struck or touched, it was guaranteed that even Venerates would have their bones broken and their flesh shattered.
Ling Han humphed as he channeled the Destructive Energy and launched it at the man in the coffin.
What!
The man in the coffin instinctively felt a sense of danger, and hurriedly dodged.

Boom, the Destructive Energy struck, and blasted onto the ground, melting a large area of the ground soundlessly. Even the Saintly corpses would not be able to escape this fate, as a small corner had been scraped off.
Though it was only a small corner, that was a Saintly corpse! Theoretically speaking, it was equivalent to a Saintly Material!
Heavens!
The man in the coffin frowned. This kind of high-level energy… he seemed to have heard of it, but only vaguely.
“Who are you?” He did not attack again, but rather asked darkly.
Ling Han broke into a smile, “Before asking others, shouldn’t you tell them your name first? Don’t you understand this kind of rule?”
The man in the coffin wanted to flip out again, but after some thought, he forcibly suppressed the urge, and said, “I am Tong Ming!”
As expected!

Everyone gave an ‘oh’. The Black Sunflower Demon Emperor took the surname of Tong, and this surname… was too rare. It was so rare that only the Black Sunflower Clan still used it, and even if there were others with the surname of Tong, they would still change their surname to avoid any issues.
“Alright, tell me your name!” the man in the coffin, Tong Ming, said.
Ling Han smiled, and turned to look at the large black dog, “Old Black.”
“Your Grandpa Ling’s surname is naturally Ling, and his name is Han.” The large black dog was used to cooperating with Ling Han. Even if he angered someone to death, he would not care about it.
The corners of Tong Ming’s mouth twitched madly. At this moment, he really wanted to kill someone.

“You really think I can’t deal with you guys?” he said balefully. A black sunflower suddenly appeared behind him. Its roots were covered with complex veined patterns, and it was filled with demonic aura.
Tong Xiao instantly felt his body tremble. He wanted to kneel down and worship this Demonic Sunflower.

This was a suppression on his bloodline, and he no longer had the slightest doubt. Even if Tong Ming was not the son of the Great Emperor, he was still a descendant of his ancestor. His bloodline was far nobler and purer than his.
“En?” Right at this moment, a frightening aura surged out madly.
Tong Ming immediately stopped, and looked into the distance.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple figures walked over from the sky.
Saints!
Finally, the Saints appeared.
Realization dawned on everyone. Actually, both paths could lead here, forming a circle.
“The son of a Great Emperor?” The Imperial Sons all reported the situation, which naturally caused the Saints to feel surprised. There was actually a son of a Great Emperor here?
Hiss, in terms of seniority, he was innumerable times superior to these Saints.
“Humph, you’re a fake, right?” A Saint immediately moved, grabbing out at Tong Ming.

Actually, he had already confirmed Tong Ming’s identity. However, the value of having the son of a Great Emperor was too great. To be able to “extract” secrets like the Imperial Scroll, they definitely had to directly deny it, and kill him directly to pluck out his soul.
“You dare?!” The Saint from the Black Sunflower Clan hurriedly tried to stop him, yet he was immediately blocked by another Saint.
“Humph!” Yet Tong Ming was unafraid.

Everyone was astonished upon hearing this. ‘Although you possess the power of a Saint, you’re only at One Star or Two Stars, at most. Moreover, you can’t draw on the Regulations, so what right do you have to challenge a genuine Saint?’
Boom, this large hand had already caught hold of him.
However, a strange scene appeared.
A Saintly corpse suddenly moved, and forcibly grabbed hold of the giant hand that was blasting towards him.
What!
Everyone couldn’t help but feel numb. A Saintly corpse would actually make a move?
When a person died, everything was over. This was a common truth that would never change. Why had it changed here?
“You want to capture me? How dare you!” Tong Ming smirked coldly. Boom, a Saintly corpse suddenly charged towards the Saint that had previously moved.
Boom!
The Saintly corpse attacked, completely unconcerned about whether it would be injured or not. Every move was ruthless and fatal.
This caused the Saint to be extremely passive, and he had no choice but to retreat continuously. He did not dare to face this attack head-on at all.
Ling Han frowned, and looked towards Brother Monkey, only to see that Brother Monkey was also frowning.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
A Venerate… could actually control a Saintly corpse?
This was too inconceivable.
No wonder Tong Ming had been so confident just now. So that was the case.
Being able to control a Saintly corpse was naturally awesome.
Hold on!
Ling Han and the large black dog inhaled sharply at the same time. This guy could control “only” one Saintly corpse?
He had not even finished this thought, when he saw Tong Ming wave his hand again. Another two Saintly corpses stood up, and charged towards that Saint.
In a one-on-one battle, the Saint was naturally unafraid. After all, he was a true Saint, so how could a Saintly corpse compare?
Previously, he had been dodging because he did not want to fight head-on with the corpse. Even if he would only suffer a slight injury, it was not worth it.
However, with three Saintly corpses attacking him at the same time, the pressure on him instantly increased explosively.
“Three isn’t enough? Then let’s have some more,” Tong Ming said with a smile. Immediately, another five Saintly corpses crawled up from the ground and joined the battle.
This!
The Saint’s expression finally changed drastically. Even he wouldn’t be able to withstand a battle of eight against one.
Without another word, he directly turned around and fled.
Seeing this scene, everyone was speechless.
A dignified Saint was actually scared off by a Venerate.
Though this was not because Tong Ming’s own battle prowess was as strong as this, being able to control Saintly corpses was also a sign of strength.

If he faced it head-on, he would definitely be severely injured, and every single bone in his body would be crushed!
Peng, this attack had already arrived.
Light exploded, incredibly dazzling.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
What kind of terrifying attack was this?
So what if it was a nine-star Venerate?
He would probably be smashed into smithereens under this attack.
Was this the battle prowess of the son of a Great Emperor?
This was too shocking.
The Golden Generation elites were even more humiliated.
They were all claimed to be close to the level of the Great Emperors in the past, and compared to the actual sons of Great Emperors, just how wide was the gap between them?
And they still wanted to compare to the Great Emperors in the past?
Pei!
“En?” A hint of surprise appeared on the man’s face.
The light dissipated, and Ling Han was still standing proudly in the air.
However, a tower had appeared above his head, and Primal Chaos Qi was emanating from it.
There was supreme lightning flickering.
“Imperial Weapon!” the man in the coffin said in a solemn voice.
However, he immediately shook his head and said with a burning gaze, “Origin Gold!
You actually obtained a piece of Origin Gold!”
Origin Gold was too rare.
Who knew how many years it would take for the heaven and earth to nurture a piece.
Thus, even if the Great Emperor was invincible in this world, they could only obtain one piece of Origin Gold, and forge an Imperial Weapon.
It could not be helped.
With the lifespan of a Great Emperor, even if he lived a second life, he would not be able to wait until the appearance of a second piece of Origin Gold.
Thus, it was possible that there would only be one such Great Emperor that could encounter two pieces of Origin Gold in his lifetime.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You have good insight.
Old Black, deliver a reward.”
The large black dog immediately retrieved a bone and tossed it toward the man in the coffin.
‘Holy f*ck!’
You guys are really too despicable, aren’t you?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
They had not thought that Ling Han would still be in the mood to make fun of others at this moment, and the large black dog actually had a bone with him.
—It really was a dog.
Meanwhile, the man in the coffin exploded in fury.
Veins were popping on his forehead and neck, and he looked like he was about to commit murder and devour someone.
“Die!” He charged over, six stars surrounding him.
This was completely a deadly weapon.
As long as they was struck or touched, it was guaranteed that even Venerates would have their bones broken and their flesh shattered.
Ling Han humphed as he channeled the Destructive Energy and launched it at the man in the coffin.
What!
The man in the coffin instinctively felt a sense of danger, and hurriedly dodged.
Boom, the Destructive Energy struck, and blasted onto the ground, melting a large area of the ground soundlessly.
Even the Saintly corpses would not be able to escape this fate, as a small corner had been scraped off.
Though it was only a small corner, that was a Saintly corpse!
Theoretically speaking, it was equivalent to a Saintly Material!
Heavens!
The man in the coffin frowned.
This kind of high-level energy… he seemed to have heard of it, but only vaguely.
“Who are you?” He did not attack again, but rather asked darkly.
Ling Han broke into a smile, “Before asking others, shouldn’t you tell them your name first?
Don’t you understand this kind of rule?”
The man in the coffin wanted to flip out again, but after some thought, he forcibly suppressed the urge, and said, “I am Tong Ming!”
As expected!
Everyone gave an ‘oh’.
The Black Sunflower Demon Emperor took the surname of Tong, and this surname… was too rare.
It was so rare that only the Black Sunflower Clan still used it, and even if there were others with the surname of Tong, they would still change their surname to avoid any issues.
“Alright, tell me your name!” the man in the coffin, Tong Ming, said.
Ling Han smiled, and turned to look at the large black dog, “Old Black.”
“Your Grandpa Ling’s surname is naturally Ling, and his name is Han.” The large black dog was used to cooperating with Ling Han.
Even if he angered someone to death, he would not care about it.
The corners of Tong Ming’s mouth twitched madly.
At this moment, he really wanted to kill someone.
“You really think I can’t deal with you guys?” he said balefully.
A black sunflower suddenly appeared behind him.
Its roots were covered with complex veined patterns, and it was filled with demonic aura.
Tong Xiao instantly felt his body tremble.
He wanted to kneel down and worship this Demonic Sunflower.
This was a suppression on his bloodline, and he no longer had the slightest doubt.
Even if Tong Ming was not the son of the Great Emperor, he was still a descendant of his ancestor.
His bloodline was far nobler and purer than his.
“En?” Right at this moment, a frightening aura surged out madly.
Tong Ming immediately stopped, and looked into the distance.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Multiple figures walked over from the sky.
Saints!
Finally, the Saints appeared.
Realization dawned on everyone.
Actually, both paths could lead here, forming a circle.
“The son of a Great Emperor?” The Imperial Sons all reported the situation, which naturally caused the Saints to feel surprised.
There was actually a son of a Great Emperor here?
Hiss, in terms of seniority, he was innumerable times superior to these Saints.
“Humph, you’re a fake, right?” A Saint immediately moved, grabbing out at Tong Ming.
Actually, he had already confirmed Tong Ming’s identity.
However, the value of having the son of a Great Emperor was too great.
To be able to “extract” secrets like the Imperial Scroll, they definitely had to directly deny it, and kill him directly to pluck out his soul.
“You dare?!” The Saint from the Black Sunflower Clan hurriedly tried to stop him, yet he was immediately blocked by another Saint.
“Humph!” Yet Tong Ming was unafraid.
Everyone was astonished upon hearing this. ‘Although you possess the power of a Saint, you’re only at One Star or Two Stars, at most.
Moreover, you can’t draw on the Regulations, so what right do you have to challenge a genuine Saint?’
Boom, this large hand had already caught hold of him.
However, a strange scene appeared.
A Saintly corpse suddenly moved, and forcibly grabbed hold of the giant hand that was blasting towards him.
What!
Everyone couldn’t help but feel numb.
A Saintly corpse would actually make a move?
When a person died, everything was over.
This was a common truth that would never change.
Why had it changed here?
“You want to capture me?
How dare you!” Tong Ming smirked coldly.
Boom, a Saintly corpse suddenly charged towards the Saint that had previously moved.
Boom!
The Saintly corpse attacked, completely unconcerned about whether it would be injured or not.
Every move was ruthless and fatal.
This caused the Saint to be extremely passive, and he had no choice but to retreat continuously.
He did not dare to face this attack head-on at all.
Ling Han frowned, and looked towards Brother Monkey, only to see that Brother Monkey was also frowning.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
A Venerate… could actually control a Saintly corpse?
This was too inconceivable.
No wonder Tong Ming had been so confident just now.
So that was the case.
Being able to control a Saintly corpse was naturally awesome.
Hold on!
Ling Han and the large black dog inhaled sharply at the same time.
This guy could control “only” one Saintly corpse?
He had not even finished this thought, when he saw Tong Ming wave his hand again.
Another two Saintly corpses stood up, and charged towards that Saint.
In a one-on-one battle, the Saint was naturally unafraid.
After all, he was a true Saint, so how could a Saintly corpse compare?
Previously, he had been dodging because he did not want to fight head-on with the corpse.
Even if he would only suffer a slight injury, it was not worth it.
However, with three Saintly corpses attacking him at the same time, the pressure on him instantly increased explosively.
“Three isn’t enough?
Then let’s have some more,” Tong Ming said with a smile.
Immediately, another five Saintly corpses crawled up from the ground and joined the battle.
This!
The Saint’s expression finally changed drastically.
Even he wouldn’t be able to withstand a battle of eight against one.
Without another word, he directly turned around and fled.
Seeing this scene, everyone was speechless.
A dignified Saint was actually scared off by a Venerate.
Though this was not because Tong Ming’s own battle prowess was as strong as this, being able to control Saintly corpses was also a sign of strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 4588: Aftershock
paragraphs: Chapter 4588: Aftershock
Editor: Henyee Translations
“Now, it’s your turn!” Tong Ming looked coldly at Ling Han and the others.
He was determined to obtain the Origin Gold.
Xiu! The Nine Mountains Saint immediately reached over and grabbed Ling Han and the others. He then leaped into the air to leave.
“Where do you think you’re going?!” Tong Ming snapped his fingers, and another 10 Saintly corpses instantly crawled up and started to chase after the Nine Mountains Saint.
Just how many Saintly corpses could this guy control at the same time?
Everyone was shocked. Could such a Venerate’s strength be measured in terms of Venerate Tier?
“Die!” Tong Ming roared in a baleful voice. Immediately, more and more Saintly corpses crawled up and started to attack them.
This caused everyone’s scalps to go numb with shock, and it was unbelievable to the extreme for them.
Human power was limited at times. No matter what, Tong Ming was only a Venerate, so how could he control so many Saintly corpses?
This was just like the Saint Tool. It did not mean that the more Saint Tools there were, the better. Instead, it was referring to how much might one could unleash.
Ordinarily speaking, activating one Saint Tool would be enough to occupy a Saint. Thus, very few Saints would use two Saint Tools at the same time — even if he did indeed have two Saint Tools.

Saintly corpses could be seen as Saint Tools. Thus, being able to control one was already extremely inconceivable, but now, there were thousands upon thousands of them. This was naturally too terrifying.
How was this possible?

However, though they were confused, and though they were stunned, everyone immediately began to flee under the protection of the Saints. To say nothing of the fact that there were so many Saintly corpses, even if they could win, what meaning was there to it?
The Saintly corpses were already deader than dead, and they weren’t afraid of getting injured, but what about the Saint?
Thus, this was an unequal battle. The Saints weren’t prepared to battle to the death either.
Tong Ming smirked coldly. With a leap, he had already sat on the body of a Saint-level tiger. Xiu, this Saintly tiger corpse immediately shot forwards at an astonishing speed.
He definitely had to obtain the Origin Gold.

The Nine Mountains Saint continued to charge forward. To his shock, he discovered that the corpses of the Saints in their path were actually starting to awaken. When he passed them, they all started to attack him.
“Old man, here.” Ling Han handed the control of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to the Nine Mountains Saint.
The old man took the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon and used this tower like a staff.
Because this wasn’t a genuine Imperial Weapon, it couldn’t unleash Imperial Might. However, if it was used as a staff… it could still unleash a terrifying might.
Origin Gold was indestructible by itself, and so what if it was a Saint?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The Saintly corpses would not dodge. With a knock from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, they were instantly smashed into smithereens.
The Nine Mountains Saint forcefully barged his way through, completely invincible.

However, this kind of battling while fleeing would ultimately affect his speed. Very quickly, the Saints behind them had already caught up, and slightly further behind them, Tong Ming was also riding on the corpse of the Saintly tiger, soaring in midair, staring coldly at them.
As a Venerate, being able to force the Saints to this extent was really worth it.
Was this the might of the son of the Great Emperor?
Everyone sighed ruefully, then continued to sprint madly.

The Imperial Weapons had all been left behind at the front lines to suppress the Skeleton Saint Tools. Thus, they were unable to suppress so many Saintly corpses at this moment. Apart from fleeing, what else could they do?
No one was prepared to fight to the death.
More and more Saintly corpses joined the pursuit, and they were also getting closer and closer.
Finally, a black forest appeared ahead of them.

This was where the old Holy Beast was. After leaving this place, they would soon be able to leave the Saint Tomb, and once they exited the Mystery Realm, the Saints would be able to tear a rip into space and leave. It would practically be impossible for them to pursue any further.
However, the Saintly corpses also caught up.

There were a few Saintly corpses of the bird race that were astonishingly fast. With a flap of their wings, they could actually temporarily tear a rip into space here, and dash forwards, forming a pincer attack from the front and back.
What could they do?
If they were blocked, they would be trapped in the ocean of Saintly corpses. No matter how strong they were, so what? They would eventually be exhausted to death.
Everyone was anxious, and even felt a kind of hopelessness.
Boom!

Right at this moment, the black forest in front of them suddenly moved. The old Holy Beast crawled up, and swatted out a paw, sending the corpses of those Saintly birds in front of it flying, “Come, I will buy you some time!”
“Old beast, you dare!” Tong Ming shouted harshly. Just when it looked like the Origin Gold was about to fall into his hands, he had failed on the verge of success, driving him crazy.
The old Holy Beast laughed loudly, “I don’t have much time left anyways, so I just want to disgust you guys a bit!”
He dodged to the side, allowing the Nine Mountains Saint and the other Saints to pass. Then, he suddenly collapsed. Boom! A large portion of the Saintly corpses were crushed into the ground.
However, being large didn’t mean that its strength was invincible. Pu, pu, pu! Its body was forcefully torn open, and blood spurted out. There was a white turbid substance exuding a fishy smell.
Countless Saintly corpses charged out, continuing their pursuit.
“Stop right there!” the old Holy Beast roared. Weng! A devastating shockwave rippled into the surroundings.
With this strike, all the Saintly corpses froze, as if time itself had stopped.

Tong Ming flew into a thunderous rage, “Old beast, you actually dare sever my connection with these Saintly corpses! You deserve death! You deserve death! Even if you die, I will make sure that you will never have a day of peace!”
“Hahahaha.” The old Holy Beast merely laughed loudly, “I have already had enough of living a life of torture. Death would be the best release.”
It showed an expression of pain, and those Saintly corpses that had been frozen were restless.
—It could no longer suppress them.
Peng!

One of its claws instantly exploded, and blood sprayed like rain. Yet it was completely unaware of this, and merely channelled the last of its power with all its might, continuing to sever Tong Ming’s connection with these Saintly corpses.
Pa, it exploded another claw, then another, right until all of them exploded. Then, its body also exploded, and finally, its head.
Boom, saintly might spread out, and the air was filled with a light feeling of relief.
The old Holy Beast had died, and returned to the heaven and earth.
To it, death was actually the best end. Otherwise, in this kind of period before death, it would only be suffering.

What was baffling was that after it severed the connection between the Saintly corspes and Tong Ming, it could have killed Tong Ming. After all, with its strength, wouldn’t it be easy for it to kill a Venerate?
However, it didn’t.
Why?

Ling Han turned around to look. Though he was very far away, he could still see the old Holy Beast desperately delaying the pursuit of the Saintly corpses. This made him feel admiration, touched, and at the same time, a little sad.
This old Holy Beast should be Nine Stars, and could be claimed to be one of the strongest in the world, but in its old age, it had fallen into such a miserable state. How could he not sigh in pity?

Xiu, the Nine Mountains Saint had already brought Ling Han and the others into the passageway, and returned the way they had come. Not long after, they had already rushed out of that massive crack in space.
The Nine Mountains Saint tore a rip into space at the first instant, and leaped in.
“Nine Mountains, don’t even think of fleeing!” Behind them, a great many Saints from the Imperial Clans all moved, wanting to stop the Nine Mountains Saint.
However, the Nine Mountains Saint had also mastered the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. Even if he hadn’t completely mastered it, his speed was still far above that of ordinary Saints.
He couldn’t be stopped.

chapters.title: Chapter 4589: Final Preparations
paragraphs: Chapter 4589: Final Preparations
Editor: Henyee Translations
Led by the Nine Mountains Saint, Ling Han and the others successfully returned.
They asked about the Nine Mountains Saint’s gains, but they were extremely negligible.
How could the holy flame be so easily obtained?

The Saints that had entered were all here to snatch the holy flame. Thus, they would either become old, and have long since died there, or return empty-handed. The difficulty level of obtaining it was naturally much higher.
Moreover, when the conversation returned to Tong Ming, they were all frowning deeply.

“Grandpa Dog has a guess,” the large black dog said. “Grandpa Dog’s guess is that the so-called Lord of Yin River, Lord of Blood Sea, or this Tong Ming are all the sons of the Great Emperors. Furthermore, they have also been bestowed with Mystical Powers by the Great Emperors, allowing them to control corpses!”
After all, controlling the corpses was a fact. How many Saintly corpses were there in the Yin River and the sea of blood?
Even in the fog where Di Wuji was, just how many Saintly corpses were buried under the so-called safe zone?
Thus, even though these people were only at Venerable Tier, they could still cause boundless commotion.
“But the problem is, why does the Netherworld cooperate?” Ling Han asked.
If it was only the son of a Great Emperor, then no matter what, there was no way they could control the Yin Saints, right?
Did the Yin Saints need to give face to the Great Emperor?
When one had reached the height of a Saint, they could always flee. Even if they wielded the Imperial Weapon, they still wouldn’t be able to do anything to them.
“Er, could it be that the Great Emperors of the past had reached some kind of agreement with the Netherworld?” the large black dog guessed.

Ling Han’s mind whirred, and he said, “Take the Saint Tomb that we went to for example. There’s not just a single corpse tower there. So, what if there’s a bronze casket underneath each corpse tower?”
The little azure dragon inhaled sharply, “You’re saying that there are more children of Great Emperors?”
Ling Han nodded, “It is very possible that one or two of them are extremely outstanding, and have reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor.”

Only those with the talent of a Pseudo-Emperor could pose real threat to Saints. How many Saints had Buddha Doga killed in the past? This showed that when a Pseudo-Emperor wanted to kill Saints, Saints were not even qualified to flee.
That being the case, it was at least understandable that the Yin Saints would cooperate.
“If these deductions are all correct, then why would the sons of the Great Emperors do this?” the little azure dragon asked.
This was indeed an unsolved mystery.
In the past, the might of the Great Emperors had shaken the world, and they had been invincible for an era. As the sons of the Great Emperors, what else did they have to aspire for?

This was because the theoretical lifespan of the Great Emperor was 10 million years. If they lived another life, it would be a lifespan of 20 million years. They would definitely live a much, much longer time than their own childrenand grandchildren.
Thus, the Great Emperor’s children would always be enveloped by the strongest halo of glory, and there was no need for them to have any reservations.
What was there to pursue?
“First, become Emperor!” everyone concluded.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in an era. Thus, no matter how outstanding the child of a Great Emperor was, it was useless. The heaven and earth did not allow him to become Emperor.
Thus, if one wanted to become Emperor, they could only skip over this era.
However, there was another problem, and that was as long as there was no Emperor in this world, they could take this step. Why did they have to do it in this era?

“No, we’re taking it for granted! How can we be sure that they haven’t appeared repeatedly in history?” Ling Han immediately said. He thought of Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and the others. These people had set foot on Imperial Path quite a few times.

As long as it wasn’t a Great Emperor, they could be sealed by the Primordial Source Clay for a long time — a Great Emperor couldn’t. They were too powerful, and even the Primordial Source Clay couldn’t seal them away.
“So, they would appear every other era to fight for the chance to become Emperor?” The large black dog continued the conversation.
“Possibly,” Ling Han said with a nod. Right now, this was only a speculation.
“Then the second possibility is… immortality!”
Immortality was probably everyone’s ultimate goal.
It was because everyone feared death, and dreamed of attaining immortality.
Thus, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Canopy Demon Emperor, and Ancestral King Lingtian all went to the edge of the universe in search of a path to immortality.
However, this conjecture caused everyone to be clueless.
Even the Great Emperors hadn’t truly set foot on the path to immortality. Who could guess the truth?

“They are the children of the Great Emperors, and it’s possible that they obtained bits and pieces of information from the mouth of the Great Emperors at that time. It’s because of this that they have attempted to do this generation after generation.”
At this point in the discussion, they could only stop abruptly.

The Nine Mountains Saint left. He had other matters to attend to, and now that Ling Han and the others were getting closer and closer to Saint Tier, it was about time to reestablish the Nine Suns Holy Land.
This naturally required preparation.
Brother Monkey continued to cultivate in seclusion. He had half a foot into the Saint Tier, so he naturally had to attain it in one go.
Meanwhile, Ling Han concocted alchemical pills. This time, he had obtained a considerable amount of Celestial Qi.
As he concocted alchemical pills one after another, everyone’s strength was also rapidly improving.
Ling Han’s bottomless pit had swallowed countless Celestial Qi, but his improvement was astonishingly slow.
This was understandable, because he was too strong. This was the price that one had to pay for being strong.
Seven years later, he refined all the Celestial Qi, consuming them as he refined them.
Fifteen Stars … he was finally halfway through.
Only halfway?
Ling Han almost wanted to cry. This was too slow, wasn’t it? Was it really so difficult to break through to Venerate Tier?
What could he do now?
Without a new Mystery Realm or ancient site opening, he could only rely on luck to capture Celestial Qi, so his advancement naturally would be overwhelmingly slow.
No, this was too slow.
Ling Han quickly made his decision. He was going to kill Yin souls.
At present, though the battle lines had stabilized, it did not mean that there was no war.

In truth, the Netherworld didn’t care about the “lives” of the Yin souls at all. They were attacking at all times, and every time the Saints became tired to the point of being unable to control the Imperial Weapons, the Skeleton Saint Tools would open the path and push the battle line outwards.
Thus, it had actually been the Netherworld being at the upper hand all this while. When they devoured the territory of the Living Realm, their speed was not the slightest bit slow either.
“All right, then let’s go and kill the Yin souls.”
This time, Ling Han didn’t call anyone over, and he acted alone.
He snuck into the territory of the Yin souls, and began a massacre.
What abilities did he have now?

An ordinary nine-star Venerate could only be insta-killed by him. Even if he really encountered the Yin Saint, it was not that he did not have the ability to flee when he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. Furthermore, he had also grasped Destructive Energy, which had a very strong restraining effect on Yin souls.
Thus, he actually wasn’t too afraid of the Yin Saint.

However, it was a different story for the Skeleton Saint Tool. It was completely forged from Saintly Material, and could not be restrained by Destructive Energy. Faced with such an existence, Ling Han could only flee.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
Die! Die! Die!

He killed in one location for three consecutive days, and even when he alerted the Yin Saint, he only retreated as he fought. It was only when a Skeleton Saint Tool came over, that he left after countering a single move.
But this move caused Ling Han extreme injury.

No wonder even Saints had to retreat. This Skeleton Saint Tool was really too terrifying. Even if he had already summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, two thirds of his bones had still been broken from the impact.
After spending two months to recover from his injuries, Ling Han continued to slaughter Yin souls.
This time, he was extremely careful. He didn’t give the Skeletal Saint Tool any chance to come near him.
There were more and more Yin souls that he had completely killed, and his cultivation level finally began to rapidly increase.
