Editor: Henyee Translations
Led by the Nine Mountains Saint, Ling Han and the others successfully returned.
They asked about the Nine Mountains Saint’s gains, but they were extremely negligible.
How could the holy flame be so easily obtained?
The Saints that had entered were all here to snatch the holy flame.
Thus, they would either become old, and have long since died there, or return empty-handed.
The difficulty level of obtaining it was naturally much higher.
Moreover, when the conversation returned to Tong Ming, they were all frowning deeply.
“Grandpa Dog has a guess,” the large black dog said.
“Grandpa Dog’s guess is that the so-called Lord of Yin River, Lord of Blood Sea, or this Tong Ming are all the sons of the Great Emperors.
Furthermore, they have also been bestowed with Mystical Powers by the Great Emperors, allowing them to control corpses!”
After all, controlling the corpses was a fact.
How many Saintly corpses were there in the Yin River and the sea of blood?
Even in the fog where Di Wuji was, just how many Saintly corpses were buried under the so-called safe zone?
Thus, even though these people were only at Venerable Tier, they could still cause boundless commotion.
“But the problem is, why does the Netherworld cooperate?” Ling Han asked.
If it was only the son of a Great Emperor, then no matter what, there was no way they could control the Yin Saints, right?
Did the Yin Saints need to give face to the Great Emperor?
When one had reached the height of a Saint, they could always flee.
Even if they wielded the Imperial Weapon, they still wouldn’t be able to do anything to them.
“Er, could it be that the Great Emperors of the past had reached some kind of agreement with the Netherworld?” the large black dog guessed.
Ling Han’s mind whirred, and he said, “Take the Saint Tomb that we went to for example.
There’s not just a single corpse tower there.
So, what if there’s a bronze casket underneath each corpse tower?”
The little azure dragon inhaled sharply, “You’re saying that there are more children of Great Emperors?”
Ling Han nodded, “It is very possible that one or two of them are extremely outstanding, and have reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor.”
Only those with the talent of a Pseudo-Emperor could pose real threat to Saints.
How many Saints had Buddha Doga killed in the past?
This showed that when a Pseudo-Emperor wanted to kill Saints, Saints were not even qualified to flee.
That being the case, it was at least understandable that the Yin Saints would cooperate.
“If these deductions are all correct, then why would the sons of the Great Emperors do this?” the little azure dragon asked.
This was indeed an unsolved mystery.
In the past, the might of the Great Emperors had shaken the world, and they had been invincible for an era.
As the sons of the Great Emperors, what else did they have to aspire for?
This was because the theoretical lifespan of the Great Emperor was 10 million years.
If they lived another life, it would be a lifespan of 20 million years.
They would definitely live a much, much longer time than their own childrenand grandchildren.
Thus, the Great Emperor’s children would always be enveloped by the strongest halo of glory, and there was no need for them to have any reservations.
What was there to pursue?
“First, become Emperor!” everyone concluded.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in an era.
Thus, no matter how outstanding the child of a Great Emperor was, it was useless.
The heaven and earth did not allow him to become Emperor.
Thus, if one wanted to become Emperor, they could only skip over this era.
However, there was another problem, and that was as long as there was no Emperor in this world, they could take this step.
Why did they have to do it in this era?
“No, we’re taking it for granted!
How can we be sure that they haven’t appeared repeatedly in history?” Ling Han immediately said.
He thought of Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and the others.
These people had set foot on Imperial Path quite a few times.
As long as it wasn’t a Great Emperor, they could be sealed by the Primordial Source Clay for a long time — a Great Emperor couldn’t.
They were too powerful, and even the Primordial Source Clay couldn’t seal them away.
“So, they would appear every other era to fight for the chance to become Emperor?” The large black dog continued the conversation.
“Possibly,” Ling Han said with a nod.
Right now, this was only a speculation.
“Then the second possibility is… immortality!”
Immortality was probably everyone’s ultimate goal.
It was because everyone feared death, and dreamed of attaining immortality.
Thus, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Canopy Demon Emperor, and Ancestral King Lingtian all went to the edge of the universe in search of a path to immortality.
However, this conjecture caused everyone to be clueless.
Even the Great Emperors hadn’t truly set foot on the path to immortality.
Who could guess the truth?

He had half a foot into the Saint Tier, so he naturally had to attain it in one go.

This was understandable, because he was too strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 4590: 4592: Encountering Di Wuji again
paragraphs: Chapter 4590: 4592: Encountering Di Wuji again
Editor: Henyee Translations
The rewards from heaven and earth were very random.
Sometimes, it would increase Ling Han’s life force, and at other times, it would increase his cultivation level. This was not definite.
Thankfully, both were very useful to Ling Han.
When he was breaking through to Fifteen Stars, his life force was severely damaged, and he would practically be on the verge of death if he lost even a little bit more.
Now that the life force had recovered slightly, Ling Han felt much more at ease.
And just like that, he battled endlessly.
After killing in one place for a few days, he switched to another battlefield. He definitely could not allow the Skeleton Saint Tool to have the chance to surround him.

Even though he was only one person, his battle prowess was enough to overwhelm everyone below Saint Tier. The Destructive Energy was especially effective against Yin souls, and was even more effective at killing than Saints.
Because of him, the pressure on the various battle lines was slightly lightened.

This caused the people at the front lines to feel very curious. Why was it that there would be times when the Netherworld troops would be scattered all over the place? Aside from the twelve Skeleton Saint Tools, it was really unbearable to watch.
Unfortunately, they didn’t know that Ling Han was fighting on his own ahead of them.
10 years, 20 years, 30 years. This time, Ling Han fought longer and longer, but he still hadn’t reached the end of Fifteen Stars.
On this day, he was in the midst of a bloody battle, when he suddenly felt a frightening aura assault him.

He humphed. Boom, the phoenix wings spread out, as long as three hundred meters, and were entwined with Destructive Energy. With a single strike, the Yin souls in the vicinity collapsed one after another.
In the distance, the Yin souls did not immediately fill in, because a Yin Saint appeared, and took control of the Yin souls.
However, Ling Han did not look towards that Yin Saint, because the aura he sensed was not from Yin souls.
“Come out!” he said calmly. His voice was stimulated by a powerful force, and could be rapidly transmitted even in space.
“Hehe, Brother Ling’s senses are really sharp.” Amidst a long laugh, a man walked over in midair. He was tall and slender, and there were seven stars vaguely flickering behind him.
Di Wuji!
Ling Han’s expression became serious. Though he had already guessed that Di Wuji was very likely related to the Netherworld, guesses were guesses. Witnessing it with his own eyes was another matter.
“You collaborated with the Netherworld to destroy the Living Realm. Can you face the Wolf Emperor?” he said.

Di Wuji cracked a smile, “In front of the great undertaking of eternity, what are millions and millions of living creatures worth? Furthermore, what need is there to distinguish between the Netherworld and the Living Realm?”
“Bullsh*t!” Ling Han scoffed. Boom, the phoenix wings flapped, and he immediately charged towards Di Wuji.

“Ling Han, you are already eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master, so why don’t you find a peaceful place to live in peace?” Di Wuji brandished his palm in response. A massive wolf’s claw appeared, and struck out at Ling Han.
Peng!

The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han was immediately sent backwards. In terms of power, he was definitely no match for Di Wuji. Di Wuji’s body could accommodate seven stars, and this was the power of a Saint!
However, Destructive Energy and 99 Six Star Regulations swept past, and also left a wound on the palm of Di Wuji’s hand.
Right now, the gulf between Ling Han and him wasn’t as large as before.

Di Wuji revealed a shocked expression. He already had half a foot into Saint Tier, yet could only gain a slight upper hand. This Sect Master was truly heaven-defyingly strong, and could not be judged with common sense.

“Fortunately, you are eternally trapped at Sect Master-level. Otherwise, I would really be having a headache,” he said with a smile. It was unknown whether he was comforting himself, or deliberately provoking Ling Han.
But if it was the latter, then he was destined to be disappointed, because Ling Han would not suffer the slightest blow.
“Die!” Di Wuji charged over. Seven stars continuously boosted his power, allowing him to unleash a terrifying battle prowess.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Di Wuji used his ultimate moves frequently. As the son of a Great Emperor, he had a variety of techniques, and his proficiency in using the Imperial Technique was far from what the ordinary Imperial Son could compare to.
It could be said that even if he did not have the help of the power of stars, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, the Golden Generation would still be no match for him.
However, his opponent was Ling Han!
He had powerful moves, but did Ling Han not?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unleashed. He was practically unafraid of power attacks, unless the power was overwhelming enough that the shockwave would be able to kill him.
But Di Wuji’s greatest advantage was his power. In terms of power, he could not overwhelm Ling Han, so he naturally could do nothing against Ling Han.
The two of them exchanged blows. Though the battle was incredibly intense, it was difficult to decide who was stronger.
“Hehe, why didn’t you bring the Saintly corpses over?” Ling Han asked.
“To kill you?” Di Wuji shook his head, “No need.”
“Is that so?” Ling Han said with a smile. “Then I won’t play with you anymore.”
His goal was to kill Yin souls to obtain the rewards of heaven and earth. What was the point of tangling with Di Wuji?
This was a waste of time.
“Trying to escape!” The image of a silver wolf suddenly appeared behind Di Wuji. It was as large as a planet, and suddenly swooped down to swallow Ling Han.
This was too big, and its speed was also astonishingly fast, so Ling Han couldn’t dodge at all.
Weng, he felt his soul being attacked.
Hehe, competing with him in the strength of his soul?
Ling Han smiled faintly. “An”, he called out lightly, and instantly, peace returned to his mind.
“Yi, you have actually grasped the means of the Buddhist Race!” Di Wuji was slightly surprised.
Ling Han ignored him completely. With a flap of his phoenix wings, flames soared sky-high.
How could Yin souls block it?
As the fiery shadows flashed, the Yin souls were all burnt to ash.
“This person is really quite troublesome,” Di Wuji said. Then, he looked towards a corner, “What do you think?”
In the empty space, a person actually walked out. He was dressed in black, and carried a long sword on his back. Even his face was hidden under a black cloth.
However, judging by her shapely curves, this should be a woman.
“He is eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, so there’s no need to pay attention to him,” the black-robed person said. True enough, this was a woman.
“If you had moved just now, and we had attacked together, we should have been able to detain this brat,” Di Wuji said, but did not use a reprimanding tone.
The woman in black shook her head and said, “This person also mastered the Strange Shadow Steps. If I come a little closer, he’ll definitely discover me.”
Judging by her words, it was as if she belonged to the Battle God Palace.

Di Wuji laughed in spite of himself, “This brat is really knowledgeable. He has all kinds of techniques, and has learnt a little of all kinds of ultimate moves. Fine then, since he is eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, we will try our best to control him, to prevent him from killing too much, and delay our progress.”
The woman in black didn’t speak, and she simply disappeared into the darkness of the universe.
Speaking of Ling Han, after he broke free from Di Wuji’s grasp, he continued to sweep through the Yin souls.
However, he discovered that the number of Yin souls was rapidly decreasing.
In the past, wherever he killed, the nearby Yin souls would immediately surge over, determined to kill him, or seize his body.
But now?
Not only were there no nearby Yin souls coming over, but the Yin souls in this region were actually retreating, as if he was some bringer of misfortune.
In this way, Ling Han’s killing efficiency naturally dropped drastically.
His battle prowess was indeed incredibly awesome, but he still had to have Yin souls for him to kill.
What was the meaning of you guys hiding?
Ling Han could only widen the range of his attacks. Even so, the efficiency of him harvesting Yin souls was still incomparable to before.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
“Di Wuji, this enmity is really great!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4591: Breaking through to Fourth Extreme
paragraphs: Chapter 4591: Breaking through to Fourth Extreme
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han ignored everything else, and merely continued to battle.

The deadline of a hundred years was getting closer and closer, yet he had not cultivated to the end of Fifteen Stars and be able to attempt breaking through to Venerate Tier, so it was inevitable that he would feel slightly anxious.
In the past, he had personally boasted that he would go to the Donglin Imperial Clan and take Chi Menghan away with him.
A promise from a gentleman would not change even if the heavens collapsed!

He killed, killed, killed, and killed until he completely forgot himself. Finally, water slowly pierced through stone, and he had reached the end of Fifteen Stars, and counting, there were only three years left until the deadline of a hundred years.
Ling Han did not return. Instead, he found a large planet nearby, and began to break through to the fourth pinnacle level.

His appreciation of cultivation level was already enough. It should be known that he had long since refined two slivers of Seven Star Regulations, but due to the limitation of his cultivation level, the Regulations could not strengthen further. Thus, now that he had reached the end of Fifteen Stars, it would not be difficult for him to break through to the fourth pinnacle level.
In truth, the hardest part was breaking through to Ten Stars, and the next hardest was accumulation. It was too time-consuming.
Boom!
In his mind, the fruit of cultivation broke open, forming four seeds that were exuding light.
These were the seeds of Fourth Extreme.
Ling Han planted them separately, and then with a thought.
Grow!

The four seeds immediately grew madly, and at the same time, Ling Han’s embodiment also turned into a massive whirlpool that madly devoured the power of heaven and earth and Regulations in the surroundings.

However, no matter how much he swallowed like a whale, there would always be a sliver of energy seeping out, causing the plants in the surroundings to grow madly. Very soon, they had surpassed him, and enveloped him completely.
The growth of the Fourth Extreme was a process, and could be long or short.

The shortest was only a few days, and the longest was a good few months. Thus, Ling Han was calm and unmoved, and merely absorbed the power of heaven and earth and Regulations with all his might, speeding up the growth of the Fourth Extreme.
However, several days passed, several months passed, and the growth of the Fourth Extreme still did not stop. It was as if this was only the beginning.
If this was known to others, they would definitely exclaim in disbelief.
Who would need so much time to break through to Fourth Extreme?

The two women exclaimed. They actually dared to do something inappropriate in the land of gods, so how could they not anger the god?
Peng! Right at this moment, the cage of vines suddenly shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 4592: Finally becoming a Venerate
paragraphs: Chapter 4592: Finally becoming a Venerate
Editor: Henyee Translations
‘What?’
The two rascals were both dumbfounded, and felt their scalps go numb.
In these few years, it was rumored that there were great beasts in the forest, and that was why such a change had taken place. Now, they were naturally scared out of their wits.
Peng, the vines broke apart, and a young man was actually standing inside. He looked to be in his early twenties, at most.
They both calmed down. This didn’t look like a monster at all.
“Who do you think you are?” Zhang Dong shouted.
Ling Han broke into a smile. He had finally stepped onto the fourth pinnacle level. From today onwards, he was a Venerate!
“I was in a good mood at first, but you people insist on ruining things.” He shook his head, then snapped his fingers. Pa, pa, Zhang Dong and Ma San had directly disappeared without a trace.
They were dead, and there was not even a speck of dust left behind.
“Thank you, Lord God!” The two women hurriedly knelt down and kowtowed.
Ling Han waved his sleeve, tore a rip into space, and left.
The time limit of 100 years was close at hand. He had to directly go to the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Now that he had become a Venerate, just how powerful would his ability to transmigrate through the Void be?
It was comparable to a Saint!
In just three days, he arrived at Donglin Planet.
At this moment, there were still seven days until Chi Menghan’s wedding.
“The time is really tight,” Ling Han murmured. On a mountain peak, he began to examine his own strength.
He knew that after he advanced into Venerate Tier, his abilities would definitely increase greatly, but exactly how strong would he be?
With a wave of his hand, twenty Seven Star Regulations appeared.
‘Holy f*ck!’
If the other Venerates saw this, they would definitely wet themselves in fright.
That was because 20 Seven Star Regulations was the limit of Venerate Tier. Others could only be infinitely close, and could not possibly reach this limit.
But what about Ling Han?
He was only a One Star Venerate!
If he reached nine stars, then how many Regulations would he be able to deliver with a single strike?
It couldn’t be helped. After breaking through from Fifteen Stars of Sect Master-level, if Ling Han still couldn’t reach a freakish strength, what justice was there left in this world?
“Sweeping aside Venerates would definitely be no problem. More importantly, can I match Saints?”
Ling Han unleashed another attack. This time, though it was still 20 Regulations appearing at the same time, they were intertwined with each other.
“The interweaving of Regulations can further increase battle prowess.”
“Going by experience, twenty flashes of Seven Star Regulations should be able to match two flashes of Eight Star Regulations.”
Ling Han murmured to himself. In other words, he could battle ordinary Two Star Saints.
In truth, they had already become a Saint, so how could they be ordinary?
“Thus, I should only be able to match a One Star Saint.”
What was there to be dissatisfied about? He was only a One Star Venerate!
Ling Han nodded. If his deduction was correct, then in terms of Regulations, he really could match a Saint.
“As for power… this is a shortcoming.”
No matter what, even if he was still a Body Arts cultivator, he was ultimately unable to compensate for the gap of so many major tiers and minor levels in cultivation.
“However, I still have other methods.”
With a thought from Ling Han, an Earth Qi immediately rose up by his feet, turning into the same appearance as him.
Unfortunately, the strength had still not reached Saint Tier.
But it was all right, because… there were many of them.
One after another, “Ling Han” appeared beside him. There were a total of 99 of them!
“This seems to be the limit. I clearly still have some energy left, but I can’t summon any new Earth Qi.”
“Forget it.”
Ling Han smiled knowingly. This was another trump card of his.
He waved his hand again, and four stone pillars suddenly appeared, suppressing his surroundings.
This was his fourth pinnacle!

The Fourth Extreme was forged from Regulations, and they were all Seven Star Regulations, so there was naturally no difference in strength. Thus, the four pinnacle pillars looked more or less the same.
Occasionally, there would be Celestial medicine, which could increase the grade of the Fourth Extreme, and bestow some special effects on the Fourth Extreme, but it was pitifully little.
“My four pinnacle pillars are actually the same as the primitive Celestial Gate.
“However, what’s the use?”
Ling Han scratched his head. This could only be known during battle.
He observed his four pinnacle pillars. Each pinnacle pillar had a seal, but it was covered by the aura of Primal Chaos. He could only vaguely see its shape, and could not accurately recognize it.
“Yi?”
“Others’ four pinnacle pillars should have circles on them. One circle represents one star, and two circles represent two stars. Why don’t I have a circle, but a single seal?”
“A single seal… means that I am a One Star Venerate?”
Ling Han was slightly dumbfounded, but since he had cultivated to Fifteen Stars in Sect Master-level, now that he had become a Venerate, he was definitely different from the rest.
“Forget it. Who cares if it’s a circle or a seal? It’s fine as long as one’s abilities are strong enough.”
“There are still seven days.”
“I’ll get used to my battle prowess first, so that I won’t be too heavy-handed. If I kill him right from the start, it won’t be fun.”
Day after day passed, and the Donglin Planet also became livelier and livelier.

Within a few days, the Ziwei Imperial Clan would come to receive the bride, and the one getting married was the Imperial Daughter, Chi Menghan. Of course, they would hold an incredibly luxurious feast at the Donglin Imperial Clan.
The matrimonial union between two great Imperial Clans was a great matter in itself, what more when this implicated Ling Han.
At that time, Ling Han had made a grand promise, saying that he would personally come to the Donglin Imperial Clan and take Chi Menghan away with him.
That being the case, this deadline was already nearing its end. If Chi Menghan married into the Ziwei Imperial Clan, Ling Han would never be able to fulfill this promise.
Thus, everyone wanted to know whether Ling Han would come or not.
Judging by Ling Han’s usual behaviour, he would definitely come.
However, it was said that Baili Tian had already become a Saint, so what would Ling Han come here for?
Anyone below the level of Saint was nothing but an ant.
“Latest news, latest news, Baili Tian has not become a Saint, but a Pseudo-Saint!”
There would always be well-informed people who had found out some information that could still be considered a top secret at present, and spread it out on the Galaxy Network.
“A Pseudo-Saint, or rather a Half-Saint, already has one foor into Saint Tier, and can draw on a portion of Saintly power.”
“Hiss, Saint-level battle prowess overwhelms all. Even if he is only a Half-Saint, that would be enough to kill all Venerates.”
“It can’t be, right? A hundred years have already passed, and Baili Tian still hasn’t truly become a Saint?”

“F***, it’s easier said than done. Why don’t you think about it? In an era when there is no Emperor in the world, Saints are the most powerful power. They stand at the pinnacle of the universe, so just how difficult would it be to set foot on that level?”
“That’s right. To say nothing of a hundred years, even if he could become a Saint in ten thousand years, this would still be incredibly terrifying.”
“As expected of the strongest of the Golden Generation. Imperial Son Tian is only 300 years old, yet he’s already a Half-Saint. At most, he’ll be able to become a true Saint in another 100 years.”
“Throughout history, this kind of rate of advancement is definitely top-notch.”

“However, I’ve heard that the earlier one becomes a Saint, the better. In history, there have been a great many powerful Saints who could have become Saints long ago, yet deliberately settled down for a few thousand years, or even tens of thousands of years, just to cultivate their cultivation level to a more perfect level.”
“Thus, perhaps it is not that Imperial Son Tian is unable to truly become a Saint, but rather wants to pursue perfection.”
“En, that is very possible!”

On the Galaxy Network, everyone was discussing spiritedly. Some thought that Baili Tian had already tried his best, while others thought that he was holding back, and was deliberately pursuing perfection.
And amidst such discussions, the day finally arrived for Chi Menghan to get married.

“However, I’ve heard that the earlier one becomes a Saint, the better.

In history, there have been a great many powerful Saints who could have become Saints long ago, yet deliberately settled down for a few thousand years, or even tens of thousands of years, just to cultivate their cultivation level to a more perfect level.”
“Thus, perhaps it is not that Imperial Son Tian is unable to truly become a Saint, but rather wants to pursue perfection.”
“En, that is very possible!”
On the Galaxy Network, everyone was discussing spiritedly.
Some thought that Baili Tian had already tried his best, while others thought that he was holding back, and was deliberately pursuing perfection.
And amidst such discussions, the day finally arrived for Chi Menghan to get married.

chapters.title: Chapter 4593: The Wedding Banquet Begins
paragraphs: Chapter 4593: The Wedding Banquet Begins
On this day, everyone was filled with anticipation.
A hundred years ago, the Ziwei Imperial Clan announced that their clansman was going to marry Chi Menghan today, and this was destined to be a marriage that would go down in history.
It was not uncommon for Imperial Clans to becomee in-laws, but this was the first time that the Imperial Son had married the Imperial Daughter.
This meant that the two Imperial Clans would be cooperating at a deeper level. This would break some traditions, and loosen some taboos.
From a certain aspect, this should be because the pressure from the invasion of Yin souls was too great, forcing the two great Imperial Clans to make such a decision.

It was not just these two Imperial Clans. The other Imperial Clans had also begun to form strong alliances among themselves. However, the Donglin and Zi Wei Clans were the first to make such a decision. Furthermore, it was also because Baili Tian and Chi Menghan were the most renowned.
“This is really benefiting Baili Tian.”
“That’s right. That guy is too lucky.”
“Not only is Chi Menghan’s aptitude comparable to the Golden Generation, but she’s also one of the most beautiful beauties in the universe!”
“If I can marry Chi Menghan, I’ll be satisfied even if I can only live another hundred years.”
“Pei, why don’t you take a piss and take a look at yourself? Are you even worthy?”
“I’m not qualified, so are you?”
The wedding banquet wasn’t held at the ancestral grounds of the Donglin Imperial Clan. In other words, it wasn’t held under the protection of the Imperial Formation. Instead, it was held outside.
There was naturally consideration for this arrangement.
—Was the theft of the Ziwei Imperial Clan not enough to alert them?
During the wedding, how many outsiders would come to watch the ceremony? They would definitely have to close the imperial formation. In that case, would they still be able to guard against Ling Han?
Thus, the wedding banquet had to be held outside to protect the treasures of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Ling Han changed his appearance, and slowly walked forwards.

The Donglin Imperial Clan was rich and imposing, and prepared countless banquet tables. Anyone could come to attend and observe the ceremony and. Furthermore, guests could offer wedding gifts, or only come to eat and drink. There would definitely be no one chasing them away.
There were really too many people, and Ling Han practically didn’t recognize any of them.
He didn’t care. In any case, he was here to cause trouble.
He found a table and sat down. He sipped his wine and savored snacks unhurriedly, waiting for the wedding to officially begin.
A table could seat ten people. Though he found an empty table to sit at, it wasn’t long before people came and filled the whole table.
The other nine people were in a total of four groups. At first, they did not know each other, but as they ate and drank, they soon conversed.
“Do you guys think Ling Han will come?” Someone suddenly changed the topic to Ling Han.

“He probably will. This guy is unafraid of heaven and earth, and has even killed a considerable number of Imperial Sons. Now that Imperial Son Tian wants to snatch his woman, how could he not come?” Immediately, someone replied.

“That may not be the case,” a man in yellow robes said with a shake of his head. “Previously, Ling Han was no weaker than his opponent, and that’s why he appeared. However, it’s different this time. Imperial Son Tian has already become a Half-Saint, while he’s eternally trapped at Sect Master-level. If he appears, he’ll only be seeking death.”
“En, I don’t think he would come either.” His companion, a man in a tight-fitting green outfit, nodded in agreement.
Ling Han smiled, “I think he will come.”𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖
“You?” The yellow-robed man couldn’t help but sneer, “What use do you think it is? Yi, you, a Core Formation Tier cultivator, can actually enter into the main venue?”
Although the Donglin Imperial Clan didn’t set any restrictions, the cultivation world itself was a strict hierarchy, with a strict hierarchy of seniority and inferiority.

Thus, those who could enter the main venue were either brought here by the “Lords” of their clans and sects, or had reached Spiritual Transformation Tier or above. If they were any other cultivation level, they could only stay in the secondary venue.
And in Ling Han’s case, he was clearly just one person, and there were no elites by his side, so how had a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator managed to sneak in?
Ling Han smiled, “Do you want to make a bet?”
“What are we betting on?” Though the yellow-robed man felt it was a little strange, he soon put it aside, and thought that Ling Han was only outrageously bold, and had snuck in secretly.
“When Ling Han comes later, just call me grandpa,” Ling Han said.
“Humph!” The yellow-robed man instantly looked displeased. In his eyes, this was completely a provocation.
He stared at Ling Han for a while, then nodded, “All right!”
In truth, if he knew that he was facing Ling Han, he would actually be very happy to call him grandpa.
Wasn’t that obtaining Ling Han as backer?

Though Ling Han was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, he possessed the strength to sweep aside all Venerates, and could be claimed to be the strongest below Saints. Who would not want such a grandfather?
The others at the table were all laughing as they watched the excitement. How boring would it be just to attend a wedding?
Thus, they wanted nothing more than to have more of this kind of small interlude to pass the time. When they returned, they would naturally have more topics to talk about.
At noon, the members of the Ziwei Imperial Clan finally appeared.

Because Baili Yun had been killed, and Baili Che had been crippled, the Baili Clan naturally had to appoint another Imperial Son to replenish their resources, and form a ladder-shaped nurturing formation.
This time, two new Imperial Sons had come, and they had even mobilized a newly advanced Saint.
Baili Chuixue!
He had finally ignited the holy flame, and become a Saint.
This was not a Half-Saint or Pseudo-Saint, but a genuine Saint.
The newly promoted Saint had brought two Imperial Sons over to receive the bride; the Baili Clan had given them enough face.
The members of the Baili Clan also helped to receive guests at the main venue. After all, there were also a great many members of Imperial Clans here, so they naturally couldn’t treat them lightly.
The yellow-robed man left for a while, but very soon returned to his seat. Who knew what he had gone off to do.
Not long after, a person walked over, his eyes fixed on Ling Han.
“You!” He pointed, “Stand up.”
Yi?
Ling Han was drinking, and when he heard this, he merely looked coldly at that person, “Why should I listen to you?”
“Because I’m Baili Jian!” the man said in a solemn voice.
“Hehe.” Ling Han smiled faintly, and ignored him.
“Didn’t you say that you were very optimistic about Ling Han?” Baili Jian asked coldly, “What is it? You don’t dare to admit it now?”
Ling Han was surprised, and glanced at the yellow-robed man. As it turned out, this guy had left just now to tell on him.
Though he had not revealed his identity, wasn’t supporting Ling Han equivalent to going against the Baili Clan?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s right. I have high hopes that Ling Han will slap your mouths!”
“How dare you!” Baili Jian flew into a thunderous rage, and pointed a finger at Ling Han, “Kneel down immediately and confess your guilt. Otherwise, I will make you die a tragic death.”
“This seems to be the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan, right? Since when has it been your turn to make decisions?” Ling Han said calmly.
Baili Jian said proudly, “The Donglin Imperial Clan is now on the same side as our Baili Clan, so why can’t I make decisions?”
“Heh.” Ling Han chuckled, and said, “This wedding mightn’t necessarily be a success!”
“You actually dare to curse the wedding?” Baili Jian said angrily. This was too arrogant, “You’re seeking death!” He moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Ling Han did not move, and merely said calmly, “To commit a crime at the wedding venue, aren’t you afraid that it would be unlucky?”

Baili Jian instantly faltered. If he killed someone here, even if his initial intentions were good, it would still ruin the atmosphere of the wedding. Once Baili Tian knew, what kind of punishment would he suffer?
The present Baili Tianlong was already a Half-Saint, and would soon become the person with the highest status in the clan. How could he dare to offend him?

chapters.title: Chapter 4594: I object
paragraphs: Chapter 4594: I object
“Hehe, Brother Jian, forget it, forget it.” A person walked over, and advised Baili Jian.
This was a member of the Donglin Imperial Clan. Thus, Baili Jian naturally had to give the host some face. Coincidentally, he was also stuck in a dilemma, and this gave him a way out.
“Humph, for the sake of Brother Yuan, I’ll spare you for the moment!” Baili Jian said balefully. “When the wedding banquet ends, you’ll know what it means to speak inappropriately.”
Ling Han smiled, and murmured, “I wonder if you would dare to make a move by then.”
After finding out who he was, how many people in the world would dare to make a move?
Baili Jian strode off, but it was clear that he had already set his eyes on Ling Han. There was absolutely no way he would forget him.
Too bad.
Everyone shook their heads. They had not managed to watch the excitement that they had been anticipating, which made them feel slightly disappointed.
Thinking about it, it made sense. How many people were so outrageously bold that they would dare to cause trouble at such a grand gathering?
Thus, if they wanted to watch the excitement, they could only anticipate Ling Han’s appearance.
Ling Han, please don’t disappoint us.
The banquet continued. Everyone ate and drank in anticipation, and as time passed, everyone’s hearts began to beat faster.
Where was Ling Han? Why hadn’t he appeared yet?
Finally, the banquet reached its climax.
The grrom and bride were about to come out to pay respects to the heaven and earth.

Because the two Imperial Clans were really too far apart from each other, the wedding would be held once in the Donglin Imperial Clan. Then, it would be held once in the Ziwei Imperial Clan. Everything had to be done. After all, they were both Imperial Clans, so they could not afford to lose face.
Baili Tian was dressed in a bright red wedding attire, which set off his handsome face and slender figure, making him look even more dashing and out of the ordinary.
Moreover, he was already a Half-Saint now. Even if he had curbed his saintly might, he still possessed a terrifying might.

Chi Menghan was similarly dressed in a bright red wedding attire, with a red veil covering her head. There was a maid supporting her by her side. Her appearance was not obvious, and her figure only had occasional curves, making one’s heart itch just by looking at her.
“I’ve long heard that Chi Menghan is the third most beautiful woman in the universe, but I don’t know what kind of beauty she is.”
“Hehe, if you have the ability, you can go and take off her veil!”
“… Er, I don’t want to seek death!”
To remove Chi Menghan’s red veil… Was he trying to cuckold Baili Tian1?
What else could it be but courting death?
The ceremony progressed step by step, and they were about to be married.
Yi, why hadn’t Ling Han appeared yet?
“Er, why didn’t the master of ceremonies ask if anyone objected to this wedding?” At this moment, an extremely disharmonious voice suddenly sounded.
Shua, everyone’s eyes turned in that direction.
Was it Ling Han?
No.
Everyone could clearly see that this was a large, sturdy man. His skin was slightly tanned, and he looked like a hooligan.
Beside him, there was also an eleven or twelve-year-old boy, and there was another young man. However, he had a furred face, and his features could practically not be seen clearly.
Yi, what a strange combination.
Yet Ling Han immediately guessed that these were the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and Brother Monkey.
They had indeed come.
“Go, don’t cause trouble!” Immediately, someone from the Donglin Imperial Clan appeared to stop them.

The large black dog raised his hands, and said with a smile, “Fine, fine, fine. Grandpa Dog won’t say anything, right?! Don’t worry, Grandpa Dog has no plans to make a move today. I’m just here to watch the show.”

In a wedding, the last thing one wanted was to see bloodshed affect the atmosphere. Thus, since the large black dog had shut up, the Donglin Imperial Clan didn’t want to cause trouble with him for the time being either.
Of course, once the wedding ended, hehe, who would be so naive? Who would think that they could cause trouble at the Donglin Imperial Clan?

“Let’s continue.” A Saint personally hosted the wedding. It could be seen that the Donglin Imperial Clan placed great importance on this wedding. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have sent a Saint to host the wedding.
“The new couple will bow to heaven and earth!” A master of ceremonies called out in a majestic voice.
They was going to bow, they were going to bow to the heaven and earth, but where was Ling Han?
“I object!” Right at this moment, a voice rang out slowly.
Instantly, the rhythm of the wedding stopped again. Countless eyes swept over in unison.
This time, it was naturally Ling Han.
F***, what are you doing?
The expressions of the nine people at the same table changed drastically, as if they were sitting on pins and needles.
They could feel that a great many eyes were focused on them, and among them, there was no shortage of Sect Masters or even Venerates, which made them feel fear.
It wasn’t them who said it, so don’t look at them!
These nine people all shuffled back in their chairs, drawing a clear dividing line between themselves and Ling Han, to avoid others from mistakenly thinking that they were in the same group.
In this way, Ling Han, who was still leaning over the table and drinking wine, appeared very outstanding.
Faced with this kind of situation, Ling Han merely smiled faintly, “When that person asked just now, did anyone object? Hence, I will object.”
Are you crazy? Is this something that you can object to?
Who do you think you are!
The yellow-robed young man shook his head internally. Looks like he wouldn’t have the chance to complete the bet with Ling Han.
It was clear that the Imperial Clan definitely wouldn’t allow people to cause trouble time and time again. They would definitely make an example of them.
Ling Han stood up and clapped his hands, saying, “Alright, I’m almost done eating.”
He walked towards the centre of the banquet. There was a large empty space there, and the two newlyweds were bowing to the heaven and earth here.

“Brat, you really know how to seek death!” Baili Jian jumped out. He had already tolerated Ling Han for a long time, but previously, because he did not want to draw blood at the wedding, he had forcibly suppressed his killing intent.
But now, Ling Han was seeking death, so there was naturally no need for him to wait any longer.
He charged towards Ling Han and shouted, “You’re seeking death!”
Ling Han smiled, and casually delivered a palm strike.
Pa, Baili Jian’s face was actually slapped off forcefully, revealing a ghastly white skull, and his two eyeballs were directly hanging off.
Gods!
Seeing such a bloody scene all of a sudden, everyone felt their scalps go numb.
What was going on?
Ling Han actually dared to make a move, and it was a member of the Imperial Clan at that?
Though he had not killed anyone, you had slapped the face off the clan member of the groom at his wedding. What kind of provocation was that?
“Ah!” Baili Jian released a terrible scream. His face had been forcefully smacked away; just how painful was that?
Furthermore, this was really “humiliating” from any angle.
Baili Tian’s expression instantly darkened. At his own wedding, someone actually dared to cause trouble?
Was it Ling Han?

He stared at Ling Han, but could not be certain. After all, Ling Han had cultivated the Soul Forming Technique, and he himself had also advanced into the Fourth Extreme. Those who could see through his disguise would probably have to be top-notch Saints.
However, as the groom, he also had to take care of his own status. Furthermore, this was the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Brat, you’ve had too much to drink!” A member of the Donglin Imperial Clan jumped out. With his cultivation level of True Self Tier, he immediately came over to pull Ling Han away.
They would first set this matter aside, and then it was up to them whether they wanted to kill or torture him.
In everyone’s eyes, Ling Han was only a Core Formation Tier. Thus, sending out a True Self Tier cultivator would naturally deal with him easily.
—Do you think that everyone was Ling Han, someone who could battle against someone with a higher cultivation level than him?

They was going to bow, they were going to bow to the heaven and earth, but where was Ling Han?
“I object!” Right at this moment, a voice rang out slowly.
Instantly, the rhythm of the wedding stopped again.
Countless eyes swept over in unison.
This time, it was naturally Ling Han.
F***, what are you doing?
The expressions of the nine people at the same table changed drastically, as if they were sitting on pins and needles.
They could feel that a great many eyes were focused on them, and among them, there was no shortage of Sect Masters or even Venerates, which made them feel fear.
It wasn’t them who said it, so don’t look at them!
These nine people all shuffled back in their chairs, drawing a clear dividing line between themselves and Ling Han, to avoid others from mistakenly thinking that they were in the same group.
In this way, Ling Han, who was still leaning over the table and drinking wine, appeared very outstanding.
Faced with this kind of situation, Ling Han merely smiled faintly, “When that person asked just now, did anyone object?
Hence, I will object.”
Are you crazy?
Is this something that you can object to?
Who do you think you are!
The yellow-robed young man shook his head internally.
Looks like he wouldn’t have the chance to complete the bet with Ling Han.
It was clear that the Imperial Clan definitely wouldn’t allow people to cause trouble time and time again.
They would definitely make an example of them.
Ling Han stood up and clapped his hands, saying, “Alright, I’m almost done eating.”
He walked towards the centre of the banquet.
There was a large empty space there, and the two newlyweds were bowing to the heaven and earth here.
“Brat, you really know how to seek death!” Baili Jian jumped out.
He had already tolerated Ling Han for a long time, but previously, because he did not want to draw blood at the wedding, he had forcibly suppressed his killing intent.
But now, Ling Han was seeking death, so there was naturally no need for him to wait any longer.
He charged towards Ling Han and shouted, “You’re seeking death!”
Ling Han smiled, and casually delivered a palm strike.
Pa, Baili Jian’s face was actually slapped off forcefully, revealing a ghastly white skull, and his two eyeballs were directly hanging off.
Gods!
Seeing such a bloody scene all of a sudden, everyone felt their scalps go numb.
What was going on?
Ling Han actually dared to make a move, and it was a member of the Imperial Clan at that?
Though he had not killed anyone, you had slapped the face off the clan member of the groom at his wedding.
What kind of provocation was that?
“Ah!” Baili Jian released a terrible scream.
His face had been forcefully smacked away; just how painful was that?
Furthermore, this was really “humiliating” from any angle.
Baili Tian’s expression instantly darkened.
At his own wedding, someone actually dared to cause trouble?
Was it Ling Han?
He stared at Ling Han, but could not be certain.
After all, Ling Han had cultivated the Soul Forming Technique, and he himself had also advanced into the Fourth Extreme.
Those who could see through his disguise would probably have to be top-notch Saints.
However, as the groom, he also had to take care of his own status.
Furthermore, this was the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Brat, you’ve had too much to drink!” A member of the Donglin Imperial Clan jumped out.
With his cultivation level of True Self Tier, he immediately came over to pull Ling Han away.
They would first set this matter aside, and then it was up to them whether they wanted to kill or torture him.
In everyone’s eyes, Ling Han was only a Core Formation Tier.
Thus, sending out a True Self Tier cultivator would naturally deal with him easily.
—Do you think that everyone was Ling Han, someone who could battle against someone with a higher cultivation level than him?

chapters.title: Chapter 4595: I’m Here
paragraphs: Chapter 4595: I’m Here
Sure enough, Ling Han didn’t resist at all, falling into the hands of the True Self Tier.
In everyone’s eyes, this was naturally a matter of course.
“Aren’t you coming with me?” the True Self Tier cultivator shouted. He pulled with all his might. Yi, he actually couldn’t move Ling Han.
This surprised him. What was going on?
He was a True Self Tier! With a gap of a major tier between them, shouldn’t he have an absolute advantage?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I don’t like men tugging at me.”
“So what?” Although the True Self Tier found this strange, he didn’t take it to heart. After all, this was Donglin Planet. What did he need to be afraid of? What did he need to be wary of?
Ling Han cracked a smile, and with a shake of his hand, peng, the True Self Tier was sent flying.
It was incredibly easy.
Yi?
Everyone was astonished. This was far too surprising.
Was there such a powerful Core Formation Tier cultivator?

“Humph, suppressing your cultivation level, acting all mysterious!” Among the members of the Donglin Imperial Clan, a Spirit Transformation True Lord walked out. “Brat, if you want to become famous, you’ve got the wrong idea!”
He thought that Ling Han was some rising star, and wanted to use this opportunity to become famous.
But taking advantage of the Imperial Clan’s influence?
Hehe, how dare you, you must have gotten the wrong idea.

Ling Han picked his ear, and said, “Are you all from the Donglin Imperial Clan? I just heard from the Baili Clan that the two clans are on the same side, and are no different from a family. So, you guys can also send a few members of the Baili Clan for me to pummel.”
“Impudence!” The Spirit Transformation True Lord was enraged, and he reached over to grab Ling Han.
To be so insolent in the Imperial Clan, and still act so arrogant, who knew where he had gotten such courage from.
Ling Han smiled, and casually snapped his fingers. Peng! The Spirit Transformation True Lord was sent flying, directly disappearing into the air and becoming a tiny dot.
Yi!
The Spirit Transformation True Lord was also no match for him?
“Who are you?” A person walked out from the Baili Imperial Clan.
The newly promoted Imperial Son, Baili Heng, Sect Master!
This person was far too strange. His cultivation level had spiked from Core Formation Tier, and this was far too illogical.
Ling Han smiled, “I am who I am, the one and only me.”
‘Holy f*ck!’
Everyone felt a headache coming on. What kind of character was this, to be so mischievous?
“Who cares who you are? You have already made a great mistake!” Baili Heng moved. Boom, the Sect Master-level aura was boiling.

His expression was filled with arrogance. Previously, he had only been an ordinary clansman of the Baili Clan. Though he was a member of the Imperial Clan, how could he possibly compare to Baili Che and the other Imperial Sons?
But now, he had advanced to become the Imperial Son, so his status was completely different.
This was the Imperial Son, a person that the Imperial Clan had nurtured with their full efforts. His future prospects were limitless!
Now, he had moved practically under the eyes of the whole world, so he was naturally feeling extremely pleased.
Come, let’s see how mighty he can be.
He deliberately paused for three seconds, and only then did Baili Heng truly stretch out his hand.
Boom, a large hand stretched out, as if it could blot out the skies, as if it could blot out the sun.
Ling Han shook his head, and still snapped his fingers.
Pa, Baili Heng’s head immediately shattered, white-colored brain matter mixed with blood, possessing an indescribable poignant beauty.
Baili Heng crashed onto the ground, his life force instantly cut off.
He was dead.
‘F*ck! How did he die?’
Whether it was the spectators on the scene, or those watching the live broadcast through the Galaxy Network, they were all extremely confused.

This was the Imperial Son, so he definitely had a Substitution Seal on him. Furthermore, the level of Sect Master had not exceeded the scope of effect of the Substitution Seal, so why was it no longer effective?
Hiss, there was only one person who could ignore the Substitution Seal and commit murder!
“Ling Han!”
“This person is Ling Han!”
“F***, this guy really came!”
The venue and the Galaxy Network instantly became lively.
Ling Han really dared to come!
The corners of the yellow-robed young man’s mouth twitched. He wanted nothing more than for a crack to suddenly appear in the ground so that he could crawl in.
He actually made a bet with the main character, and the bet was whether the latter dared to come or not.
How hilarious. If Ling Han didn’t dare to come, how could he have made a bet with him?
Thus, he would definitely lose this bet.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂

Chi Menghan also became excited all of a sudden. Her slender body trembled slightly, and she suddenly lifted her red veil, revealing a breathtakingly beautiful face. Her radiance radiated in all directions, and everyone who saw her couldn’t help but look shocked.
She was too beautiful!
“Ling Han!” she called out, her tone extremely complicated. There was excitement, gratification, as well as reluctance.
Ling Han looked at her and said softly, “I said I would pick you up and leave. You’ve waited long, haven’t you?”
Chi Menghan instantly burst into tears. The hero in every woman’s heart was probably like this, right?
Just because of these words, this figure stood proudly in front of her, and all her longings had been reciprocated.
“I knew you would definitely come!” she called out loudly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Now, I will take you away!”
“No!” Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “That you were able to come, I already have no regrets!”
She turned to Baili Tian and said, “Let him leave peacefully, and I’ll marry you. Otherwise…” She brandished a dagger and radiated with a terrifying aura.
“A Saint Tool!” everyone exclaimed in shock.
F***, who would deliberately hide a Saint Tool at their wedding?
It was clear that she had made up her mind. Even if Ling Han didn’t come, she would still fight Baili Tian to the death.
However, for the sake of Ling Han, she was willing to sacrifice herself.
This!
Everyone shook their heads. Baili Tian was truly being cuckolded.
Furthermore, in full public, and even the Galaxy Network was broadcasting live, everyone in the whole universe could see clearly that Baili Tian’s had lost both his vanity and substance completely.
Even if he really became Emperor in future, that would be a joke that would last for eternity.
—The Great Emperor had been cuckolded? The cuckolded Emperor?
Baili Tian’s expression was dark, and he suddenly exploded, shouting, “Shut up!”
This woman!
She actually dared to humiliate him in public. There was no way he would spare her so easily. However, the first person he had to deal with now was naturally Ling Han.
He actually dared to make trouble at their wedding?

Hehe, you, a trash trapped forever at Sect Master-level, are not going to spend the rest of your life peacefully in some remote corner of the universe, but insist on coming to cause trouble. You are really tired of living.
“Ling Han, your courage impresses me. You actually dare to come here! However, today is also the day of your death!” he said balefully.
Right now… he was already a Half-Saint.
Just like how a Pseudo-Emperor with the word ‘Emperor’ could sweep aside all Saints, his label having the word ‘Saint’ naturally meant he was able to sweep aside all Venerates.
This was the true number one below Saint Tier!
No matter how strong Ling Han was, how could an eternal Sect Master be a match for him?
“Baili Tian!” Chi Menghan chided. She was resolute, and she had already activated her Saint Tool.
At first, she had planned to assassinate Baili Tian.
For a Venerate to use a Saint Tool to assassinate, even a Half-Saint would very likely be killed with a single strike. However, in order to save Ling Han, Chi Menghan naturally couldn’t care less.
This naturally infuriated Baili Tianu even more. However, there was no need for him to stop her. The Saint from the Donglin Imperial Clan naturally moved to restrain Chi Menghan.
“Menghan, stop messing around!” this Saint rebuked. It was precisely the Crystal Saint.
On the other side, Baili Tian was also striding towards Ling Han, his killing intent clear.

chapters.title: Chapter 4596: Ling Han has become a Venerate!
paragraphs: Chapter 4596: Ling Han has become a Venerate!
“To touch Old Sun’s brother, have you asked the staff in Old Sun’s hand?”
Brother Monkey suddenly jumped out. Boom, the terrifying saintly might surged.
This was not the aura of a Half-Saint, but the true might of a Saint!
Though he had seen Ling Han appear, he was still worried that he would not be able to break through to the fourth pinnacle level. Thus, he naturally had to stand up for Ling Han.
“Monkey, stand aside!”
Boom, the newly advanced Saint of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, Baili Chuixue, also stepped out, his aura locking down on Brother Monkey.
In this way, Brother Monkey had to be prepared to parry an attack. Otherwise, if he was struck by a Saint, it was guaranteed that he would die completely.
Saint-level beings were already standing at the pinnacle of the world, so how could they be underestimated?
Ling Han turned around and smiled at Brother Monkey. “Don’t worry, Brother Monkey. I’m fine!”
With these words, Brother Monkey was naturally relieved.
Things were certain now.
He bared his teeth in a grin, his sharp teeth protruding, filled with violence, “Come, Old Sun will fight you for 300 rounds.”
With a leap, Brother Monkey had already appeared outside Donglin Planet.
The battle between Saints naturally had to be carried out in space. Otherwise, they would be able to destroy a planet in a few moves.
Baili Chuixue naturally wouldn’t back down. He also stepped forward and entered into space.
Boom!
Brilliant light instantly burst into the surroundings. The two Saints were already locked in an intense battle.
Hiss, Brother Monkey had become a Saint!

Everyone was stunned. They all thought that Baili Tian would be the first among the young king tiers to advance into Saint Tier. Though this did not mean that Baili Tian would definitely become Emperor in future, it still had great significance.
However… as it turned out, Brother Monkey was the first Saint of the younger generation.
Everyone couldn’t help but sigh. Naturally, it was another heated discussion.
Baili Tian’s expression became uglier and uglier.
Not only had someone caused trouble at his wedding, but the bride had even betrayed him in public. And now, it was even better. His title as the first Saint had also been removed.
All of a sudden, he was like a failure in life.
The main culprit behind all this was naturally Ling Han.
His eyes were baleful as he gazed at Ling Han, his killing intent boiling.
“You shouldn’t have come,” he said calmly.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Don’t show off. I’m here to pick up my wife, and this has nothing to do with you! However, killing you while I’m at it isn’t impossible.”
“Ha! Ha!” Baili Tian sneered. His expression became darker and darker, so dark that water could drip from it.
This day could be considered the most humiliating day of his life.
However, it didn’t matter. Those who humiliated him were destined to die.
“Ling Han, who gave you the courage?” He moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Instantly, the Regulations took form, turning into a giant hand. It carried the willpower of the heavens, and would definitely not allow disobedience.
A Saint was the manifestation of heaven and earth!
Even if Baili Tian hadn’t truly broken through yet, he already possessed a sliver of such might.
“In any case, it’s not from you.” Ling Han smiled, and flicked out a finger.
Pu!
The Saint’s giant hand was immediately pierced through, and then the Regulations dispersed, one after another. By the time they had reached Ling Han, they no longer had the slightest bit of might.
This… Everyone was numb with shock.
With just a snap of his fingers, the Half-Saint’s attack had disappeared without a trace?
Are you a f****** Saint?
Baili Tian was also shocked. Though this was only a casual move, as a Half-Saint, he could insta-kill a Venerate with a casual strike, so how could it be so easily resolved by a Sect Master?
“Little Han, good job!” the large black dog called out loudly, cheering Ling Han on.
“Snatch the bride! Snatch the bride!” The little azure dragon also shouted from the sidelines. Not only did he shout himself, but he also wanted to get the people around him to shout as well.
But aside from the few of them that were outrageously bold, who else would dare act wantonly in the Imperial Clan?
No one joined in, making the little azure dragon feel very depressed.
“Bunch of cowards!” He shook his head, then released his nine spiritual bodies and shouted at the same time.
‘You can do that?’
Everyone was speechless. As expected, those who were with Ling Han were all unreliable characters.
However, how could Ling Han be so powerful?
That was the attack of a Half-Saint!
Baili Tian frowned, but he immediately delivered another strike. This time, he had naturally increased his power slightly, and this large hand was even more majestic and vast.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Baili Tian, you’ve truly disappointed me. A hundred years have passed, yet you still haven’t become a Saint!”
Just look at Brother Monkey!

Of course, the reason why Brother Monkey could completely advance into Saint Tier was actually because he could not do so without the help of the seed of Regulations. This was a gift from a Nine-Star Saint. If it was not for the fact that that old Holy Beast was about to die, who would be willing to give it away?

Hence, Brother Monkey had digested these two seeds of Regulations, and added with his own freakish talent, he had also begun to break through to Saint Tier before Baili Tian, so it was only natural that he would completely become a Saint.
However, Baili Tian didn’t know this, so he could only feel gloomy upon hearing this.
Indeed, he was no match for Brother Monkey.
So what?
He controlled this attack to blast towards Ling Han. ‘You are about to become a corpse.’
Ling Han smiled, and waved his hand in a slashing motion. The Regulations turned into a divine light that slashed towards that giant hand.
This divine light was like a supreme Divine Sword, effortlessly splitting the large hand into two.
Baili Tian’s second attack was also declared ineffective.
This time, everyone could no longer remain calm.
The first time, it could be said that Baili Tian had been careless, and had not gotten serious at all, but what about this attack?𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
Hiss, did Ling Han really have the power to match a Half-Saint?
Wasn’t this guy eternally trapped at Sect Master-level? Why was it that there was no limit to his battle prowess, and he could continue to charge upwards?
Baili Tian, meanwhile, looked stunned. “Fourth Extreme! Fourth Extreme! You actually became a Venerate!”
He could clearly see that Ling Han’s attack clearly contained Seven Star Regulations.
Being able to use the Seven Star Regulations, and not just a sliver, could only mean one thing.
Ling Han had become a Venerate!
What? Hearing these words, everyone was shocked.
How was this possible?
Wasn’t Ling Han eternally trapped at Sect Master-level? How could he become a Venerate?
This guy was envied by the heaven and earth. Heavens, he could even break through the restrictions of the heaven and earth. Then what other barriers in this world could imprison him?
If he did not become Emperor… who else would be worthy?
“How could you possibly break through!” Baili Tian said through gritted teeth.

When Ling Han was still at the Sect Master Tier, he could practically defeat all Venerates. Then, now that he had broken through to the Venerate Tier, what was so strange about him being able to match a Half-Saint?
However, Baili Tian couldn’t figure it out, and couldn’t accept it at all!

This kind of person was envied by the heavens, and was eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master. This would be a happy ending for everyone, so as to avoid affecting the balance. Why had this guy suddenly broken through?
In this way, who would still be able to compete with Ling Han for the throne?
Ling Han spread out his hands and said, “Who told you that I was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level? I was only perfecting the Minor Element Advanced Tier a bit, so I spent a little more time.”
Everyone was speechless. F***, how could there be such a forceful explanation?
The large black dog stood up, raised his hands, and said very sincerely, “It’s Grandpa Dog’s fault, Grandpa Dog’s fault. Everyone has misunderstood. Grandpa Dog hereby apologize to you!”
It pretended to bow.
‘Is this an apology? You’re clearly rubbing it in!’

Baili Chuixue naturally wouldn’t back down.
He also stepped forward and entered into space.
Boom!
Brilliant light instantly burst into the surroundings.
The two Saints were already locked in an intense battle.
Hiss, Brother Monkey had become a Saint!
Everyone was stunned.
They all thought that Baili Tian would be the first among the young king tiers to advance into Saint Tier.
Though this did not mean that Baili Tian would definitely become Emperor in future, it still had great significance.
However… as it turned out, Brother Monkey was the first Saint of the younger generation.
Everyone couldn’t help but sigh.
Naturally, it was another heated discussion.
Baili Tian’s expression became uglier and uglier.
Not only had someone caused trouble at his wedding, but the bride had even betrayed him in public.
And now, it was even better.
His title as the first Saint had also been removed.
All of a sudden, he was like a failure in life.
The main culprit behind all this was naturally Ling Han.
His eyes were baleful as he gazed at Ling Han, his killing intent boiling.
“You shouldn’t have come,” he said calmly.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Don’t show off.
I’m here to pick up my wife, and this has nothing to do with you!
However, killing you while I’m at it isn’t impossible.”
“Ha!
Ha!” Baili Tian sneered.
His expression became darker and darker, so dark that water could drip from it.
This day could be considered the most humiliating day of his life.
However, it didn’t matter.
Those who humiliated him were destined to die.
“Ling Han, who gave you the courage?” He moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Instantly, the Regulations took form, turning into a giant hand.
It carried the willpower of the heavens, and would definitely not allow disobedience.
A Saint was the manifestation of heaven and earth!
Even if Baili Tian hadn’t truly broken through yet, he already possessed a sliver of such might.
“In any case, it’s not from you.” Ling Han smiled, and flicked out a finger.
Pu!
The Saint’s giant hand was immediately pierced through, and then the Regulations dispersed, one after another.
By the time they had reached Ling Han, they no longer had the slightest bit of might.
This…
Everyone was numb with shock.
With just a snap of his fingers, the Half-Saint’s attack had disappeared without a trace?
Are you a f****** Saint?
Baili Tian was also shocked.
Though this was only a casual move, as a Half-Saint, he could insta-kill a Venerate with a casual strike, so how could it be so easily resolved by a Sect Master?
“Little Han, good job!” the large black dog called out loudly, cheering Ling Han on.
“Snatch the bride!
Snatch the bride!” The little azure dragon also shouted from the sidelines.
Not only did he shout himself, but he also wanted to get the people around him to shout as well.
But aside from the few of them that were outrageously bold, who else would dare act wantonly in the Imperial Clan?
No one joined in, making the little azure dragon feel very depressed.
“Bunch of cowards!” He shook his head, then released his nine spiritual bodies and shouted at the same time.
‘You can do that?’
Everyone was speechless.
As expected, those who were with Ling Han were all unreliable characters.
However, how could Ling Han be so powerful?
That was the attack of a Half-Saint!
Baili Tian frowned, but he immediately delivered another strike.
This time, he had naturally increased his power slightly, and this large hand was even more majestic and vast.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Baili Tian, you’ve truly disappointed me.
A hundred years have passed, yet you still haven’t become a Saint!”
Just look at Brother Monkey!
Of course, the reason why Brother Monkey could completely advance into Saint Tier was actually because he could not do so without the help of the seed of Regulations.
This was a gift from a Nine-Star Saint.
If it was not for the fact that that old Holy Beast was about to die, who would be willing to give it away?

Hence, Brother Monkey had digested these two seeds of Regulations, and added with his own freakish talent, he had also begun to break through to Saint Tier before Baili Tian, so it was only natural that he would completely become a Saint.
However, Baili Tian didn’t know this, so he could only feel gloomy upon hearing this.
Indeed, he was no match for Brother Monkey.
So what?
He controlled this attack to blast towards Ling Han. ‘You are about to become a corpse.’
Ling Han smiled, and waved his hand in a slashing motion.
The Regulations turned into a divine light that slashed towards that giant hand.
This divine light was like a supreme Divine Sword, effortlessly splitting the large hand into two.
Baili Tian’s second attack was also declared ineffective.
This time, everyone could no longer remain calm.
The first time, it could be said that Baili Tian had been careless, and had not gotten serious at all, but what about this attack?𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
Hiss, did Ling Han really have the power to match a Half-Saint?
Wasn’t this guy eternally trapped at Sect Master-level?
Why was it that there was no limit to his battle prowess, and he could continue to charge upwards?
Baili Tian, meanwhile, looked stunned.
“Fourth Extreme!
Fourth Extreme!
You actually became a Venerate!”
He could clearly see that Ling Han’s attack clearly contained Seven Star Regulations.
Being able to use the Seven Star Regulations, and not just a sliver, could only mean one thing.
Ling Han had become a Venerate!
What?
Hearing these words, everyone was shocked.
How was this possible?
Wasn’t Ling Han eternally trapped at Sect Master-level?
How could he become a Venerate?
This guy was envied by the heaven and earth.
Heavens, he could even break through the restrictions of the heaven and earth.
Then what other barriers in this world could imprison him?
If he did not become Emperor… who else would be worthy?
“How could you possibly break through!” Baili Tian said through gritted teeth.
When Ling Han was still at the Sect Master Tier, he could practically defeat all Venerates.
Then, now that he had broken through to the Venerate Tier, what was so strange about him being able to match a Half-Saint?
However, Baili Tian couldn’t figure it out, and couldn’t accept it at all!
This kind of person was envied by the heavens, and was eternally trapped at the level of Sect Master.
This would be a happy ending for everyone, so as to avoid affecting the balance.
Why had this guy suddenly broken through?
In this way, who would still be able to compete with Ling Han for the throne?
Ling Han spread out his hands and said, “Who told you that I was eternally trapped at Sect Master-level?
I was only perfecting the Minor Element Advanced Tier a bit, so I spent a little more time.”
Everyone was speechless.
F***, how could there be such a forceful explanation?
The large black dog stood up, raised his hands, and said very sincerely, “It’s Grandpa Dog’s fault, Grandpa Dog’s fault.
Everyone has misunderstood.
Grandpa Dog hereby apologize to you!”
It pretended to bow.
‘Is this an apology?
You’re clearly rubbing it in!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4597: Battling a Half-Saint
paragraphs: Chapter 4597: Battling a Half-Saint
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han had become a Venerate!
This news spread like lightning on the Galaxy Network, and soon, almost everyone in the universe knew.
Heavens!
When they found out, everyone’s scalps went numb.
Who was Ling Han?
The number one Sect Master in history, publicly acknowledged as the number one natural talent in cultivation!
As a result, he was envied by the heaven and earth, and eternally trapped at Sect Master-level.
But now?
He broke through the restrictions and advanced into the Venerate Tier.
In fact, he was already capable of standing against a Half-Saint.
Heavens, then when he reached the nine-star Venerate Tier, would even a four-star or five-star Saint be unable to suppress him?
The higher the cultivation level, the more difficult it would be to battle above one’s cultivation level. After all, which of them wasn’t a prodigy among prodigies?
Hence, even if it was the Golden Generation, being able to surpass one star, or two stars of battle prowess at Saint Tier was already an incredibly impressive feat.

But when it came to Ling Han, he was actually capable of standing against a middle level, or even a high level Saint while he himself was only a Venerate… was there still any f****** justice in this world?
This guy had broken through the shackles of heaven and earth. Who could still suppress him?
All the Imperial Sons’ expressions changed drastically, and thankfully, Ding Shu and the others had not come. Otherwise, they would definitely not be able to maintain their composure now.
—In some corner of the universe, they should have also received the news. It was just that Ling Han could not see their reaction.
“How could this be!” Baili Tian gritted his teeth. On one hand, he could not accept this, and on the other, he was filled with fury and regret.
If they had known this earlier, the Imperial Clans would definitely spare no expense to get rid of Ling Han!
That’s right, they had fallen into a trap.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖

In an instant, the Imperial Clan elites came to their senses. Ling Han’s side had deliberately released a smoke bomb to mislead them into thinking that Ling Han no longer had room for improvement. Thus, they naturally wouldn’t pay any more attention to him.
They would still kill him, but they could not possibly execute it at too great a price.

It was no wonder that they had fallen into his trap. That was because Ling Han’s previous performance was indeed in line with someone who had had his cultivation level restricted. Otherwise, this guy would have long since advanced into the fourth pinnacle level.
Now, Ling Han had already passed the most dangerous period, and his battle prowess was at least at the level of Half-Saint.
What other person or force in the world would dare to say that they could capture Ling Han?
With the word ‘Saint’, wouldn’t it be easy for him to escape?
Don’t forget, Ling Han had grasped the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. That was the Imperial Technique of the True Phoenix, the fastest and strongest movement technique in the world.
It could be said that even Saints may not be able to detain Ling Han.
Unless a Pseudo-Emperor made a move.
The problem was, where would the Imperial Clans get a Pseudo-Emperor from?
Hence, there was no solution to this.
At this time, Ling Han had truly taken hold of his own fate, and no longer needed to be threatened by anyone.
The higher-ups of the Donglin Imperial Clan all exchanged looks, revealing expressions of regret.
As it turned out, Ling Han hadn’t become a cripple!
F***, couldn’t you reveal some information to them?
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have betrothed Chi Menghan to Baili Tian.
As long as they weren’t idiots, they could clearly see who was stronger between Ling Han and Baili Tian.
Regret!
Aside from feeling regret, they naturally blamed Ling Han as well. He actually hid such a big piece of news from them, causing them to make the wrong decision.
In short, the Imperial Clan was definitely not wrong. The one who was wrong was definitely someone else.
Baili Tian took a deep breath to calm himself down.
Since things had already come to this, what was the point of being shocked?
He was a Half-Saint, and with the word ‘Saint’, that represented the strongest battle prowess in the current world.
“Very good, you have broken through. If I kill you now, it can make you feel even more hopeless,” he said balefully.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Please continue your performance.”
“Die!” Baili Tian roared as he unleashed his Saint Tool. With a slash, it was as if the heavens were about to be split into two.
Everyone was shocked. F***, a battle of Saint-level power was actually happening on a planet?
Wasn’t he afraid that innocents would be implicated?
The Crystal Saint hurriedly moved. At this time, only he could clean up the mess.
Ling Han leaped into the air. Peng!
He wasn’t thinking for the sake of the Donglin Imperial Clan. Rather, there were far too many innocent people here.
“Die!” Baili Tian gave chase. He brandished the saintly saber, and shua, shua, shua, the saber illuminated the skies.
With his current cultivation level as a Half-Saint, no matter what, he would be able to activate 30-40% of the might of this Saint Tool.
Was that still not enough?
Shua, saber light slashed out in waves, like a world-destroying God Tool.
Ling Han was filled with heroic spirit. He wanted to see just how strong his battle prowess was.
“Come!” he roared loudly, Seven Star Regulations entwined around his fists, and he took the initiative to parry the saber light.
Crazy, this was crazy!

Everyone exclaimed in shock. That was a Saint Tool, so the attack it delivered was naturally Saint-level as well, and no matter how strong Ling Han was, he was still only a Venerate, after all. How could he possibly match Saint Tier?
Fighting head-on… was he seeking death?
‘You’re far too confident.’
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, and a flash of saber light was instantly extinguished. As for him… he was completely unscathed.
‘Holy motherf*cker!’
Everyone was numb with shock, their eyes almost popping out of their heads.
‘He’s blocked it?!’
Ling Han had actually blocked the attack of a Saint Tool!
That was a genuine Saint-level attack.
Heavens!
A great many people were grabbing their heads, completely unable to believe this.
He was freakishly strong.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han shot out punches continuously, destroying the saber light that was attacking him one after another. Furthermore, he was not just defending, but was also charging towards Baili Tian.
Defense has never been his habit.
Like a hot knife through butter, he aggressively advanced.
Everyone was rendered speechless. They could only feel admiration for Ling Han’s freakish strength.
He was actually able to contend against a Saint Tool with just his bare fists. How was his strength, as compared to Baili Tian?
He was clearly stronger.
Baili Tian gritted his teeth, feeling extremely humiliated.
On the day of the wedding, it was not enough if someone caused trouble, the bride betrayed him, and in fact, he was still unable to deal with this troublemaker.
How could he endure this?
What face would the number one elite of the Golden Generation have?
He roared loudly, and the Saintly bone in his body wasstimulated, continuously pouring Saintly Particles into him, increasing his battle prowess.
Instantly, his battle prowess rose to another level, truly reaching Saint Tier.
However, it was useless.
That was because Ling Han’s battle prowess was Saint Tier in the first place. So what if you have reached Saint Tier? At most, you would only be able to match him.
However, would he be able to resist?
Ling Han used all 20 Seven Star Regulations, intertwining them into pieces, allowing him to reach the level of being able to match two Eight Star Regulations.
As for Baili Tian?

He was only a Half-Saint, and he could only use a sliver of Eight Star Regulations. Even if he used the power of his Saintly bone, that would only reach the extent of a single sliver of Eight Star Regulations.
How could a single Eight Star Regulation be able to resist two Eight Star Regulations? Though Ling Han’s “two” Eight Star Regulations had been accumulated by Seven Star Regulations.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged blows. In terms of power, Baili Tian had the upper hand, but in terms of Regulations, he was too far behind.
However, at this level, power was becoming less and less important in terms of battle prowess, and Regulations was the true power!
Ling Han had the advantage in Regulations, so he naturally had the advantage in battle prowess.
Thus, everyone saw an interesting scene.
Ling Han was sent flying back and forth, and more and more wounds appeared on Baili Tian’s body.
