chapters.title: Chapter 4598: Baili Tian was defeated
paragraphs: Chapter 4598: Baili Tian was defeated
Baili Tian… was going to lose.

Anyone could see this clearly. Baili Tian had the advantage in power, but he was completely unable to wound Ling Han. Furthermore, he was too far behind in terms of Regulations. Every time they exchanged blows, he would only be adding another wound to himself.
At this rate, a minor injury would become a major injury, and a major injury would become a serious injury.
Furthermore, what was even more frightening?
Ling Han still hadn’t activated Destructive Energy!
By now, everyone knew that Ling Han had grasped a terrifying high-level energy, and its destructive power was extremely strong.
If he used this move again, would Baili Tian immediately be defeated?
The strongest member of the Golden Generation was actually going to end up in such a miserable state?
Baili Tian roared loudly, and continuously shot out Imperial Techniques.

After reaching the level of Half-Saint, the Imperial Techniques could be used almost endlessly, and its might was also terrifyingly great. However, in front of Ling Han, this was still completely ineffective.
“You can’t even withstand a single blow!” Ling Han shook his head, and with a sweep of his palm, Regulations turned into a flash of sword light that slashed out towards Baili Tian.
Baili Tian couldn’t dodge this strike, and his chest was instantly struck, causing his body to fall.
He was severely wounded.
Ling Han was just about to follow up with another attack, when he saw Baili Chuixue quickly rush over and grab hold of Baili Tian.
This newly advanced Saint looked at Ling Han coldly, as if he wanted to see through him.

Behind him, Brother Monkey had already caught up to him. However, he did not make a move. Instead, he retracted his staff and placed it on his shoulder, showing how unreasonable and domineering he was.
“You—” Baili Chuixue showed a hint of confusion, “I seem to have seen you somewhere!”
Tsk, this was the sensing ability of a Saint.

He had indeed “seen” Ling Han before. That was in the Medicinal Garden of the Ziwei Imperial Clan. However, at the time, he had only sensed a sliver of Ling Han’s aura, and had not personally seen him. Now, the feeling of familiarity that he had was also Ling Han’s aura.

“That’s right. That day, you entered our clan to steal!” Baili Chuixue also came to his senses. He revealed a baleful killing intent, “How dare you come to our clan to steal. Today, this Saint will take your wretched dog’s life.”
The large black dog felt a pain in his chest. He had been innocently attacked.
“Haha!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly.
“Old geezer, your opponent is Grandpa Sun!” Brother Monkey waved his staff, fighting spirit soaring sky-high.
Ling Han stopped him, and said, “Brother Monkey, let me give it a try.”
He wanted to spar with a true Saint. Baili Tian was really too weak.
“Alright.” Brother Monkey nodded and put away the staff.
A look of fury spread across Baili Chuixue’s face. He was a Saint, yet he was still being challenged by others?
This was a great disrespect!
“A mere Fourth Extreme!” Baili Chuixue smirked coldly, then stretched out a hand and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Boom! A giant hand that was as large as a planet appeared, with Eight Star Regulations entwined around it. There were a total of… two!
Ling Han was unafraid, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
The fist landed on the giant hand, and the giant hand instantly crumbled. However, the fist also lost its might. It only blasted out for a short distance before crumbling.
It was a tie.

Hiss, on the Donglin Planet, those who could see all inhaled sharply, and there would always be busybodies who deliberately came into space as well. They activated their connecting devices and continued to broadcast live on the Galaxy Network.
Heavens, it was actually a tie.
Everyone was numb with shock. It should be known that this was not a Half-Saint like Baili Tian, but a real Saint.
However, Ling Han was still not inferior.
This was practically… enough to blow up the heavens.
However, the power of Saints was far too powerful. After being struck by the shockwaves, Ling Han was still sent flying hundreds of kilometers away. However, how could pure power wound him?
This wasn’t a crushing factor.
“This guy!”
“He has just broken through to Venerate Tier, and already possesses the battle prowess of a One Star Saint!”
“This is nature-defying!”
“The number one Venerate in history!”
Everyone sighed ruefully. Though Ling Han was only a One Star Venerate, he had definitely reserved the title of the strongest Venerate in history in advance.
Just ask, who could compare?
Baili Tian, who had been tossed aside by Baili Chuixue, could only sigh in admiration at this moment.
How could he compare to such battle prowess?
With the help of the Saint Tool, he could just barely match Ling Han. In terms of true battle prowess, he was far inferior to Ling Han.
However, Ling Han was only a One Star Venerate!
With such a comparison, he really did not have the slightest excuse.
The gap between them was huge, and not just by a little bit.
His hands were tightly clenched into fists, his heart filled with fury and defiance.
—At his wedding, Ling Han had forcefully appeared, and snatched away all his glory.
His newlywed wife, the glorious title of the strongest prodigy, was all gone.
All of this was because of Ling Han, which caused him to fall from the peak of his life to rock bottom all of a sudden.
No, he definitely could not accept this.
He was Baili Tian, the strongest Golden Generation. He would definitely become Emperor!
He stared fixedly at Ling Han, and a terrifying aura was spreading out from his body.
He wanted to become a true Saint as soon as possible. Then, he would battle Ling Han again and kill this opponent.
Only in this way would he be able to regain his lost confidence and pride.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han and Baili Chuixue were currently engaged in an intense battle. The two of them were equal in terms of Regulations, but in terms of power, Baili Chuixue naturally had the upper hand, and was suppressing Ling Han. However, this did not bring him any advantage.
It could only be said that Baili Chuixue was slightly on the upper hand now.
However, Ling Han still had many powerful moves that he had yet to use.
Let’s give it a try.
Ling Han shouted loudly, “Come!”
Boom, he waved his hand at Donglin Planet below, and a streak of Earth Qi immediately shot into the sky, turning into a human figure that stood beside him.

A smile appeared on his face. When he had been at the level of Sect Master, he had not been able to extract Earth Qi from such a far distance, but after advancing into Venerate Tier, he was finally able to do so.
“Humph, a mere Venerate Tier-level Earth Qi manifestation!” Baili Chuixue said disdainfully.
He had really underestimated him too much. Was Ling Han deluding himself into thinking that he could use this to stop him, or defeat him?

However, he had not even finished his words, when he saw Ling Han wave his hand again. Another streak of Earth Qi shot out, and took human form. Then, it was the third streak, the fourth streak, the fifth streak… it was increasing at an astonishing rate.
Baili Chuixue was dumbfounded. He naturally didn’t care about one Venerate, but how many were there now?

Moreover, he was certain that every Earth Qi manifestation was at the level of Nine Star Venerate Tier. Although he would definitely be able to insta-kill them in a one-on-one battle, if so many of them attacked at the same time, even he would frown.
After all, he was only a One Star Saint.
And most importantly?
This was Earth Qi. Whether they were injured or killed, what was the loss? It was good as long as they could exhaust a little of his energy.
“Haha, come fight me!” Ling Han charged over, and the 99 Earth Qi doppelgangers also followed. Each of them had the battle prowess of the fourth pinnacle level.
In this way, Baili Chuixue also felt a headache coming on.
Merely Ling Han alone was more or less capable of fighting him to a tie, what more when there were 99 top tier Venerates assisting him?

That’s right. Those below Saint Tier were all ants, but it could not be helped that there were really too many ants here. Hadn’t they heard of the saying that an abundance of ants could bite an elephant to death?
“Damn it!” Baili Chuixue cursed softly, and had no choice but to use a powerful move.
Boom, a holy flame rose up!

Baili Tian… was going to lose.
Anyone could see this clearly.
Baili Tian had the advantage in power, but he was completely unable to wound Ling Han.
Furthermore, he was too far behind in terms of Regulations.
Every time they exchanged blows, he would only be adding another wound to himself.
At this rate, a minor injury would become a major injury, and a major injury would become a serious injury.
Furthermore, what was even more frightening?
Ling Han still hadn’t activated Destructive Energy!
By now, everyone knew that Ling Han had grasped a terrifying high-level energy, and its destructive power was extremely strong.
If he used this move again, would Baili Tian immediately be defeated?
The strongest member of the Golden Generation was actually going to end up in such a miserable state?
Baili Tian roared loudly, and continuously shot out Imperial Techniques.
After reaching the level of Half-Saint, the Imperial Techniques could be used almost endlessly, and its might was also terrifyingly great.
However, in front of Ling Han, this was still completely ineffective.
“You can’t even withstand a single blow!” Ling Han shook his head, and with a sweep of his palm, Regulations turned into a flash of sword light that slashed out towards Baili Tian.
Baili Tian couldn’t dodge this strike, and his chest was instantly struck, causing his body to fall.
He was severely wounded.
Ling Han was just about to follow up with another attack, when he saw Baili Chuixue quickly rush over and grab hold of Baili Tian.
This newly advanced Saint looked at Ling Han coldly, as if he wanted to see through him.
Behind him, Brother Monkey had already caught up to him.
However, he did not make a move.
Instead, he retracted his staff and placed it on his shoulder, showing how unreasonable and domineering he was.
“You—” Baili Chuixue showed a hint of confusion, “I seem to have seen you somewhere!”
Tsk, this was the sensing ability of a Saint.
He had indeed “seen” Ling Han before.
That was in the Medicinal Garden of the Ziwei Imperial Clan.
However, at the time, he had only sensed a sliver of Ling Han’s aura, and had not personally seen him.
Now, the feeling of familiarity that he had was also Ling Han’s aura.
“That’s right.
That day, you entered our clan to steal!” Baili Chuixue also came to his senses.
He revealed a baleful killing intent, “How dare you come to our clan to steal.
Today, this Saint will take your wretched dog’s life.”
The large black dog felt a pain in his chest.
He had been innocently attacked.
“Haha!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly.
“Old geezer, your opponent is Grandpa Sun!” Brother Monkey waved his staff, fighting spirit soaring sky-high.
Ling Han stopped him, and said, “Brother Monkey, let me give it a try.”
He wanted to spar with a true Saint.
Baili Tian was really too weak.
“Alright.” Brother Monkey nodded and put away the staff.
A look of fury spread across Baili Chuixue’s face.
He was a Saint, yet he was still being challenged by others?
This was a great disrespect!
“A mere Fourth Extreme!” Baili Chuixue smirked coldly, then stretched out a hand and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Boom!
A giant hand that was as large as a planet appeared, with Eight Star Regulations entwined around it.
There were a total of… two!
Ling Han was unafraid, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
The fist landed on the giant hand, and the giant hand instantly crumbled.
However, the fist also lost its might.
It only blasted out for a short distance before crumbling.
It was a tie.
Hiss, on the Donglin Planet, those who could see all inhaled sharply, and there would always be busybodies who deliberately came into space as well.
They activated their connecting devices and continued to broadcast live on the Galaxy Network.
Heavens, it was actually a tie.
Everyone was numb with shock.
It should be known that this was not a Half-Saint like Baili Tian, but a real Saint.
However, Ling Han was still not inferior.
This was practically… enough to blow up the heavens.
However, the power of Saints was far too powerful.
After being struck by the shockwaves, Ling Han was still sent flying hundreds of kilometers away.
However, how could pure power wound him?
This wasn’t a crushing factor.
“This guy!”
“He has just broken through to Venerate Tier, and already possesses the battle prowess of a One Star Saint!”
“This is nature-defying!”
“The number one Venerate in history!”
Everyone sighed ruefully.
Though Ling Han was only a One Star Venerate, he had definitely reserved the title of the strongest Venerate in history in advance.
Just ask, who could compare?

How could he compare to such battle prowess?
With the help of the Saint Tool, he could just barely match Ling Han.
In terms of true battle prowess, he was far inferior to Ling Han.
However, Ling Han was only a One Star Venerate!
With such a comparison, he really did not have the slightest excuse.
The gap between them was huge, and not just by a little bit.

All of this was because of Ling Han, which caused him to fall from the peak of his life to rock bottom all of a sudden.
No, he definitely could not accept this.

chapters.title: Chapter 4599: Four Extremes Support the Skies
paragraphs: Chapter 4599: Four Extremes Support the Skies
The holy flame was the foundation of a Saint, and it was also the most powerful weapon of a Saint.

However, the holy flame was usually stored in one’s mind, and was used to illuminate Regulations. Once it was used, its might would be great, but it also had a fatal disadvantage, and that was it would cause the holy flame to be exhausted.
Thus, unless they encountered a powerful opponent, what Saint would be willing to use the holy flame?
Now that Baili Chuixue had used the holy flame, it was clear just how far Ling Han had forced him to!

It couldn’t be helped. If news spread that even a Saint was unable to deal with a Venerate head-on, he would definitely become the most cowardly Saint in history, and go down in the annals of history—of course, it would be a negative image.

Boom, his holy flame was only the size of a pinky. It was blazing white in colour, and was clearly like a dying candle in the wind, as if it would be extinguished at the slightest blow, yet gave off an incredibly terrifying pressure.
In essence, the holy flame was actually not a real flame, but rather a manifestation of energy and Regulations.
Thus, this holy flame didn’t exude any heat at all. Instead, it was ice-cold and baleful.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He was still unafraid, and continued to charge over with the 99 Earth Qi clones.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

After summoning the holy flame, Baili Chuixue’s destructive power increased exponentially. A sliver of his might could destroy a single Earth Qi embodiment. However, there were really too many embodiments of Earth Qi.
If you destroyed one, so be it. With a single thought, Ling Han could summon a new one.
This made Baili Chuixue too sullen.
He only had invincible battle prowess, but he couldn’t hit the main target at all. How could he not become more and more anxious as the battle progressed?

It should be known that every time the holy flame was used, a little bit would be used up. Though it was enough to support him in battle for a few years, how could he endure the fact that he had to expend the holy flame when he had just advanced into Saint Tier?

He was stuck in a dilemma. On the one hand, for the sake of his pride, he definitely had to kill Ling Han. At the very least, he had to defeat this opponent, but on the other hand, he did not want to expend too much of the holy flame. This was naturally a contradiction.
Everyone saw Baili Chuixue’s expression, and they all sighed in their hearts.
As a Saint, he had actually been forced into such an awkward situation.
Who else could do that in this world?
Only Ling Han could!
Ling Han could no longer be regarded as a Venerate. This was a Saint. Cultivation level was not applicable to him, and only his strength could be the main consideration.
With this in mind, it was understandable that Baili Chuixue couldn’t defeat Ling Han.
However, Baili Chuixue didn’t think so. He didn’t want to become Ling Han’s stepping stone.
Oh, you will go down in history with a single battle, and become the greatest glory of all eternity, while I will become a pitiful footnote?
No way!
Baili Chuixue shouted loudly, and the Regulations transformed into a long river that shot towards Ling Han.

However, the 99 Earth Qi manifestations could all act as Ling Han’s human shields. In any case, they were all top-notch Venerates, so if one of them couldn’t block a single strike from a Saint, then what about two or even ten?
No matter what Baili Chuixue did, he couldn’t suppress Ling Han at all.
Ling Han laughed loudly. Destructive Energy channelled, and he was also getting serious.
‘Come!’
He charged over, and the Destructive Energy surged around him. Whatever Regulations attacked the Destructive Energy would be melted.
After advancing into the Venerate Tier, the destructive power of Destructive Energy was further unleashed, becoming even more terrifying.
How could Ling Han block such an attack?
Baili Chuixue refused to give up, and clashed head-on with Ling Han.
Peng, though Ling Han was sent flying, a wound had also been left on Baili Chuixue’s hand, and it was still continuously widening.
Baili Chuixue channeled the power of Saint Tier, yet he couldn’t control his injury at all. He could only cut his losses and directly sever this wounded hand. Only then did his injury stop spreading.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. How could there be such a terrifying high-level energy?
That kind of destructive power was completely unreasonable. His saintly power was completely ineffective against this kind of high-level energy.
This was too terrifying.
“The holy flame illuminates the world and freezes it!” Baili Chuixue shouted loudly. As the holy flame flickered, endless coldness spread out, and the already cold space instantly became even colder.
This was the might of the holy flame.
Ling Han felt as if his body had become stiff, and his blood had congealed. He couldn’t move a single muscle.
“Humph, this is the true ability of a Saint!” Baili Chuixue said balefully.
So what if you are even stronger than this?
This was the suppression of Regulations.

Ling Han could summon the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and he could also use the Destructive Energy to engulf this coldness. However, with a thought, four pillars of extreme power suddenly materialized around him.
Weng, on the extreme pillars, every seal lit up.
The chill instantly disappeared, and Ling Han regained his mobility.

“What!” Baili Chuixue almost threw up blood. It should be known that unleashing this move had caused him to expend an extremely large amount of the holy flame, yet it was actually easily resolved by Ling Han. This naturally made him extremely depressed.
However, the Four Extremes were actually capable of dispersing the might of the holy flame?
Wasn’t this a joke?
It should be known that this was a suppression of a whole level.
“That’s Ling Han’s Four Extremes!”
“Yi, why do they seem to be four stone pillars?”
“That’s right. Shouldn’t the Four Extremes be formed from Regulations? They should look like multiple pillars of light, though the color would be slightly different.”

“I’ve heard that some Celestial medicines can improve the quality of the Four Extremes, and bestow some special Mystical Powers on the Four Extremes. However, such pillars of Fourth Extreme are completely unheard of.”
“They look very ordinary, like four stone pillars, but why do they have an indescribably ancient aura?”
“Also, also, what do those four seals mean?”
“That’s right. There should be circles on the four pinnacle pillars, and the number of circles reflect the number of stars of Venerate Tier. What does this seal mean?”
“Could it be that his seals are equivalent to the circles of other Venerates?”
Everyone cried out one after another. Ling Han was indeed different from the rest. No wonder this guy was so freakish.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s eyes were slightly closed, and he was currently experiencing it.
The Four Extremes spread out, forming an area that he had absolute control over.
Thus, so what if the might of the holy flame was powerful? It could not affect him at all!
This was too shocking. The Mystical Power formed by a Venerate was actually capable of standing against a Saint!
“Come fight me again!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged towards Baili Chuixue.
He tried to expand the Fourth Extreme to a greater extent, but he immediately reached his limit.
—It could only open up a space of thirty meters square.
There was nothing he could do about this. After all, he was facing a Saint. This was a suppression from a superior level.
This was enough.
Ling Han threw a flurry of punches. Without the threat of the holy flame, what did he have to fear from Baili Chuixue?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Baili Chuixue clashed with Ling Han, but he couldn’t suppress Ling Han at all. Instead, he would be injured by Destructive Energy.
The longer they fought, the more serious his injuries became.
Saints could indeed regrow severed limbs, but did they not need to pay a price for doing so?
After so many times, even a Saint couldn’t bear it any longer.

“Ah!” This new Saint released a great roar towards the sky, and no longer hesitated. He stretched out a hand, and grabbed Baili Tian and the members of the Ziwei Imperial Clan. He tore a rip into space and left.
Since he was no match, he could only flee.
Ling Han didn’t give chase. He was only slightly stronger than Baili Chuixue, and didn’t have a crushing advantage.
Moreover, the Ziwei Imperial Clan wouldn’t disappear!

chapters.title: Chapter 4600: Snatching the bride
paragraphs: Chapter 4600: Snatching the bride
Ling Han stood proudly in space.
Beneath him, everyone could only look up at him.
At this moment, even a Saint would be moved and impressed.
As a Venerate, he had scared off a Saint!
Just ask the world, was there a second person that could do it?
There was definitely none.
This was unprecedented, and it was also possible that it would never happen again!
“Hahaha, come down and take a seat!” The Crystal Saint, laughed loudly, and waved his hand at Ling Han.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey both flew down, and stood beside the Crystal Saint.
They already had Saint-level battle prowess, so even though there were still differences in strength among Saints, it no longer affected their standing on the same level.
Without becoming a Saint, he would still be an ant in the end. Now, both Ling Han and Brother Monkey were qualified to stand above all life.

The Crystal Saint sighed internally. When they had first met, Ling Han hadn’t even been worthy of a second glance from him. However, only a few hundred years had passed, and Ling Han was already standing on the same level as him.
And it should be known that Ling Han was only a Venerate!
Was it easier for Venerates to advance by one star, or was it easier for Saints to advance by one star?
Of course, it was the former.
Thus, it was possible that before he had even advanced into five stars, Ling Han would already be a nine-star Venerate.
With how freakish Ling Han was, he would probably be able to compete with Four-Star or Five-Star Saints by then.
This was practically a legend.
The others were also rendered speechless. A great many female cultivators were so excited that they wanted to throw themselves into Ling Han’s arms.

At that time, Ling Han had said that he would personally come to the Donglin Imperial Clan to pick Chi Menghan up. At that time, most people had thought that this was a joke, an arrogant boast that came from overestimation of himself.
What right do you have?

Being eternally trapped at Sect Master-level, he was already a “cripple”, and even if Ling Han could advance into the Venerate Tier, with the wealth of the Donglin and Ziwei Imperial Clans, how could they allow Ling Han to act wantonly?
Unexpectedly, Ling Han managed to do so.
What woman wouldn’t be moved by such a heroic and affectionate person?

“Friends, please come to the ancestral grounds for a chat.” The Crystal Saint invited them earnestly. There were really too many outsiders here, so it was not appropriate for them to speak in too much detail.
Ling Han smiled, shook his head and said, “I just broke through, and still have a lot of matters to attend to, so it’s best that I don’t go in. Whatever Friend Crystal has to say, just say it.”
Friend Crystal!
This caused everyone’s hearts to tremble when they heard this. This was an address from an equal.

Even though they already knew that Ling Han possessed the battle prowess of a Saint, they still found it difficult to accept the fact that they had witnessed him chatting and laughing with a Saint with their own eyes.

Ling Han naturally refused. What a joke. If one wanted to enter into the ancestral grounds of the Donglin Imperial Clan, they would definitely have to enter into the Great Emperor Formation, and if they entered into the Great Emperor Formation, wouldn’t they still be on the chopping block?

Hehe, he would rather believe that a sow would climb a tree!

He wasn’t a hot-blooded young man who would be easily provoked.
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey didn’t say anything. He wasn’t good at this, but if it was a fight, he would pick up his staff and fight.

“Friend Ling, after what you’ve done today, how will Menghan be able to face others in the future?” There was grief on his face, and he continued, “You have to bear this responsibility.”
Ling Han smiled, “No problem.”

The Crystal Saint nodded in satisfaction, and said, “Menghan is the most outstanding successor of our Donglin Imperial Clan. To have her marry out of the clan, I’m also reluctant. Thus, Friend Ling’s betrothal gift must be extremely sincere.”
F***, you are really realistic.
Ling Han asked, “What betrothal gift does the Donglin Imperial Clan want?”
The Crystal Saint made an exorbitant demand, saying, “First, an Imperial Scroll.”
He explained, “If Menghan marries you, it would be equivalent to marrying the Imperial Scroll of our Clan. Of course, you would have to bring out the corresponding amount.”
“Secondly, three Imperial Techniques, Technique, of which one must be Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.”
“Thirdly, the Spirit Diagram of the black high-level energy that you have grasped needs to be handed over to us.”
The Crystal Saint t made three requests, and this was still the majority. There were innumerable other requests like Celestial medicines and Saintly Material.
“Friend Ling, what do you think?”
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “I have a better betrothal gift.”
“Oh, what?” The Crystal Saint was slightly surprised. There was actually something more valuable than this?
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’ll gift you a son of a Great Emperor!”
The Crystal Saint faltered for a moment before flushing.
‘F*ck! You b*stard! You’re so stingy, yet you want to make Donglin Imperial Clan’s daughter pregnant?’
“Friend Ling, you’ve gone too far!” he said in displeasure.

Ling Han didn’t pay any more attention to the Crystal Saint. Instead, he looked at Chi Menghan and said, “I already said that I want to take you away from the Donglin Imperial Clan. However, I still haven’t asked you whether you’re willing or not.”
Chi Menghan immediately nodded, “I am!”
“All right, then I’ll continue to snatch the bride!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged out, rapidly rushing towards Chi Menghan.
“Brat, you dare?!” The Crystal Saint’s face instantly twisted in anger. This brat was far too audacious! He actually dared to snatch the bride right in front of him!
However, he had just moved, when he saw that Brother Monkey had already smashed his staff towards him.
They were both Saints, so the Crystal Saint didn’t dare to let his guard down.
He could only parry.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two of them battled fiercely. Brother Monkey was only a One Star Saint. Even if his natural talent was astonishing, that would only be comparable to the battle prowess of a Two Star Saint, at most. However, the Crystal Saint was a Four Star Saint, and the gulf between them was not just a little bit.

It wasn’t long before Brother Monkey fell into a disadvantage. However, this was the Donglin Planet, so the Crystal Saint naturally had to be careful when he attacked. Thus, he couldn’t do anything to Brother Monkey at this moment.
Ling Han had already reached Chi Menghan. With another wave of his hand, he grabbed the large black dog and little azure dragon as well.
“Brother Monkey, let’s go.”𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
He tore a rip into space, and directly left.
Brother Monkey bared his teeth in a grin. With a wave of his staff, he too left.
If a Saint wanted to flee, there was practically no one in this world that could stop him, even if it was a one-star Saint against a nine-star Saint.

Thus, Saints enjoyed a transcendent status. No force would be willing to offend a Saint. After all, they couldn’t kill him and if they had to eep an eye on him all day long, any force would feel a headache coming on.

The Crystal Saint didn’t give chase. Instead, he used his divine sense to transmit a message, saying, “Ancestor Ming, why don’t you let me unleash my full strength? Moreover, if you attack, none of them will be able to escape!”
The so-called Ancestor Ming was another Saint of the Donglin Imperial Clan. He was also a true pillar of support.
A Nine-Star Saint, Chi Taiming.
Chi Taiming’s divine sense transmitted a message intohis mind, and said, “Heh, this brat is loyal and faithful. As long as Chi Menghan follows him, he’ll be inextricably linked to our clan.”
